```css
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BLOG — Premium Editorial Design
   Version: 3.0 — Token-based, no hardcoded colors
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── Reading Progress ── */
.reading-progress {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  z-index: 9999;
  background: transparent;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.reading-progress-bar {
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent-2),
    var(--accent),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, #000)
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow);
  transition: width 0.1s ease-out;
  border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
}

/* ── Back Home ── */
.blog-back-home {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-decoration: none;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: all 0.3s var(--ease-out);
}

.blog-back-home:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
  transform: translateX(-4px);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LAYOUT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.blog-page,
.blog-post-page {
  padding: 140px 0 100px;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.blog-header {
  margin-bottom: 48px;
  max-width: 720px;
}

.blog-header h1 {
  margin: 16px 0 20px;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.2rem);
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.blog-header p {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TAGS FILTER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.blog-tags-filter {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  padding-bottom: 32px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-tags-label {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.blog-tags-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.blog-tag-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: inherit;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 999px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.25s var(--ease-out);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.blog-tag-chip:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
}

.blog-tag-chip.active {
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent));
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent),
    0 4px 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

.blog-tag-chip:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FEATURED POST
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.blog-featured-card {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
  padding: 48px;
  border-radius: 28px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  overflow: hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      var(--accent-tint) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) 100%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 50%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent);
  transition:
    transform 0.4s var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 0.4s ease;
}

.blog-featured-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 24px 48px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

.blog-featured-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent));
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
}

.blog-featured-content h2 {
  margin: 12px 0 16px;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.2rem);
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.blog-featured-card:hover h2 {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.blog-featured-content p {
  margin: 0 0 24px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  max-width: 600px;
}

.blog-featured-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent);
  transition: gap 0.3s ease;
}

.blog-featured-card:hover .blog-featured-cta {
  gap: 14px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GRID & CARDS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.blog-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
  gap: 28px;
}

.blog-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 28px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 40%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  transition:
    transform 0.4s var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 0.4s ease,
    border-color 0.3s ease;
}

.blog-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 24px 48px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent);
}

.blog-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.blog-card-reading::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-left: 12px;
  margin-right: 12px;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.blog-card-title {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.blog-card:hover .blog-card-title {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.blog-card-excerpt {
  margin: 0 0 24px;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  flex: 1;
}

.blog-card-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-card-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.blog-card-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.blog-card-arrow {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: var(--accent);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.blog-card:hover .blog-card-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
}

.blog-empty {
  padding: 80px 20px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BLOG POST PAGE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.blog-post-container {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.blog-back-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.blog-back-link:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.blog-post-header {
  margin-bottom: 48px;
  padding-bottom: 40px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-post-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.blog-post-header h1 {
  margin: 0 0 24px;
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.6rem);
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.blog-post-excerpt {
  margin: 0 0 24px;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.blog-post-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* ── Content typography ── */
.blog-post-content {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.blog-post-content h2 {
  margin: 48px 0 20px;
  font-size: 1.65rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
  scroll-margin-top: 100px;
}

.blog-post-content h3 {
  margin: 36px 0 16px;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--ink);
  scroll-margin-top: 100px;
}

.blog-post-content p {
  margin: 0 0 22px;
}

.blog-post-content ul,
.blog-post-content ol {
  margin: 0 0 24px;
  padding-right: 24px;
}

.blog-post-content li {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.blog-post-content blockquote {
  margin: 32px 0;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  border-right: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 4px 16px 16px 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent-tint) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-tint) 40%, transparent) 100%
  );
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.blog-post-content blockquote p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.blog-post-content code {
  padding: 2px 8px;
  font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace;
  font-size: 0.9em;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink);
  border-radius: 6px;
  direction: ltr;
  display: inline-block;
}

.blog-post-content pre {
  margin: 28px 0;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  background: var(--ink);
  border-radius: 16px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  direction: ltr;
  text-align: left;
}

.blog-post-content pre code {
  background: none;
  padding: 0;
  color: var(--paper);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  display: block;
}

.blog-post-content hr {
  margin: 48px 0;
  border: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-post-content strong {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.blog-post-content a {
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}

.blog-post-content table {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 28px 0;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.blog-post-content th {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.blog-post-content td {
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TOC
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.toc-inline {
  margin: 32px 0;
  padding: 20px 24px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.toc-inline summary {
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  list-style: none;
}

.toc-inline summary::before {
  content: "فهرست مطالب";
}

.toc-inline nav {
  margin-top: 16px;
}

.toc-inline ul {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.toc-inline li {
  margin: 8px 0;
}

.toc-inline li a {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.toc-inline li a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.toc-inline .toc-level-3 {
  padding-right: 16px;
}

.toc-sidebar {
  display: none;
}

@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  .toc-sidebar {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    top: 120px;
    left: calc((100vw - 720px) / 2 + 720px + 60px);
    width: 240px;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 160px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 50%, transparent);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .toc-sidebar-label {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink-3);
  }

  .toc-sidebar nav ul {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
  }

  .toc-sidebar li {
    margin: 6px 0;
  }

  .toc-sidebar li a {
    display: block;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--ink-2);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-left: 2px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
    transition: all 0.25s ease;
  }

  .toc-sidebar li a:hover {
    color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-tint);
  }

  .toc-sidebar li.is-active a {
    color: var(--accent);
    font-weight: 600;
    border-left-color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-tint);
  }

  .toc-sidebar .toc-level-3 {
    padding-right: 12px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RELATED POSTS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.blog-related {
  margin-top: 80px;
  padding-top: 48px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-related-title {
  margin: 0 0 32px;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.blog-related-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
}

.blog-related-card {
  display: block;
  padding: 24px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.blog-related-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
}

.blog-related-card h4 {
  margin: 12px 0 10px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--ink);
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.blog-related-card:hover h4 {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.blog-related-card p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.blog-post-footer {
  margin-top: 64px;
  padding-top: 48px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-post-cta {
  padding: 32px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent-tint) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-tint) 40%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-cta p {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SKELETON LOADING
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.blog-back-home-skeleton,
.skeleton-line {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--paper-2) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, var(--line)) 50%,
    var(--paper-2) 100%
  );
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  border-radius: 8px;
  animation: skeleton-shimmer 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.blog-back-home-skeleton {
  width: 160px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}

.blog-header-skeleton {
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.skeleton-line {
  height: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.skeleton-line-sm {
  width: 80px;
  height: 12px;
}

.skeleton-line-md {
  width: 60%;
}

.skeleton-line-lg {
  width: 90%;
  height: 28px;
}

.blog-card-skeleton {
  padding: 28px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

@keyframes skeleton-shimmer {
  0% {
    background-position: 200% 0;
  }
  100% {
    background-position: -200% 0;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — TABLET (max-width: 900px)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .blog-page,
  .blog-post-page {
    padding: 120px 0 80px;
  }

  .blog-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
    gap: 22px;
  }

  .blog-featured-card {
    padding: 40px 32px;
    border-radius: 24px;
  }

  .blog-featured-content h2 {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }

  .blog-related-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — MOBILE (max-width: 720px)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .blog-page,
  .blog-post-page {
    padding: 100px 16px 100px;
  }

  .blog-back-home {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
  }

  .blog-header {
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }

  .blog-header h1 {
    font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 7vw, 2rem);
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin: 10px 0 14px;
  }

  .blog-header p {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .blog-tags-filter {
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 20px;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .blog-tags-label {
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }

  .blog-tags-list {
    gap: 6px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    padding-bottom: 6px;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: var(--accent) transparent;
  }

  .blog-tags-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 3px;
  }

  .blog-tags-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: var(--accent);
    border-radius: 3px;
  }

  .blog-tag-chip {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding: 7px 13px;
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .blog-featured-card {
    padding: 24px 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .blog-featured-badge {
    padding: 4px 11px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .blog-featured-content h2 {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    line-height: 1.35;
    margin: 8px 0 10px;
  }

  .blog-featured-content p {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .blog-featured-cta {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
  }

  .blog-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .blog-card {
    padding: 20px 18px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .blog-card-meta {
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .blog-card-reading::before {
    margin-left: 6px;
    margin-right: 6px;
  }

  .blog-card-title {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .blog-card-excerpt {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .blog-card-footer {
    padding-top: 12px;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .blog-card-tag {
    padding: 3px 8px;
    font-size: 0.64rem;
  }

  .blog-card-arrow {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
  }

  .blog-post-container {
    max-width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
  }

  .blog-back-link {
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  .blog-post-header {
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    padding-bottom: 22px;
  }

  .blog-post-meta {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .blog-post-header h1 {
    font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 6vw, 1.75rem);
    line-height: 1.25;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .blog-post-excerpt {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .blog-post-content {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  .blog-post-content h2 {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
    margin: 32px 0 14px;
  }

  .blog-post-content h3 {
    font-size: 1.08rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin: 26px 0 12px;
  }

  .blog-post-content p {
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .blog-post-content ul,
  .blog-post-content ol {
    padding-right: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .blog-post-content li {
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .blog-post-content blockquote {
    padding: 14px 18px;
    margin: 22px 0;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    border-radius: 4px 12px 12px 4px;
  }

  .blog-post-content pre {
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin: 18px 0;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content code {
    padding: 2px 6px;
    font-size: 0.85em;
  }

  .blog-post-content table {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    margin: 18px 0;
  }

  .blog-post-content th,
  .blog-post-content td {
    padding: 9px 10px;
  }

  .toc-inline {
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin: 20px 0;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .toc-inline summary {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
  }

  .toc-inline li a {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
  }

  .blog-related {
    margin-top: 40px;
    padding-top: 28px;
  }

  .blog-related-title {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .blog-related-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .blog-related-card {
    padding: 16px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .blog-related-card h4 {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    margin: 6px 0 6px;
  }

  .blog-related-card p {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }

  .blog-post-footer {
    margin-top: 40px;
    padding-top: 28px;
  }

  .blog-post-cta {
    padding: 22px 18px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .blog-post-cta p {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .blog-post-cta .button {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .blog-card-skeleton {
    padding: 20px 18px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .skeleton-line-lg {
    height: 22px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — SMALL MOBILE (max-width: 420px)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .blog-page,
  .blog-post-page {
    padding: 90px 14px 90px;
  }

  .blog-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }

  .blog-featured-card {
    padding: 20px 16px;
  }

  .blog-featured-content h2 {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
  }

  .blog-card {
    padding: 16px 14px;
  }

  .blog-card-title {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .blog-post-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.3rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content h2 {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content h3 {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .blog-card,
  .blog-featured-card,
  .blog-related-card,
  .blog-back-home,
  .blog-tag-chip {
    transition: none;
  }

  .reading-progress-bar,
  .skeleton-line,
  .blog-back-home-skeleton {
    animation: none;
  }
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LEAD FUNNEL — Author Box + End CTA
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ─── AUTHOR BOX ─── */
.blog-author {
  margin-top: 56px;
  padding: 24px 26px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-author-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.blog-author-mark {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 800;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
    0 4px 12px -4px var(--accent-glow);
}

.blog-author-meta {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.blog-author-name {
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.blog-author-role {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.blog-author-bio {
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.blog-author-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.blog-author-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding-inline: 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  transition:
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-author-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.blog-author-btn--primary {
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0a0908 0%, #211c18 55%, #0a0908 100%);
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    0 6px 16px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.35);
}

.blog-author-btn--primary:hover {
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%);
  border-color: transparent;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-author-btn--primary {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%);
}

/* ─── END CTA (LEAD FUNNEL) ─── */
.blog-funnel {
  margin-top: 64px;
  padding: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px) clamp(24px, 4vw, 48px);
  border-radius: 24px;
  text-align: center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 80% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 80%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.blog-funnel::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -40%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 60%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.blog-funnel-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
  position: relative;
}

.blog-funnel-title {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
  position: relative;
}

.blog-funnel-title em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.blog-funnel-text {
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0 auto 28px;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
  position: relative;
}

.blog-funnel-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  position: relative;
}

.blog-funnel-trust {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: clamp(20px, 4vw, 44px);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 24px 0 0;
  list-style: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  position: relative;
}

.blog-funnel-trust-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.blog-funnel-trust-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.blog-funnel-trust-label {
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

/* ─── Remove old footer/CTA (deprecated) ─── */
.blog-post-footer {
  display: none;
}

.blog-post-cta {
  display: none;
}

/* ─── Responsive ─── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .blog-author {
    margin-top: 40px;
    padding: 20px 18px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .blog-author-mark {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    font-size: 15px;
  }

  .blog-author-name {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }

  .blog-author-bio {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }

  .blog-author-btn {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 42px;
  }

  .blog-funnel {
    margin-top: 44px;
    padding: 32px 20px;
    border-radius: 20px;
  }

  .blog-funnel-title {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    line-height: 1.35;
  }

  .blog-funnel-text {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    margin-bottom: 22px;
  }

  .blog-funnel-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .blog-funnel-actions .button {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .blog-funnel-trust {
    gap: 18px;
    padding-top: 20px;
  }

  .blog-funnel-trust-value {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }

  .blog-funnel-trust-label {
    font-size: 0.625rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .blog-author-btn {
    transition: none;
  }
}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   INLINE CTA — mid-article lead capture
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.blog-inline-cta {
  margin: 48px 0;
  padding: 28px 26px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  text-align: center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 80% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 80%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.blog-inline-cta::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -30%;
  inset-inline-end: -15%;
  width: 50%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.blog-inline-cta-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
  position: relative;
}

.blog-inline-cta-title {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
  position: relative;
}

.blog-inline-cta-title em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.blog-inline-cta-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  position: relative;
}

.blog-inline-cta-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  min-height: 42px;
  padding-inline: 20px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  transition:
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-inline-cta-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.blog-inline-cta-btn--primary {
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0a0908 0%, #211c18 55%, #0a0908 100%);
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    0 6px 16px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.35);
}

.blog-inline-cta-btn--primary:hover {
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%);
  border-color: transparent;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-inline-cta-btn--primary {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%);
}

/* ─── Responsive ─── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .blog-inline-cta {
    margin: 32px 0;
    padding: 22px 18px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .blog-inline-cta-title {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .blog-inline-cta-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .blog-inline-cta-btn {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 46px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .blog-inline-cta-btn {
    transition: none;
  }
  .blog-inline-cta-btn:hover {
    transform: none;
  }
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { getAllPosts, getAllTags } from "@/lib/blog";
import { getBlogIndexSchema } from "@/lib/schema";
import BlogList from "@/components/BlogList";
import "@/styles/blog-index-ultimate.css";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "بلاگ | امیرحسین شرکائی",
  description: "مقالات امیرحسین شرکائی درباره طراحی وب، توسعه فرانت‌اند، UI/UX و هوش مصنوعی.",
  alternates: { canonical: "/blog" },
};

export default function BlogPage() {
  const posts = getAllPosts();
  const tags = getAllTags();
  const blogSchema = getBlogIndexSchema(posts.map((p) => ({ slug: p.slug, title: p.title, date: p.date })));

  return (
    <main id="main">
      <script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(blogSchema) }} />
      <header className="blog-index-header">
        <h1 className="blog-index-title">مجله و مقالات</h1>
        <p className="blog-index-subtitle">یادداشت‌ها و تجربه‌های من درباره طراحی وب، توسعه، هوش مصنوعی و رشد کسب‌وکار.</p>
      </header>
      <div className="container">
        <BlogList posts={posts} tags={tags} />
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Metadata } from "next";
import Link from "next/link";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { getPostBySlug, getAllPosts, getRelatedPosts } from "@/lib/blog";
import { getBlogPostSchema } from "@/lib/schema";
import MarkdownContent from "@/components/MarkdownContent";
import ReadingProgress from "@/components/ui/ReadingProgress";
import TableOfContents from "@/components/blog/TableOfContents";
import AIActions from "@/components/blog/AIActions";
import BlogComments from "@/components/blog/BlogComments";
import BlogShare from "@/components/BlogShare";
import BlogAuthorBox from "@/components/BlogAuthorBox";
import BlogPrevNext from "@/components/BlogPrevNext";
import BlogEndCTA from "@/components/BlogEndCTA";
import BlogInlineCTA from "@/components/BlogInlineCTA";

type Props = {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>;
};

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Props): Promise<Metadata> {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const post = getPostBySlug(resolvedParams.slug);
  
  if (!post) return { title: "یافت نشد" };
  
  return {
    title: post.title,
    description: post.excerpt,
    alternates: { canonical: `https://shorakaei.ir/blog/${post.slug}` },
    openGraph: {
      title: post.title,
      description: post.excerpt,
      url: `https://shorakaei.ir/blog/${post.slug}`,
      type: "article",
      publishedTime: post.date,
    },
  };
}

export function generateStaticParams() {
  return getAllPosts().map((post) => ({ slug: post.slug }));
}

export default async function BlogPostPage({ params }: Props) {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const post = getPostBySlug(resolvedParams.slug);
  
  if (!post) notFound();

  const articleSchema = getBlogPostSchema({
    title: post.title,
    excerpt: post.excerpt,
    date: post.date,
    slug: post.slug,
  });

  const relatedPosts = getRelatedPosts(post.slug, post.tags, 3);
  const breadcrumbSchema = {
    "@context": "https://schema.org",
    "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
    itemListElement: [
      { "@type": "ListItem", position: 1, name: "خانه", item: "https://shorakaei.ir" },
      { "@type": "ListItem", position: 2, name: "بلاگ", item: "https://shorakaei.ir/blog" },
      { "@type": "ListItem", position: 3, name: post.title, item: `https://shorakaei.ir/blog/${post.slug}` },
    ],
  };

  return (
    <>
      <ReadingProgress />
      <script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(articleSchema) }} />
      <script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: JSON.stringify(breadcrumbSchema) }} />
      
      <main className="blog-post">
        <div className="container">
          
          <header className="blog-post-header">
            <span className="blog-post-category">{post.category}</span>
            <h1 className="blog-post-title">{post.title}</h1>
            <p className="blog-post-excerpt">{post.excerpt}</p>
            <div className="blog-post-meta">
              <span>{post.dateFormatted}</span>
              <span>·</span>
              <span>{post.readingTime} دقیقه مطالعه</span>
            </div>
          </header>

          <div className="blog-post-layout">
            <article className="blog-post-content">
              <MarkdownContent content={post.content || ""} />
              
              <AIActions title={post.title} slug={post.slug} />
              
              <BlogInlineCTA />
              <BlogShare title={post.title} />
              <BlogAuthorBox />
              <BlogEndCTA />
              
              <BlogComments serverURL="https://shorakaei-comments.vercel.app" path={`/blog/${post.slug}`} />
            </article>
            
            {post.toc && post.toc.length > 0 && (
              <aside className="blog-post-sidebar">
                <TableOfContents items={post.toc} />
              </aside>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Related Posts */}
          {relatedPosts.length > 0 && (
            <section className="related-posts-section" style={{ marginTop: "5rem", paddingTop: "3rem", borderTop: "1px solid var(--line-strong)" }}>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: "1.5rem", marginBottom: "2rem", color: "var(--ink)" }}>مقالات مرتبط</h2>
              <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr))", gap: "1.5rem" }}>
                {relatedPosts.map((related) => (
                  <Link key={related.slug} href={`/blog/${related.slug}`} className="related-post-card" style={{ padding: "1.5rem", background: "var(--surface)", borderRadius: "16px", border: "1px solid var(--line-strong)", display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "0.5rem" }}>
                    <span style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-mono)", fontSize: "0.75rem", color: "var(--accent)" }}>{related.category}</span>
                    <h3 style={{ fontSize: "1.1rem", color: "var(--ink)", lineHeight: 1.4 }}>{related.title}</h3>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: "0.85rem", color: "var(--ink-3)" }}>{related.dateFormatted}</span>
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}
          <BlogPrevNext currentSlug={post.slug} />

        </div>
      </main>
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

export default function AIActions({ title, slug }: { title: string; slug: string }) {
  const url = `https://shorakaei.ir/blog/${slug}`;
  const prompt = encodeURIComponent(`Please read and summarize this article: "${title}" at ${url}`);
  
  return (
    <div className="blog-actions">
      <a
        href={`https://chat.openai.com/?q=${prompt}`}
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
        className="action-btn"
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true">🤖</span> Read with ChatGPT
      </a>
      <a
        href={`https://claude.ai/new?q=${prompt}`}
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
        className="action-btn"
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true">🧠</span> Read with Claude
      </a>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## FILE: src\components\blog\BlogComments.tsx
```tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import Image from "next/image";

type Comment = {
  objectId: string;
  nick: string;
  comment: string;
  created: string;
  avatar?: string;
};

export default function BlogComments({ serverURL, path }: { serverURL: string; path: string }) {
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ nick: "", mail: "", link: "", comment: "" });
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "loading" | "success" | "error">("idle");
  const [message, setMessage] = useState("");
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<Comment[]>([]);
  const [loadingComments, setLoadingComments] = useState(true);

  // Fetch comments on load
  const fetchComments = async () => {
    setLoadingComments(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${serverURL}/api/comment?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}&type=recent&pageSize=50`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) {
        // Filter only approved (status = 'approved')
        const approved = data.data.filter((c: any) => c.status === "approved");
        setComments(approved);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch comments:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingComments(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchComments();
  }, [path]);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setStatus("loading");
    setMessage("");

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${serverURL}/api/comment`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...formData,
          url: path,
          ua: navigator.userAgent,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok || data.errno !== 0) {
        throw new Error(data.errmsg || "خطایی در ثبت دیدگاه رخ داد.");
      }

      setStatus("success");
      setMessage("دیدگاه شما با موفقیت ثبت شد و پس از تایید نمایش داده می‌شود.");
      setFormData({ nick: "", mail: "", link: "", comment: "" });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatus("error");
      setMessage(err.message || "خطایی رخ داد. لطفاً دوباره تلاش کنید.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="waline-wrapper">
      <h2 className="waline-header-title">گفتگو و دیدگاه‌ها</h2>
      
      {/* Form */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="custom-comment-form">
        
        <div className="form-row">
          <div className="input-group">
            <input
              type="text"
              id="nick"
              placeholder=" "
              value={formData.nick}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, nick: e.target.value })}
              required
            />
            <label htmlFor="nick">نام شما</label>
          </div>

          <div className="input-group">
            <input
              type="email"
              id="mail"
              placeholder=" "
              value={formData.mail}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, mail: e.target.value })}
            />
            <label htmlFor="mail">ایمیل شما (اختیاری)</label>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="input-group">
          <input
            type="url"
            id="link"
            placeholder=" "
            value={formData.link}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, link: e.target.value })}
          />
          <label htmlFor="link">وب‌سایت شما (اختیاری)</label>
        </div>

        <div className="input-group">
          <textarea
            id="comment"
            placeholder=" "
            value={formData.comment}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, comment: e.target.value })}
            required
          />
          <label htmlFor="comment">دیدگاه خود را اینجا بنویسید...</label>
        </div>

        {message && (
          <div className={`form-message ${status === "success" ? "success" : "error"}`}>
            {message}
          </div>
        )}

        <button type="submit" disabled={status === "loading"} className="custom-submit-btn">
          {status === "loading" ? "در حال ثبت..." : "ثبت دیدگاه"}
        </button>
      </form>

      {/* Comments List */}
      <div className="comments-list-wrapper">
        <h3 className="comments-list-title">دیدگاه‌های ثبت شده</h3>
        
        {loadingComments ? (
          <p className="comments-loading">در حال بارگذاری دیدگاه‌ها...</p>
        ) : comments.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="comments-empty">هنوز دیدگاهی ثبت نشده. اولین نفر باشید!</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="comments-list">
            {comments.map((comment) => (
              <div key={comment.objectId} className="comment-card">
                <div className="comment-header">
                  <div className="comment-avatar">
                    {comment.avatar ? (
                      <Image src={comment.avatar} alt={comment.nick} width={40} height={40} style={{ borderRadius: "50%" }} />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="avatar-placeholder">{comment.nick.charAt(0)}</div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="comment-meta">
                    <strong className="comment-nick">{comment.nick}</strong>
                    <span className="comment-date">{new Date(comment.created).toLocaleDateString('fa-IR')}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="comment-content">{comment.comment}</p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## FILE: src\components\blog\TableOfContents.tsx
```tsx
"use client";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

type TOCItem = { id: string; title: string; level: number };

export default function TableOfContents({ items }: { items: TOCItem[] }) {
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) setActiveId(entry.target.id);
        });
      },
      { rootMargin: "0% 0% -80% 0%" }
    );

    items.forEach((item) => {
      const el = document.getElementById(item.id);
      if (el) observer.observe(el);
    });
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [items]);

  if (!items.length) return null;

  return (
    <nav className="toc-container" aria-label="فهرست مطالب">
      <h3 className="toc-title">در این مقاله می‌خوانید</h3>
      <ul className="toc-list">
        {items.map((item) => (
          <li key={item.id} style={{ paddingLeft: (item.level - 2) * 1 + "rem" }}>
            <a
              href={`#${item.id}`}
              className={`toc-link ${activeId === item.id ? "active" : ""}`}
            >
              {item.title}
            </a>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  );
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   ADAPTIVE NAVIGATION — Swipe, Long-Press, Snap Sheets
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - Visual feedback for long-press state
   - Preview overlay styling
   - Swipe hint UI (subtle)
   - Bottom sheet multi-snap support
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LONG-PRESS WRAPPER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.long-press-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  touch-action: pan-y;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
  user-select: none;
  transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
  .long-press-wrapper.is-pressing {
    transform: scale(0.98);
    transition-duration: 120ms;
  }
}

/* Prevent native context menu on long-press */
.long-press-wrapper,
.long-press-wrapper * {
  -webkit-touch-callout: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LONG-PRESS PREVIEW OVERLAY
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.long-press-preview {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 500;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 24px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 75%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.4);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.4);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: previewFadeIn 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.long-press-preview-inner {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 360px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 22px 24px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent) inset,
    0 24px 60px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.24);
  transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  animation: previewPopIn 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

@keyframes previewFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes previewPopIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

[data-theme="dark"] .long-press-preview {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 82%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SWIPE HINT — subtle indicator (only first visit)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.swipe-hint {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: calc(110px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 60;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 82%, transparent);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) inset,
    0 12px 32px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.4);
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: swipeHintSequence 5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 2s forwards;
}

.swipe-hint-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  color: currentColor;
  animation: swipeArrowSlide 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
}

.swipe-hint-icon svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

@keyframes swipeArrowSlide {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  50%      { transform: translateX(-6px); }
}

@keyframes swipeHintSequence {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(12px); }
  10%  { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
  80%  { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(12px); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .swipe-hint {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* Hide hint on desktop */
@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .swipe-hint {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BOTTOM SHEET — MULTI-SNAP support
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* The sheet has 3 snap states set via data-snap attribute */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .project-modal-shell[data-snap="peek"] {
    transform: translateY(calc(100% - 180px)) !important;
    transition: transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  }

  .project-modal-shell[data-snap="half"] {
    transform: translateY(50%) !important;
    transition: transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  }

  .project-modal-shell[data-snap="full"] {
    transform: translateY(0) !important;
    transition: transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  }

  /* During drag, don't animate */
  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] .project-modal-shell {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION — no transforms
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .long-press-wrapper,
  .long-press-wrapper.is-pressing {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .long-press-preview,
  .long-press-preview-inner {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

```css
  }

  .portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-canvas-mark {
    opacity: 0.85 !important;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1) !important;
  }
}
```
