```css
/* ============================================================
   BASE — Reset, Layout, Glass, Typography, Utilities,
          Buttons, Forms, Badges, Divider, Tooltip, Skeleton, Toast
   Typography Edition 2026
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   1. Reset & base
   ============================================================ */
*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
  text-size-adjust: 100%;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-kerning: normal;
  font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures contextual;
  font-variant-numeric: normal;
  font-synthesis: none;
}

html,
body {
  max-width: 100vw;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 320px;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  line-height: var(--lh-body);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-feature-settings: "ss01", "ss02";
  font-optical-sizing: auto;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-normal);
  overflow-wrap: break-word;
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

button,
input,
textarea,
select {
  font: inherit;
  color: inherit;
  font-feature-settings: inherit;
  font-optical-sizing: inherit;
  letter-spacing: inherit;
}

button {
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  text-align: inherit;
}

button,
a {
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

img,
svg,
video,
canvas {
  max-width: 100%;
  display: block;
  height: auto;
}

img {
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-drag: none;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6,
p, ul, ol, figure, blockquote, dl, dd {
  margin: 0;
}

ul, ol {
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

hr {
  border: none;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin: 0;
}

::selection {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
}

:focus {
  outline: none;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-ring) solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-offset);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none;
}

input,
textarea,
select {
  font-size: 16px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
  input,
  textarea,
  select {
    font-size: inherit;
  }
}

/* ── Custom scrollbar ── */
* {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--line-strong) transparent;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 3px solid transparent;
  background-clip: content-box;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: var(--accent);
  background-clip: content-box;
}

/* ============================================================
   2. Layout primitives
   ============================================================ */
.container {
  width: min(calc(100% - 48px), var(--container));
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.container-narrow {
  width: min(calc(100% - 48px), 920px);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.section {
  padding-block: clamp(80px, 10vw, 140px);
  position: relative;
}

.section-compact {
  padding-block: clamp(56px, 7vw, 96px);
}

.section-flush {
  padding-block: 0;
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  top: -100px;
  right: 16px;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  transition: top var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.skip-link:focus {
  top: 16px;
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* ============================================================
   3. Glass system
   ============================================================ */
.glass-minimal {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 40%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
}

.glass-soft {
  background: var(--glass-soft);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
}

.glass {
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
}

.glass-strong {
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .glass-soft {
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }
  .glass {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3);
  }
  .glass-strong {
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  }
}

.glass-card {
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.glass-panel {
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.glass-pill {
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
}

.glass-modal {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .glass-card {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3);
  }
  .glass-panel {
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  }
  .glass-pill {
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.4);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   4. Typography — 2026 Standards
   ============================================================ */

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   HEADINGS
   - text-wrap: balance prevents orphaned words in titles
   - tighter line-height as size grows
   - Persian script never gets letter-spacing
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 800;
  text-wrap: balance;
  font-kerning: normal;
  font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures contextual;
}

h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h1);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: var(--lh-h1);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
}

h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: var(--lh-h2);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
}

h3 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: var(--lh-h3);
}

h4 {
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: var(--lh-tight);
}

h5, h6 {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: var(--lh-tight);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   BODY TEXT
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
p {
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: var(--lh-body);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
  max-width: var(--reading-wide);
}

/* ── Display ── */
.display {
  font-size: var(--fs-display);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: var(--lh-display);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h1);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: var(--lh-h1);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
}

.h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: var(--lh-h2);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
}

.h3 {
  font-size: var(--fs-h3);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: var(--lh-h3);
}

/* ── Lead paragraph ── */
.body {
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: var(--lh-body);
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.body-lead {
  font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + 0.35vw, 1.25rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: pretty;
  max-width: var(--reading-wide);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   META / MONO — LTR only
   ⚠️ Persian script must NEVER appear in these
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.meta {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
}

.mono {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
}

/* ── Eyebrow ── */
.eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.eyebrow::before {
  content: "";
  width: 24px;
  height: 1px;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.eyebrow--plain::before {
  display: none;
}

/* ── Section index ── */
.section-index {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
}

.section-index::before {
  content: "";
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint);
}

/* ── Section heading ── */
.section-heading {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr);
  align-items: end;
  gap: 40px 80px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 72px);
}

.section-heading h2 {
  margin-top: 18px;
  font-size: var(--fs-h1);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: var(--lh-h1);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-tight);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.section-heading h2 span {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.section-heading h2 em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.section-heading > p {
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-body);
  max-width: var(--reading-narrow);
  line-height: var(--lh-body);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.section-heading--center {
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  text-align: center;
}

.section-heading--center > p {
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   LISTS
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
ul:not([class]),
ol:not([class]) {
  padding-inline-start: 1.5em;
  margin-block: 1em;
}

ul:not([class]) li,
ol:not([class]) li {
  padding-inline-start: 0.25em;
  margin-block: 0.35em;
  line-height: var(--lh-body);
}

ul:not([class]) li {
  list-style: disc;
}

ol:not([class]) li {
  list-style: decimal;
}

ul:not([class]) li::marker,
ol:not([class]) li::marker {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   QUOTES
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
blockquote {
  hanging-punctuation: first last;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: var(--lh-body);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   CODE — always LTR, tabular nums
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
code,
kbd,
samp,
pre {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.925em;
  direction: ltr;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
}

code {
  padding: 0.15em 0.4em;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-feature-settings: "calt" 1;
}

kbd {
  padding: 0.15em 0.4em;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-bottom-width: 2px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  font-size: 0.85em;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   FIGURES & CAPTIONS
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
figure {
  margin-block: 1.5em;
}

figcaption {
  margin-top: 0.75em;
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  line-height: var(--lh-small);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   NUMBER FORMATTING HELPERS
   ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.num-en {
  direction: ltr;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
}

.num-fa {
  direction: rtl;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
  font-variant-numeric: normal;
}

/* ============================================================
   5. Utilities
   ============================================================ */
.text-accent { color: var(--accent); }
.text-muted { color: var(--ink-3); }
.text-ink { color: var(--ink); }
.text-center { text-align: center; }
.text-start { text-align: start; }
.text-end { text-align: end; }

.ltr { direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate; }
.rtl { direction: rtl; unicode-bidi: isolate; }

.balance { text-wrap: balance; }
.pretty { text-wrap: pretty; }

.flex { display: flex; }
.flex-col { flex-direction: column; }
.flex-wrap { flex-wrap: wrap; }
.items-center { align-items: center; }
.items-start { align-items: flex-start; }
.items-end { align-items: flex-end; }
.justify-center { justify-content: center; }
.justify-between { justify-content: space-between; }

.gap-1 { gap: var(--space-1); }
.gap-2 { gap: var(--space-2); }
.gap-3 { gap: var(--space-3); }
.gap-4 { gap: var(--space-4); }
.gap-5 { gap: var(--space-5); }
.gap-6 { gap: var(--space-6); }
.gap-7 { gap: var(--space-7); }
.gap-8 { gap: var(--space-8); }

.grid { display: grid; }
.grid-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.grid-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.grid-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .grid-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .grid-2,
  .grid-3,
  .grid-4 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

.hidden { display: none; }
.block { display: block; }
.inline-block { display: inline-block; }

.relative { position: relative; }
.absolute { position: absolute; }
.sticky { position: sticky; }

.w-full { width: 100%; }
.h-full { height: 100%; }

.overflow-hidden { overflow: hidden; }

.rounded-sm { border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
.rounded-md { border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
.rounded-lg { border-radius: var(--radius-lg); }
.rounded-xl { border-radius: var(--radius-xl); }
.rounded-full { border-radius: var(--radius-full); }

/* ============================================================
   6. Buttons
   ============================================================ */
.button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 52px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-inline: 26px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-normal);
  line-height: var(--lh-tight);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-wrap: nowrap;
  transition:
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.button:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.button > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.button:hover > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transform: translateX(-3px);
}

.button-primary {
  background: var(--burgundy);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px -12px var(--burgundy-glow);
}

.button-primary:hover {
  background: var(--burgundy-2);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 48px -14px var(--burgundy-glow);
}

.button-secondary {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.button-secondary:hover {
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-color: var(--ink);
}

.button-ghost {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  border-color: var(--line);
}

.button-ghost:hover {
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.button-glass {
  background: var(--glass);
  color: var(--ink);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .button-glass {
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.4);
  }
}

.button-glass:hover {
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.button-text {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  padding-inline: 0;
  min-height: auto;
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.button-text:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  transform: none;
}

.button-sm {
  min-height: 40px;
  padding-inline: 18px;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
}

.button-lg {
  min-height: 60px;
  padding-inline: 32px;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
}

.button-xl {
  min-height: 68px;
  padding-inline: 40px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.button-icon {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}

.button-icon-sm {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  min-height: 36px;
}

.button[disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.button-block {
  width: 100%;
}

/* ============================================================
   7. Forms
   ============================================================ */
.input,
.textarea,
.select {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: var(--lh-tight);
  outline: none;
  transition:
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.textarea {
  min-height: 150px;
  resize: vertical;
  line-height: var(--lh-body);
}

.input:hover,
.textarea:hover,
.select:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.input:focus,
.textarea:focus,
.select:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--paper);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint);
}

.input:disabled,
.textarea:disabled,
.select:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.input::placeholder,
.textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}

.select {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  padding-inline-end: 44px;
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='%235a5550' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'><polyline points='6 9 12 15 18 9'/></svg>");
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: left 14px center;
  background-size: 16px;
}

[dir="rtl"] .select {
  background-position: left 14px center;
}

/* ── Checkbox ── */
.checkbox {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  user-select: none;
  position: relative;
}

.checkbox input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.checkbox-mark {
  display: grid;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--surface);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.checkbox-mark::after {
  content: "";
  width: 5px;
  height: 10px;
  border: solid #fff;
  border-width: 0 2px 2px 0;
  transform: rotate(45deg) scale(0);
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-spring);
}

.checkbox input:checked ~ .checkbox-mark {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.checkbox input:checked ~ .checkbox-mark::after {
  transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1);
}

.checkbox input:focus-visible ~ .checkbox-mark {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ── Radio ── */
.radio {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  user-select: none;
  position: relative;
}

.radio input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.radio-mark {
  display: grid;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.radio-mark::after {
  content: "";
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  transform: scale(0);
  transition: transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-spring);
}

.radio input:checked ~ .radio-mark {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.radio input:checked ~ .radio-mark::after {
  transform: scale(1);
}

.radio input:focus-visible ~ .radio-mark {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.field-hint {
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  line-height: var(--lh-small);
}

.field-error {
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  color: var(--danger);
  line-height: var(--lh-small);
}

.input-error {
  border-color: var(--danger) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(180, 35, 24, 0.08) !important;
}

/* ============================================================
   8. Badges & tags
   ============================================================ */
.badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  background: var(--surface);
  line-height: 1;
  direction: ltr;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
}

.badge-accent {
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  border-color: transparent;
}

.badge-ink {
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  border-color: transparent;
}

.badge-success {
  background: rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.1);
  color: var(--success);
  border-color: transparent;
}

.badge-danger {
  background: rgba(180, 35, 24, 0.1);
  color: var(--danger);
  border-color: transparent;
}

.tag-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wide);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  transition:
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.tag:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ============================================================
   9. Divider
   ============================================================ */
.divider {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-wider);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.divider::before,
.divider::after {
  content: "";
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.divider--start::before {
  display: none;
}

.divider--end::after {
  display: none;
}

/* ============================================================
   10. Tooltip
   ============================================================ */
[data-tooltip] {
  position: relative;
}

[data-tooltip]::after {
  content: attr(data-tooltip);
  position: absolute;
  bottom: calc(100% + 8px);
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--ink);
  color: var(--paper);
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: var(--tracking-normal);
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition:
    opacity var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

[data-tooltip]:hover::after,
[data-tooltip]:focus-visible::after {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px);
}

/* ============================================================
   11. Skeleton
   ============================================================ */
.skeleton {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.skeleton::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent),
    transparent
  );
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  animation: skeletonShimmer 1.6s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes skeletonShimmer {
  to {
    transform: translateX(100%);
  }
}

.skeleton-text {
  height: 1em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.skeleton-title {
  height: 2em;
  width: 60%;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

/* ============================================================
   12. Toast
   ============================================================ */
.toast-stack {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 24px;
  inset-inline-start: 24px;
  z-index: 300;
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 360px;
}

.toast {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  line-height: var(--lh-small);
  animation: toastIn var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.toast-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
}

.toast-success .toast-icon {
  background: rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.12);
  color: var(--success);
}

.toast-error .toast-icon {
  background: rgba(180, 35, 24, 0.12);
  color: var(--danger);
}

@keyframes toastIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(12px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   BLOG ARTICLE PREMIUM — صفحه‌ی مقاله
   ============================================================ */

/* ─── 1. Layout ─── */
.blog-post-page {
  padding-block: clamp(120px, 14vw, 160px) clamp(80px, 10vw, 120px);
}

/* ─── 2. Breadcrumb ─── */
.blog-breadcrumb {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-breadcrumb-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.blog-breadcrumb-item a {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-decoration: none;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: all 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-breadcrumb-item a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
}

.blog-breadcrumb-item[aria-current="page"] span {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  max-width: 40ch;
  display: inline-block;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.blog-breadcrumb-sep {
  opacity: 0.4;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
}

/* ─── 3. Header ─── */
.blog-post-header {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
  padding-bottom: clamp(28px, 4vw, 44px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  text-align: start;
}

.blog-post-header h1 {
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0 0 clamp(20px, 2.5vw, 28px);
  max-width: 22ch;
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
}

.blog-post-header h1::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: 72px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 100%
  );
}

.blog-post-excerpt {
  font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 0.95rem + 0.5vw, 1.25rem);

  margin: 0 0 clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ─── 4. Meta row ─── */
.blog-post-meta {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px 20px;
  padding: 12px 0;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.blog-post-meta > * {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.blog-post-meta > *::before {
  content: "";
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.65;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.blog-post-meta > *:first-child::before {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

/* ─── 5. Tags ─── */
.blog-post-tags {

  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.blog-post-tags .blog-card-tag {

  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);

}

.blog-post-tags .blog-card-tag:hover {

}

/* ─── 6. Share bar ─── */
.blog-share {

  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.blog-share.is-compact {

}

.blog-share-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);

.blog-share-btn:hover {

.blog-share-btn--copy:hover {

/* ─── 7. Content ─── */
.blog-post-content {

.blog-post-content > p:first-of-type {

}

.blog-post-content h2 {

  margin-block: 2.4em 0.9em;
  scroll-margin-top: 100px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;

}

.blog-post-content h2::before {
  content: counter(editorial-h2, persian) " ·";
  counter-increment: editorial-h2;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);

}

.blog-post-content h3 {

.blog-post-content ul,
.blog-post-content ol {

}

.blog-post-content li {

.blog-post-content ul li::marker {

.blog-post-content ol li::marker {
  color: var(--accent);

}

.blog-post-content blockquote {

  margin: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px) 0;

.blog-post-content blockquote::before {

.blog-post-content hr::before,
.blog-post-content hr::after {

    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) 100%
  );
}

.blog-post-content hr::after {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 100%
  );

.blog-post-content img {

  border-radius: 16px;

.blog-post-content figcaption {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);

  gap: 12px;

}

.blog-post-content figcaption::before {
  content: "—";
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  opacity: 0.85;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.blog-post-content a {
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 65%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 65%, transparent) 100%
  );
  background-size: 100% 1.5px;
  background-position: 0 100%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  padding-bottom: 1px;
  transition: background-size 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-content a:hover {
  background-size: 0 1.5px;
  background-position: 100% 100%;
}

/* ─── 8. Content counter ─── */
.blog-post-content {
  counter-reset: editorial-h2;
}

/* ─── 9. Prev/Next ─── */
.blog-prevnext {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  margin: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px) auto 0;
  padding-top: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  max-width: 900px;
}

.blog-prevnext-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 20px 22px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  transition: all 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  min-height: 110px;
  justify-content: center;
}

.blog-prevnext-card:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, var(--line));
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}

.blog-prevnext-card--prev {
  text-align: end;
  align-items: flex-end;
}

.blog-prevnext-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.blog-prevnext-title {
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink);
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ─── 10. TOC Sidebar ─── */
.toc-sidebar {
  display: none;
}

@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  .toc-sidebar {
    display: block;
    position: sticky;
    top: 120px;
    align-self: start;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 160px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 22px 20px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 65%, transparent);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

/* ─── 11. Mobile ─── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .blog-post-page {
    padding-block: 96px 64px;
  }

  .blog-post-header h1 {
    font-size: clamp(1.625rem, 7vw, 2.25rem);
    line-height: 1.2;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .blog-post-excerpt {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }

  .blog-post-content {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.85;
  }

  .blog-post-content h2 {
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 5.5vw, 1.5rem);
    margin-block: 2em 0.75em;
  }

  .blog-post-content pre {
    padding: 18px 16px;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .blog-post-content table {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    display: block;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }

  .blog-post-content blockquote {
    padding: 18px 20px;
    border-radius: 4px 14px 14px 4px;
  }

  .blog-share {
    padding: 14px;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .blog-share-label {
    display: none;
  }

  .blog-share-buttons {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .blog-share-btn {
    flex: 1;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 10px;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }

  .blog-share-btn-text {
    display: none;
  }

  .blog-share-btn svg {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
  }

  .blog-prevnext {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .blog-prevnext-card--prev {
    text-align: start;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }
}

/* ─── 12. Reduced motion ─── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .blog-share-btn,
  .blog-prevnext-card,
  .blog-post-tags .blog-card-tag,
  .blog-post-content a {
    transition: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   BLOG EDITORIAL — Infinite Edition
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   سیستم ادیتوریال کامل برای مقالات بلاگ
   
   مبانی طراحی:
   - Perfect Fourth scale (1.333) برای بدنه، Golden Ratio (1.618) برای تیترها[reference:0]
   - Measure: 50-75 کاراکتر (هدف 66)[reference:1]
   - Line-height بدنه: 1.5-1.6 دسکتاپ، 1.3-1.45 موبایل[reference:2]
   - خط‌چین تیترها: 1.1-1.2، تیترهای بزرگ ~1.0 با tracking منفی[reference:3]
   - اندازه فونت بدنه: حداقل 16px، ایده‌آل 18px برای long-form[reference:4]
   - RTL: استفاده از logical properties (start/end) به جای left/right[reference:5]
   - بدون letter-spacing منفی روی فارسی (اتصال حروف را می‌شکند)[reference:6]
   - کاهش انیمیشن در محتوای متنی[reference:7]
   
   ساختار:
   1. Design Tokens (متغیرهای محلی)
   2. Layout & Container
   3. H2 Numbering (شماره‌گذاری خودکار)
   4. H3 & H4
   5. Paragraphs & Lead
   6. Lists
   7. Pull Quote & Blockquote
   8. Code & Pre
   9. Tables
   10. Figure & Caption
   11. Links
   12. HR & Dividers
   13. Editorial Marks
   14. Sidebar Notes
   15. Responsive
   16. Dark Mode
   17. Reduced Motion
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. DESIGN TOKENS — متغیرهای محلی ادیتوریال
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content {
  /* ─── Type Scale (Perfect Fourth) ─── */
  --ed-scale: 1.333;
  
  --ed-fs-body:   1.0625rem;   /* 17px */
  --ed-fs-body-lg: 1.125rem;   /* 18px */
  --ed-fs-lead:   clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.5vw, 1.375rem);
  --ed-fs-h3:     calc(var(--ed-fs-body) * var(--ed-scale));
  --ed-fs-h2:     calc(var(--ed-fs-h3) * var(--ed-scale));
  --ed-fs-h1:     calc(var(--ed-fs-h2) * var(--ed-scale));
  --ed-fs-small:  calc(var(--ed-fs-body) / var(--ed-scale));
  --ed-fs-micro:  calc(var(--ed-fs-small) / var(--ed-scale));
  
  /* ─── Line Heights ─── */
  --ed-lh-body:    1.85;
  --ed-lh-heading: 1.25;
  --ed-lh-tight:   1.15;
  --ed-lh-lead:    1.75;
  
  /* ─── Measure ─── */
  --ed-measure:      65ch;
  --ed-measure-wide:  75ch;
  --ed-measure-narrow: 55ch;
  
  /* ─── Spacing (baseline: 8px) ─── */
  --ed-space-1:  0.25rem;  /* 4px */
  --ed-space-2:  0.5rem;   /* 8px */
  --ed-space-3:  0.75rem;  /* 12px */
  --ed-space-4:  1rem;     /* 16px */
  --ed-space-5:  1.5rem;   /* 24px */
  --ed-space-6:  2rem;     /* 32px */
  --ed-space-7:  3rem;     /* 48px */
  --ed-space-8:  4rem;     /* 64px */
  --ed-space-9:  5rem;     /* 80px */
  
  /* ─── Editorial Spacing (special) ─── */
  --ed-heading-top:    var(--ed-space-7);
  --ed-heading-bottom: var(--ed-space-4);
  --ed-paragraph-gap:  1.4em;
  --ed-block-gap:      var(--ed-space-6);
  
  /* ─── Colors ─── */
  --ed-accent:       var(--accent);
  --ed-accent-soft:  color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
  --ed-accent-faint: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent);
  --ed-ink:          var(--ink);
  --ed-ink-2:        var(--ink-2);
  --ed-ink-3:        var(--ink-3);
  --ed-line:         var(--line);
  --ed-surface:      var(--surface);
  --ed-paper:        var(--paper-2);
  
  /* ─── Motion ─── */
  --ed-ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --ed-duration: 320ms;
  
  /* ─── Counter ─── */
  counter-reset: ed-h2 ed-h3 ed-pullquote;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. LAYOUT & CONTAINER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content {
  font-size: var(--ed-fs-body);
  line-height: var(--ed-lh-body);
  color: var(--ed-ink-2);
  max-width: var(--ed-measure);
  margin-inline: auto;
  text-wrap: pretty;
  font-kerning: normal;
  font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures contextual;
}

/* ─── تمام فرزندان مستقیم ─── */
.blog-post-content > * {
  max-width: 100%;
}

/* ─── وقتی داخل grid layout هستیم ─── */
.blog-post-layout .blog-post-content {
  max-width: 100%;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. H2 — شماره‌گذاری خودکار + تزئین
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content h2 {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1.2vw, 2rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: var(--ed-lh-heading);
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
  margin-block: var(--ed-heading-top) var(--ed-heading-bottom);
  padding-block-start: var(--ed-space-2);
  scroll-margin-top: 100px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* ─── شماره فارسی ─── */
.blog-post-content h2::before {
  content: counter(ed-h2, persian) " ·";
  counter-increment: ed-h2;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
  font-size: 0.6em;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
  transform: translateY(-0.05em);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ─── خط تزئینی بالای H2 ─── */
.blog-post-content h2::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: 48px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--ed-accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 30%, transparent) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0.6;
}

/* ─── ریست شماره H3 وقتی H2 جدید میاد ─── */
.blog-post-content h2 + h3 {
  counter-reset: ed-h3;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. H3 & H4
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content h3 {
  position: relative;
  font-size: clamp(1.1875rem, 1.05rem + 0.6vw, 1.5rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.35;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
  margin-block: var(--ed-space-6) var(--ed-space-3);
  scroll-margin-top: 100px;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

/* ─── نقطه شماره H3 ─── */
.blog-post-content h3::before {
  content: counter(ed-h3);
  counter-increment: ed-h3;
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: calc(var(--ed-space-5) * -1);
  top: 0.15em;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
  font-size: 0.625em;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  opacity: 0.5;
  direction: ltr;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ─── H4 ─── */
.blog-post-content h4 {
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.4;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
  margin-block: var(--ed-space-5) var(--ed-space-2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. PARAGRAPHS & LEAD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content p {
  margin-block: 0 var(--ed-paragraph-gap);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ─── پاراگراف اول (Lead) ─── */
.blog-post-content > p:first-of-type {
  font-size: var(--ed-fs-lead);
  line-height: var(--ed-lh-lead);
  font-weight: 450;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
  margin-block-end: 1.6em;
}

/* ─── پاراگراف آخر ─── */
.blog-post-content > p:last-of-type {
  margin-block-end: 0;
}

/* ─── پاراگرافی که بعد از تیتر میاد ─── */
.blog-post-content h2 + p,
.blog-post-content h3 + p,
.blog-post-content h4 + p {
  margin-block-start: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. LISTS — لیست‌های مرتب و نامرتب
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content ul,
.blog-post-content ol {
  margin-block: var(--ed-space-4) var(--ed-space-5);
  padding-inline-start: 1.5em;
}

.blog-post-content li {
  padding-inline-start: 0.35em;
  margin-block: 0.55em;
  line-height: 1.85;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ─── Marker ─── */
.blog-post-content ul li::marker {
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  font-size: 1.1em;
}

.blog-post-content ol li::marker {
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ─── لیست تودرتو ─── */
.blog-post-content li > ul,
.blog-post-content li > ol {
  margin-block: 0.4em 0.6em;
  margin-inline-start: 0.5em;
}

/* ─── لیستی که بعد از تیتر میاد ─── */
.blog-post-content h2 + ul,
.blog-post-content h2 + ol,
.blog-post-content h3 + ul,
.blog-post-content h3 + ol {
  margin-block-start: var(--ed-space-3);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. PULL QUOTE & BLOCKQUOTE
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Pull quote یک "visual event" است، نه heading[reference:8]
   باید ریتم بدنه را بشکند
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content blockquote {
  position: relative;
  margin: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px) 0;
  padding: clamp(22px, 2.8vw, 30px) clamp(24px, 3.4vw, 36px);
  border: none;
  border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--ed-accent);
  border-radius: 4px 18px 18px 4px;
  
  /* پس‌زمینه گرادیانی ظریف */
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      var(--ed-accent-soft) 0%,
      var(--ed-accent-faint) 100%
    );
  
  /* عمق */
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 45%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 30%, transparent);
  
  font-style: italic;
  counter-increment: ed-pullquote;
}

/* ─── علامت نقل‌قول تزئینی ─── */
.blog-post-content blockquote::before {
  content: "\201C";
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px;
  inset-inline-end: 18px;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: 72px;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  opacity: 0.1;
  pointer-events: none;
  font-style: normal;
}

/* ─── پاراگراف داخل ─── */
.blog-post-content blockquote p {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 1rem + 0.3vw, 1.1875rem);
  line-height: 1.75;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
  font-style: italic;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.blog-post-content blockquote p + p {
  margin-block-start: 0.8em;
}

/* ─── Cite / Author ─── */
.blog-post-content blockquote cite {
  display: block;
  margin-block-start: var(--ed-space-4);
  padding-block-start: var(--ed-space-3);
  border-block-start: 1px solid
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 20%, transparent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ed-ink-3);
  font-style: normal;
  direction: ltr;
  text-align: start;
}

.blog-post-content blockquote cite::before {
  content: "— ";
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

/* ─── Pull Quote بزرگ (برای نقل‌قول‌های برجسته) ─── */
.blog-post-content blockquote.is-pull {
  margin-inline: calc(var(--ed-space-6) * -1);
  border-inline-start-width: 6px;
  border-radius: 6px 24px 24px 6px;
  padding: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px) clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
}

.blog-post-content blockquote.is-pull p {
  font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.1rem + 1vw, 1.75rem);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

/* ─── Pull Quote وسط‌چین ─── */
.blog-post-content blockquote.is-centered {
  border-inline-start: none;
  border-inline-end: none;
  border-block-start: 3px solid var(--ed-accent);
  border-block-end: 3px solid var(--ed-accent);
  border-radius: 0;
  text-align: center;
  padding-block: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
}

.blog-post-content blockquote.is-centered::before {
  inset-inline: 0;
  top: -32px;
  text-align: center;
  opacity: 0.15;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. CODE & PRE
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   کد باید LTR بمونه، حتی در متن RTL[reference:9]
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ─── Inline Code ─── */
.blog-post-content code {
  font-family: var(--font-mono, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace);
  font-size: 0.9em;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--ed-paper);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-ink) 6%, transparent);
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 80%, var(--ed-ink));
  direction: ltr;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-variant-ligatures: none;
}

/* ─── Code Block ─── */
.blog-post-content pre {
  position: relative;
  margin: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) 0;
  padding: 22px 24px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: #0a0908;
  color: #f5efe6;
  overflow-x: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  direction: ltr;
  text-align: left;
  tab-size: 2;
  
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    0 20px 48px -24px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.5);
}

/* ─── Terminal Dots ─── */
.blog-post-content pre::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  inset-inline-start: 18px;
  width: 46px;
  height: 10px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 5px 5px, #ff5f57 4px, transparent 4.5px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 17px 5px, #febc2e 4px, transparent 4.5px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 29px 5px, #28c840 4px, transparent 4.5px);
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  opacity: 0.85;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ─── Code داخل Pre ─── */
.blog-post-content pre code {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  padding: 14px 0 0;
  color: inherit;
  display: block;
  font-size: inherit;
  white-space: pre;
  word-break: normal;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. TABLES
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content table {
  width: 100%;
  margin: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) 0;
  border-collapse: separate;
  border-spacing: 0;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-ink) 8%, transparent);
  border-radius: 14px;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
}

/* ─── Header ─── */
.blog-post-content thead th {
  padding: 14px 18px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 10%, transparent);
  color: var(--ed-ink);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  text-align: start;
  border-block-end: 1px solid
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-ink) 6%, transparent);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ─── Cells ─── */
.blog-post-content tbody td {
  padding: 14px 18px;
  text-align: start;
  border-block-end: 1px solid
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-ink) 6%, transparent);
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ed-ink-2);
}

/* ─── آخرین ردیف ─── */
.blog-post-content tbody tr:last-child td {
  border-block-end: none;
}

/* ─── Zebra Stripe ─── */
.blog-post-content tbody tr:nth-child(even) td {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-paper) 40%, transparent);
}

/* ─── Hover ─── */
.blog-post-content tbody tr:hover td {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 4%, transparent);
  transition: background 160ms var(--ed-ease);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. FIGURE & CAPTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content figure {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0;
  margin: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px) 0;
}

/* ─── Image ─── */
.blog-post-content figure img,
.blog-post-content > img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--ed-line);
  background: var(--ed-paper);
  box-shadow:
    0 4px 12px -6px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
    0 16px 40px -24px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.15);
}

/* ─── Caption ─── */
.blog-post-content figcaption {
  margin-block-start: 12px;
  padding-block-start: 12px;
  border-block-start: 1px solid var(--ed-line);
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ed-ink-3);
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ─── خط تزئینی قبل از caption ─── */
.blog-post-content figcaption::before {
  content: "—";
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  opacity: 0.85;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ─── Strong در caption ─── */
.blog-post-content figcaption strong {
  color: var(--ed-ink-2);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   11. LINKS
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Underline انیمیت‌شده، از راست به چپ (RTL native)[reference:10]
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content a {
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  text-decoration: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 60%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 60%, transparent) 100%
  );
  background-size: 100% 1.5px;
  background-position: 0 100%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  padding-block-end: 1px;
  transition: background-size var(--ed-duration) var(--ed-ease);
}

.blog-post-content a:hover {
  background-size: 0 1.5px;
  background-position: 100% 100%;
}

/* ─── External Links ─── */
.blog-post-content a[target="_blank"]::after {
  content: " ↗";
  font-size: 0.8em;
  opacity: 0.7;
  display: inline-block;
  transform: translateY(-0.1em);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   12. HR & DIVIDERS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-content hr {
  margin: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px) auto;
  max-width: 320px;
  height: auto;
  border: none;
  background: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

/* ─── خط چپ ─── */
.blog-post-content hr::before {
  content: "";
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 45%, transparent) 100%
  );
}

/* ─── خط راست ─── */
.blog-post-content hr::after {
  content: "";
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 45%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   13. EDITORIAL MARKS — نشانه‌های ادیتوریال
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ─── Definition Lists ─── */
.blog-post-content dl {
  margin-block: var(--ed-space-5);
}

.blog-post-content dt {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
  margin-block-start: var(--ed-space-4);
}

.blog-post-content dd {
  margin-inline-start: 0;
  margin-block-start: var(--ed-space-2);
  padding-inline-start: var(--ed-space-4);
  border-inline-start: 2px solid
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 20%, transparent);
  color: var(--ed-ink-2);
}

/* ─── Mark (هایلایت) ─── */
.blog-post-content mark {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    transparent 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 22%, transparent) 40%
  );
  color: inherit;
  padding: 0 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ─── KBD ─── */
.blog-post-content kbd {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
  font-size: 0.8125em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--ed-surface) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-paper) 60%, var(--ed-surface)) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-ink) 12%, transparent);
  border-block-end-width: 2px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  direction: ltr;
  unicode-bidi: isolate;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 70%, transparent);
  line-height: 1;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* ─── Abbr ─── */
.blog-post-content abbr[title] {
  text-decoration: underline dotted;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  cursor: help;
}

/* ─── Small ─── */
.blog-post-content small {
  font-size: var(--ed-fs-small);
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ed-ink-3);
}

/* ─── Strong & Em ─── */
.blog-post-content strong {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
}

.blog-post-content em {
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ed-ink);
}

/* ─── Sup & Sub ─── */
.blog-post-content sup,
.blog-post-content sub {
  font-size: 0.75em;
  line-height: 0;
  position: relative;
  vertical-align: baseline;
}

.blog-post-content sup { top: -0.5em; }
.blog-post-content sub { bottom: -0.25em; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   14. SIDEBAR NOTES — یادداشت‌های کناری
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ─── Aside داخل محتوا ─── */
.blog-post-content aside {
  margin-block: var(--ed-space-6);
  padding: var(--ed-space-5) var(--ed-space-5);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-paper) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--ed-line);
  border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--ed-accent);
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--ed-ink-2);
}

.blog-post-content aside p:last-child {
  margin-block-end: 0;
}

/* ─── Callout / Note ─── */
.blog-post-content .callout {
  padding: var(--ed-space-5) var(--ed-space-5);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 6%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ed-accent) 15%, transparent);
  margin-block: var(--ed-space-6);
}

.blog-post-content .callout-title {
  display: block;
  margin-block-end: var(--ed-space-2);
  font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ed-accent);
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ─── Warning ─── */
.blog-post-content .callout.is-warning {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #f59e0b 8%, transparent);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #f59e0b 20%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-content .callout.is-warning .callout-title {
  color: #b45309;
}

/* ─── Success ─── */
.blog-post-content .callout.is-success {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #10b981 8%, transparent);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #10b981 20%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-content .callout.is-success .callout-title {
  color: #047857;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   15. RESPONSIVE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ─── تبلت (≤ 900px) ─── */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .blog-post-content {
    --ed-measure: 100%;
    --ed-heading-top: 2.5rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content h3::before {
    position: static;
    inset-inline-start: auto;
    margin-inline-end: 8px;
  }
}

/* ─── موبایل (≤ 720px) ─── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .blog-post-content {
    --ed-fs-body: 1rem;
    --ed-fs-lead: 1.0625rem;
    --ed-lh-body: 1.85;
    --ed-heading-top: 2rem;
    --ed-heading-bottom: 0.75rem;
    --ed-paragraph-gap: 1.3em;
  }

  /* ─── H2 ─── */
  .blog-post-content h2 {
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 5.5vw, 1.5rem);
    line-height: 1.3;
    gap: 10px;
    padding-block-start: 0;
  }

  .blog-post-content h2::before {
    font-size: 0.7em;
  }

  .blog-post-content h2::after {
    width: 32px;
    height: 1.5px;
  }

  /* ─── H3 ─── */
  .blog-post-content h3 {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    margin-block: 1.6em 0.6em;
  }

  .blog-post-content h3::before {
    display: none;
  }

  /* ─── Paragraph ─── */
  .blog-post-content > p:first-of-type {
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }

  /* ─── Blockquote ─── */
  .blog-post-content blockquote {
    padding: 18px 20px;
    border-radius: 4px 14px 14px 4px;
  }

  .blog-post-content blockquote::before {
    font-size: 56px;
    inset-inline-end: 14px;
  }

  .blog-post-content blockquote p {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content blockquote.is-pull {
    margin-inline: 0;
    padding: 20px 22px;
  }

  .blog-post-content blockquote.is-pull p {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }

  /* ─── Code ─── */
  .blog-post-content pre {
    padding: 18px 16px;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .blog-post-content code {
    font-size: 0.85em;
    padding: 2px 6px;
  }

  /* ─── Table ─── */
  .blog-post-content table {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    display: block;
    overflow-x: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .blog-post-content th,
  .blog-post-content td {
    padding: 10px 12px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* ─── Figure ─── */
  .blog-post-content figure {
    margin-block: 24px;
  }

  .blog-post-content figure img,
  .blog-post-content > img {
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .blog-post-content figcaption {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    margin-block-start: 10px;
    padding-block-start: 10px;
  }

  /* ─── Lists ─── */
  .blog-post-content ul,
  .blog-post-content ol {
    padding-inline-start: 1.25em;
  }

  /* ─── Aside ─── */
  .blog-post-content aside,
  .blog-post-content .callout {
    padding: 16px 18px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }
}

/* ─── موبایل کوچک (≤ 400px) ─── */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .blog-post-content {
    --ed-fs-body: 0.9375rem;
    --ed-heading-top: 1.75rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content h2 {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content h3 {
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
  }

  .blog-post-content blockquote {
    padding: 16px 16px;
  }

  .blog-post-content pre {
    padding: 16px 14px;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   16. DARK MODE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
[data-theme="dark"] .blog-post-content {
  --ed-accent: #14b1ab;
  --ed-accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, #14b1ab 12%, transparent);
  --ed-accent-faint: color-mix(in srgb, #14b1ab 6%, transparent);
  --ed-ink: #f5efe6;
  --ed-ink-2: #c9c2b8;
  --ed-ink-3: #a9a296;
  --ed-line: rgba(245, 239, 230, 0.08);
  --ed-surface: #14120f;
  --ed-paper: #11100e;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-post-content code {
  background: #1a1815;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-post-content pre {
  background: #050505;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05),
    0 20px 48px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-post-content kbd {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a1815 0%, #11100e 100%);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-post-content mark {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    transparent 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, #14b1ab 30%, transparent) 40%
  );
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-post-content .callout.is-warning {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #f59e0b 12%, transparent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-post-content .callout.is-success {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #10b981 12%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   17. REDUCED MOTION
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   خوانندگان انیمیشن را در محتوای متنی آزاردهنده می‌دانند[reference:11]
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .blog-post-content a {
    transition: none !important;
  }

  .blog-post-content a:hover {
    background-size: 100% 1.5px;
    background-position: 0 100%;
  }

  .blog-post-content tbody tr:hover td {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   18. PRINT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media print {
  .blog-post-content {
    --ed-measure: 100%;
    --ed-fs-body: 11pt;
    color: #000;
  }

  .blog-post-content blockquote,
  .blog-post-content pre,
  .blog-post-content figure img {
    box-shadow: none;
    border-color: #ccc;
  }

  .blog-post-content a {
    color: #000;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .blog-post-content a[target="_blank"]::after {
    content: " (" attr(href) ")";
    font-size: 0.8em;
    color: #666;
  }
}
```
