```css
/* ============================================================
   BLOG PREMIUM — Infinite Edition
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Pure CSS layer. No component changes.
   Loaded AFTER blog.css so it wins the cascade.
   Every animation = transform + opacity only (GPU-composited).
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. AURORA — soft glow behind both blog pages
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-page,
.blog-post-page {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.blog-page::before,
.blog-post-page::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 8%;
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 90vw;
  height: 90vw;
  max-width: 900px;
  max-height: 900px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 7%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 2%, transparent) 30%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  filter: blur(70px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-page::before,
[data-theme="dark"] .blog-post-page::before {
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 30%,
    transparent 65%
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. BACK HOME — premium pill
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-page .blog-back-home {
  position: relative;
  padding: 10px 20px 10px 16px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 65%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 65%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
  transition:
    transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-page .blog-back-home:hover {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent) 100%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 4px 14px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. BLOG HEADER — premium editorial
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-page .blog-header .section-index {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px !important;
  padding: 8px 16px 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  font-size: 10.5px !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
}

.blog-page .blog-header .section-index::before {
  width: 6px !important;
  height: 6px !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) !important;
}

.blog-page .blog-header h1 {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--ink) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 78%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. TAGS FILTER — premium chips
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-page .blog-tags-filter {
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
}

.blog-page .blog-tags-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
}

.blog-page .blog-tags-label::before {
  content: "";
  width: 14px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.blog-page .blog-tag-chip {
  position: relative;
  padding: 9px 18px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 45%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
  font-weight: 600;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  transition:
    transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-page .blog-tag-chip:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 3%, transparent) 100%
    );
  color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 8px 20px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, transparent);
}

.blog-page .blog-tag-chip.active {
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 70%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  );
  border-color: transparent;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 1px 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.3),
    0 10px 26px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 58%, transparent);
}

.blog-page .blog-tag-chip:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.97);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. FEATURED CARD — 6-layer glass + shine sweep
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-page .blog-featured-card {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 90%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 78%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 86%, transparent) 100%
    );

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 92%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    inset -1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 7%, transparent),
    0 20px 48px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 16%, transparent),
    0 48px 100px -32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 24%, transparent);

  transition:
    transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-page .blog-featured-card {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 95%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 85%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, transparent) 100%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45),
    0 20px 48px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    0 48px 100px -32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);
}

/* Gradient ring border */
.blog-page .blog-featured-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) 35%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent) 65%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* Ambient glow */
.blog-page .blog-featured-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -40%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 70%;
  height: 70%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  filter: blur(40px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.blog-page .blog-featured-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 98%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent),
    0 28px 60px -18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 32%, transparent),
    0 60px 120px -40px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 26%, transparent);
}

/* Featured badge — glow + shine */
.blog-page .blog-featured-badge {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 7px 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 100%
  );
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32),
    0 4px 14px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent);
}

.blog-page .blog-featured-badge::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  left: -60%;
  width: 50%;
  height: 200%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    100deg,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  transform: skewX(-20deg);
  animation: blogBadgeShine 5.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}

@keyframes blogBadgeShine {
  0%, 62% { left: -60%; }
  82%, 100% { left: 160%; }
}

.blog-page .blog-featured-content h2 {
  font-weight: 800;
  transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-page .blog-featured-cta {
  padding: 10px 22px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    #100e0c 0%,
    #26201b 45%,
    #100e0c 100%
  );
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
    0 8px 22px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42);
  transition:
    gap 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-page .blog-featured-card:hover .blog-featured-cta {
  gap: 14px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  );
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24),
    0 12px 30px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. BLOG GRID CARDS — 6-layer glass + lift
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-page .blog-card {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 72%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 84%, transparent) 100%
    );

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 90%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 45%, transparent),
    inset -1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 45%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 16px 36px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 14%, transparent),
    0 40px 88px -32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 22%, transparent);

  transition:
    transform 460ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 460ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .blog-page .blog-card {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 94%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 90%, transparent) 100%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42),
    0 16px 36px -14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52),
    0 40px 88px -32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72);
}

/* Gradient ring on hover only */
.blog-page .blog-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 48%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent) 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-page .blog-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 96%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent),
    0 24px 52px -18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent),
    0 52px 104px -36px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 24%, transparent);
}

.blog-page .blog-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Meta and title polish */
.blog-page .blog-card-meta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
  align-self: flex-start;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent);
}

.blog-page .blog-card-title {
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-page .blog-card-footer {
  border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
}

.blog-page .blog-card-tag {
  padding: 5px 12px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 40%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 45%, transparent);
  font-weight: 600;
  transition:
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-page .blog-card:hover .blog-card-tag:first-child {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* Arrow badge */
.blog-page .blog-card-arrow {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  transition:
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    background 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-page .blog-card:hover .blog-card-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-6px) rotate(0deg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  );
  border-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25),
    0 8px 20px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent);
}

/* Empty state */
.blog-page .blog-empty {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 80px 24px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 40%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 12%, transparent);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
}

.blog-page .blog-empty::before {
  content: "◌";
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. BLOG POST PAGE — header & typography
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-page .blog-back-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 65%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 50%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent);
  font-weight: 500;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-back-link:hover {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
  color: var(--accent);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 3%, transparent) 100%
    );
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-header {
  position: relative;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-meta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-header h1 {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--ink) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 82%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-tags .blog-card-tag {
  padding: 6px 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-tags .blog-card-tag:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. CONTENT TYPOGRAPHY — editorial
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-page .blog-post-content {
  font-size: 1.0625rem;
  line-height: 1.9;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content > p:first-of-type::first-letter {
  font-size: 3.2em;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 0.9;
  float: right;
  margin-inline-end: 12px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content h2 {
  position: relative;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content h2::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0.15em;
  width: 3px;
  height: 1.1em;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 100%
  );
  transform: translateX(-16px);
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content blockquote {
  position: relative;
  padding: 24px 28px;
  margin: 36px 0;
  border-radius: 4px 20px 20px 4px;
  border-right: 4px solid var(--accent);
  border-inline-end: 4px solid var(--accent);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 3%, transparent) 100%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 8px 24px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content blockquote::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 12px;
  inset-inline-start: 16px;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.35;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Code blocks */
.blog-post-page .blog-post-content pre {
  position: relative;
  padding: 22px 26px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 100%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 88%, #000) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 100%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    0 20px 48px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.6);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content pre::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  inset-inline-start: 20px;
  width: 44px;
  height: 10px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 5px 5px, #ff5f57 4px, transparent 4.5px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 15px 5px, #febc2e 4px, transparent 4.5px),
    radial-gradient(circle at 25px 5px, #28c840 4px, transparent 4.5px);
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content pre code {
  padding-top: 14px;
  display: block;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content :not(pre) > code {
  padding: 3px 9px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 100%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 70%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  border-radius: 7px;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 45%, transparent);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 80%, var(--ink));
}

/* Tables */
.blog-post-page .blog-post-content table {
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 8px 24px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 18%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content th {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 7%, transparent) 100%);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content tr:nth-child(even) td {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 40%, transparent);
}

/* Horizontal rule — ornamental */
.blog-post-page .blog-post-content hr {
  position: relative;
  height: 24px;
  border: none;
  margin: 56px 0;
  background: none;
  text-align: center;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content hr::before {
  content: "✦ ✦ ✦";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  padding: 0 20px;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.5em;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content hr::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  inset-inline: 20%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 12%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent
  );
}

/* Links */
.blog-post-page .blog-post-content a {
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent) 100%
  );
  background-size: 0 1.5px;
  background-position: 0 100%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  padding-bottom: 1px;
  transition: background-size 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-post-content a:hover {
  background-size: 100% 1.5px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. TOC INLINE — premium collapsible
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-page .toc-inline {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
  border-radius: 18px;
}

.blog-post-page .toc-inline summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 4px 0;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .toc-inline summary:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.blog-post-page .toc-inline summary::after {
  content: "▾";
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: var(--accent);
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .toc-inline[open] summary::after {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.blog-post-page .toc-inline li a {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 4px 0;
  transition:
    color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    padding-inline-start 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .toc-inline li a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  padding-inline-start: 6px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. TOC SIDEBAR — glass + glow active
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
  .toc-sidebar {
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 65%, transparent) 100%
      ) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5) !important;
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 70%, transparent),
      inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent),
      0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
      0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
      0 16px 40px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 16%, transparent) !important;
  }

  .toc-sidebar-label {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding-bottom: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 14px !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  }

  .toc-sidebar-label::before {
    content: "";
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint),
      0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent);
  }

  .toc-sidebar li a {
    border-inline-end: 2px solid transparent;
    border-left: none;
    border-radius: 8px 0 0 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition:
      background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      padding-inline-start 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .toc-sidebar li a:hover {
    color: var(--accent);
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent);
    padding-inline-start: 14px;
  }

  .toc-sidebar li.is-active a {
    color: var(--accent);
    font-weight: 700;
    border-inline-end-color: var(--accent);
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        transparent 0%,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 100%
      );
    padding-inline-start: 14px;
    box-shadow:
      inset -3px 0 8px -3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   11. RELATED POSTS — premium cards
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-page .blog-related {
  margin-top: 72px;
  padding-top: 56px;
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  position: relative;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-related::before {
  content: "◆";
  position: absolute;
  top: -8px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--paper);
  padding: 0 12px;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-related-title {
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-related-card {
  position: relative;
  padding: 26px 24px;
  border-radius: 18px;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 65%, transparent) 100%
    );

  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03),
    0 12px 32px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 12%, transparent);

  transition:
    transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-related-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 70%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent),
    0 16px 40px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-related-card h4 {
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-related-card:hover h4 {
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   12. AUTHOR BOX — accent ring on logo
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-page .blog-author {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 28px 30px;
  border-radius: 22px;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 62%, transparent) 100%
    );

  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 65%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 16px 40px -18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 14%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-author::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -40%;
  inset-inline-end: -25%;
  width: 60%;
  height: 80%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  filter: blur(30px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-author-mark {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 70%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent),
    0 12px 28px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
  font-weight: 800;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-author-btn--primary {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 70%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  );
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 1px 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.3),
    0 8px 22px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-author-btn--primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5),
    0 12px 32px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 68%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   13. INLINE CTA — premium mid-article funnel
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-page .blog-inline-cta {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 30px 28px;
  border-radius: 22px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 80% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 84%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 64%, transparent) 100%
    );

  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 70%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 20px 48px -18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-inline-cta::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -40%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 60%;
  height: 80%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  filter: blur(36px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-inline-cta-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 24%, transparent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-inline-cta-title {
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-inline-cta-btn {
  padding: 11px 24px;
  min-height: 46px;
  font-weight: 700;
  transition:
    transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    background 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-inline-cta-btn--primary {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 70%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  );
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 8px 22px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-inline-cta-btn--primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5),
    0 12px 32px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 68%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   14. END CTA (FUNNEL) — full upgrade
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-page .blog-funnel {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: clamp(40px, 5.5vw, 64px) clamp(26px, 4vw, 52px);
  border-radius: 28px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 80% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 86%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 66%, transparent) 100%
    );

  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 70%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 24px 56px -20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 32%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-funnel::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -40%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 70%;
  height: 90%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  filter: blur(44px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-funnel-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-funnel-title {
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.blog-post-page .blog-funnel-trust {
  border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
}

.blog-post-page .blog-funnel-trust-value {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--ink) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 70%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   15. READING PROGRESS — thick + glow
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.reading-progress {
  height: 4px !important;
}

.reading-progress-bar {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 70%, transparent) 0%,
    var(--accent) 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, #000) 100%
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 65%, transparent),
    0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 90%, transparent) !important;
  border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
  transition: width 0.08s linear !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   16. STAGGERED ENTRY
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@keyframes blogCardIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(14px);
    filter: blur(3px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    filter: blur(0);
  }
}

.blog-page .blog-card {
  animation: blogCardIn 640ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
}

.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 40ms; }
.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 120ms; }
.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 200ms; }
.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 280ms; }
.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 340ms; }
.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 400ms; }
.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 460ms; }
.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(8) { animation-delay: 520ms; }
.blog-page .blog-card:nth-child(n+9) { animation-delay: 560ms; }

.blog-page .blog-featured-card {
  animation: blogCardIn 760ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
}

.blog-page .blog-header {
  animation: blogCardIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
}

.blog-page .blog-tags-filter {
  animation: blogCardIn 640ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 120ms both;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   17. REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .blog-page .blog-card,
  .blog-page .blog-featured-card,
  .blog-page .blog-header,
  .blog-page .blog-tags-filter,
  .blog-page .blog-featured-badge::after {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .blog-page .blog-card:hover,
  .blog-page .blog-featured-card:hover,
  .blog-page .blog-tag-chip:hover,
  .blog-page .blog-tag-chip.active,
  .blog-page .blog-back-home:hover,
  .blog-post-page .blog-back-link:hover,
  .blog-post-page .blog-related-card:hover,
  .blog-post-page .blog-post-tags .blog-card-tag:hover,
  .blog-post-page .blog-inline-cta-btn:hover,
  .blog-post-page .blog-author-btn--primary:hover {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .blog-post-page .blog-post-content > p:first-of-type::first-letter {
    font-size: inherit;
    float: none;
    margin: 0;
    color: inherit;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   18. MOBILE — kill hover, keep light
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .blog-post-page .blog-post-content > p:first-of-type::first-letter {
    font-size: 2.6em;
    margin-inline-end: 8px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .blog-post-page .blog-post-content h2::before {
    transform: translateX(-12px);
    width: 2px;
  }

  .blog-post-page .blog-post-content blockquote {
    padding: 18px 20px;
    border-radius: 4px 16px 16px 4px;
  }

  .blog-post-page .blog-post-content pre {
    padding: 18px 18px 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }

  .blog-post-page .blog-post-content pre::before {
    top: 12px;
    inset-inline-start: 16px;
  }

  .blog-page .blog-tag-chip:hover,
  .blog-page .blog-card:hover,
  .blog-page .blog-featured-card:hover {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .blog-page .blog-tag-chip:active {
    transform: scale(0.96);
  }

  .blog-page .blog-card:active {
    transform: scale(0.99);
  }
}

@media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   BLOG ULTIMATE 2026 — EDITORIAL & IMMERSIVE
   ============================================================ */

/* Article Layout */
.blog-post-header {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto 4rem;
  text-align: center;
  padding-top: 8rem;
}
.blog-post-category {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}
.blog-post-title {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
  line-height: 1.1;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.blog-post-excerpt {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 65ch;
  margin: 0 auto;
}
.blog-post-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  margin-top: 2rem;
}

/* Reading Progress Bar */
.reading-progress-bar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--accent);
  transform-origin: 0 50%;
  z-index: 9999;
}

/* Main Content Grid */
.blog-post-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr min(65ch, 100%) 1fr;
  gap: 4rem;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 1rem;
}
.blog-post-content {
  grid-column: 2;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}
.blog-post-sidebar {
  grid-column: 3;
  position: sticky;
  top: 8rem;
  height: fit-content;
}

/* TOC */
.toc-container {

  padding-left: 1.5rem;
}
.toc-title {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.toc-list {

  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}
.toc-list li {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}
.toc-link {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  transition: color 0.2s;
}
.toc-link:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.toc-link.active {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* AI Actions & Share */
.blog-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin: 2rem 0;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.action-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: var(--surface-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  transition: all 0.2s;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.action-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

/* Code Block Copy Button */
.code-block-wrapper {
  position: relative;
}
.copy-code-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0.75rem;
  right: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.code-block-wrapper:hover .copy-code-btn {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Mobile Responsive */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .blog-post-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .blog-post-sidebar { display: none; }
  .blog-post-content { grid-column: 1; }
}
/* Shiki Code Block Styling */
.mdx-content figure[data-rehype-pretty-code-figure] {

}

}
.mdx-content [data-highlighted-line] {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);

}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
```

## FILE: src\styles\chapter-rail.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   CHAPTER RAIL — Vertical section navigator (v2)
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Editorial side rail with:
   - A glass pill container around the dots
   - Active label always visible (num + label + short)
   - Vertical line + dots
   - RTL-aware (rail on right, label on left)
   
   Desktop: fixed at start edge (RTL = right)
   Mobile:  horizontal pill above bottom nav
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  --rail-edge: 20px;
  --rail-box-width: 40px;
  --rail-gap: 20px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RAIL WRAPPER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.chapter-rail {
  position: fixed;
  top: 50%;
  inset-inline-start: var(--rail-edge);
  transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(16px);
  z-index: 85;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  flex-direction: row-reverse; /* label on left, box on right (RTL) */

  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition:
    opacity 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

.chapter-rail.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0);
  pointer-events: auto;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ACTIVE LABEL — always visible
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.chapter-rail-active {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 14px 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;

  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 8px 24px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.18);

  white-space: nowrap;
  animation: chapter-rail-label 420ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

@keyframes chapter-rail-label {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(6px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

.chapter-rail-active-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--accent);
  direction: ltr;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.chapter-rail-active-label {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.chapter-rail-active-short {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.55;
  direction: ltr;
  padding-inline-start: 6px;
  border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin-inline-start: 2px;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GLASS BOX — around the dots
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.chapter-rail-box {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 12px 0;
  width: var(--rail-box-width);
  border-radius: 999px;

  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.5);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 45%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -16px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.22);
}

/* ─── Vertical line behind dots ─── */
.chapter-rail-line {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  top: 24px;
  bottom: 24px;
  width: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 15%, transparent) 12%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 15%, transparent) 88%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LIST
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.chapter-rail-list {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--rail-gap);
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.chapter-rail-item-wrap {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DOT BUTTON
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.chapter-rail-item {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 50%;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.chapter-rail-item:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

/* ─── Dot ─── */
.chapter-rail-dot {
  display: block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 22%, transparent);
  transition:
    width 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    height 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    background-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

/* ─── Hover ─── */
.chapter-rail-item.is-hovered .chapter-rail-dot {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
  transform: scale(1.25);
}

/* ─── Active ─── */
.chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, transparent),
    0 0 14px -2px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MOBILE — horizontal pill above bottom nav
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .chapter-rail {
    top: auto;
    bottom: calc(90px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    inset-inline-start: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(12px);
    max-width: calc(100% - 24px);

    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .chapter-rail.is-visible {
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  }

  /* Hide long label on mobile — too much */
  .chapter-rail-active {
    padding: 6px 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-active-label {
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-active-short {
    display: none;
  }

  .chapter-rail-box {
    flex-direction: row;
    width: auto;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    border-radius: 999px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-line {
    display: none;
  }

  .chapter-rail-list {
    flex-direction: row;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-item {
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-dot {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
    width: 9px;
    height: 9px;
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent),
      0 0 10px -1px var(--accent-glow);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   VERY SMALL MOBILE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .chapter-rail {
    bottom: calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  .chapter-rail-box {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-item {
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-dot {
    width: 5px;
    height: 5px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-active {
    padding: 5px 10px;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-active-num {
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .chapter-rail-active-label {
    font-size: 10.5px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .chapter-rail,
  .chapter-rail-item,
  .chapter-rail-dot,
  .chapter-rail-active {
    transition: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PRINT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media print {
  .chapter-rail {
    display: none !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   COMMITMENTS SECTION — Trust building
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   6 commitment cards, honest and specific
   ============================================================ */

.commitments-section {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.commitments-section::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 10% 20%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent),
    transparent 45%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MASTHEAD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.commitments-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.commitments-masthead-left,
.commitments-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.commitments-masthead-center {
  font-size: 14px;
  opacity: 0.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GRID
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.commitments-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CARD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.commitment-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 30px);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  transition:
    border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--c-index, 0) * 60ms);
}

.commitment-card:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, var(--line));
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04),
    0 16px 40px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.12);
}

.commitment-card-icon svg {
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   CONTACT LINKS — Editorial Contact Cards
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Two variants:
   - .contact-links-grid — 3 elegant cards (Footer, Final CTA)
   - .contact-links-inline — horizontal text list (subtle)
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GRID VARIANT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.contact-links-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.contact-card {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 64px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, var(--paper-2)) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 80%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  transition:
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

/* Accent border glow on hover */
.contact-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  z-index: 1;
}

.contact-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 12px 28px -12px var(--accent-glow);
}

.contact-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* ─── Primary (SMS) ─── */
.contact-card--primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    #0a0908 0%,
    #211c18 55%,
    #0a0908 100%
  );
  border-color: transparent;
  color: #fff9f4;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12),
    0 8px 22px -10px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42);
}

.contact-card--primary .contact-card-label {
  color: #fff9f4;
}

.contact-card--primary .contact-card-value {
  color: rgba(255, 249, 244, 0.72);
}

.contact-card--primary .contact-card-icon {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  color: #fff9f4;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}

.contact-card--primary .contact-card-arrow {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.contact-card--primary:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
    0 16px 40px -12px var(--accent-glow);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .contact-card--primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  color: #fff;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .contact-card--primary:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent-2) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 70%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
}

/* ─── Icon ─── */
.contact-card-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition:
    background-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.contact-card-icon svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
}

.contact-card:hover .contact-card-icon {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--accent);
  transform: scale(1.06) rotate(-3deg);
}

/* ─── Body ─── */
.contact-card-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.contact-card-label {
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.contact-card-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  line-height: 1.3;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

/* ─── Arrow ─── */
.contact-card-arrow {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.contact-card:hover .contact-card-arrow {
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-4px) translateY(-1px);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   INLINE VARIANT — horizontal minimal list
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.contact-links-inline {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.contact-link-inline {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 80%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition:
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.contact-link-inline:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.contact-link-inline-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.contact-link-inline-icon svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .contact-links-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .contact-card {
    min-height: 60px;
    padding: 11px 13px;
    gap: 11px;
  }

  .contact-card-icon {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    border-radius: 10px;
  }

  .contact-card-icon svg {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
  }

  .contact-card-label {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }

  .contact-card-value {
    font-size: 0.625rem;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .contact-card,
  .contact-card::before,
  .contact-card-icon,
  .contact-card-arrow,
  .contact-link-inline {
    transition: none !important;
  }

  .contact-card:hover,

}
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

## FILE: src\styles\count-up.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   COUNT UP — Visual polish for animated numbers
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Adds subtle visual treatment to numbers that count up:
   - Tabular nums (so digits don't jiggle during animation)
   - Slight letter-spacing during animation
   - Amber glow accent on the animating span
   ============================================================ */

.about-proof-count {
  display: inline-block;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  line-height: 1;
  min-width: 1ch;
  transition: color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.about-proof-count[data-counting="true"] {
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Subtle pulse when counting finishes
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@keyframes proof-count-finish {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1.04);
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

.about-proof-count.is-finished {
  animation: proof-count-finish 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Reduced motion — kill any animation
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .about-proof-count {
    transition: none !important;
  }
  .about-proof-count.is-finished {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}
```


## FILE: src\styles\density-standardization.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   DENSITY STANDARDIZATION — 2026 Global Standard
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Problem: site felt "everything is too big"
   Solution: scale down the whole system ~20% to match
             Vercel / Linear / Framer / Stripe baselines.
   
   - Body text:      17-18px → 15-16px
   - Hero title:     80px    → 60px
   - Section pad:    140px   → 104px
   - Line-height:    1.85    → 1.70
   - Mobile root:    17px    → 16px
   - Reading width:  75ch    → 66ch (Persian-optimized)
   
   Loaded LAST in layout.tsx — wins every cascade.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. TOKENS — override the entire type + space scale
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root {
  /* ── Font sizes (~15-20% tighter) ── */
  --fs-micro:   clamp(0.625rem,   0.61rem   + 0.0625vw, 0.6875rem); /* 10 → 11 */
  --fs-mono:    clamp(0.625rem,   0.61rem   + 0.1vw,    0.75rem);    /* 10 → 12 */
  --fs-small:   clamp(0.75rem,    0.74rem   + 0.05vw,   0.8125rem);  /* 12 → 13 */
  --fs-body:    clamp(0.875rem,   0.86rem   + 0.1vw,    1rem);       /* 14 → 16 */
  --fs-h3:      clamp(1.125rem,   1.08rem   + 0.25vw,   1.5rem);     /* 18 → 24 */
  --fs-h2:      clamp(1.5rem,     1.35rem   + 0.85vw,   2.5rem);     /* 24 → 40 */
  --fs-h1:      clamp(1.75rem,    1.4rem    + 1.75vw,   3rem);       /* 28 → 48 */
  --fs-display: clamp(2.25rem,    1.7rem    + 2.75vw,   4.5rem);     /* 36 → 72 */

  /* ── Line heights (tighter, more standard) ── */
  --lh-display: 1.05;
  --lh-h1:      1.10;
  --lh-h2:      1.15;
  --lh-h3:      1.28;
  --lh-body:    1.70;
  --lh-small:   1.55;
  --lh-tight:   1.28;

  /* ── Space scale (~20% tighter) ── */
  --space-1:  clamp(0.25rem,   0.245rem + 0.025vw, 0.28125rem);
  --space-2:  clamp(0.5rem,    0.49rem  + 0.05vw,  0.5625rem);
  --space-3:  clamp(0.6875rem, 0.67rem  + 0.1vw,   0.8125rem);
  --space-4:  clamp(0.875rem,  0.85rem  + 0.15vw,  1.0625rem);
  --space-5:  clamp(1.125rem,  1.09rem  + 0.2vw,   1.3125rem);
  --space-6:  clamp(1.375rem,  1.33rem  + 0.25vw,  1.5625rem);
  --space-7:  clamp(1.75rem,   1.69rem  + 0.35vw,  2rem);
  --space-8:  clamp(2rem,      1.93rem  + 0.4vw,   2.5rem);
  --space-9:  clamp(2.5rem,    2.4rem   + 0.5vw,   3rem);
  --space-10: clamp(3rem,      2.88rem  + 0.6vw,   3.75rem);
  --space-11: clamp(4rem,      3.84rem  + 0.8vw,   5rem);
  --space-12: clamp(5.5rem,    5.28rem  + 1.1vw,   7rem);

  /* ── Hero-specific scale ── */
  --hero-display:    clamp(1.75rem,  1.15rem + 3vw,   3.75rem);
  --hero-display-lh: 1.12;
  --hero-role:       clamp(0.9375rem, 0.9rem + 0.2vw, 1.0625rem);
  --hero-role-lh:    1.5;
  --hero-desc:       clamp(0.875rem, 0.85rem + 0.15vw, 0.9375rem);
  --hero-desc-lh:    1.75;
  --hero-cta:        clamp(0.875rem, 0.85rem + 0.1vw,  0.9375rem);
  --hero-eyebrow:    clamp(0.625rem, 0.6rem  + 0.05vw, 0.6875rem);
  --hero-meta:       clamp(0.5625rem, 0.55rem + 0.05vw, 0.625rem);

  /* ── Reading widths (Persian-optimized) ── */
  --reading:        58ch;
  --reading-wide:   66ch;
  --reading-narrow: 44ch;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.section {
```
