## FILE: src\styles\editorial-structure.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   EDITORIAL STRUCTURE — Magazine System
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   - Big section numerals (۰۱، ۰۲، ۰۳)
   - Pull quotes with editorial line
   - Figure captions (magazine style)
   - Ornamental section dividers
   - Editorial meta rows
   No changes to existing typography sizes.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. SECTION NUMBER — numeral + label + rule
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.section-num {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.section-num-figure {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}

.section-num-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  direction: ltr;
  display: inline-block;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
}

.section-num-rule {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: block;
  width: clamp(40px, 6vw, 80px);
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  border-radius: 1px;
}

.section-num-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.8;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ─── Layout integration: وقتی SectionNumber بالای heading هست ─── */
.section-heading .section-num,
.why-header .section-num {
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

/* ─── Mobile: کوچک‌تر ─── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .section-num-value {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 9vw, 3rem);
  }

  .section-num-rule {
    width: 40px;
    height: 1.5px;
  }

  .section-num-label {
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. EDITORIAL DIVIDER — ✦ ✦ ✦
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.editorial-divider {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 20px;
  margin: clamp(56px, 7vw, 88px) auto;
  max-width: 720px;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.editorial-divider::before,
.editorial-divider::after {
  content: "";
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

.editorial-divider::before {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 100%
  );
}

.editorial-divider::after {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

.editorial-divider-mark {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.5em;
  color: var(--accent);
  padding-inline-start: 0.5em;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. FIGURE & CAPTION — magazine style
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.editorial-figure {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-block: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
}

.editorial-figure img,
.editorial-figure picture,
.editorial-figure video {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.editorial-caption {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 14px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.editorial-caption::before {
  content: "—";
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.editorial-caption strong {
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. PULL QUOTE — برجسته‌تر از blockquote معمولی
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.editorial-pullquote {
  position: relative;
  margin: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px) auto;
  padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
  max-width: 720px;
  border-radius: 4px 20px 20px 4px;
  border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--accent);
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 3%, transparent) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 8px 28px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}

.editorial-pullquote p {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font-display, inherit);
  font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.9vw, 1.5rem);
  line-height: 1.55;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: pretty;
  font-style: italic;
}

.editorial-pullquote cite {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding-top: 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-style: normal;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ─── Mark روی گوشه ─── */
.editorial-pullquote::before {
  content: "\201C";
  position: absolute;
  top: 8px;
  inset-inline-end: 20px;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: clamp(56px, 7vw, 88px);
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.15;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. EDITORIAL META ROW — بالای بخش‌ها
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.editorial-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px 24px;
  padding: 14px 0;
  margin-bottom: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.editorial-meta-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.editorial-meta-item::before {
  content: "";
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.editorial-meta-item:first-child::before {
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. SIDE NOTE — Margin note (desktop only)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.editorial-aside {
  position: relative;
  float: inline-end;
  clear: inline-end;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 240px;
  margin-inline-start: 32px;
  margin-block-end: 24px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--accent);
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.editorial-aside-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.5625rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  direction: ltr;
}

/* روی موبایل به block تبدیل می‌شه */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .editorial-aside {
    float: none;
    max-width: 100%;
    margin-inline: 0;
    margin-block: 24px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. BLOG POST — تزریق خودکار در مقاله
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Drop Cap فقط برای مقالات با محتوای Latin */
.blog-post-content[data-lang="en"] > p:first-of-type::first-letter {
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: 4em;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 0.85;
  float: right;
  margin-inline-end: 10px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  color: var(--accent);
  padding: 2px 8px 2px 0;
}

/* برای فارسی، هیچ drop cap نمی‌ذاریم — چون حروف متصل هستن */

/* ─── شماره‌گذاری H2 در مقالات ─── */
.blog-post-content h2 {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
}

.blog-post-content h2::before {
  content: counter(h2-counter, persian) " ·";
  counter-increment: h2-counter;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.65em;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.75;
  transform: translateY(-0.08em);
}

.blog-post-content {
  counter-reset: h2-counter;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .section-num-value,
  .editorial-pullquote,
  .editorial-divider,
  .editorial-caption {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}
```

/* ============================================================
   ENHANCEMENTS — All batches and overrides
   ⚠️ This file preserves the exact cascade order of globals.css

   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================

   ============================================================ */

.service-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);

  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--accent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.service-icon svg {

  height: 18px;
}

}

.service-features {

  margin-top: 22px;

}

.service-feature {

  gap: 10px;

}

.service-feature::before {

  height: 5px;
  margin-top: 9px;
  border-radius: 50%;

}

.service-meta {

  gap: 20px 32px;
  margin-top: 22px;

}

.service-meta-item {

}

.service-meta-item span {

}

}

.portfolio-card-caption-text {

}

.portfolio-card-subtitle {

}

.portfolio-card-view {

  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;

    opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-view,

.portfolio-footer {

}

.project-modal-shell {
  position: relative;

.project-modal-nav-btn {

}

.project-modal-nav-btn:hover:not([disabled]) {

/* ============================================================
   BATCH 4 — Hero redesign, Theme toggle v2, Order fixes
   ============================================================ */

}

}

.hero-title-accent::after {
  content: "";

  inset-inline: -6px;
  bottom: 0.08em;

  background: var(--accent);

.hero-signature {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  width: auto;
  opacity: 1;
}

.hero-signature-mark {
  display: block;
  width: clamp(90px, 10vw, 140px);
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.hero-signature-mark svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.hero-signature-name {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.hero-signature-name strong {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.hero-signature-name small {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero-signature-mark {
    width: 80px;
  }
  .hero-signature-name strong {
    font-size: 12px;
  }
}

.hero-name {
  display: none;
}

.theme-toggle {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.theme-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.theme-toggle:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.96);
}

.theme-toggle-inner {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
}

.theme-icon {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  transition:
    opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-spring);
}

.theme-icon-sun {
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 1;
  transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
}

.theme-icon-moon {
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: rotate(-90deg) scale(0.6);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .theme-icon-sun {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: rotate(90deg) scale(0.6);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .theme-icon-moon {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint);
}

.order-page {
  min-height: 100svh;
  padding-block: clamp(90px, 11vw, 120px) 80px;
  scroll-margin-top: 80px;
}

.order-success-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .order-success-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
  .order-success-actions .button {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   BATCH 4.2 — Order page fixes
   ============================================================ */

.order-page {
  min-height: auto;
  padding-block: clamp(88px, 10vw, 120px) 60px;
  scroll-margin-top: 80px;
}

.order-header {
  max-width: 820px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px);
}

.order-header .order-back {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.order-header .section-index {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.order-header h1 {
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 46px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.12;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}

.order-header p {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin-top: 14px;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.85;
}

.order-success-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.order-success-actions .button {
  min-height: 52px;
  padding-inline: 26px;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .order-page {
    padding-top: 100px;
  }

  .order-header {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .order-header .order-back {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .order-success-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
  .order-success-actions .button {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   BATCH 4.3 — Hero scale, Scroll indicator, Custom scrollbar
   ============================================================ */

.hero-section {
  padding-block: clamp(110px, 13vw, 150px) clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
}

.hero-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.06;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
}

.hero-title-line {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(32px, 5.5vw, 60px);
}

.hero-title-line + .hero-title-line {
  margin-top: 0.05em;
}

.hero-title-accent::after {
  inset-inline: -4px;
  bottom: 0.06em;
  height: 0.05em;
  opacity: 0.32;
}

.hero-top {
  margin-bottom: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 32px);
}

.hero-role {
  margin-top: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 34px);
  font-size: clamp(15px, 1.5vw, 19px);
  padding: 8px 16px;
}

.hero-description {
  margin-top: 20px;
  font-size: clamp(14px, 1.05vw, 16px);
  line-height: 1.85;
}

.hero-actions {
  margin-top: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px);
}

.hero-footer {
  margin-top: clamp(44px, 5vw, 68px);
  padding-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 32px);
}

.hero-scroll {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: clamp(18px, 2.6vw, 32px);
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 3;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: heroScrollIn 1s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 1.6s forwards;
}

@keyframes heroScrollIn {
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

.hero-scroll-text {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.hero-scroll-line {
  display: block;
  width: 1px;
  height: 44px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, var(--line-strong));
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-scroll-line::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  top: 0;
  height: 36%;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 1px;
  animation: scrollLinePulse 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes scrollLinePulse {
  0%   { transform: translateY(-120%); opacity: 0; }
  15%  { opacity: 1; }
  85%  { opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translateY(280%); opacity: 0; }
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero-scroll {
    display: none;
  }
}

* {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: var(--accent) var(--paper-2);
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
  border-radius: 8px;
  border: 3px solid var(--paper-2);
  background-clip: content-box;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent));
  background-clip: content-box;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:active {
  background: var(--accent);
  background-clip: content-box;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-corner {
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-scroll {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 1;
  }
  .hero-scroll-line::after {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0.5;
    transform: translateY(50%);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   BATCH 4.4 — Hero title definitive small size
   ============================================================ */

.hero-section .hero-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.12;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.hero-section .hero-title .hero-title-line {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 42px);
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.hero-section .hero-title .hero-title-line + .hero-title-line {
  margin-top: 0.1em;
}

.hero-section .hero-title .hero-title-accent {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}

.hero-section .hero-title .hero-title-accent::after {
  inset-inline: -3px;
  bottom: 0.06em;
  height: 0.05em;
  opacity: 0.3;
}

.hero-section .hero-name {
  display: none;
}

.hero-section .hero-name-line {
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 42px);
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.hero-section .hero-top {
  margin-bottom: clamp(18px, 2.2vw, 28px);
}

.hero-section .hero-role {
  margin-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 30px);
  font-size: clamp(14px, 1.4vw, 17px);
  padding: 7px 14px;
}

.hero-section .hero-description {
  margin-top: 18px;
  max-width: 520px;
  font-size: clamp(13.5px, 1vw, 15.5px);
  line-height: 1.85;
}

.hero-section .hero-actions {
  margin-top: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 30px);
}

.hero-section .hero-footer {
  margin-top: clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 60px);
  padding-top: clamp(18px, 2.2vw, 28px);
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title .hero-title-line,
  .hero-section .hero-name-line {
    font-size: clamp(24px, 6.5vw, 34px);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title .hero-title-line,
  .hero-section .hero-name-line {
    font-size: clamp(22px, 7vw, 30px);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   MOBILE BOTTOM NAVIGATION — from globals.css
   ============================================================ */

.mobile-nav {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  body {
    padding-bottom: calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  .nav-order-button {
    display: none;
  }

  .mobile-nav {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    bottom: calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 90;
    width: calc(100% - 24px);
    max-width: 460px;
    padding: 6px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    box-shadow:
      0 12px 40px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.22),
      0 2px 8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
      inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent);
    transition:
      transform 320ms var(--ease-out),
      opacity 320ms var(--ease-out);
    will-change: transform;
  }

  .mobile-nav.is-hidden {
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(24px);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .mobile-nav-list {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 2px;
    position: relative;
  }

  .mobile-nav-list > li {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3px;
    padding: 8px 4px 6px;
    min-height: 52px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    color: var(--ink-3);
    text-decoration: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    position: relative;
    transition:
      color 200ms var(--ease-out),
      background-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
      transform 200ms var(--ease-out);
  }

  .mobile-nav-item:active {
    transform: scale(0.94);
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active {
    color: var(--accent);
    background: var(--accent-soft);
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 2px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 4px;
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--accent);
    animation: navDotIn 300ms var(--spring) both;
  }

  @keyframes navDotIn {
    from {
      transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0);
      opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
      transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1);
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 22px;
    height: 22px;
    transition: transform 250ms var(--ease-out);
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active .mobile-nav-icon {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }

  .mobile-nav-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta-wrap {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding-inline-start: 5px;
    margin-inline-start: 3px;
    border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3px;
    padding: 8px 16px 6px;
    min-height: 52px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--paper);
    text-decoration: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
      transform 220ms var(--ease-out),
      box-shadow 220ms var(--ease-out);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      transparent 0%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) 50%,
      transparent 100%
    );
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta:active {
    transform: scale(0.94);
    background: var(--accent);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -8px var(--accent);
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta-icon {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta-icon svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta .mobile-nav-label {
    color: inherit;
    font-size: 10px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .mobile-nav {
    width: calc(100% - 16px);
    padding: 5px;
    bottom: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  .mobile-nav-item {
    padding: 7px 2px 5px;
    min-height: 50px;
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
  }

  .mobile-nav-label {
    font-size: 9.5px;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta {
    padding: 7px 12px 5px;
    min-height: 50px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 340px) {
  .mobile-nav-cta .mobile-nav-label {
    display: none;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta {
    padding: 7px 14px;
    min-width: 52px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .back-top {
    bottom: calc(92px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    inset-inline-end: 16px;
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    z-index: 85;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .order-page {
    padding-bottom: calc(120px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  .site-footer {
    padding-bottom: 40px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  [data-theme="dark"] .mobile-nav {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 78%, transparent);
    border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line-strong) 60%, transparent);
    box-shadow:
      0 12px 40px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
      0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mobile-nav-cta {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mobile-nav-cta:active {
    background: var(--accent-2);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mobile-nav,
  .mobile-nav-item,
  .mobile-nav-cta,
  .mobile-nav-icon {
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav.is-hidden {
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active::after {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   MOBILE — Section-by-Section Optimization
   ============================================================ */

    width: min(calc(100% - 32px), var(--container));
  }

  .hero-title-line {

  .hero-description {

  .hero-footer {

  .hero-signature {

@media (max-width: 900px) {

  }

  .services-list {

  }

  .service-item {

  .service-item .service-icon {

  .service-number {

  .service-preview-top {

  }

  .service-preview-content {

  .service-preview-label {

  .service-preview-content h3 {

  .service-preview-content p {

  .service-features {

/* ============================================================
   PERFORMANCE — Lazy skeleton + image optimization hints
   ============================================================ */

.lazy-skeleton-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.lazy-skeleton-card {
  grid-column: span 6;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--paper-2) 0%,
    var(--surface) 50%,
    var(--paper-2) 100%
  );
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: lazyShimmer 1.6s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.lazy-skeleton-card:nth-child(3) {
  grid-column: span 12;
  aspect-ratio: 21 / 9;
}

@keyframes lazyShimmer {
  0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .lazy-skeleton-card,
  .lazy-skeleton-card:nth-child(3) {
    grid-column: span 12;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  }
}

img {
  image-rendering: auto;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .why-section,
  .cta-final,
  .site-footer {
    content-visibility: auto;
    contain-intrinsic-size: auto 600px;
  }
}

.hero-orb,
.hero-role-dot,
.mobile-nav,
.mobile-nav-cta::before {
  transform: translateZ(0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

.fonts-loading * {
  font-synthesis: none;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .hero-section,
  .services-section,
  .portfolio-section,
  .about-section {
    will-change: auto;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .nav-order-button,
  .mobile-nav-cta {
    contain: layout;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   MICRO-INTERACTIONS — Every touch feels alive
   ============================================================ */

@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
  button,
  a,
  [role="button"],
  .btn,
  .nav-order-button,
  .service-item,
  .portfolio-card,
  .project-type-option,
  .contact-method {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      transform 120ms var(--ease-out),
      opacity 120ms var(--ease-out);
  }

  button:active,
  a:active,
  [role="button"]:active,
  .btn:active,
  .nav-order-button:active {
    transform: scale(0.96);
    opacity: 0.92;
  }
}

.btn {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.btn::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at var(--x, 50%) var(--y, 50%),
    color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 22%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 45%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out);
  z-index: -1;
}

.btn:hover::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

.btn-primary {
  transition:
    transform 250ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.btn > span[aria-hidden="true"],
.btn > svg:last-child {
  transition: transform 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.btn:hover > span[aria-hidden="true"],
.btn:hover > svg:last-child {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
}

.btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98);
  transition-duration: 80ms;
}

.btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  transition:
    outline-offset 200ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

a:not(.btn):not(.brand):not(.nav-link):not(.mobile-nav-item):not(.mobile-nav-cta):not(.portfolio-card):not(.service-item) {
  position: relative;
}

.desktop-nav a {
  transition:
    color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 200ms var(--ease-out);
}

.desktop-nav a::after {
  transition: width 320ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item {
  transition:
    color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 350ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 350ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item:hover {
  transform: translateX(-4px) scale(1.005);
}

.service-item .service-chev {
  transition:
    transform 350ms var(--spring),
    color 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item.is-active .service-chev {
  transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1.1);
}

.service-preview {
  transition:
    border-color 400ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-preview:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.portfolio-card {
  transition: transform 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.portfolio-card-visual {
  transition:
    transform 500ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 500ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: 0 32px 70px -24px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.24);
}

.portfolio-card-arrow {
  transition:
    background-color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 350ms var(--spring);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-arrow {
  transform: rotate(-45deg) scale(1.08);
}

.portfolio-card-category {
  transition: color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-category {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.portfolio-card-view {
  transition:
    opacity 350ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 350ms var(--ease-out);
}

.form-field input,
.form-field textarea {
  transition:
    border-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 320ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 220ms var(--ease-out);
}

.form-field input:focus,
.form-field textarea:focus {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint),
    0 6px 24px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}

.project-type-option,
.contact-method {
  transition:
    border-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 250ms var(--spring);
}

.project-type-option:hover,
.contact-method:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.project-type-option.is-selected,
.contact-method.is-selected {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint),
    0 8px 20px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}

.project-type-option input,
.contact-method input,
.form-checkbox input {
  transition: transform 200ms var(--spring);
}

.project-type-option.is-selected input,
.contact-method.is-selected input {
  transform: scale(1.15);
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .mobile-nav-item {
    transition:
      color 220ms var(--ease-out),
      background-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
      transform 200ms var(--spring);
  }

  .mobile-nav-item:active {
    transform: scale(0.9);
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon {
    transition: transform 300ms var(--spring);
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active .mobile-nav-icon {
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.05);
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta {
    transition:
      background-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
      transform 220ms var(--spring),
      box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-out);
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta:active {
    transform: scale(0.9);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint),
      0 12px 32px -8px var(--accent);
  }
}

.theme-toggle {
  transition:
    border-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 320ms var(--spring);
}

.theme-toggle:active {
  transform: scale(0.9) rotate(-15deg);
}

.theme-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  transition: transform 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(24px);
  filter: blur(4px);
  transition:
    opacity 800ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 900ms var(--ease-out),
    filter 800ms var(--ease-out);
}

.reveal.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  filter: blur(0);
}

.portfolio-grid .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0ms; }
.portfolio-grid .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 80ms; }
.portfolio-grid .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 160ms; }
.portfolio-grid .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 240ms; }
.portfolio-grid .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 320ms; }
.portfolio-grid .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 400ms; }

.about-principles-grid .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0ms; }
.about-principles-grid .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 100ms; }
.about-principles-grid .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 200ms; }

.why-list .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0ms; }
.why-list .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 100ms; }
.why-list .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 200ms; }

.section {
  transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.project-modal {
  transition:
    opacity 300ms var(--ease-out),
    visibility 300ms;
}

.project-modal-shell {
  transition:
    transform 380ms var(--ease-out),
    opacity 380ms var(--ease-out);
}

.project-modal-nav-btn {
  transition:
    background-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 200ms var(--spring);
}

.project-modal-nav-btn:hover:not([disabled]) {
  transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.05);
}

.project-modal-nav-btn:active:not([disabled]) {
  transform: scale(0.94);
}

.icon-btn {
  transition:
    background-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 300ms var(--spring);
}

.icon-btn:hover {
  transform: rotate(8deg) scale(1.05);
}

.icon-btn:active {
  transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(0.94);
}

.back-top {
  transition:
    background-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 320ms var(--spring),
    opacity 320ms var(--ease-out);
}

.back-top:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.05);
}

.back-top:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.94);
}

.brand-mark {
  transition:
    background-color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 350ms var(--spring);
}

.brand:hover .brand-mark {
  transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.05);
}

.hero-role {
  transition: background-color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-role-text {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: roleSlideIn 500ms var(--spring);
}

@keyframes roleSlideIn {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.95);
  }
  60% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

.footer-nav a {
  position: relative;
  transition:
    color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    padding-inline-start 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.footer-nav a::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 50%;
  width: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--accent);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  transition: width 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.footer-nav a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  padding-inline-start: 12px;
}

.footer-nav a:hover::before {
  width: 8px;
}

.form-submit-row .btn[type="submit"] {
  transition:
    background-color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.form-submit-row .btn[type="submit"]:not([disabled]):hover {
  box-shadow:
    0 16px 40px -12px var(--accent-glow),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
}

.toast {
  transition:
    transform 350ms var(--spring),
    opacity 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .btn:hover,
  .service-item:hover,
  .portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual,
  .portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-arrow,
  .icon-btn:hover,
  .back-top:hover,
  .brand:hover .brand-mark,
  .theme-toggle:hover,
  .mobile-nav-item.is-active .mobile-nav-icon {
    transform: none;
  }

  .btn::after {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-role-text {
    animation: none;
  }

  .portfolio-grid .reveal,
  .about-principles-grid .reveal,
  .why-list .reveal {
    transition-delay: 0ms !important;
  }
}

/* ⏸️ پایان بخش ۱ — بخش ۲ در پیام بعدی *//* ============================================================
   VISUAL POLISH — Refined details everywhere
   ============================================================ */

h1, h2, h3, .section-title, .hero-title {
  text-wrap: balance;
}

p, li, .body {
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.section-title,
.hero-title {
  letter-spacing: -0.032em;
}

.service-num,
.why-num,
.principle-num,
.hero-meta-value,
.stat-value {
  font-feature-settings: "tnum", "zero";
}

body[dir="rtl"] h1,
body[dir="rtl"] h2,
body[dir="rtl"] h3 {
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.service-preview,
.about-statement,
.final-cta-aside,
.price-card,
.testimonial,
.project-modal-shell {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent),
    0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 2%, transparent);
}

.portfolio-card-canvas {
  position: relative;
}

.portfolio-card-canvas::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent);
  z-index: 3;
}

.form-field input,
.form-field textarea {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 70%, transparent);
}

.form-field input:hover:not(:focus),
.form-field textarea:hover:not(:focus) {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual {
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 4px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
    0 12px 32px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.12),
    0 32px 72px -24px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.18);
}

.btn-primary {
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
    0 8px 24px -8px var(--accent-glow);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
    0 16px 40px -10px var(--accent-glow),
    0 6px 16px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}

.services-section::before {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 90% 10%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent),
      transparent 45%
    ),
    var(--paper-2);
}

.why-section::before {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 10% 90%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent),
      transparent 45%
    ),
    var(--paper-2);
}

.final-cta {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 80% 60% at 30% 20%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 50% at 80% 80%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 5%, transparent),
      transparent 60%
    ),
    var(--glass-strong);
}

.about-statement {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 100% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent),
      transparent 40%
    ),
    var(--glass);
}

.hero-section::before {
  animation: heroOrbFloat 24s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes heroOrbFloat {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }
  50% {
    transform: translate(-20px, 20px) scale(1.05);
    opacity: 0.5;
  }
}

.portfolio-card-canvas img,
.project-modal-visual img {
  filter: saturate(1.02) contrast(1.01);
  transition: filter 500ms var(--ease-out);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-canvas img {
  filter: saturate(1.05) contrast(1.03);
}

.portfolio-card-chrome {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 100%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 92%, var(--surface)) 100%
    );
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 80%, transparent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent);
}

.portfolio-card-chrome-dots span {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent);
}

.btn-primary {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 100%, #fff 4%) 0%,
      var(--accent) 100%
    );
}

.btn-primary:hover {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 100%, #fff 4%) 0%,
      var(--accent-2) 100%
    );
}

.btn-secondary {
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent);
}

.section-index::before {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint),
    0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
}

.hero-title-accent::after,
.section-title em::after {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      var(--accent) 15%,
      var(--accent) 85%,
      transparent 100%
    );
  opacity: 0.45;
}

.hero-eyebrow-dot {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 40%, transparent);
}

.site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--glass-strong) 100%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--glass-strong) 96%, var(--ink)) 100%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent),
    0 8px 24px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08);
}

.brand-mark {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      145deg,
      var(--accent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
    0 4px 12px -4px var(--accent-glow);
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .mobile-nav {
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 100%
      );
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent),
      0 2px 4px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
      0 12px 40px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.22);
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta {
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        145deg,
        var(--ink) 0%,
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 88%, var(--accent)) 100%
      );
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
      0 4px 12px -4px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.3);
  }
}

*:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint);
}

button:focus-visible,
a:focus-visible {
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--accent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
    );
  border: 3px solid var(--paper-2);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background-clip: content-box;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--accent-2) 0%,
      var(--accent-2) 100%
    );
  background-clip: content-box;
}

.project-modal {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 50%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 82%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 94%, transparent) 100%
    );
}

.service-preview {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 100% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent),
      transparent 40%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 0% 100%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 4%, transparent),
      transparent 40%
    ),
    var(--glass);
}

.service-preview::before {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 65%
    );
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.portfolio-card-caption {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, var(--paper-2)) 100%
    );
}

.why-item {
  position: relative;
}

.why-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 32px;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: 2px;
  height: 24px;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.why-item:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.stat-value,
.hero-meta-value {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--ink) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 80%, var(--accent)) 100%
    );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}

.final-cta::before {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 60% 80% at 100% 100%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    );
  opacity: 1;
  inset: 0;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  transform: none;
}

.site-loader {
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 40%,
      var(--paper) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 94%, var(--paper-2)) 100%
    );
}

::selection {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 90%, transparent);
  color: #fff;
}

a {
  transition: color 200ms var(--ease-out);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-section::before {
    animation: none;
  }

  .why-item::before {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   SIGNATURE EDITION — Scroll progress, theme morph, stagger
   ============================================================ */

.scroll-progress {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline: 0;
  height: 2px;
  z-index: 9999;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 60%, transparent);
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.scroll-progress.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
}

.scroll-progress-bar {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  transform-origin: right center;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 50%, transparent),
    0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 80%, transparent);
  transition: transform 100ms linear;
  will-change: transform;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .scroll-progress {
    height: 2.5px;
  }
}

html.is-theme-morphing,
html.is-theme-morphing *,
html.is-theme-morphing *::before,
html.is-theme-morphing *::after {
  transition:
    background-color 380ms var(--ease-out),
    color 380ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 380ms var(--ease-out),
    fill 380ms var(--ease-out),
    stroke 380ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 380ms var(--ease-out) !important;
}

.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(28px);
  filter: blur(6px);
  transition:
    opacity 900ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 1000ms var(--ease-out),
    filter 900ms var(--ease-out);
  will-change: opacity, transform, filter;
}

.reveal.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  filter: blur(0);
  will-change: auto;
}

.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 70ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 140ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 210ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 280ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 350ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 420ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: 490ms; }

.services-list .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0ms; }
.services-list .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 60ms; }
.services-list .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 120ms; }
.services-list .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 180ms; }

.why-list .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0ms; }
.why-list .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 90ms; }
.why-list .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 180ms; }

.about-principles-grid .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0ms; }
.about-principles-grid .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 100ms; }
.about-principles-grid .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 200ms; }

.section {
  position: relative;
}

@keyframes sectionBreath {
  0% { opacity: 0.98; }
  50% { opacity: 1; }
  100% { opacity: 0.98; }
}

.btn-primary .arrow,
.btn-primary span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform 320ms var(--ease-spring);
}

.btn-primary:hover .arrow,
.btn-primary:hover span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transform: translateX(-6px);
}

.hero-eyebrow {
  animation:
    heroFadeUp 900ms var(--ease-out) 300ms both,
    heroEyebrowIn 1200ms var(--ease-out) 300ms both;
}

@keyframes heroEyebrowIn {
  from {
    transform: translateX(-8px);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.hero-role {
  animation: heroRolePop 900ms var(--ease-spring) 900ms both;
}

@keyframes heroRolePop {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.92);
  }
  60% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

.portfolio-card-visual {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.portfolio-card-visual::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    115deg,
    transparent 0%,
    transparent 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, #fff 15%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 60%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  transition: transform 0ms;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 4;
  opacity: 0;
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual::before {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(100%);
  transition: transform 900ms var(--ease-out), opacity 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.form-field input,
.form-field textarea {
  position: relative;
}

.site-nav .nav-inner {
  animation: navSlideDown 700ms var(--ease-out) 100ms both;
}

@keyframes navSlideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-12px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .mobile-nav {
    animation: mobileNavIn 700ms var(--ease-spring) 600ms both;
  }

  @keyframes mobileNavIn {
    0% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);
    }
    60% {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    100% {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    }
  }
}

*:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  animation: focusGlow 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes focusGlow {
  from {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-tint);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint);
  }
}

.footer-nav a,
.footer-email {
  position: relative;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .scroll-progress-bar {
    transition: transform 0ms linear;
  }

  .reveal {
    filter: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
    transition: opacity 300ms var(--ease-out) !important;
  }

  .hero-eyebrow,
  .hero-role,
  .site-nav .nav-inner,
  .mobile-nav {
    animation: none !important;
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual::before {
    transform: none !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
  }

  .btn-primary:hover .arrow {
    transform: none;
  }

  *:focus-visible {
    animation: none;
  }
}

html:not(.is-theme-morphing) {
  transition: none;
}

/* ============================================================
   STEP 2 — Signature Glass System + Depth Refinement
   ============================================================ */

.glass-soft {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 78%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 50%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
}

.glass {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 72%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 30%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent),
    0 8px 24px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.12);
}

.glass-strong {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 85%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 8px 24px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.1);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .glass-soft {
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.2);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.2);
  }
  .glass {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
  }
  .glass-strong {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
  }
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.5);
  }

  .service-preview {
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
  }

  .about-statement {
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
  }

  .final-cta {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
  }

  .mobile-menu {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
  }

  .project-modal-shell {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.service-item {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 350ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 350ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 400ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 12%;
  bottom: 12%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: 3px;
  border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  transform: scaleY(0);
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: transform 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item.is-active::before {
  transform: scaleY(1);
}

.service-item.is-active {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 100%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 95%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, var(--line));
  transform: translateX(-4px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -16px var(--accent-glow),
    0 4px 12px -6px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08);
}

.service-icon {
  transition:
    background-color 400ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 400ms var(--ease-out),
    color 400ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 400ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item.is-active .service-icon {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  border-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
  transform: scale(1.08) rotate(-3deg);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
    0 8px 20px -8px var(--accent-glow);
}

.service-item.is-active .service-number {
  color: var(--accent);
  transition: color 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item.is-active .service-title {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 700;
  transition: font-weight 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-preview {
  position: relative;
  transition:
    border-color 500ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 500ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 500ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-preview::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  pointer-events: none;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, #fff 6%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 40%,
    transparent 60%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 3%, transparent) 100%
  );
  z-index: 1;
}

.service-preview:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--glass-border));
  box-shadow:
    var(--shadow-lg),
    0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
}

.service-preview-label {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-preview-label::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  transition: transform 800ms var(--ease-out);
}

.service-preview:hover .service-preview-label::before {
  transform: translateX(100%);
}

.portfolio-card-visual {
  transition:
    transform 500ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 500ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual {
  transform: translateY(-8px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
    0 16px 40px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.15),
    0 48px 88px -32px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.18);
}

.about-statement,
.final-cta-aside {
  transition:
    box-shadow 500ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.about-statement:hover,
.final-cta-aside:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, var(--glass-border));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 35%, transparent),
    var(--shadow-lg),
    0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
}

.hero-role {
  position: relative;
  transition:
    background-color 400ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 400ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-role:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, var(--glass-border));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 35%, transparent),
    0 8px 24px -12px var(--accent-glow);
}

.hero-top-meta {
  transition:
    border-color 400ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-top-meta:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 30%, var(--glass-border));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 30%, transparent),
    0 4px 16px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 30%, transparent);
}

.about-skills span {
  transition:
    border-color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 300ms var(--ease-spring);
}

.about-skills span:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 4px 12px -6px var(--accent-glow);
}

.form-field input,
.form-field textarea {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 2%, transparent);
}

.form-field input:hover:not(:focus),
.form-field textarea:hover:not(:focus) {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 2%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px -4px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08);
}

.form-field input:focus,
.form-field textarea:focus {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 20%, transparent),
    0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint),
    0 8px 24px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
}

.site-footer {
  position: relative;
}

.site-footer::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline: 15%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    var(--line-strong) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.services-section::after,
.why-section::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  inset-inline: 20%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.btn-primary {
  position: relative;
}

.btn-primary::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) 0%,
    transparent 50%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.btn-primary:hover::before {
  opacity: 0.9;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .service-item,
  .service-item::before,
  .service-icon,
  .service-item.is-active .service-icon,
  .portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual,
  .about-skills span:hover {
    transform: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }

  .service-preview-label::before {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   STEP 3 — Performance polish (no visual change)
   ============================================================ */

.services-section,
.portfolio-section,
.about-section,
.why-section,
.cta-final,
.site-footer {
  contain: layout style;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .services-section,
  .portfolio-section,
  .about-section,
  .why-section,
  .cta-final {
    contain: layout style paint;
  }
}

body,
button,
input,
textarea {
  font-synthesis: none;
  font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures;
}

.service-number,
.why-num,
.principle-num,
.hero-meta-value,
.stat-value,
.project-modal-nav-counter,
.portfolio-card-chrome-meta {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

img {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent);
}

.portfolio-card-canvas img,
.project-modal-visual img {
  content-visibility: auto;
}

.hero-orb,
.hero-section::before,
.hero-section::after,
.service-preview::before,
.about-statement::before,
.cta-final::before {
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  contain: strict;
}

.hero-section::before,
.hero-section::after,
.service-preview::before,
.about-statement::before,
.cta-final::before {
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}

html {
  background-attachment: scroll;
}

.project-modal-body,
.cart-items {
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.btn,
.btn-primary,
.service-item,
.portfolio-card,
.portfolio-card-visual,
.portfolio-card-arrow,
.mobile-nav,
.mobile-nav-item,
.mobile-nav-cta,
.theme-toggle,
.back-top,
.brand-mark {
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

.btn,
.service-item,
.portfolio-card {
  contain: layout;
}

a[href="/order"] {
  touch-action: manipulation;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-data: reduce) {
  .reveal {
    filter: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
    transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out) !important;
  }

  .hero-orb,
  .hero-section::before,
  .hero-section::after {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-orb,
  .hero-section::before,
  .hero-section::after,
  .service-preview::before,
  .about-statement::before,
  .cta-final::before {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

*:focus:not(:focus-visible) {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: none;
  animation: none;
}

@media print {
  * {
    box-shadow: none !important;
    text-shadow: none !important;
    filter: none !important;
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .mobile-nav,
  .site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
    will-change: transform;
  }

  .services-section,
  .portfolio-section,
  .about-section,
  .why-section,
  .cta-final,
  .site-footer {
    content-visibility: auto;
    contain-intrinsic-size: auto 700px;
  }

  .hero-section {
    content-visibility: visible;
  }
}

::selection {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 90%, transparent);
  color: #fff;
}

.hero-orb,
.mobile-nav,
.back-top,
.theme-toggle .theme-icon,
.reveal {
  transform: translateZ(0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

/* ============================================================
   FIXES & UPGRADES
   ============================================================ */

.services-section,
.portfolio-section,
.about-section,
.why-section,
.cta-final,
.site-footer {
  content-visibility: visible !important;
  contain-intrinsic-size: none !important;
}

.portfolio-section {
  contain: layout style;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .services-section,
  .portfolio-section,
  .about-section,
  .why-section,
  .cta-final,
  .site-footer {
    content-visibility: visible !important;
    contain-intrinsic-size: none !important;
    contain: none !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-actions {
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: clamp(28px, 3.2vw, 40px);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 58px;
  padding: 0 32px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  gap: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  transition:
    transform 300ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 300ms var(--ease-out),
    color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    #0a0908 0%,
    #2a2420 55%,
    #0a0908 100%
  );
  color: #fff9f4;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08),
    0 12px 32px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.4);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -2px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 50%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  filter: blur(12px);
  transition: opacity 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: opacity 350ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15),
    0 20px 48px -16px var(--accent-glow);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary:hover::before,
.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary:hover::after {
  opacity: 1;
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(-1px) scale(0.98);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-secondary {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04);
  position: relative;
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-secondary::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--surface) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 350ms var(--ease-out);
  z-index: -1;
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-secondary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 16px 40px -16px var(--accent-glow),
    0 4px 12px -4px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-secondary:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-secondary:active {
  transform: translateY(-1px) scale(0.98);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn > span[aria-hidden="true"],
.hero-section .hero-actions .btn > svg:last-child {
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform 400ms var(--ease-spring);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn:hover > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transform: translateX(-6px);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn > .btn-ripple {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at var(--x, 50%) var(--y, 50%),
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) 0%,
    transparent 50%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 350ms var(--ease-out);
  z-index: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn:hover > .btn-ripple {
  opacity: 1;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .hero-section .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 12px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-actions .btn {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 56px;
    padding-inline: 24px;
    justify-content: center;
  }
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 75%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
    0 16px 40px -14px var(--accent-glow);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary::after {
  display: none;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-actions .btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-actions .btn-secondary:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.order-page {
  padding-block: clamp(96px, 11vw, 130px) 100px;
}

.order-header {
  max-width: 780px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
}

.order-header h1 {
  font-size: clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 56px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  margin-top: 14px;
}

.order-header h1 span {
  color: var(--accent);
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}

.order-header p {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.order-page .order-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1px;
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 100%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--line-soft) 100%, transparent) 100%
    );
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03),
    0 24px 60px -24px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.14);
}

.order-page .form-section {
  padding: clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 56px);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 100% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 3%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 45%
    ),
    var(--glass);
  position: relative;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .order-page .form-section {
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.order-page .form-section-heading {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  position: relative;
  align-items: start;
}

.order-page .form-section-heading > span {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  padding-top: 0;
  position: relative;
}

.order-page .form-section-heading > span::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 1px;
  height: 32px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent),
    transparent
  );
}

.order-page .form-section-heading h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.order-page .form-section-heading p {
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.order-page .form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 22px;
}

.order-page .form-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.order-page .form-field-full {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.order-page .form-field > span,
.order-page .form-fieldset legend {
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.order-page .form-field b,
.order-page .form-fieldset b {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.order-page .form-field input,
.order-page .form-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 80%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, var(--paper-2)) 100%
    );
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  outline: none;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.02),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.02);
  transition:
    border-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 320ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 220ms var(--ease-out);
}

.order-page .form-field input {
  min-height: 56px;
}

.order-page .form-field textarea {
  min-height: 180px;
  resize: vertical;
  line-height: 1.9;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.order-page .form-field input::placeholder,
.order-page .form-field textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.order-page .form-field input:hover:not(:focus),
.order-page .form-field textarea:hover:not(:focus) {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 94%, var(--paper-2)) 100%
    );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 4px 12px -4px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06);
}

.order-page .form-field input:focus,
.order-page .form-field textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint),
    0 12px 32px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.order-page .form-field input:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.order-page .form-fieldset {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}

.order-page .form-fieldset legend {
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}

.order-page .project-type-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.order-page .project-type-option,
.order-page .contact-method {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 58px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 18px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 80%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, var(--paper-2)) 100%
    );
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  line-height: 1.4;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.02);
  transition:
    border-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 320ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 250ms var(--ease-spring),
    color 220ms var(--ease-out);
}

.order-page .project-type-option:hover,
.order-page .contact-method:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 6px 16px -6px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08);
}

.order-page .project-type-option.is-selected,
.order-page .contact-method.is-selected {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      var(--accent-tint) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-tint) 60%, var(--surface)) 100%
    );
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint),
