    0 12px 28px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
}

.order-page .project-type-option input,
.order-page .contact-method input,
.order-page .form-checkbox input {
  accent-color: var(--accent);
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 200ms var(--ease-spring);
}

.order-page .project-type-option.is-selected input,
.order-page .contact-method.is-selected input {
  transform: scale(1.15);
}

.order-page .form-checkbox {
  display: flex;
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, var(--paper-2)) 100%
    );
  border: 1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 100%, transparent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  min-height: 56px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    border-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 220ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 320ms var(--ease-out);
}

.order-page .form-checkbox:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.order-page .form-checkbox:has(input:checked) {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  border-style: solid;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

.order-page .form-checkbox input {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}

.order-page .form-checkbox span {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.order-page .contact-methods {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

.order-page .contact-method {
  min-height: 60px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.order-page .contact-method input {
  display: none;
}

.order-page .form-honeypot {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px !important;
  height: 1px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: -1px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}

.order-page .form-message {
  padding: 18px 24px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 4%, transparent) 100%
    );
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 20%, transparent);
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
}

.order-page .form-message-error {
  color: var(--danger);
}

.order-page .form-message-error::before {
  content: "!";
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--danger);
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

.order-page .form-submit-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: 28px clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 56px);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 100%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 100%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 60%, transparent);
}

.order-page .form-submit-row p {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  line-height: 1.7;
  max-width: 380px;
}

.order-page .form-submit-row .btn {
  min-height: 60px;
  padding-inline: 36px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    #0a0908 0%,
    #2a2420 55%,
    #0a0908 100%
  );
  color: #fff9f4;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
    0 16px 40px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.35);
  transition:
    transform 300ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.order-page .form-submit-row .btn:hover:not([disabled]) {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
    0 20px 48px -16px var(--accent-glow);
}

.order-page .form-submit-row .btn:active:not([disabled]) {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98);
}

.order-page .order-success {
  padding: clamp(60px, 9vw, 100px) clamp(28px, 5vw, 60px);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 50%
    ),
    var(--glass);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 32px 80px -24px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.14);
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.order-page .order-success::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  inset-inline-start: -20%;
  width: 60%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

.order-page .order-success-icon {
  width: 88px;
  height: 88px;
  margin: 0 auto 28px;
  border: 2px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 30% 30%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent) 0%,
      var(--accent-tint) 100%
    );
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 36px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent),
    0 20px 48px -16px var(--accent-glow);
  animation: successPop 700ms var(--ease-spring) both;
}

@keyframes successPop {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.6) rotate(-15deg);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  60% {
    transform: scale(1.08) rotate(3deg);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.order-page .order-success h2 {
  margin: 16px 0 14px;
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.order-page .order-success p {
  max-width: 520px;
  margin: 0 auto 36px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.9;
}

.order-page .order-success-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.order-page .order-success-actions .btn {
  min-height: 54px;
  padding-inline: 28px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .order-page {
    padding-block: 88px 80px;
  }

  .order-page .form-section {
    padding: 32px 22px;
  }

  .order-page .form-section-heading {
    grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }

  .order-page .form-section-heading > span {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .order-page .form-section-heading > span::after {
    height: 24px;
  }

  .order-page .form-section-heading h2 {
    font-size: 17px;
  }

  .order-page .form-section-heading p {
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .order-page .form-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 18px;
  }

  .order-page .form-field-full {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .order-page .form-field input,
  .order-page .form-field textarea {
    font-size: 16px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
  }

  .order-page .form-field input {
    min-height: 54px;
  }

  .order-page .form-field textarea {
    min-height: 150px;
  }

  .order-page .project-type-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .order-page .project-type-option,
  .order-page .contact-method {
    min-height: 54px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 13.5px;
  }

  .order-page .contact-methods {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .order-page .contact-method {
    min-height: 56px;
    padding: 10px 8px;
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }

  .order-page .form-submit-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    padding: 22px;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .order-page .form-submit-row p {
    text-align: center;
    max-width: none;
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }

  .order-page .form-submit-row .btn {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 56px;
  }

  .order-page .order-success {
    padding: 56px 24px;
  }

  .order-page .order-success-icon {
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    font-size: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 22px;
  }

  .order-page .order-success h2 {
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .order-page .order-success p {
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .order-page .order-success-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .order-page .order-success-actions .btn {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

[data-theme="dark"] .order-page .order-form {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--line-soft) 100%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 60%, transparent) 100%
  );
}

[data-theme="dark"] .order-page .form-field input,
[data-theme="dark"] .order-page .form-field textarea {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--surface) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 94%, #000) 100%
  );
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .order-page .form-field input:focus,
[data-theme="dark"] .order-page .form-field textarea:focus {
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06),
    0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint),
    0 12px 32px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .order-page .form-submit-row .btn {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  color: #fff;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-section .hero-actions .btn:hover,
  .order-page .form-field input:focus,
  .order-page .form-field textarea:focus,
  .order-page .project-type-option.is-selected,
  .order-page .contact-method.is-selected,
  .order-page .form-submit-row .btn:hover:not([disabled]) {
    transform: none;
  }

  .order-page .order-success-icon {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   FIX — Hero buttons vertical centering
   ============================================================ */

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn,
.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-primary,
.hero-section .hero-actions .btn-secondary {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  padding: 0 32px !important;
  min-height: 58px !important;
  height: 58px !important;
  vertical-align: middle;
  text-align: center;
  flex-direction: row !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-inline-start: 2px;
}

/* ============================================================
   NATIVE IMAGES — portfolio + modal
   ============================================================ */

.portfolio-card-canvas img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  transition: transform 700ms var(--ease-out);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-canvas img {
  transform: scale(1.03);
}

.project-modal-visual img {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
}

.portfolio-card-canvas > span[style*="position:absolute"] {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .portfolio-card-canvas {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  }
}

/* ⏸️ پایان بخش ۲ — بخش ۳ در پیام بعدی *//* ============================================================
   Footer CTA Block
   ============================================================ */

.footer-cta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  padding: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem) 0 clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent);
  margin-bottom: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
}

.footer-cta-title {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4.5vw, 3rem);
  line-height: 1.1;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  margin: 0;
  color: currentColor;
}

.footer-cta-title em {
  font-style: normal;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.footer-cta-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* ============================================================
   ABOUT — IDENTITY BLOCK
   ============================================================ */

.about-identity {
  padding-bottom: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  margin-bottom: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  border-bottom: 1px solid;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
}

.about-identity-title {
  margin: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) 0 0;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.1em;
}

.about-identity-title span {
  display: block;
}

.about-identity-em {
  opacity: 0.45;
  font-style: normal;
}

.about-identity-rule {
  width: 64px;
  height: 1px;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.35;
  margin: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem) 0 1rem;
}

.about-identity-sub {
  font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.5vw, 1.1rem);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  opacity: 0.7;
  margin: 0 0 clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
}

.about-facts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.25rem 2rem;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.about-fact {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding-top: 0.85rem;
  border-top: 1px solid;
  border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent);
}

.about-fact-label {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  font-weight: 500;
  opacity: 0.5;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.about-fact-value {
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

/* ============================================================
   ABOUT — STATS STRIP
   ============================================================ */

.about-stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
  margin-top: clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  border-top: 1px solid;
  border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
}

.about-stat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  padding: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 2rem) clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
  text-align: center;
  border-inline-end: 1px solid;
  border-inline-end-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent);
}

.about-stat:last-child {
  border-inline-end: none;
}

.about-stat-value {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  line-height: 1;
}

.about-stat-label {
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .about-stat {
    border-inline-end: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid;
    border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent);
  }

  .about-stat:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO — EDITORIAL ENHANCEMENTS
   ============================================================ */

.hero-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.35;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-corner::before,
.hero-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.hero-corner::before {
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0;
}

.hero-corner::after {
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
}

.hero-corner-tl {
  top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  inset-inline-start: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
}

.hero-corner-tr {
  top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  inset-inline-end: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

.hero-corner-bl {
  bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  inset-inline-start: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  transform: scaleY(-1);
}

.hero-corner-br {
  bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  inset-inline-end: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  transform: scale(-1, -1);
}

.hero-rail {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  inset-inline-end: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-rail-line {
  width: 1px;
  height: 40px;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.25;
}

.hero-rail-text {
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.45;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero-rail {
    display: none;
  }
}

.hero-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.25rem;
  margin-bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
  border-bottom: 1px solid;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.hero-masthead-left,
.hero-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.hero-masthead-center {
  opacity: 0.4;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .hero-masthead {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  }
  .hero-masthead-center {
    display: none;
  }
}

.hero-arrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  opacity: 0.4;
  align-self: center;
  color: currentColor;
  transform: rotate(-8deg);
  animation: hero-arrow-float 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.hero-arrow svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

@keyframes hero-arrow-float {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-8deg) translateY(0); }
  50%      { transform: rotate(-8deg) translateY(4px); }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .hero-arrow {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-arrow {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO — MARQUEE STRIP
   ============================================================ */

.hero-marquee {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.25rem) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid;
  border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
}

.hero-marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  width: max-content;
  animation: hero-marquee-scroll 38s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.hero-marquee-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.hero-marquee-sep {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  opacity: 0.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

@keyframes hero-marquee-scroll {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-marquee-track {
    animation: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   NAV — EDITORIAL ENHANCEMENTS
   ============================================================ */

.brand-issue {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-inline-start: 0.85rem;
  padding-inline-start: 0.85rem;
  border-inline-start: 1px solid;
  border-inline-start-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 15%, transparent);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  opacity: 0.55;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.brand-issue-sep {
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.brand-issue-num {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .brand-issue {
    display: none;
  }
}

.desktop-nav {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.desktop-nav-label {
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  opacity: 0.4;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-inline-end: 0.85rem;
  border-inline-end: 1px solid;
  border-inline-end-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 15%, transparent);
}

.desktop-nav-list {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
}

.desktop-nav-indicator {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -8px;
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.9;
  transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
              opacity 260ms ease;
  pointer-events: none;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  transform: translateX(
    calc(
      var(--nav-index) * 100% + var(--nav-index) * 0.35rem + 1.75rem
    )
  );
}

.desktop-nav-counter {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  margin-inline-start: 0.85rem;
  padding-inline-start: 0.85rem;
  border-inline-start: 1px solid;
  border-inline-start-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 15%, transparent);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  opacity: 0.65;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.desktop-nav-counter-current {
  opacity: 1;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.desktop-nav-counter-sep {
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.desktop-nav-counter-total {
  opacity: 0.55;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .desktop-nav-label,
  .desktop-nav-counter,
  .desktop-nav-indicator {
    display: none;
  }
}

.nav-progress {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent);
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 300ms ease;
}

.site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-progress {
  opacity: 1;
}

.nav-progress-bar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.85;
  transform: scaleX(var(--nav-progress, 0));
  transform-origin: left center;
  transition: transform 120ms linear;
}

:where([dir="rtl"]) .nav-progress-bar {
  transform-origin: right center;
}

.site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
  padding-block: 0.55rem;
  transition: padding-block 320ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

.nav-inner {
  transition: padding-block 320ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .desktop-nav-indicator,
  .nav-progress-bar,
  .nav-inner {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   SERVICES — EDITORIAL ENHANCEMENTS
   ============================================================ */

.services-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.1rem;
  margin-bottom: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  border-bottom: 1px solid;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.services-masthead-left,
.services-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.services-masthead-center {
  opacity: 0.4;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .services-masthead {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  }
  .services-masthead-center {
    display: none;
  }
}

.services-list-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0 0 0.85rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.services-list-header-label {
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.services-list-header-count {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  opacity: 0.75;
}

.service-item {
  position: relative;
}

.service-item-dot {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 5px;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  background: transparent;
  opacity: 0.35;
  transition:
    opacity 260ms ease,
    background-color 260ms ease,
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.service-item.is-active .service-item-dot {
  opacity: 1;
  background: currentColor;
  transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.35);
}

.service-preview {
  position: relative;
}

.service-preview-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.28;
  z-index: 2;
}

.service-preview-corner::before,
.service-preview-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.service-preview-corner::before {
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0;
}

.service-preview-corner::after {
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
}

.service-preview-corner-tl {
  top: 10px;
  inset-inline-start: 10px;
}

.service-preview-corner-tr {
  top: 10px;
  inset-inline-end: 10px;
  transform: scaleX(-1);
}

.service-preview-corner-bl {
  bottom: 10px;
  inset-inline-start: 10px;
  transform: scaleY(-1);
}

.service-preview-corner-br {
  bottom: 10px;
  inset-inline-end: 10px;
  transform: scale(-1, -1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .service-item-dot {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   TOP NAV — FULL RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .site-nav .container {
    padding-inline: 1rem;
  }

  .desktop-nav-label,
  .desktop-nav-counter {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .brand-issue {
    display: none;
  }

  .nav-order-button {
    padding-inline: 0.85rem;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    height: 34px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .site-nav .container {
    padding-inline: 0.85rem;
  }

  .site-nav .nav-inner {
    padding-block: 0.55rem;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-height: 56px;
  }

  .brand {
    gap: 0;
  }

  .brand-text {
    display: none;
  }

  .brand-mark {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .desktop-nav {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .nav-order-button {
    display: none;
  }

  .theme-toggle {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .site-nav .container {
    padding-inline: 0.65rem;
  }

  .site-nav .nav-inner {
    padding-block: 0.45rem;
    min-height: 52px;
  }

  .brand-mark {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  .theme-toggle {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 340px) {
  .site-nav .container {
    padding-inline: 0.5rem;
  }

  .brand-mark {
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }

  .theme-toggle {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   MOBILE BOTTOM NAV — FULL RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .mobile-nav {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  body {
    padding-bottom: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  .mobile-nav {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    inset-inline: 0;
    z-index: 90;
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    transition:
      transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
      opacity 260ms ease;
  }

  .mobile-nav.is-hidden {
    transform: translateY(120%);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item {
    min-height: 44px;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta {
    min-height: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .mobile-nav-list {
    padding-inline: 0.5rem;
  }

  .mobile-nav-label {
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  body {
    padding-bottom: calc(66px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  .mobile-nav-list {
    padding-inline: 0.35rem;
  }

  .mobile-nav-label {
    font-size: 0.62rem;
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta-icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 340px) {
  .mobile-nav-label {
    font-size: 0.58rem;
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   SAFE AREA — iPhone notch & home indicator
   ============================================================ */

@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
  .site-nav {
    padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
  }
}

@supports (padding: env(safe-area-inset-left)) {
  .site-nav .container {
    padding-inline-start: calc(
      1rem + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)
    );
    padding-inline-end: calc(
      1rem + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)
    );
  }

  .mobile-nav-list {
    padding-inline-start: calc(
      0.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px)
    );
    padding-inline-end: calc(
      0.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px)
    );
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   LANDSCAPE MOBILE — compact everything
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-height: 500px) and (orientation: landscape) {
  .site-nav .nav-inner {
    padding-block: 0.35rem;
    min-height: 46px;
  }

  body {
    padding-bottom: calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  .mobile-nav {
    padding-block: 0.25rem;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item {
    min-height: 38px;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta {
    min-height: 38px;
    min-width: 38px;
  }

  .mobile-nav-label {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mobile-nav {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   GLOBAL MOBILE SETUP — prevents horizontal scroll everywhere
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  html, body {
    overflow-x: hidden;
    max-width: 100vw;
  }

  body {
    padding-bottom: calc(72px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  img, video, iframe, svg {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }

  button, a, [role="button"] {
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    touch-action: manipulation;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   HERO — FULL RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero-rail {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-section {
    padding-block: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.5rem);
  }

  .hero-inner {
    padding-inline: 1rem;
  }

  .hero-corner {
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    opacity: 0.3;
  }

  .hero-corner-tl { top: 0.75rem; inset-inline-start: 0.75rem; }
  .hero-corner-tr { top: 0.75rem; inset-inline-end: 0.75rem; }
  .hero-corner-bl { bottom: 0.75rem; inset-inline-start: 0.75rem; }
  .hero-corner-br { bottom: 0.75rem; inset-inline-end: 0.75rem; }

  .hero-masthead {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    padding-bottom: 0.85rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .hero-masthead-center {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-masthead-left,
  .hero-masthead-right {
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 8vw, 2.75rem);
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

  .hero-description {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }

  .hero-tech {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem;
  }

  .hero-tech-chip {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem;
  }

  .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 0.65rem;
  }

  .hero-actions .btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hero-arrow {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-footer {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.85rem;
    padding-top: 1.25rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .hero-masthead {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.3rem;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  }

  .hero-masthead-left,
  .hero-masthead-right {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: start;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .hero-masthead-right {
    text-align: end;
  }

  .hero-top {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.6rem;
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 9vw, 2.25rem);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .hero-inner {
    padding-inline: 0.75rem;
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-size: 1.4rem;
  }

  .hero-description {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
  }

  .hero-masthead {
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }
}

   ============================================================ */

  }

  body {
    padding-bottom: calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   PROJECT CASE STUDY — Premium Modal Sections
   ============================================================ */

.project-modal-visual {
  position: relative;
}

.project-modal-metrics {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 24px;
  right: 24px;
  left: 24px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(120px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  z-index: 2;
}

.project-modal-metric {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.55);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%);
  backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(160%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) inset,
    0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

.project-modal-metric strong {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  color: #ffffff;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.project-modal-metric span {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
  line-height: 1.35;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.project-modal-subtitle {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.project-modal-subtitle .dot {
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.project-case-study {
  margin: 40px 0 32px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 32px;
}

.case-study-section {
  position: relative;
  padding-right: 28px;
}

.case-study-section::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: 6px;
  bottom: 6px;
  width: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent)
  );
}

.case-study-section--quote::before {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 85%, transparent),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent)
  );
}

.case-study-heading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.case-study-num {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 30px;
  height: 22px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  border-radius: 6px;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.case-study-section p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.93rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.case-study-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.case-study-list li {
  position: relative;
  padding-right: 22px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.case-study-list li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: 0.65em;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent);
}

.case-study-list--highlight li::before {
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

.case-study-section--quote blockquote {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 16px 20px;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent-tint) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-tint) 40%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border-right: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 4px 12px 12px 4px;
}

.project-modal-tech {
  margin: 24px 0 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.project-modal-tech-label {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.project-modal-tech-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}

.project-modal-tech-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.project-modal-tech-chip:hover {
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .project-modal-metrics {
    position: static;
    margin: 16px;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .project-modal-metric strong {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
  }

  .project-case-study {
    margin: 32px 0 24px;
    gap: 26px;
  }

  .case-study-section {
    padding-right: 20px;
  }

  .case-study-heading {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  .case-study-section p,
  .case-study-list li {
    font-size: 0.88rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .project-modal-metric,
  .project-modal-tech-chip {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   FIX — Modal Nav overlap + spacing
   ============================================================ */

.project-modal-nav {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 5;
  padding: 16px 24px !important;
  background: var(--surface) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.project-modal-main {
  padding-top: 24px !important;
}

.project-modal-body {
  padding-top: 8px !important;
}

.project-modal-visual {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
}

.project-modal-nav-counter {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .project-modal-nav {
  background: var(--surface) !important;
  border-bottom-color: var(--line);
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .project-modal-nav {
    padding: 12px 16px !important;
  }
  .project-modal-main {
    padding-top: 16px !important;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   Hero Typography — Persian block (kept for compatibility)
   ============================================================ */

.hero-typography {
  font-family: inherit;
  direction: rtl;
  text-align: right;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
  line-height: 1.9;
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 75%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  padding: 30px 40px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 40px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 15px;
  max-width: 600px;
  position: relative;
  transition: all 0.4s ease;
}

.hero-typography::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  top: 20%;
  height: 60%;
  width: 6px;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px;
}

.hero-typography .muted-text {
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  display: block;
}

.hero-typography .highlight-text {
  font-weight: 900;
  color: var(--ink);
  display: inline-block;
  position: relative;
  padding-right: 25px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ink) 30%, var(--accent) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, filter 0.3s ease;
}

.hero-typography:hover .highlight-text {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 15px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent));
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .hero-typography {
    padding: 20px 25px;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
  }
  .hero-typography .highlight-text {
    padding-right: 15px;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   LIVE DEMO BUTTON — Project Viewer Actions
   ============================================================ */

.project-modal-actions .button-secondary {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
}

.project-modal-actions .button-secondary:hover {
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-color: var(--ink);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.project-modal-actions .button svg {
  transition: transform 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.project-modal-actions .button:hover svg {
  transform: translate(2px, -2px);
}

.project-modal-actions .button-primary {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.project-modal-actions .button svg {
  margin-inline-start: 6px;
}

/* ============================================================
   LIVE DEMO BUTTON — Top of Project Modal
   ============================================================ */

.project-modal-nav-left {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.project-modal-nav-demo {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
    0 6px 18px -6px var(--accent-glow);
  transition:
    background-color 250ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 300ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.project-modal-nav-demo:hover {
  background: var(--accent-2);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25),
    0 10px 26px -8px var(--accent-glow);
}

.project-modal-nav-demo svg {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition: transform 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.project-modal-nav-demo:hover svg {
  transform: translate(2px, -2px);
}

.project-modal-nav-demo-text {
  display: inline;
}

.project-modal-nav-demo-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  animation: livePulse 2s var(--ease-out) infinite;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes livePulse {
  0% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  }
  70% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);
  }
  100% {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .project-modal-nav {
    padding: 12px 14px !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
    gap: 10px !important;
    align-items: center !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-buttons {
    order: 1 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    justify-content: space-between !important;
    display: flex !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-left {
    order: 2 !important;
    flex: 1 1 100% !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    gap: 10px !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-demo {
    flex: 1 !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    padding: 11px 18px !important;
    min-height: 44px !important;
    font-size: 13.5px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    gap: 10px !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-demo .project-modal-nav-demo-text {
    display: inline !important;
    font-size: 13.5px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-demo svg {
    width: 14px !important;
    height: 14px !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-demo-dot {
    width: 7px !important;
    height: 7px !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-counter {
    font-size: 11px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .project-modal-nav-demo {
    padding: 10px 14px !important;
    font-size: 12.5px !important;
    min-height: 42px !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-demo .project-modal-nav-demo-text {
    display: inline !important;
    font-size: 12.5px !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-counter {
    font-size: 10px !important;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .project-modal-nav-demo-dot {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .project-modal-nav-demo,
  .project-modal-nav-demo svg {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   LATEST BLOG POSTS — Homepage Section
   ============================================================ */

.latest-blog-section {
  position: relative;
}

.latest-blog-section::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  z-index: -1;
}

.latest-blog-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
}

.latest-blog-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 28px 24px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  transition:
    transform 400ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.latest-blog-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.latest-blog-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.latest-blog-reading::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-inline-end: 10px;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.latest-blog-title {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.4;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
  transition: color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.latest-blog-card:hover .latest-blog-title {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.latest-blog-excerpt {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  flex: 1;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.latest-blog-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--accent);
  transition: gap 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.latest-blog-card:hover .latest-blog-cta {
  gap: 14px;
}

.latest-blog-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .latest-blog-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .latest-blog-card {
    padding: 22px 20px;
  }

  .latest-blog-title {
    font-size: 16px;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   FAQ SECTION — Premium Editorial Design
   ============================================================ */

.faq-section {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.faq-section::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 20%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 60vw;
  height: 60vw;
  max-width: 700px;
  max-height: 700px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.faq-section .container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.faq-section .section-heading h2 em {
  position: relative;
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.faq-section .section-heading h2 em::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: -4px;
  bottom: 0.08em;
  height: 0.08em;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.25;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.faq-list {
  max-width: 880px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.faq-item {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    border-color 350ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 350ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.faq-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 20%;
  bottom: 20%;
  width: 3px;
  border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
  background: var(--accent);
  transform: scaleY(0);
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: transform 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.faq-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  transform: translateX(-2px);
}

.faq-item.is-open {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, var(--surface)) 0%,
    var(--surface) 100%
  );
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -12px var(--accent-glow),
    0 4px 12px -6px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08);
}

.faq-item.is-open::before {
  transform: scaleY(1);
}

.faq-question {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 24px 28px;
  text-align: start;
  font-size: 16.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 250ms var(--ease-out);
}

.faq-question:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.faq-question:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: -4px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}

.faq-question-text {
  flex: 1;
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
}

.faq-icon {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  transition:
    background-color 350ms var(--ease-out),
    color 350ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 500ms var(--ease-spring),
    box-shadow 400ms var(--ease-out);
}

.faq-icon::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.8);
  transition:
    opacity 400ms var(--ease-out),
    transform 500ms var(--ease-out);
}

.faq-icon svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: transform 400ms var(--ease-spring);
}

.faq-item.is-open .faq-icon {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  transform: rotate(135deg);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -4px var(--accent-glow);
}

.faq-item.is-open .faq-icon::before {
  opacity: 0.3;
  transform: scale(1.4);
}

.faq-answer {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 0fr;
  transition: grid-template-rows 450ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.faq-item.is-open .faq-answer {
  grid-template-rows: 1fr;
}

.faq-answer-inner {
  overflow: hidden;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 350ms var(--ease-out) 150ms;
}

.faq-item.is-open .faq-answer-inner {
  opacity: 1;
}

.faq-answer-inner p {
  padding: 0 28px 26px;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  max-width: 760px;
  position: relative;
}

.faq-answer-inner p::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 28px;
  top: 0;
  width: 24px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.faq-question-text::before {
  content: attr(data-num);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.5;
  margin-inline-end: 12px;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .faq-question {
    padding: 20px 20px;
    gap: 16px;
    font-size: 15px;
  }

  .faq-question-text {
    padding-inline-end: 8px;
  }

  .faq-icon {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
  }

  .faq-icon svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
  }

  .faq-answer-inner p {
    padding: 0 20px 22px;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .faq-answer-inner p::before {
    inset-inline-start: 20px;
  }

  .faq-question-text::before {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .faq-item,
  .faq-item::before,
  .faq-icon,
  .faq-icon::before,
  .faq-answer,
  .faq-answer-inner {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* ✅ enhancements.css کامل شد */
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PORTFOLIO VIEW-ALL LINK
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.portfolio-view-all {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.portfolio-view-all:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  transform: translateX(-3px);
}

.portfolio-view-all span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.portfolio-view-all:hover span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
}

/* Make .portfolio-card a link — remove button-specific styles */
a.portfolio-card {
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  padding: 0;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: start;
}
