## FILE: src\styles\final-polish-2026.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   FINAL POLISH 2026 — ULTIMATE EDITION
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   基于 WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA、Core Web Vitals 2026、现代 CSS 特性、
   国际化（i18n/RTL）以及性能最佳实践构建。
   
   覆盖范围：
   1. 架构层（@layer）
   2. 零特异性重置（基于 :where()）
   3. 现代色彩系统（oklch, color-mix, relative color）
   4. 无障碍完成度（焦点、目标尺寸、辅助技术）
   5. 用户偏好媒体查询（动效、对比度、透明、数据）
   6. 现代布局（容器查询、:has()、逻辑属性）
   7. 视图过渡与滚动驱动动画
   8. 打印样式
   9. 国际化与双向文本（RTL）
   10. 微细节（选区、光标、滚动条）
   11. 性能优化（GPU 合成、内容可见性）
   12. 终极打磨（排版节奏、间距系统）
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. 架构层 — 显式级联顺序
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   使用 @layer 定义明确的优先级，彻底告别 !important 和特异性战争[reference:0]。
   顺序：reset → tokens → base → layout → components → utilities → overrides
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer reset, tokens, base, layout, components, utilities, overrides;

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. 零特异性重置 — 基于 :where()
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   所有规则包裹在 :where() 中，特异性为 0，确保任何自定义样式都能轻松覆盖[reference:1]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer reset {
  /* 盒模型与尺寸 */
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0 solid currentColor; /* 确保边框可见于强制颜色模式[reference:2] */
  }

  /* 文档基础 */
  html {
    -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    -moz-text-size-adjust: 100%;
    text-size-adjust: 100%;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    font-kerning: normal;
    font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures contextual;
    font-synthesis: none;
    scrollbar-gutter: stable; /* 防止滚动条出现/消失时的布局抖动[reference:3] */
    overflow-x: clip; /* 兼容 position: sticky 的水平安全裁剪[reference:4] */
    tab-size: 2;
  }

  /* 正文 */
  body {
    min-height: 100svh;
    line-height: 1.5;
    text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* 媒体元素 */
  :where(img, picture, video, canvas, svg) {
    display: block;
    max-inline-size: 100%;
    max-block-size: 100%;
  }

  /* 表单元素 */
  :where(input, button, textarea, select) {
    font: inherit;
    color: inherit;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    outline: none;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
  }

  /* 按钮和链接 */
  :where(button, [role="button"]) {
    cursor: pointer;
    background: none;
    text-align: inherit;
  }

  :where(a) {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  /* 列表 */
  :where(ul, ol) {
    list-style: none;
  }

  /* 标题和段落 */
  :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p) {
    font-size: inherit;
    font-weight: inherit;
    text-wrap: balance; /* 标题自动平衡 */
  }

  :where(p) {
    text-wrap: pretty; /* 段落避免孤行 */
  }

  /* 表格 */
  :where(table) {
    border-collapse: collapse;
    border-spacing: 0;
    text-indent: 0;
  }

  /* 代码 */
  :where(pre, code, kbd, samp) {
    font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace);
    font-size: 0.9em;
    direction: ltr; /* 代码始终 LTR */
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
  }

  /* 引用 */
  :where(blockquote, q) {
    quotes: none;
  }

  /* 细节/摘要 */
  :where(details) {
    display: block;
  }

  :where(summary) {
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }

  :where(summary)::-webkit-details-marker {
    display: none;
  }

  :where(summary)::marker {
    content: "";
  }

  /* 强制颜色模式下的无障碍基础 */
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    :where(button, input, textarea, select, a, [role="button"]) {
      border: 1px solid ButtonText;
    }
    :where(img) {
      forced-color-adjust: auto;
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. 设计令牌层
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   语义化令牌，与现代色彩空间结合，支持无缝主题切换[reference:5]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer tokens {
  :root {
    /* ─── 色彩空间基础（OKLCH 提供感知均匀性）[reference:6] ─── */
    --accent: oklch(0.62 0.22 40);   /* 强烈橙红色 */
    --accent-2: oklch(0.72 0.20 55);
    --accent-soft: oklch(0.88 0.08 55);
    --accent-tint: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 12%, transparent);
    --accent-glow: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);

    --ink: oklch(0.15 0.02 80);
    --ink-2: oklch(0.35 0.02 80);
    --ink-3: oklch(0.55 0.02 80);
    --ink-3-strong: oklch(0.45 0.02 80);
    --ink-muted: oklch(0.75 0.01 80);

    --paper: oklch(0.98 0.005 80);
    --paper-2: oklch(0.95 0.008 80);
    --surface: oklch(0.99 0.003 80);
    --surface-2: oklch(0.97 0.005 80);

    --line: oklch(0.15 0.02 80 / 0.08);
    --line-soft: oklch(0.15 0.02 80 / 0.04);
    --line-strong: oklch(0.15 0.02 80 / 0.18);

    --success: oklch(0.55 0.15 160);
    --danger: oklch(0.55 0.22 25);

    /* ─── 语义令牌（组件只引用这些） ─── */
    --color-bg: var(--paper);
    --color-text: var(--ink-2);
    --color-text-strong: var(--ink);
    --color-text-muted: var(--ink-3);
    --color-border: var(--line);
    --color-surface: var(--surface);
    --color-accent: var(--accent);

    /* ─── 间距系统（4px 基准，与流式单位结合） ─── */
    --space-1: clamp(0.25rem, 0.2rem + 0.25vw, 0.5rem);
    --space-2: clamp(0.5rem, 0.4rem + 0.5vw, 1rem);
    --space-3: clamp(0.75rem, 0.6rem + 0.75vw, 1.5rem);
    --space-4: clamp(1rem, 0.8rem + 1vw, 2rem);
    --space-5: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1.5vw, 3rem);
    --space-6: clamp(2rem, 1.6rem + 2vw, 4rem);
    --space-7: clamp(3rem, 2.4rem + 3vw, 6rem);
    --space-8: clamp(4rem, 3.2rem + 4vw, 8rem);

    /* ─── 圆角系统 ─── */
    --radius-xs: 4px;
    --radius-sm: 8px;
    --radius-md: 12px;
    --radius-lg: 16px;
    --radius-xl: 24px;
    --radius-2xl: 32px;
    --radius-full: 9999px;

    /* ─── 字体系统 ─── */
    --font-sans: var(--font-vazirmatn, system-ui), -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    --font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;

    /* ─── 现代缓动曲线（2026） ─── */
    --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    --ease-out-quart: cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
    --ease-out-quint: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    --ease-in-out-quart: cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1);
    --ease-spring-soft: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.3, 0.64, 1);
    --ease-spring-bold: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);

    /* ─── 时长 ─── */
    --dur-fast: 160ms;
    --dur-normal: 240ms;
    --dur-slow: 400ms;
    --dur-slower: 640ms;

    /* ─── 阅读宽度 ─── */
    --measure: 65ch;
    --measure-narrow: 50ch;
    --measure-wide: 80ch;

    /* ─── 布局 ─── */
    --container: 1280px;
    --container-narrow: 780px;

    /* ─── 阴影 ─── */
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px -1px oklch(0.15 0.02 80 / 0.06);
    --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px -4px oklch(0.15 0.02 80 / 0.1);
    --shadow-lg: 0 12px 32px -12px oklch(0.15 0.02 80 / 0.18);
    --shadow-xl: 0 24px 64px -24px oklch(0.15 0.02 80 / 0.24);
    --shadow-accent: 0 8px 24px -8px var(--accent-glow);

    /* ─── 强制颜色模式下的系统颜色回退[reference:7] ─── */
    --sys-canvas: Canvas;
    --sys-canvas-text: CanvasText;
    --sys-button-text: ButtonText;
    --sys-link-text: LinkText;
    --sys-highlight: Highlight;
  }

  /* ─── 暗色主题（OKLCH 色彩空间重映射） ─── */
  [data-theme="dark"] {
    --ink: oklch(0.95 0.01 80);
    --ink-2: oklch(0.78 0.01 80);
    --ink-3: oklch(0.62 0.01 80);
    --ink-3-strong: oklch(0.7 0.01 80);
    --ink-muted: oklch(0.35 0.01 80);

    --paper: oklch(0.1 0.005 80);
    --paper-2: oklch(0.13 0.008 80);
    --surface: oklch(0.15 0.01 80);
    --surface-2: oklch(0.18 0.01 80);

    --line: oklch(0.95 0.01 80 / 0.08);
    --line-soft: oklch(0.95 0.01 80 / 0.04);
    --line-strong: oklch(0.95 0.01 80 / 0.18);

    --accent: oklch(0.72 0.24 40);
    --accent-2: oklch(0.78 0.22 55);

    --success: oklch(0.72 0.18 160);
    --danger: oklch(0.72 0.2 25);

    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px -1px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.4);
    --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px -4px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.5);
    --shadow-lg: 0 12px 32px -12px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.6);
    --shadow-xl: 0 24px 64px -24px oklch(0 0 0 / 0.8);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. 现代色彩函数 — 动态与对比
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   使用相对颜色语法和 color-contrast() 实现自适应对比度[reference:8]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer base {
  /* ─── 基于 Accent 的派生色 ─── */
  .derived-accent {
    color: oklch(from var(--accent) l c h); /* 原始 */
    color: oklch(from var(--accent) calc(l + 0.15) c h); /* 变亮 */
    color: oklch(from var(--accent) calc(l - 0.15) c h); /* 变暗 */
    color: oklch(from var(--accent) l calc(c * 0.5) h); /* 去饱和 */
  }

  /* ─── 自适应对比度文本（现代浏览器） ─── */
  @supports (color: contrast-color(red)) {
    .adaptive-text {
      color: contrast-color(var(--surface));
    }
  }

  /* ─── 回退：使用 color-mix 计算亮度差 ─── */
  .adaptive-text-fallback {
    color: light-dark(var(--ink), var(--paper));
  }

  /* ─── 动态透明度（不依赖预定义变量） ─── */
  .tinted {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
  }

  /* ─── 色相旋转动画（使用 @property 实现平滑插值）[reference:9] ─── */
  @property --hue-rotate {
    syntax: "<angle>";
    inherits: false;
    initial-value: 0deg;
  }

  .hue-cycle {
    transition: --hue-rotate 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  .hue-cycle:hover {
    --hue-rotate: 360deg;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. 无障碍完成度 — WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   焦点、目标尺寸、辅助功能，全部到位。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer base {
  /* ─── 焦点可见性（2.4.7 Focus Visible） ─── */
  :where(
    a,
    button,
    input,
    textarea,
    select,
    [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"]),
    [role="button"],
    [role="link"],
    summary,
    details
  ):focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
    outline-offset: 3px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    transition: outline-offset var(--dur-fast) var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  /* ─── 焦点不被遮挡（2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured）[reference:10] ─── */
  :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, [id]) {
    scroll-margin-block-start: 6rem; /* 为粘性头部预留空间 */
    scroll-margin-block-end: 2rem;
  }

  /* ─── 触摸目标尺寸（2.5.8 Target Size）[reference:11] ─── */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    :where(
      button,
      a,
      [role="button"],
      [role="link"],
      input[type="checkbox"],
      input[type="radio"],
      summary,
      .oform-option,
      .oform-contact
    ) {
      min-block-size: 44px;
      min-inline-size: 44px;
    }

    /* 内联文本中的链接除外 */
    :where(p, li, blockquote, dd) :where(a) {
      min-block-size: auto;
      min-inline-size: auto;
      padding: 2px 4px;
      margin: -2px -4px;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 拖拽替代（2.5.7 Dragging Movements）[reference:12] ─── */
  /* 对于任何可拖拽元素，提供键盘/点击替代方案 */
  [draggable="true"] {
    cursor: grab;
  }

  [draggable="true"]:active {
    cursor: grabbing;
  }

  /* 确保滑块有数字输入回退 */
  .slider-with-fallback {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--space-2);
  }

  /* ─── 跳过链接（2.4.1 Bypass Blocks） ─── */
  .skip-link {
    position: fixed;
    inset-block-start: -100px;
    inset-inline-start: 1rem;
    z-index: 10000;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--paper);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
    transition: inset-block-start var(--dur-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  .skip-link:focus,
  .skip-link:focus-visible {
    inset-block-start: 1rem;
    outline: 3px solid var(--accent);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  /* ─── 屏幕阅读器专用（1.3.1 Info and Relationships） ─── */
  .sr-only {
    position: absolute !important;
    inline-size: 1px !important;
    block-size: 1px !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: -1px !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    clip-path: inset(50%) !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    border: 0 !important;
  }

  .sr-only-focusable:focus,
  .sr-only-focusable:focus-visible {
    position: static !important;
    inline-size: auto !important;
    block-size: auto !important;
    padding: inherit !important;
    margin: inherit !important;
    overflow: visible !important;
    clip-path: none !important;
    white-space: normal !important;
  }

  /* ─── ARIA 状态样式 ─── */
  [aria-busy="true"] {
    cursor: progress;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  [aria-disabled="true"] {
    cursor: not-allowed;
    opacity: 0.5;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ─── 减少动态效果（2.3.3 Animation from Interactions） ─── */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
      transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: auto !important;
    }

    :where(.reveal, .reveal-fade, .reveal-scale) {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      filter: none !important;
      transition: none !important;
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. 用户偏好媒体查询 — 完整的无障碍矩阵
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   尊重操作系统层面的每一个用户偏好[reference:13][reference:14]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer utilities {
  /* ─── 颜色方案偏好（自动，由主题系统处理） ─── */
  :root {
    color-scheme: light dark;
  }

  /* ─── 强制颜色模式（Windows 高对比度）[reference:15] ─── */
  @media (forced-colors: active) {
    * {
      forced-color-adjust: auto;
    }

    :where(.button, .btn, button, a, input, textarea, select) {
      border: 1px solid ButtonText;
    }

    :where(.button-primary, .btn-primary, .oform-btn--primary) {
      background: ButtonText;
      color: ButtonFace;
      border: 2px solid ButtonText;
    }

    :where(.card, .panel, .modal, .dialog, .work-card, .blog-card) {
      border: 2px solid CanvasText;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    /* 隐藏装饰性元素 */
    :where(
      .hero-bg-orb,
      .hero-aperture,
      .hero-bg-grain,
      .hero-bg-grid,
      .manuscript-grid-pattern,
      .blog-page::before,
      .work-page::before,
      .not-found-page::before
    ) {
      display: none !important;
    }

    /* 焦点 */
    :focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid Highlight;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    /* 移除透明背景 */
    :where(.glass, .glass-soft, .glass-strong, .nav-pill, .mbn) {
      background: Canvas !important;
      backdrop-filter: none !important;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 对比度偏好：更高[reference:16] ─── */
  @media (prefers-contrast: more) {
    :root {
      --line: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 35%, transparent);
      --line-strong: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 55%, transparent);
      --ink-3: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 85%, transparent);
    }

    :where(p, li, td, dd, .body) {
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    :where(a:not([class]), .blog-post-content a) {
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 3px;
      text-decoration-thickness: 2px;
    }

    :where(.button, .btn, input, textarea, select, .card, .panel) {
      border-width: 2px;
    }

    :where(button, [role="button"], .button) {
      outline: 1px solid currentColor;
      outline-offset: 1px;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 对比度偏好：更低 ─── */
  @media (prefers-contrast: less) {
    :root {
      --line: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
      --line-strong: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink) 12%, transparent);
    }
  }

  /* ─── 透明度偏好：减少 ─── */
  @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) {
    :where(
      .glass,
      .glass-soft,
      .glass-strong,
      .nav-pill,
      .mbn,
      .welcome-backdrop,
      .project-modal,
      .hero-glass,
      .blog-inline-cta,
      .blog-funnel
    ) {
      backdrop-filter: none !important;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
      background: var(--surface) !important;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
  }

  /* ─── 数据偏好：减少 ─── */
  @media (prefers-reduced-data: reduce) {
    :where(
      .hero-bg-orb,
      .hero-aperture,
      .hero-bg-grain,
      .hero-bg-grid,
      .manuscript-grid-pattern,
      .blog-page::before,
      .work-page::before,
      .not-found-page::before
    ) {
      display: none !important;
    }

    img {
      image-rendering: optimizeSpeed;
      content-visibility: auto;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 色彩空间偏好：P3 ─── */
  @media (color-gamut: p3) {
    :root {
      --accent: oklch(0.62 0.24 40); /* 更鲜艳的 P3 色彩 */
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. 现代布局 — 容器查询、:has()、逻辑属性
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   组件响应父容器宽度，而非视口[reference:17][reference:18]。
   :has() 实现父级条件样式[reference:19]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer layout {
  /* ─── 容器查询基础 ─── */
  .card,
  .work-card,
  .blog-card,
  .commitment-card,
  .process-step,
  .testimonial-card,
  .service-item {
    container-type: inline-size;
    container-name: card;
  }

  /* ─── 卡片在窄容器中 ─── */
  @container card (max-width: 400px) {
    :where(.card, .work-card, .blog-card, .commitment-card) {
      padding: var(--space-2);
    }
  }

  /* ─── 卡片在宽容器中 ─── */
  @container card (min-width: 600px) {
    :where(.card, .work-card, .blog-card) {
      padding: var(--space-4);
    }

    :where(.work-card-title, .blog-card-title, .card-title) {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
    }
  }

  /* ─── :has() 条件样式 ─── */
  .form-field:has(input:focus) {
    --field-focus: 1;
  }

  .form-field:has(input:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown)) {
    --field-error: 1;
  }

  .form-field:has(input:valid:not(:placeholder-shown)) {
    --field-valid: 1;
  }

  /* ─── 有图片的卡片 → 溢出隐藏 ─── */
  .work-card:has(img),
  .blog-card:has(img),
  .portfolio-card:has(img) {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  /* ─── 空列表容器 ─── */
  :where(ul, ol, .grid, .list):not(:has(li, .item, .card))::after {
    content: "هیچ موردی برای نمایش وجود ندارد";
    display: block;
    padding: var(--space-4);
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--ink-3);
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    font-style: italic;
  }

  /* ─── 逻辑属性优先（RTL 原生支持）[reference:20] ─── */
  .container {
    inline-size: min(calc(100% - var(--space-4) * 2), var(--container));
    margin-inline: auto;
  }

  .container-narrow {
    inline-size: min(calc(100% - var(--space-4) * 2), var(--container-narrow));
    margin-inline: auto;
  }

  /* ─── 网格间距使用逻辑属性 ─── */
  :where(.grid, .grid-2, .grid-3, .grid-4) {
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--space-3);
  }

  /* ─── 边距使用块轴属性 ─── */
  :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6) {
    margin-block-start: 0;
    margin-block-end: var(--space-2);
  }

  :where(p, ul, ol, blockquote, figure, pre, table) {
    margin-block-end: var(--space-3);
  }

  /* ─── 内边距使用逻辑属性 ─── */
  :where(.button, .btn) {
    padding-block: 0.75rem;
    padding-inline: 1.5rem;
  }

  /* ─── 边框使用逻辑属性 ─── */
  .callout,
  .aside,
  .note {
    border-inline-start: 3px solid var(--accent);
    padding-inline-start: var(--space-3);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. 视图过渡与滚动驱动动画
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   View Transitions API 和 scroll-driven animations 是现代
   页面过渡和滚动效果的基石[reference:21]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer utilities {
  /* ─── 视图过渡（跨页面） ─── */
  @view-transition {
    navigation: auto;
  }

  ::view-transition-old(root) {
    animation: fade-out 200ms var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  ::view-transition-new(root) {
    animation: fade-in 240ms var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  @keyframes fade-out {
    from { opacity: 1; }
    to { opacity: 0; }
  }

  @keyframes fade-in {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to { opacity: 1; }
  }

  /* ─── 滚动驱动动画（渐进增强） ─── */
  @supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
    .scroll-fade-in {
      animation: scroll-fade-in linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% cover 40%;
    }

    .scroll-slide-up {
      animation: scroll-slide-up linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% cover 50%;
    }

    @keyframes scroll-fade-in {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }

    @keyframes scroll-slide-up {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(24px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
  }

  /* ─── 回退：使用 IntersectionObserver（已有 .reveal 系统） ─── */
  @supports not (animation-timeline: view()) {
    .scroll-fade-in,
    .scroll-slide-up {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 减少动态效果时的回退 ─── */
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    ::view-transition-old(root),
    ::view-transition-new(root) {
      animation: none;
    }

    .scroll-fade-in,
    .scroll-slide-up {
      animation: none !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. 打印样式
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   专业的打印输出，A4 优化，隐藏装饰性元素。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer utilities {
  @media print {
    @page {
      margin: 2cm;
      size: A4 portrait;
    }

    /* ─── 隐藏非内容元素 ─── */
    :where(
      .site-nav,
      .mbn,
      .chapter-rail,
      .back-to-top,
      .sound-toggle,
      .mobile-nav,
      .footer-masthead,
      .footer-hero,
      .footer-bottom-wrap,
      .welcome-overlay,
      .page-transition,
      .scroll-progress,
      .reading-progress,
      .toast-stack,
      .hero-bg,
      .hero-marquee,
      .hero-ruler,
      .hero-crosshair,
      .signature-ink,
      .hero-aperture,
      .hero-glass,
      .blog-inline-cta,
      .blog-funnel,
      .blog-share,
      .project-modal,
      .oform-actions
    ) {
      display: none !important;
    }

    /* ─── 基础排版 ─── */
    html,
    body {
      background: #fff !important;
      color: #000 !important;
      font-size: 11pt !important;
      line-height: 1.5 !important;
    }

    :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6) {
      color: #000 !important;
      page-break-after: avoid;
      break-after: avoid;
    }

    :where(p, li, blockquote) {
      color: #222 !important;
      orphans: 3;
      widows: 3;
    }

    /* ─── 链接 URL 显示 ─── */
    :where(a) {
      color: #000 !important;
      text-decoration: underline !important;
    }

    :where(a[href^="http"])::after {
      content: " (" attr(href) ")";
      font-size: 0.85em;
      color: #555;
      word-break: break-all;
    }

    /* ─── 按钮作为文本 ─── */
    :where(.button, .btn) {
      border: 1px solid #000 !important;
      background: transparent !important;
      color: #000 !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    /* ─── 卡片和面板 ─── */
    :where(.card, .panel, .work-card, .blog-card, .commitment-card) {
      border: 1px solid #ccc !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
      break-inside: avoid;
    }

    /* ─── 图片和图表 ─── */
    :where(img, figure) {
      max-inline-size: 100% !important;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
      break-inside: avoid;
    }

    /* ─── 隐藏动画和过渡 ─── */
    * {
      animation: none !important;
      transition: none !important;
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. 国际化与双向文本（RTL 最佳实践）
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   波斯语文本永远不应应用 letter-spacing[reference:22]。
   代码和 LTR 内容使用 bidi isolate[reference:23]。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer base {
  /* ─── 波斯语文本：无 letter-spacing ─── */
  :where([lang="fa"], [lang="ar"], [lang="ur"], [dir="rtl"]) {
    letter-spacing: 0;
    word-spacing: normal;
  }

  /* ─── 拉丁语文本：可以使用 letter-spacing ─── */
  :where([lang="en"], [lang="la"]) {
    letter-spacing: normal;
  }

  /* ─── 混合方向内容 ─── */
  .ltr-content {
    direction: ltr;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
  }

  .rtl-content {
    direction: rtl;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
  }

  /* ─── 数字：波斯语数字使用 tabular-nums ─── */
  .persian-nums {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    direction: ltr;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
    font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
  }

  /* ─── 拉丁数字 ─── */
  .latin-nums {
    direction: ltr;
    unicode-bidi: isolate;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums;
  }

  /* ─── 代码块始终 LTR ─── */
  :where(pre, code, kbd, samp) {
    direction: ltr !important;
    unicode-bidi: isolate !important;
    text-align: left !important;
  }

  /* ─── 表单输入：根据内容方向自动切换 ─── */
  :where(input[type="email"], input[type="url"], input[type="tel"], input[type="number"]) {
    direction: ltr;
    text-align: start;
  }

  /* ─── 双向文本的容器 ─── */
  .bidi-container {
    unicode-bidi: plaintext;
  }

  /* ─── 波斯语 Typography 优化 ─── */
  :where([lang="fa"]) :where(p, li, dd, blockquote) {
    line-height: 1.85; /* 波斯语需要更高的行高 */
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   11. 微细节 — 选区、光标、滚动条
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   这些细节用户不会注意到，但缺少它们会感觉“不对”。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer base {
  /* ─── 选区 ─── */
  ::selection {
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 85%, transparent);
    color: #fff;
    text-shadow: none;
  }

  ::-moz-selection {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #fff;
  }

  /* ─── 光标 ─── */
  :where(input, textarea, [contenteditable]) {
    caret-color: var(--accent);
  }

  /* ─── 滚动条（WebKit） ─── */
  ::-webkit-scrollbar {
    inline-size: 10px;
    block-size: 10px;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 65%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 100%
    );
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 3px solid transparent;
    background-clip: content-box;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-2) 100%);
    background-clip: content-box;
  }

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-corner {
    background: transparent;
  }

  /* ─── 滚动条（Firefox） ─── */
  * {
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) transparent;
  }

  /* ─── 图片渲染优化 ─── */
  img {
    max-inline-size: 100%;
    block-size: auto;
    image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast;
  }

  img[loading="lazy"] {
    content-visibility: auto;
  }

  /* ─── Placeholder ─── */
  ::placeholder {
    color: var(--ink-muted);
    opacity: 0.8;
  }

  /* ─── 禁用状态 ─── */
  :where(button, input, textarea, select):disabled {
    opacity: 0.5;
    cursor: not-allowed;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ─── 自动填充修复（Chrome 黄色背景） ─── */
  input:-webkit-autofill,
  input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
  input:-webkit-autofill:focus,
  textarea:-webkit-autofill,
  textarea:-webkit-autofill:hover,
  textarea:-webkit-autofill:focus,
  select:-webkit-autofill {
    -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--ink);
    -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px var(--surface) inset;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px var(--surface) inset;
    transition: background-color 5000s ease-in-out 0s;
  }

  /* ─── 暗色模式自动填充 ─── */
  [data-theme="dark"] input:-webkit-autofill,
  [data-theme="dark"] textarea:-webkit-autofill {
    -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px var(--surface) inset;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--ink);
  }

  /* ─── 锚点滚动 ─── */
  :target {
    scroll-margin-block-start: 6rem;
  }

  /* ─── 触摸优化 ─── */
  :where(button, a, [role="button"], input, textarea, select) {
    touch-action: manipulation;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }

  /* ─── 内容可见性（性能优化） ─── */
  :where(section, footer, .section) {
    content-visibility: auto;
    contain-intrinsic-size: auto 800px;
  }

  :where(.hero-section) {
    content-visibility: visible;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   12. 性能优化 — GPU 合成与层管理
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   确保所有动画使用 transform 和 opacity（仅合成层）。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer utilities {
  /* ─── 合成层提升 ─── */
  :where(
    .hero-bg-orb,
    .hero-aperture,
    .hero-marquee-track,
    .page-transition,
    .reveal,
    .magnetic-inner,
    .mbn-slider,
    .mbn-aurora
  ) {
    transform: translateZ(0);
    backface-visibility: hidden;
  }

  /* ─── 仅动画 transform 和 opacity ─── */
  :where(.button, .btn, a, .card, .work-card, .blog-card) {
    transition-property: transform, opacity, box-shadow, background-color, border-color, color;
    transition-duration: var(--dur-fast);
    transition-timing-function: var(--ease-out-expo);
  }

  /* ─── 布局包容性（桌面端） ─── */
  @media (min-width: 901px) {
    :where(.services-section, .portfolio-section, .about-section, .why-section) {
      contain: layout style paint;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 移动端：禁用重型效果 ─── */
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    :where(
      .hero-bg-orb-2,
      .hero-bg-orb-3,
      .hero-aperture,
      .hero-bg-grain
    ) {
      display: none !important;
    }

    :where(.hero-bg-orb-1) {
      opacity: 0.4;
      filter: blur(60px);
    }

    :where(
      .portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual,
      .work-card:hover,
      .blog-card:hover,
      .commitment-card:hover,
      .process-step:hover,
      .testimonial-card:hover,
      .faq-item:hover
    ) {
      transform: none !important;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm) !important;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 标签页隐藏时暂停动画 ─── */
  html[data-tab-hidden="true"] *,
  html[data-tab-hidden="true"] *::before,
  html[data-tab-hidden="true"] *::after {
    animation-play-state: paused !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   13. 终极打磨 — 排版节奏与间距系统
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   统一的垂直节奏，基于 8px 基线网格的间距系统。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer utilities {
  /* ─── 流式排版比例 ─── */
  :root {
    --fs-hero: clamp(2.5rem, 1rem + 7.5vw, 9rem);
    --fs-display: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 5vw, 6rem);
    --fs-h1: clamp(1.75rem, 1rem + 3.75vw, 4.5rem);
    --fs-h2: clamp(1.5rem, 1rem + 2.5vw, 3.5rem);
    --fs-h3: clamp(1.25rem, 1rem + 1.25vw, 2rem);
    --fs-h4: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.625vw, 1.375rem);
    --fs-body: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem);
    --fs-lead: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.625vw, 1.375rem);
    --fs-small: clamp(0.875rem, 0.85rem + 0.125vw, 0.9375rem);
    --fs-micro: clamp(0.75rem, 0.72rem + 0.15vw, 0.8125rem);
  }

  /* ─── 行高 ─── */
  :root {
    --lh-hero: 1.05;
    --lh-display: 1.08;
    --lh-heading: 1.15;
    --lh-body: 1.85;
    --lh-lead: 1.75;
    --lh-small: 1.6;
  }

  /* ─── 垂直节奏 ─── */
  :where(.section, .section-compact) {
    padding-block: var(--space-7);
  }

  :where(h1) { font-size: var(--fs-h1); line-height: var(--lh-heading); }
  :where(h2) { font-size: var(--fs-h2); line-height: var(--lh-heading); }
  :where(h3) { font-size: var(--fs-h3); line-height: var(--lh-heading); }
  :where(h4) { font-size: var(--fs-h4); line-height: var(--lh-heading); }

  :where(p, li, dd, .body) {
    font-size: var(--fs-body);
    line-height: var(--lh-body);
  }

  :where(.lead, .body-lead) {
    font-size: var(--fs-lead);
    line-height: var(--lh-lead);
  }

  :where(small, .small, .caption) {
    font-size: var(--fs-small);
    line-height: var(--lh-small);
  }

  :where(.micro, .eyebrow) {
    font-size: var(--fs-micro);
    line-height: var(--lh-small);
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* ─── 阅读宽度限制 ─── */
  :where(.blog-post-content, .prose, .article-body) {
    max-inline-size: var(--measure);
    margin-inline: auto;
  }

  /* ─── 文本装饰优化 ─── */
  :where(a) {
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-skip-ink: auto;
    text-decoration-thickness: from-font;
  }

  /* ─── 强调元素 ─── */
  :where(strong, b) {
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  :where(em, i) {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  /* ─── 首字下沉 ─── */
  @supports (initial-letter: 4) {
    .drop-cap::first-letter {
      initial-letter: 4;
      margin-inline-end: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      font-weight: 800;
    }
  }

  /* ─── 悬挂标点 ─── */
  :where(blockquote, p, li) {
    hanging-punctuation: first last;
  }

  /* ─── 连字符（仅长文本） ─── */
  :where(.blog-post-content p, .prose p) {
    hyphens: auto;
    -webkit-hyphens: auto;
  }

  /* ─── 孤行寡行控制 ─── */
  :where(p, li) {
    orphans: 2;
    widows: 2;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   14. 覆盖层 — 最后的手段
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   只在极少数情况下使用。优先使用 @layer 和语义化令牌。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@layer overrides {
  /* ─── 仅针对旧浏览器修复 ─── */
  @supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) {
    .glass,
    .glass-soft,
    .glass-strong,
    .nav-pill,
    .mbn {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
  }

  /* ─── 仅针对不支持 :has() 的浏览器 ─── */
  @supports not selector(:has(*)) {
    .form-field:has(input:focus) {
      /* 回退：不应用特殊样式 */
    }
  }

  /* ─── 仅针对不支持容器查询的浏览器 ─── */
  @supports not (container-type: inline-size) {
    .card,
    .work-card,
    .blog-card {
      /* 回退到媒体查询 */
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   结束 — 这个文件应该永远是最后一个加载的 CSS。
   所有样式都被组织在 @layer 中，确保级联顺序可预测。
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
```


## FILE: src\styles\final-polish.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   FINAL POLISH — The Infinite Details
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Everything that separates "very good" from "Awwwards".
   - Custom cursor
   - Page transitions
   - Selection & focus
   - Link underlines
   - Grain overlay
   - Marquee physics
   - Scroll ornament
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. PAGE TRANSITION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.page-transition {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 99997;
  background: var(--paper);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: pageTransitionFade 780ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .page-transition {
  background: var(--paper);
}

@keyframes pageTransitionFade {
  0% {
    opacity: 0.92;
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .page-transition {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. SELECTION — signature gradient
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
::selection {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  );
  color: #ffffff;
  text-shadow: none;
}

::-moz-selection {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #ffffff;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. FOCUS — beautiful rings
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
*:focus {
  outline: none;
}

*:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent);
  transition:
    outline-offset 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
[role="button"]:focus-visible {
  border-radius: 999px;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent),
    0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent);
}

/* Skip link gets accent treatment */
.skip-link:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. LINK UNDERLINES — animated on hover
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/* Text links in content */
.blog-post-content a,
.about-content a,
p a,
li a {
  position: relative;
  text-decoration: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent) 100%
  );
  background-size: 100% 1.5px;
  background-position: 0 100%;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  padding-bottom: 1px;
  transition: background-size 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.blog-post-content a:hover,
.about-content a:hover,
p a:hover,
li a:hover {
  background-size: 0 1.5px;
  background-position: 100% 100%;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent-2) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. GRAIN OVERLAY — subtle film texture
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
body::after {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.035;
  mix-blend-mode: overlay;
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20width='200'%20height='200'%3E%3Cfilter%20id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence%20type='fractalNoise'%20baseFrequency='0.85'%20numOctaves='2'%20stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect%20width='100%25'%20height='100%25'%20filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  background-size: 180px 180px;
}

[data-theme="dark"] body::after {
  opacity: 0.055;
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  body::after {
    opacity: 0.02;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. MARQUEE — reacts to hover with pause + glow
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-marquee-track:hover {
  animation-play-state: paused;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent));
}

.hero-marquee-item {
  transition:
    color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    letter-spacing 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.hero-marquee-track:hover .hero-marquee-item {
  color: var(--accent);
  letter-spacing: 0.32em;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. HEADLINE REVEAL — scroll-driven (supported browsers)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
    .section-heading h2,
    .about-identity-title,
    .why-header h2,
    .final-cta h2,
    .blog-header h1,
    .work-title,
    .work-detail-title {
      animation: headlineReveal linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% entry 40%;
    }

    @keyframes headlineReveal {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(24px);
        filter: blur(6px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
        filter: blur(0);
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. EMPHASIS — animated accent underline on emphasized words
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.section-heading h2 em,
.final-cta h2 em,
.blog-header h1 em {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.section-heading h2 em::after,
.final-cta h2 em::after,
.blog-header h1 em::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: -2px;
  bottom: 0.08em;
  height: 0.08em;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    var(--accent) 15%,
    var(--accent) 85%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  opacity: 0.35;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. KBD + CODE — refined
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
kbd {
  padding: 3px 8px !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, var(--surface)) 100%
    ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 12%, transparent) !important;
  border-bottom-width: 2px !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 70%, transparent),
    0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  font-size: 0.78em !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   11. SCROLL ORNAMENT — vertical indicator
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 1280px) and (hover: hover) {
  .site-nav .nav-progress-bar {
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent 0%,
      var(--accent) 20%,
      var(--accent) 80%,
      transparent 100%
    ) !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   12. IMAGES — subtle sharpen
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
img {
  image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast;
}

.portfolio-card-canvas img,
.work-card-visual img,
.project-modal-visual img {
  transition:
    transform 800ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    filter 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   13. SCROLLBAR — premium
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
* {
  scrollbar-width: thin;
  scrollbar-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) transparent;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: transparent;
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 3px solid transparent;
  background-clip: content-box;
  transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  );
  background-clip: content-box;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   14. REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html.custom-cursor-active,
  html.custom-cursor-active * {
    cursor: auto !important;
  }

  .hero-marquee-track:hover {
    animation-play-state: running;
    filter: none;
  }

  .hero-marquee-track:hover .hero-marquee-item {
    color: inherit;
    letter-spacing: inherit;
  }
}
```

```css
/* 
  Fix for blog post layout that causes a giant block on the left.
  Ensures the content is perfectly centered and scrollable.
*/

/* Force the blog layout to be a centered flex container instead of a broken grid */
.blog-post-layout {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  padding: 0 1rem !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* Make sure the main content is exactly 65ch wide and centered */
.blog-post-content {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 65ch !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
}

/* Hide the sidebar on mobile/tablet to prevent layout shifts */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .blog-post-sidebar {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

/* Fix any custom scrollbar issues that might cause massive overlays */
html {
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}
body {
  overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* Ensure reading progress bar stays at the top and doesn't interfere */
.reading-progress-bar {
  position: fixed !important;
  top: 0 !important;
  left: 0 !important;
  height: 3px !important;
  z-index: 9999 !important;
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   FOOTER-EFFECTS — Footer, BackToTop, ScrollProgress,
                    Reveal & animations
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   23. Footer
   ============================================================ */
.site-footer {
  padding-block: 64px 32px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.footer-main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
  gap: 40px;
  padding-bottom: 40px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.footer-brand-block {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
}

.footer-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.footer-mark {
  display: grid;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface);
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.footer-brand > div {
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
}

.footer-brand strong {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.footer-brand span {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.footer-tagline {
  max-width: 380px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.85;
}

.footer-signature {
  display: block;
  width: 160px;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.footer-nav-block {
  display: grid;
  gap: 24px;
  align-content: start;
}

.footer-nav {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.footer-nav-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.footer-nav a {
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 14px;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.footer-nav a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.footer-email {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  direction: ltr;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.footer-email:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  padding-top: 24px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ── Footer bottom items (from enhancements) ── */
.footer-bottom-item,
.footer-bottom-center {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.footer-bottom-center {
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
}

.footer-back-top {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.footer-back-top:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .footer-bottom-center {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   24. Back to top
   ============================================================ */
.back-to-top {
  position: fixed;
  inset-inline-end: 24px;
  bottom: 24px;
  z-index: 80;
  display: grid;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 16px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  animation: backTopIn var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .back-to-top {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
  }
}

.back-to-top:hover {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

@keyframes backTopIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ============================================================
   25. Scroll progress
   ============================================================ */
.scroll-progress {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0 auto auto 0;
  z-index: 101;
  height: 2px;
  background: var(--accent);
  transform-origin: right;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transition: transform 100ms linear;
}

/* ============================================================
   26. Reveal & animations
   ============================================================ */
.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(20px);
  filter: blur(4px);
  transition:
    opacity var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out),
    filter var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out);
}

.reveal.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  filter: blur(0);
}

.reveal-fade {
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out);
}

.reveal-fade.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
}

.reveal-scale {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.96);
  transition:
    opacity var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out);
}

.reveal-scale.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes fadeOut {
  from { opacity: 1; }
  to { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes slideUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes slideDown {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-16px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes scaleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.96); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

@keyframes blurIn {
  from { opacity: 0; filter: blur(8px); }
  to { opacity: 1; filter: blur(0); }
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  from { background-position: -200% 0; }
  to { background-position: 200% 0; }
}

@keyframes float {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
}

@keyframes pulseRing {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-glow); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 20px transparent; }
}

@keyframes spin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes bounceIn {
  0% { transform: scale(0.9); opacity: 0; }
  60% { transform: scale(1.02); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

.animate-fade-in { animation: fadeIn var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out) both; }
.animate-slide-up { animation: slideUp var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out) both; }
.animate-scale-in { animation: scaleIn var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out) both; }
.animate-blur-in { animation: blurIn var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out) both; }
.animate-float { animation: float 4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite; }
.animate-pulse-ring { animation: pulseRing 1.8s var(--ease-out) infinite; }
.animate-spin { animation: spin 1s linear infinite; }
.animate-bounce-in { animation: bounceIn 500ms var(--ease-spring) both; }

.delay-1 { animation-delay: 80ms; }
.delay-2 { animation-delay: 160ms; }
.delay-3 { animation-delay: 240ms; }
.delay-4 { animation-delay: 320ms; }
.delay-5 { animation-delay: 400ms; }
.delay-6 { animation-delay: 480ms; }

.spinner {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  border-top-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: spin 0.7s linear infinite;
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   FOOTER V2 — Editorial Masterpiece (v2)
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Fixed: grid sizing, contact card layout, button widths.
   Everything responsive from 320px to 1920px.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION WRAPPER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.site-footer {
  position: relative !important;
  padding-block: 0 !important;
  background: var(--paper-2) !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  isolation: isolate !important;
}

.site-footer::before {
  content: none !important;
  display: none !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   AMBIENT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-ambient {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.footer-ambient-glow {
  position: absolute;
  top: -20%;
  inset-inline-end: -15%;
  width: 55vw;
  height: 55vw;
  max-width: 720px;
  max-height: 720px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 40% 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  opacity: 0.55;
}

.footer-ambient-grid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(
    circle at 1px 1px,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) 1px,
    transparent 0
  );
  background-size: 36px 36px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 30%,
    #000 20%,
    transparent 70%
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 30%,
    #000 20%,
    transparent 70%
  );
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MASTHEAD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-masthead {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 92%, transparent);
}

.footer-masthead-inner {
  display: flex;

  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;

  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.footer-masthead-left,
.footer-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.7;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.footer-masthead-mark {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  opacity: 0.8;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   HERO CTA
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-hero {
  position: relative;

}

.footer-hero-grid {

  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.5fr) minmax(0, 1fr);

.footer-hero-content {

.footer-hero-title {

.footer-hero-actions {

}

.footer-hero-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 56px;
  min-width: 180px;
  padding-inline: 28px;

  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),

    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),

.footer-hero-btn--primary {

  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0a0908 0%, #211c18 55%, #0a0908 100%);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    0 12px 30px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42);
}

.footer-hero-btn--primary::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: opacity 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.footer-hero-btn--primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
    0 18px 44px -14px var(--accent-glow);
}

.footer-hero-btn--primary:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.footer-hero-btn--primary > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  display: inline-flex;
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.footer-hero-btn--primary:hover > span[aria-hidden="true"] {

[data-theme="dark"] .footer-hero-btn--primary {

  );
}

[data-theme="dark"] .footer-hero-btn--primary::before {
  display: none;
}

.footer-hero-btn--secondary {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),

}

.footer-hero-btn--secondary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 12px 28px -12px var(--accent-glow);
}

/* ─── Stats aside ─── */
.footer-hero-aside {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0;
  padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 16px 40px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.1);
  align-self: center;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 380px;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .footer-hero-aside {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
    justify-self: end;
  }
}

.footer-hero-stat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  padding-block: 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.footer-hero-stat:first-child {
  padding-top: 0;
}

.footer-hero-stat:last-child {
  padding-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom: none;
}

.footer-hero-stat-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;

.footer-hero-stat-value {

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MAIN GRID
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-grid-wrap {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  padding-block: clamp(56px, 7vw, 88px);
}

.footer-grid {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  /* 4 columns: brand (wider) + 3 equal */
  grid-template-columns:

    minmax(0, 1fr)

  gap: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 48px);

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
```
