```css
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}

.footer-col--brand {
  gap: 20px;
}

.footer-brand-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  align-self: flex-start;
  transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.footer-brand-link:hover {
  transform: translateX(-2px);
}

.footer-brand-logo {
  display: block !important;
  width: 48px !important;
  height: 48px !important;
  border-radius: 13px !important;
  object-fit: cover !important;
  background: #0a0908 !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12),
    0 4px 12px -4px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.35),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.05);
}

.footer-brand-copy {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.footer-brand-copy strong {
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.footer-brand-copy small {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.5625rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.footer-brand-tagline {
  max-width: 36ch;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.footer-brand-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px 20px;
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.footer-brand-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 85%, var(--ink));
}

.footer-brand-status-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 50%, transparent);
  animation: footer-status-pulse 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes footer-status-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(0.82); }
}

.footer-brand-location {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.footer-brand-clock {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.footer-brand-location-sep {
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   NAV COLUMNS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-col--nav {
  gap: 16px;
}

.footer-col-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.footer-col-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.footer-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding-block: 6px;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition:
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    padding-inline-start 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  position: relative;
}

.footer-link::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 50%;
  width: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--accent);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  transition: width 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.footer-link:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  padding-inline-start: 14px;
}

.footer-link:hover::before {
  width: 10px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CONTACT COLUMN — Vertical stack, cards full width
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-col--contact {
  gap: 12px;
}

.footer-col--contact .contact-links-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
}

.footer-col--contact .contact-card {
  min-height: 56px;
}

.footer-col--contact .contact-card-value {
  max-width: 100%;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   EMAIL ROW
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-email-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-top: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
  padding-top: clamp(28px, 3vw, 40px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-email-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
}

.footer-email-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 1.4vw, 1.0625rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
  padding-bottom: 2px;
  transition:
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  word-break: break-all;
}

.footer-email-value:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BOTTOM BAR
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-bottom-wrap {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  padding-block: 24px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 96%, var(--ink));
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .footer-bottom-wrap {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 90%, #000);
}

.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-copyright {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.footer-signature-line {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.6;
  direction: ltr;
}

.footer-bottom-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-inline-start: auto;
}

.footer-back-to-top {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.footer-back-to-top:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.footer-back-to-top-arrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.footer-back-to-top:hover .footer-back-to-top-arrow {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — 1200px
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .footer-grid {
    grid-template-columns:
      minmax(0, 1.3fr)
      minmax(0, 1fr)
      minmax(0, 1fr)
      minmax(0, 1.3fr);
    gap: 24px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — 1024px (tablet)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .footer-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 32px 24px;
  }

  .footer-col--brand {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    padding-bottom: 28px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .footer-col--contact {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    padding-top: 28px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .footer-col--contact .contact-links-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 12px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — 900px (small tablet)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .footer-hero-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 36px;
  }

  .footer-hero-aside {
    max-width: 100%;
    justify-self: stretch;
  }

  .footer-watermark {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — 720px (mobile)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .footer-masthead-inner {
    font-size: 0.5625rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    padding-block: 16px;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .footer-masthead-left,
  .footer-masthead-right {
    white-space: normal;
    overflow: visible;
    text-overflow: clip;
    font-size: 0.5625rem;
  }

  .footer-hero {
    padding-block: 44px;
  }

  .footer-hero-eyebrow {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  }

  .footer-hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.625rem, 7.5vw, 2.25rem);
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .footer-hero-text {
    margin-top: 18px;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }

  .footer-hero-actions {
    margin-top: 24px;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .footer-hero-btn {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 54px;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    padding-inline: 20px;
  }

  .footer-hero-aside {
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .footer-hero-stat {
    padding-block: 12px;
  }

  .footer-hero-stat-value {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }

  .footer-grid-wrap {
    padding-block: 44px;
  }

  .footer-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 28px;
  }

  .footer-col--brand {
    padding-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .footer-col--contact {
    padding-top: 24px;
  }

  .footer-col--contact .contact-links-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .footer-brand-logo {
    width: 42px !important;
    height: 42px !important;
    border-radius: 11px !important;
  }

  .footer-brand-copy strong {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }

  .footer-brand-copy small {
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  }

  .footer-brand-tagline {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }

  .footer-email-row {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 32px;
    padding-top: 24px;
  }

  .footer-email-value {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }

  .footer-signature-line {
    display: none;
  }

  .footer-back-to-top {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    min-height: 38px;
  }

  .footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .footer-bottom-actions {
    margin-inline-start: 0;
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — 400px (small mobile)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .footer-masthead-inner {
    font-size: 0.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  .footer-copyright {
    font-size: 0.625rem;
  }

  .footer-hero-btn {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    padding-inline: 16px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .footer-brand-status-dot {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .footer-hero-btn,
  .footer-hero-btn::before,
  .footer-hero-btn--primary > span[aria-hidden="true"],
  .footer-link,
  .footer-link::before,
  .footer-brand-link,
  .footer-back-to-top,
  .footer-back-to-top-arrow,
  .footer-email-value {
    transition: none !important;
  }

  .footer-hero-btn:hover,
  .footer-link:hover,
  .footer-brand-link:hover,
  .footer-back-to-top:hover {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
```


## FILE: src\styles\form-progress.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   FORM PROGRESS + FIELD VALIDATION — Fixed with Flexbox
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - Icons are positioned via flexbox (never absolute top)
   - Always vertically centered with the input
   - Works identically on desktop and mobile
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══ Form progress bar ═══ */
.form-progress {
  padding: 14px 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 100%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 100%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  animation: formProgressIn 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.form-progress-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.form-progress-badge {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 1px;
  min-width: 44px;
  height: 30px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
  transition: background-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.form-progress-badge-value { line-height: 1; }
.form-progress-badge-unit { font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.7; line-height: 1; }

.form-progress[aria-valuenow="100"] .form-progress-badge {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent);
  color: var(--success);
}

.form-progress-track {
  flex: 1;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line-strong) 40%, transparent);
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.form-progress-fill {
  position: absolute;
  inset-block: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-2) 0%, var(--accent) 100%);
  transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  will-change: width;
}

.form-progress[aria-valuenow="100"] .form-progress-fill {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 70%, var(--accent)) 0%,
    var(--success) 100%
  );
}

.form-progress-label {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.form-progress[aria-valuenow="100"] .form-progress-label { color: var(--success); }

@keyframes formProgressIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FIELD VALIDATION — Flexbox layout (fixed positioning)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* The wrapper is a grid: label / input-row / error */
.form-field {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto;
  gap: 0;
  position: relative;
}

/* The input-row contains input + optional icon */
.form-field > span:first-child {
  /* This is the label */
}

.form-field input,
.form-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

/* Success — gradient background + green border */
.form-field[data-state="success"] input,
.form-field[data-state="success"] textarea {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 40%, var(--line));
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--surface) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 94%, var(--success)) 100%
  );
}

/* Error — gradient background + red border */
.form-field[data-state="error"] input,
.form-field[data-state="error"] textarea {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 50%, var(--line));
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--surface) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, var(--danger)) 100%
  );
}

/* Icon wrapper — replaces the ::after pseudo-element */
.form-field-icon {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-end: 14px;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  animation: fieldIconIn 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

/* For textarea, position at top instead of vertical center */
.form-field:has(textarea) .form-field-icon {
  top: 54px;
  transform: none;
}

.form-field[data-state="success"] .form-field-icon {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 14%, transparent);
  color: var(--success);
}

.form-field[data-state="error"] .form-field-icon {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, transparent);
  color: var(--danger);
}

.form-field-icon svg {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  stroke-width: 3;
}

.form-field[data-state="error"] .form-field-icon svg {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  stroke-width: 2.5;
}

@keyframes fieldIconIn {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.4); }
  60%  { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.15); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1); }
}

/* Textarea variant — no translateY */
.form-field:has(textarea) .form-field-icon {
  animation: fieldIconInTextarea 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

@keyframes fieldIconInTextarea {
  0%   { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.4); }
  60%  { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.15); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

/* Inline error message */
.form-field-error {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--danger);
  animation: fieldErrorMessageIn 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

@keyframes fieldErrorMessageIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* Character counter */
.form-field-counter {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 34px;
  inset-inline-end: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.form-field-counter.is-near-limit { color: var(--accent); }
.form-field-counter.is-over-limit { color: var(--danger); }

/* ═══ Mobile ═══ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .form-progress { padding: 12px 18px; }
  .form-progress-inner { gap: 10px; }
  .form-progress-badge { min-width: 40px; height: 28px; font-size: 12px; padding: 0 9px; }
  .form-progress-track { height: 5px; }
  .form-progress-label { font-size: 11px; }

  .form-field-icon {
    inset-inline-end: 12px;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
  }

  .form-field:has(textarea) .form-field-icon {
    top: 48px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .form-progress,
  .form-progress-fill,
  .form-field-icon,
  .form-field-error { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
}
```

## FILE: src\styles\grid-overlay.css

```css
/* ============================================================
   GRID OVERLAY — Visible design grid
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Hidden by default. Toggle with Ctrl+G / ⌘+G.
   ============================================================ */

.grid-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 9998;
  pointer-events: none;
  display: none;
  isolation: isolate;
}

body.show-grid .grid-overlay {
  display: block;
}

/* ─── Container (same as .container) ─── */
.grid-overlay-container {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: min(
    calc(100% - var(--grid-margin) * 2),
    var(--container)
  );
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* ─── 12 Columns ─── */
.grid-overlay-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
  gap: var(--grid-gutter);
  height: 100%;
}

.grid-overlay-column {
  position: relative;
  height: 100%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 7%, transparent);
  border-inline: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .grid-overlay-column {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
}

/* ─── Column number labels ─── */
.grid-overlay-column-num {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  inset-inline-start: 4px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
  padding: 2px 5px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 80%, transparent);
  border-radius: 3px;
}

/* ─── Baseline grid (8px) ─── */
.grid-overlay-baselines {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 1px,
    transparent 1px
  );
  background-size: 100% var(--baseline);
  opacity: 0.6;
  mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .grid-overlay-baselines {
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  background-image: linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 1px,
    transparent 1px
  );
}

/* ─── Top ruler ─── */
.grid-overlay-ruler {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline: 0;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 6px calc(var(--grid-margin) + 4px);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--accent);
  direction: ltr;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 70%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
}

/* ─── Indicator badge (bottom-start) ─── */
body.show-grid::after {
  content: "GRID · 12 COL · 8px BASE";
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 16px;
  inset-inline-start: 16px;
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  border-radius: 999px;
  pointer-events: none;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -6px var(--accent-glow);
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ─── Reduced motion: no changes needed (grid is static) ─── */
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   HERO BENTO — LIVE CELL
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Fifth bento cell — shows 3 auto-rotating states:
     1. Latest post + relative time
     2. Live index count (posts · projects)
     3. Archive pick (older post)
   Rotates every 5.5s. Fades between states. Auto-pauses on hover.
   ============================================================ */

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--live {
  grid-column: span 2 !important;
  min-height: 124px !important;
  padding: 14px 16px !important;
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto !important;
  grid-template-rows: auto 1fr !important;
  column-gap: 10px !important;
  row-gap: 8px !important;
  align-items: start !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell--live {
    min-height: 138px !important;
    padding: 16px 18px !important;
  }
}

/* ─── Top row: number + LIVE badge ─── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--live .hero-bento-num {
  grid-column: 1 !important;
  grid-row: 1 !important;
  align-self: center !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-live-badge {

  align-self: center !important;
}

  display: inline-block !important;
  width: 5px !important;
  height: 5px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--success) !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 18%, transparent),
    0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 55%, transparent) !important;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2s var(--ease-in-out) infinite !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
}

/* ─── Stack area ─── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-live-stack {
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   HERO — AWWWARDS 2026 EDITION
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   - Editorial rulers (magazine style)
   - Crosshair markers at 4 corners
   - Bento grid (asymmetric glass tiles)
   - 3-color aurora
   - Signature draw animation
   - All !important to defeat any legacy override
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section {

    padding-block: 132px 88px !important;
  }
}

  margin-inline: auto !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-inner {
    width: min(calc(100% - 48px), 1320px) !important;
  }
}

   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  inset: 0 !important;

  height: 1px !important;
  background: var(--accent) !important;
  opacity: 0.7 !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-kicker-text {
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.62rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  direction: ltr !important;
  color: var(--ink-3) !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-kicker-text {
    font-size: 0.72rem !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.4em !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MEGA TITLE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-title {
  margin: 0 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  line-height: 1.1 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
  color: var(--ink) !important;
  text-wrap: balance !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line {
  display: block !important;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 8.5vw, 2.75rem) !important;
  line-height: 1.14 !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 1.4rem + 4.5vw, 5rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.06 !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line + .hero-title-line {
  margin-top: 0.02em !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-muted {
  color: var(--ink-3) !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-accent {
  font-style: normal !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  display: inline-block !important;
  margin-inline-start: 0.02em !important;
  animation: dotGlow 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite !important;
}

@keyframes dotGlow {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; text-shadow: 0 0 0 transparent; }
  50%      { opacity: 0.85; text-shadow: 0 0 24px var(--accent-glow); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ROLE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-role {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
  margin-top: 22px !important;
  padding: 7px 14px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: var(--glass) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border) !important;
  font-size: 0.875rem !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
  color: var(--ink) !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    gap: 10px !important;
    margin-top: 32px !important;
    padding: 8px 16px !important;
    font-size: 1.0625rem !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3) !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-role-dot {
  display: inline-block !important;
  width: 6px !important;
  height: 6px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--accent) !important;
  flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-role-dot { width: 7px !important; height: 7px !important; }
}

.hero-section .hero-role-text {
  display: inline-block !important;
  animation: roleIn 420ms var(--ease-out) !important;
}

@keyframes roleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DESCRIPTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-description {
  max-width: 100% !important;
  margin-top: 20px !important;
  font-size: 0.9375rem !important;
  line-height: 1.8 !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
  color: var(--ink-2) !important;
  text-wrap: pretty !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-description {
    max-width: 52ch !important;
    margin-top: 26px !important;
    font-size: 1.0625rem !important;
    line-height: 1.75 !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BUTTONS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-actions {
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: stretch !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  margin-top: 32px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: row !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
    width: auto !important;
    margin-top: 44px !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-btn {
  position: relative !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  gap: 10px !important;
  min-height: 56px !important;
  padding-inline: 26px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-size: 0.9375rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  isolation: isolate !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  transition:
    transform 260ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 360ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    color 240ms var(--ease-out) !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-btn {
    width: auto !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
    min-height: 60px !important;
    padding-inline: 32px !important;
    font-size: 1rem !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  color: #fff9f4 !important;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0a0908 0%, #211c18 55%, #0a0908 100%) !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08),
    0 14px 34px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.44) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  content: "" !important;
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: -1px !important;
  border-radius: inherit !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  ) !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  z-index: -1 !important;
  transition: opacity 320ms var(--ease-out) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
    0 22px 50px -14px var(--accent-glow),
    0 8px 22px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.26) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover::before {
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-arrow {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  width: 20px !important;
  height: 20px !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  transition: transform 320ms var(--ease-spring) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover .hero-btn-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-5px) !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  ) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  display: none !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  color: var(--ink) !important;
  background: var(--surface) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  border-color: var(--accent) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 14px 32px -12px var(--accent-glow) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-count {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
  min-width: 26px !important;
  height: 22px !important;
  padding-inline: 7px !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  background: var(--paper-2) !important;
  color: var(--ink-3) !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 10.5px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) !important;
  color: var(--ink) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BENTO GRID
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-bento {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 12px !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 520px !important;
  margin-inline: auto !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento {
    gap: 14px !important;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento {
    margin-inline: 0 !important;
    position: sticky !important;
    top: 130px !important;
    align-self: start !important;
  }
}

/* ── Base cell ── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
  position: relative !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  padding: 16px !important;
  border-radius: 20px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  isolation: isolate !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      155deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 78%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 50%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 65%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04),
    0 16px 40px -18px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.16) !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
    padding: 20px !important;
    border-radius: 22px !important;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
    backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.7) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(1.7) !important;
  }
}

/* Gradient border ring */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell::before {
  content: "" !important;
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: -1px !important;
  border-radius: inherit !important;
  padding: 1px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent) 35%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent) 65%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent) 100%
  ) !important;
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) !important;
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) !important;
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor !important;
  mask-composite: exclude !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: -1 !important;
}

/* Interior mesh for accent cells */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell-mesh {
  position: absolute !important;
  inset: 0 !important;
  border-radius: inherit !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 0 !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell-mesh::before {
  content: "" !important;
  position: absolute !important;
  top: -40% !important;
  inset-inline-end: -30% !important;
  width: 110% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 40% 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2) 30%, transparent) 35%,
    transparent 65%
  ) !important;
  filter: blur(28px) !important;
  opacity: 0.9 !important;
  animation: bentoMesh 20s var(--ease-in-out) infinite !important;
}

@keyframes bentoMesh {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(-16px, 12px, 0) scale(1.08); }
}

/* Cell number (top-left) */
.hero-section .hero-bento-num {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.58rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em !important;
  color: var(--ink-3) !important;
  opacity: 0.75 !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
}

/* Cell label (small caps) */
.hero-section .hero-bento-label {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.55rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  color: var(--ink-3) !important;
  opacity: 0.7 !important;
  direction: ltr !important;
  margin-top: 4px !important;
}

/* ── Cell A: Name (2x2) ── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--name {
  grid-column: span 2 !important;
  min-height: 240px !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 20px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell--name {
    min-height: 320px !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--name .hero-bento-status {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  align-self: flex-start !important;
  padding: 5px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 12%, transparent) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 30%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--success) !important;
  font-size: 0.6rem !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  margin-top: 6px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell--name .hero-bento-status {
    font-size: 0.68rem !important;
    padding: 6px 12px !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-status-dot {
  display: inline-block !important;
  width: 6px !important;
  height: 6px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--success) !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 20%, transparent),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 55%, transparent) !important;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2s var(--ease-in-out) infinite !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--name .hero-bento-body {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  gap: 4px !important;
  margin-top: auto !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.58rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 55%, transparent) !important;
  direction: ltr !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-name {
  margin: 2px 0 0 !important;
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 6.5vw, 2.25rem) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  line-height: 1.02 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
  color: var(--ink) !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-name {
    font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.2vw, 2.75rem) !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-role {
  margin: 6px 0 0 !important;
  font-size: 0.8125rem !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
  font-weight: 500 !important;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 72%, transparent) !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
}

/* ── Cell B: Clock (1x1) ── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--clock {
  grid-column: span 1 !important;
  min-height: 130px !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell--clock {
    min-height: 150px !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-clock-time {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 1.125rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em !important;
  color: var(--ink) !important;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  margin-top: auto !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-clock-time {
    font-size: 1.375rem !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-live {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.55rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--success) !important;
  direction: ltr !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-live-dot {
  display: inline-block !important;
  width: 5px !important;
  height: 5px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: var(--success) !important;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2s var(--ease-in-out) infinite !important;
}

/* ── Cell C: Signature (1x1) ── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--sig {
  grid-column: span 1 !important;
  min-height: 130px !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell--sig {
    min-height: 150px !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-sig-mark {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: block !important;
  width: 100% !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  margin-top: auto !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-sig-mark svg {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: auto !important;
  display: block !important;
}

/* Signature draw animation */
.hero-section .hero-sig-path {
  stroke-dasharray: 500 !important;
  stroke-dashoffset: 500 !important;
  animation: sigDraw 2.4s var(--ease-out) 0.4s forwards !important;
}

@keyframes sigDraw {
  to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
}

/* ── Cell D: Big number (2x1) ── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--num {
  grid-column: span 2 !important;
  min-height: 140px !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 8px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell--num {
    min-height: 160px !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-bignum {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: baseline !important;
  gap: 4px !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 3.5rem !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em !important;
  color: var(--ink) !important;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums !important;
  margin-top: auto !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-bignum {
    font-size: 4.5rem !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-bignum em {
  font-size: 0.4em !important;
  font-style: normal !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  margin-inline-start: 2px !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-sub {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  font-size: 0.7rem !important;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 62%, transparent) !important;
  letter-spacing: 0 !important;
  line-height: 1.4 !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MARQUEE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-marquee {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  margin-top: 56px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  padding: 0.9rem 0 !important;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
  mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  ) !important;
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  ) !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-marquee {
    margin-top: 88px !important;
    padding: 1.1rem 0 !important;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-track {
  display: flex !important;
  gap: 2.2rem !important;
  width: max-content !important;
  animation: hero-marquee-scroll 46s linear infinite !important;
  will-change: transform !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-item {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 2.2rem !important;
  font-family: var(--font-mono) !important;
  font-size: 0.7rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  color: var(--ink-2) !important;
  direction: ltr !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {

  }
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-sep {

@keyframes hero-marquee-scroll {

  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SMALL SCREENS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: 1.75rem !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell--name {
    min-height: 220px !important;

  }

  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb,
  .hero-section .hero-masthead-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-text,
  .hero-section .hero-title-accent,
  .hero-section .hero-bento-status-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-bento-live-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell-mesh::before,
  .hero-section .hero-marquee-track,
  .hero-section .hero-sig-path {
    animation: none !important;
    stroke-dashoffset: 0 !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn:hover {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   HERO — Persian Date Cell (replaces signature cell)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell--date {
  grid-column: span 1 !important;
  min-height: 130px !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 6px !important;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {

    min-height: 150px !important;
  }
}

/* ─── Date container ─── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-date {
  position: relative !important;
  z-index: 2 !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;

}

/* ─── Weekday (e.g. جمعه) ─── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-date-weekday {

/* ─── Month (e.g. مهر) ─── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-date-month {

/* ─── Year (e.g. ۱۴۰۵) ─── */
.hero-section .hero-bento-date-year {
```

## FILE: src\styles\hero-premium.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   HERO PREMIUM — Infinite Edition
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Visual upgrades layered on top of hero-editorial.css
   ALL animations are GPU-composited (transform + opacity only)
   Zero layout thrash. Zero speed loss.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. CURSOR HALO — desktop only
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section {
  --hero-glow-x: 50%;
  --hero-glow-y: 40%;
}

.hero-cursor-halo {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 800ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  background: radial-gradient(
    600px circle at var(--hero-glow-x) var(--hero-glow-y),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 25%,
    transparent 55%
  );
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  will-change: opacity;
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .hero-section:hover .hero-cursor-halo {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-cursor-halo {
  background: radial-gradient(
    600px circle at var(--hero-glow-x) var(--hero-glow-y),
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent) 25%,
    transparent 55%
  );
}

@media (hover: none), (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-cursor-halo {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. BACKGROUND GLOW LAYER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-bg-glow {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -10%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 90%;
  height: 60%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    ellipse at center bottom,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 60%
  );
  filter: blur(60px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-bg-glow {
  background: radial-gradient(
    ellipse at center bottom,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 60%
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. ENTRY ANIMATIONS — staggered reveal
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@keyframes heroPremiumIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(24px);
    filter: blur(6px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    filter: blur(0);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 100ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-kicker {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 220ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line:nth-child(1) {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 800ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 340ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line:nth-child(2) {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 800ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 440ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line:nth-child(3) {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 800ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 540ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-description {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 660ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-actions {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 780ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 900ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell:nth-child(1) {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 480ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell:nth-child(2) {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 560ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell:nth-child(3) {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 640ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell:nth-child(4) {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 720ms;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell:nth-child(5) {
  animation: heroPremiumIn 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: 800ms;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. BENTO CELLS — 6-layer premium glass
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 95%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    inset -1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent),
    0 16px 36px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 18%, transparent),
    0 40px 88px -32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 28%, transparent) !important;
  transition:
    transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-cell:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px) scale(1.01);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 98%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 65%, transparent),
    inset -1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 65%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 10%, transparent),
    0 20px 44px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 24%, transparent),
    0 48px 100px -32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 32%, transparent) !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 80%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    0 16px 36px -14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
    0 40px 88px -32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-bento-cell:hover {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06),
    inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
    0 20px 44px -14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent),
    0 48px 100px -32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
}

/* Top specular light streak on each cell */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 18%;
  right: 18%;
  height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    color-mix(in srgb, #fff 100%, transparent) 25%,
    color-mix(in srgb, #fff 100%, transparent) 75%,
    transparent
  );
  border-radius: 1px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 4;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-bento-cell::after {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14) 25%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14) 75%,
    transparent
  );
  opacity: 0.9;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. BUTTONS — premium upgrade
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-btn {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    #100e0c 0%,
    #26201b 45%,
    #100e0c 100%
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
    inset 0 -1.5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.1),
    0 8px 24px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.38),
    0 20px 48px -16px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.28) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.1),
    0 12px 32px -10px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42),
    0 28px 60px -18px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.55) !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0d7377 50%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: opacity 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* Shine sweep */
.hero-section .hero-btn-shine {
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  left: -70%;
  width: 55%;
  height: 200%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    100deg,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  transform: skewX(-20deg);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover .hero-btn-shine {
  opacity: 1;
  animation: heroBtnShine 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

@keyframes heroBtnShine {
  0% { left: -70%; }
  100% { left: 160%; }
}

/* Secondary button — softer glass */
.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 85%, transparent) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 14%, transparent) !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) !important;
  border-color: var(--accent) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. TRUST ROW — premium refinement
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-trust-item {
  position: relative;
  padding-inline-start: 14px;
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 3px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-item:first-child::before {
  display: none;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-item:first-child {
  padding-inline-start: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-value {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--ink) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 70%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. MARQUEE — refined
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-marquee {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 40%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-item {
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 65%, transparent);
  transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-track:hover .hero-marquee-item {
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. MASTHEAD — refined
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-masthead {
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 40%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.2);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.2);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  margin-inline: -18px;
  padding-inline: 18px;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-dot {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 18%, transparent),
    0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 55%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. BENTO NUMBER — count-up feel
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-bento-bignum {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--ink) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 70%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-bignum em {
  -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. LIVE DOT — refined pulse
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@keyframes heroDotSoftPulse {
  0%, 100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 18%, transparent),
      0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 50%, transparent);
  }
  50% {
    opacity: 0.75;
    transform: scale(0.92);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 8%, transparent),
      0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 65%, transparent);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-dot,
.hero-section .hero-bento-status-dot,
.hero-section .hero-bento-live-dot {
  animation: heroDotSoftPulse 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   11. LIVE STACK — smooth crossfade between states
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@keyframes heroLiveStateIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
    filter: blur(4px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    filter: blur(0);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-live-stack > div {
  animation: heroLiveStateIn 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   12. SEAL — subtle float
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@keyframes heroSealFloat {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  50%      { transform: translateY(-3px) rotate(-2deg); }
}

.hero-section .hero-bento-seal {
  animation: heroSealFloat 6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   13. ORBS — softer, layered
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-bg-orb-1 {
  filter: blur(90px) !important;
  opacity: 0.55 !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bg-orb-2 {
  filter: blur(90px) !important;
  opacity: 0.4 !important;
}

.hero-section .hero-bg-orb-3 {
  filter: blur(80px) !important;
  opacity: 0.25 !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   14. PAUSE OFF-SCREEN — performance
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-seal,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-masthead-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-status-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-live-dot {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bento-seal,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-masthead-dot,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bento-status-dot,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bento-live-dot {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   15. REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-section .hero-masthead,
  .hero-section .hero-kicker,
  .hero-section .hero-title-line,
  .hero-section .hero-description,
  .hero-section .hero-actions,
  .hero-section .hero-trust,

  .hero-section .hero-bento-seal,
  .hero-section .hero-masthead-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-bento-status-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-bento-live-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-bento-live-stack > div,
  .hero-section .hero-btn-shine {
    animation: none !important;
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    filter: none;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell:hover {
    transform: none;
  }

  .hero-cursor-halo {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   16. MOBILE — disable cursor-halo + hover transforms
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero-cursor-halo {
    display: none;
  }

    transform: none;

      0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent),

  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover,
  .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   LAYOUT-MORE — ProjectViewer, About, WhyMe, Process,
                 Testimonial, FinalCTA

/* ============================================================
   17. Project viewer
   ============================================================ */
.project-modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 200;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 24px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 85%, transparent);
  animation: modalIn var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .project-modal {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
  }
}

@keyframes modalIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

.project-modal-content {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
  width: min(1080px, 100%);
  max-height: min(780px, calc(100svh - 48px));
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
  animation: modalContentIn var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes modalContentIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.98); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

.project-modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 3;
  top: 18px;
  inset-inline-start: 18px;
  display: grid;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 20px;
  line-height: 1;
  transition:
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.project-modal-close:hover {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  transform: rotate(90deg);
}

.project-modal-visual {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  align-content: center;
  justify-items: center;

}

.project-modal-visual::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;

  inset-inline-end: -30%;

  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-glow) 0%, transparent 65%);

}

}

.project-modal-meta {

/* ============================================================

.about-section {

}

.about-grid {

}

.about-content h2 {

/* ============================================================

.why-section {

.why-header {

.process-list {

.quote {

.quote-text {

.quote-author {

}

.quote-author-avatar {

.final-cta-section {

.final-cta {

.final-cta .section-index {

}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   LAYOUT — Navigation, Hero, Services, Portfolio
   (Extracted from globals.css sections 13-16, unchanged)
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   13. Navigation
   ============================================================ */
.site-nav {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0 0 auto;
  z-index: 100;
  padding-block: 14px;
}

.nav-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding-inline: 14px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  border-color: var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
  }
}

.brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 4px;
}

.brand-mark {
  display: grid;
  width: 34px;
  height: 34px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  transition:
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.site-nav.is-scrolled .brand-mark {
  transform: scale(0.92);
}

.brand:hover .brand-mark {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  transform: scale(1.02);
}

.brand-text {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1px;
}

.brand-text strong {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.brand-text small {
  direction: ltr;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.desktop-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.desktop-nav a {
  position: relative;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  font-weight: 500;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition:
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.desktop-nav a:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

.desktop-nav a.active {
  color: var(--ink);
}

.desktop-nav a.active::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 14px;
  bottom: 3px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--accent);
  animation: navUnderline var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes navUnderline {
  from { transform: scaleX(0); }
  to { transform: scaleX(1); }
}

.nav-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.nav-order-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 36px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding-inline: 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-accent);
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.nav-order-button:hover {
  background: var(--accent-2);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.theme-toggle,
.menu-toggle {
  display: grid;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  transition:
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.theme-toggle:hover,
.menu-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.theme-toggle {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.theme-toggle svg {
  position: absolute;
  width: 15px;
  height: 15px;
  transition:
    transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-spring),
    opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.theme-toggle .icon-sun {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0) rotate(0);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.theme-toggle .icon-moon {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(20px) rotate(-20deg);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .icon-sun {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(-20px) rotate(20deg);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .theme-toggle .icon-moon {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0) rotate(0);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.menu-toggle {
  display: none;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 0;
}

.menu-toggle span {
  display: block;
  width: 15px;
  height: 1.5px;
  background: currentColor;
  transition:
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    opacity var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.mobile-menu {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 68px 14px auto;
  z-index: 99;
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  animation: menuIn var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .mobile-menu {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
  }
}

@keyframes menuIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.mobile-menu nav {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.mobile-menu a {
  padding: 13px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.mobile-menu a:hover {
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

.mobile-order-button {
  margin-top: 8px;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.mobile-order-button:hover {
  background: var(--accent-2);
}

/* ============================================================
   14. Hero
   ============================================================ */
.hero-section {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: clamp(120px, 15vw, 180px) clamp(60px, 8vw, 100px);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-section::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -20%;
  inset-inline-end: -10%;
  width: 60vw;
  height: 60vw;
  max-width: 800px;
  max-height: 800px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-glow) 0%, transparent 65%);
  opacity: 0.7;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-section::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -30%;
  inset-inline-start: -15%;
  width: 50vw;
  height: 50vw;
  max-width: 600px;
  max-height: 600px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-tint) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: min(calc(100% - 48px), 1280px);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

.hero-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px);
}

.hero-top-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-top-meta {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
```
