    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
}

.hero-top-meta-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.18);
}

.hero-name {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 0.9;
  letter-spacing: -0.045em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.hero-name-line {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--fs-display);
}

.hero-name-line + .hero-name-line {
  margin-top: -0.04em;
}

.hero-name-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-inline-start: 0.02em;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 0.5em;
  line-height: 1;
  transform: translateY(-0.25em);
}

.hero-name-en {
  display: block;
  margin-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 32px);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: clamp(11px, 1vw, 13px);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.hero-role {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 48px);
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  font-size: clamp(17px, 1.7vw, 22px);
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-role {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
}

.hero-role-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: pulseDot 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes pulseDot {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(0.85); }
}

.hero-role-text {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: roleIn 420ms var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes roleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.hero-description {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin-top: 26px;
  font-size: clamp(15px, 1.15vw, 17px);
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 44px);
}

.hero-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-top: clamp(56px, 7vw, 96px);
  padding-top: clamp(24px, 3vw, 40px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-signature {
  display: block;
  width: clamp(140px, 14vw, 200px);
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.hero-signature svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.hero-footer-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.hero-footer-meta span + span::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-inline-end: 20px;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* ============================================================
   15. Services
   ============================================================ */
.services-section {
  position: relative;
}

.services-section::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  z-index: -1;
}

.services-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.68fr) minmax(0, 1.32fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.services-list {
  display: grid;
  align-content: start;
  gap: 6px;
}

.service-item {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr 24px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 18px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-align: right;
  transition:
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--surface);
  transform: translateX(-3px);
}

.service-item.is-active {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--surface);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -12px var(--accent-glow);
}

.service-number {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.service-item.is-active .service-number {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.service-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.service-arrow {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  transition:
    transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.service-item.is-active .service-arrow {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.service-preview {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 540px;
  padding: 32px;
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: var(--glass);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .service-preview {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
  }
}

.service-preview::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -40%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 70%;
  height: 70%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-glow) 0%, transparent 65%);
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.service-preview-top {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.service-preview-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  max-width: 540px;
  margin-top: 90px;
}

.service-preview-label {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.service-preview-content h3 {
  margin: 18px 0 16px;
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.service-preview-content p {
  max-width: 500px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
}

.service-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 26px;
}

.service-tags span {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.service-visual {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-end: -20px;
  bottom: -30px;
  width: 320px;
  height: 320px;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.service-visual-numeral {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: clamp(140px, 18vw, 220px);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.08em;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.12;
  transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.service-preview:hover .service-visual-numeral {
  opacity: 0.2;
}

/* ============================================================
   16. Portfolio
   ============================================================ */
.portfolio-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.portfolio-card {
  display: block;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  text-align: right;
  min-width: 0;
}

.portfolio-card-1 { grid-column: span 7; }
.portfolio-card-2 { grid-column: span 5; }
.portfolio-card-3 { grid-column: span 5; }
.portfolio-card-4 { grid-column: span 7; }

.portfolio-card-visual {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 380px;
  padding: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transition:
    transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.portfolio-card-chrome {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.portfolio-card-chrome-dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 5px;
}

.portfolio-card-chrome-dots span {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--line-strong);
}

.portfolio-card-chrome-dots span:first-child {
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.portfolio-card-chrome-url {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 3px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--surface);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-align: center;
  direction: ltr;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.portfolio-card-chrome-meta {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.portfolio-card-canvas {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.portfolio-card-caption {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.portfolio-card-caption > div {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
}

.portfolio-card-category {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--accent);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.portfolio-card-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.portfolio-card-arrow {
  display: grid;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 13px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-arrow {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--accent);
  transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

.preview-web {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 20px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.6fr;
  gap: 10px;
}

.preview-web-sidebar {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--surface);
  padding: 10px;
  display: grid;
  align-content: start;
  gap: 6px;
}

.preview-web-sidebar::before,
.preview-web-sidebar::after {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--line-strong);
}

.preview-web-sidebar::after {
  width: 60%;
}

.preview-web-main {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.preview-web-hero {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-tint), var(--surface));
  min-height: 60px;
}

.preview-web-blocks {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
}

.preview-web-blocks span {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--surface);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
}

.preview-shop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 20px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

.preview-shop-cell {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--surface);
  padding: 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.preview-shop-cell::before {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--paper-2), var(--surface));
}

.preview-shop-cell::after {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  height: 4px;
  width: 60%;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--line-strong);
}

.preview-shop-cell.accent::before {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
}

.preview-ai {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 20px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

.preview-ai-swatch {
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.preview-ai-swatch.c1 { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.preview-ai-swatch.c2 { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent-2); }
.preview-ai-swatch.c3 { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent-soft); }
.preview-ai-swatch.c4 { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); }
.preview-ai-swatch.c5 { background: var(--paper-2); }
.preview-ai-swatch.c6 { background: var(--surface-2); }

.preview-video {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 20px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

.preview-video-frame {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--surface);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 14px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.preview-video-frame.accent {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
  border-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
}

.preview-video-frame .play {
  display: grid;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  place-items: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 8px;
}

.preview-video-frame.accent .play {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  color: #fff;
}

.preview-mobile {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 20px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
}

.preview-mobile-phone {
  border: 2px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: var(--surface);
  padding: 10px 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.preview-mobile-phone::before {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  width: 30%;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--line-strong);
  align-self: center;
}

.preview-mobile-phone::after {
  content: "";
  display: block;
  flex: 1;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-tint), var(--surface));
}

.preview-editorial {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 20px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
}

.preview-editorial-line {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
}

.preview-editorial-block {
  flex: 1;
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.preview-editorial-block.wide { flex: 3; }
.preview-editorial-block.tall { height: 60px; }

.preview-editorial-block.accent {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2));
  border-color: transparent;
}

/* ============================================================
   PERFORMANCE OVERRIDE — Non-composited padding fix
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Lighthouse flagged `padding-bottom` and `padding-top` on
   `header.site-nav` and `.nav-inner` as non-composited
   animations. These cause layout thrashing on every scroll
   direction change.

   Fix strategy:
   - Lock `.site-nav` padding to a single value (no change)
   - Remove padding from `.nav-inner` transitions entirely
   - Keep `transform`/`opacity` transitions on `.site-nav`
     so the smart-hide behavior still works (they are composited)
   - Keep `background`/`border`/`box-shadow` on `.nav-inner`
     so the "scrolled" state is still visually clear
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Loaded AFTER layout.css but BEFORE enhancements.css — the
   `!important` flags beat every downstream override.
   ============================================================ */

.site-nav,
.site-nav.is-scrolled {
  padding-block: 14px !important;
  transition:
    transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
    opacity 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.site-nav .nav-inner,
.site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
  transition:
    background-color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out) !important;
}
/* ============================================================
   NAV — MagneticButton vertical alignment fix
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   `MagneticButton` wraps children in two inline-block divs
   (.magnetic / .magnetic-inner). Because Persian text has a
   higher visual center inside its em box, the inline baseline
   alignment pushes the button slightly above the nav center.
   Fix: force the wrappers to be inline-flex with centered
   alignment so the pill itself becomes the aligned unit.
   ============================================================ */

.nav-actions .magnetic,
.nav-actions .magnetic-inner {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.nav-actions .magnetic-inner {
  height: 100%;
}

.nav-order-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 36px;
  padding-block: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
/* ============================================================
   ABOUT — PROOF STRIP
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   جایگزین استریپ آمار فروش (که در ابتدای کار ضعیف به نظر می‌رسه)
   با اثبات‌های فنی قابل تأیید.
   ============================================================ */

.about-proof {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 0;
  margin-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.about-proof-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) clamp(16px, 2vw, 28px);
  text-align: start;
  border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--line);
  position: relative;
  transition: background-color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.about-proof-item:last-child {
  border-inline-end: none;
}

.about-proof-item:hover {
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.about-proof-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    transparent 60%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.about-proof-item:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.about-proof-value {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 2px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 44px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.about-proof-suffix {
  font-size: 0.5em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.about-proof-label {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  margin-top: 4px;
}

.about-proof-hint {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .about-proof {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .about-proof-item:nth-child(2) {
    border-inline-end: none;
  }

  .about-proof-item:nth-child(1),
  .about-proof-item:nth-child(2) {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .about-proof-item:nth-child(3),
  .about-proof-item:nth-child(4) {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .about-proof {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .about-proof-item {
    border-inline-end: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 20px 0;
  }

  .about-proof-item:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }

  .about-proof-value {
    font-size: 32px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .about-proof-item,
  .about-proof-item::before {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   HERO — 2026 TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   - Fluid scale via clamp() from 360px → 1440px
   - Persian: letter-spacing = 0 (ALReq spec compliant)
   - Latin fragments (.eyebrow-en, .hero-meta-en): letter-spacing positive
   - Three-weight system: 600 / 500 / 400
   - Line-height tighter as size grows
   ============================================================ */

/* ── Hero section base ── */
.hero-section {
  padding-block: clamp(112px, 14vw, 168px) clamp(56px, 7vw, 88px);
}

/* ── Hero title (H1) ── */
.hero-section .hero-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: var(--hero-display-lh);
  letter-spacing: var(--hero-display-ls);
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--hero-display);
  line-height: var(--hero-display-lh);
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line + .hero-title-line {
  margin-top: 0.04em;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-muted {
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.hero-section .hero-title-em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-em::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: -3px;
  bottom: 0.06em;
  height: 0.05em;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.3;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ── Hero role pill ── */
.hero-section .hero-role {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 32px);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  font-size: var(--hero-role);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: var(--hero-role-lh);
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-role-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: pulseDot 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-section .hero-role-text {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: roleIn 420ms var(--ease-out);
}

/* ── Hero description ── */
.hero-section .hero-description {
  max-width: 54ch;
  margin-top: clamp(18px, 2vw, 24px);
  font-size: var(--hero-desc);
  line-height: var(--hero-desc-lh);
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ── Eyebrow (Persian) ── */
.hero-section .eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: var(--hero-eyebrow);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  text-transform: none;
}

.hero-section .eyebrow::before {
  content: "";
  width: 20px;
  height: 1px;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* ── Hero top meta (Latin) ── */
.hero-section .hero-top-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 7px 13px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--hero-meta);
  letter-spacing: var(--hero-meta-ls);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-top-meta-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.15);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ── Hero CTA actions ── */
.hero-section .hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: clamp(26px, 3vw, 38px);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn {
  min-height: 56px;
  padding-inline: 28px;
  font-size: var(--hero-cta);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

/* ── Hero masthead (Latin) ── */
.hero-section .hero-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(28px, 3.2vw, 40px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--hero-meta);
  letter-spacing: var(--hero-meta-ls);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-left,
.hero-section .hero-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-center {
  opacity: 0.5;
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ── Hero footer ── */
.hero-section .hero-footer {
  margin-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 80px);
  padding-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 32px);
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-name strong {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-name small {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--hero-meta);
  letter-spacing: var(--hero-meta-ls);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ── Hero footer meta (Latin) ── */
.hero-section .hero-footer-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--hero-meta);
  letter-spacing: var(--hero-meta-ls);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ── Hero tech chips (Latin labels) ── */
.hero-section .hero-tech {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: clamp(16px, 1.8vw, 22px);
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-tech-chip {
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  background: var(--surface);
  direction: ltr;
  transition:
    border-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    color 200ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-tech-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ── Mobile overrides ── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    line-height: 1.22;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-description {
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-actions .btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 54px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-top-meta {
    font-size: 9px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
  }
}

/* ── Reduced motion ── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-section .hero-role-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-text {
    animation: none;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   HERO — 2026 Glass Edition
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   - Aurora mesh background (3 blurred blobs, composited only)
   - Editorial split grid: main + glass aside
   - True glassmorphism card with gradient border
   - Fluid typography (Persian-correct spacing)
   - Zero non-composited animations
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION BASE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: clamp(112px, 14vw, 168px) clamp(56px, 7vw, 88px);
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.hero-section .hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  width: min(calc(100% - 48px), 1320px);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   AURORA — ambient mesh background
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-aurora {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  contain: strict;
}

.hero-aurora-blob {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(80px);
  opacity: 0.55;
  will-change: transform;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}

.hero-aurora-blob-1 {
  top: -20%;
  inset-inline-end: -10%;
  width: 55vw;
  height: 55vw;
  max-width: 780px;
  max-height: 780px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 30% 30%,
    var(--accent-glow) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  animation: auroraFloat1 26s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-aurora-blob-2 {
  bottom: -30%;
  inset-inline-start: -15%;
  width: 45vw;
  height: 45vw;
  max-width: 620px;
  max-height: 620px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 50% 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 45%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 68%
  );
  opacity: 0.4;
  animation: auroraFloat2 32s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-aurora-blob-3 {
  top: 30%;
  inset-inline-start: 30%;
  width: 35vw;
  height: 35vw;
  max-width: 480px;
  max-height: 480px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 50% 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 70%
  );
  opacity: 0.35;
  animation: auroraFloat3 38s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes auroraFloat1 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(-24px, 20px, 0) scale(1.06); }
}

@keyframes auroraFloat2 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(20px, -18px, 0) scale(1.04); }
}

@keyframes auroraFloat3 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(-14px, -20px, 0) scale(1.05); }
}

/* Subtle dot grid overlay (mesh texture) */
.hero-aurora-grid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(
      circle at 1px 1px,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent) 1px,
      transparent 0
    );
  background-size: 32px 32px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 40%,
    #000 30%,
    transparent 75%
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 40%,
    #000 30%,
    transparent 75%
  );
  opacity: 0.35;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CORNER MARKS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.35;
  z-index: 2;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.hero-corner::before,
.hero-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.hero-corner::before {
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0;
}

.hero-corner::after {
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
}

.hero-corner-tl { top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); inset-inline-start: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); }
.hero-corner-tr { top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); inset-inline-end: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); transform: scaleX(-1); }
.hero-corner-bl { bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); inset-inline-start: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); transform: scaleY(-1); }
.hero-corner-br { bottom: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); inset-inline-end: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); transform: scale(-1, -1); }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   VERTICAL RAIL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-rail {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  inset-inline-end: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-rail-line {
  width: 1px;
  height: 40px;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: 0.25;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.hero-rail-text {
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MASTHEAD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.1rem;
  margin-bottom: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-left,
.hero-section .hero-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-center {
  opacity: 0.45;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SPLIT GRID
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
  gap: clamp(32px, 5vw, 72px);
  align-items: start;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MAIN COLUMN
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* ─── Eyebrow (Persian) ─── */
.hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  align-self: flex-start;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: clamp(0.6875rem, 0.66rem + 0.1vw, 0.75rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-eyebrow-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.15);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: pulseDot 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

/* ─── Title ─── */
.hero-section .hero-title {
  margin: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 30px) 0 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.18;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.2rem + 3.2vw, 3.75rem);
  line-height: 1.18;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line + .hero-title-line {
  margin-top: 0.04em;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-muted {
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.hero-section .hero-title-em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-em::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: -3px;
  bottom: 0.06em;
  height: 0.05em;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.3;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ─── Role pill ─── */
.hero-section .hero-role {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 32px);
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.9rem + 0.4vw, 1.25rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-role-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: pulseDot 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-section .hero-role-text {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: roleIn 420ms var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes roleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ─── Description ─── */
.hero-section .hero-description {
  max-width: 54ch;
  margin-top: clamp(18px, 2vw, 24px);
  font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 0.875rem + 0.25vw, 1.0625rem);
  line-height: 1.85;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ─── Actions ─── */
.hero-section .hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: clamp(26px, 3vw, 38px);
}

.hero-section .hero-actions .btn {
  min-height: 56px;
  padding-inline: 28px;
  font-size: clamp(0.875rem, 0.83rem + 0.2vw, 0.9375rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

/* ─── Tech row ─── */
.hero-section .hero-tech-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: clamp(24px, 2.8vw, 34px);
  padding-top: clamp(18px, 2.2vw, 26px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.hero-section .hero-tech-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-tech {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-tech-chip {
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent);
  direction: ltr;
  transition:
    border-color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    color 200ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 200ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-tech-chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GLASS ASIDE CARD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-aside {
  position: sticky;
  top: 120px;
  align-self: start;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 32px);
  border-radius: 24px;

  /* Layered glass background */
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      155deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 75%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent) 100%
    );

  /* Gradient border via background-clip */
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;

  /* Inner highlight + drop shadow */
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04),
    0 24px 60px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.14),
    0 8px 24px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);

  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

/* Gradient border ring (behind card, shows through 1px transparent border) */
.hero-section .hero-glass::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) 35%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent) 65%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* Soft sheen at top-left */
.hero-section .hero-glass::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -30%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 70%;
  height: 70%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-glass {
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  }
}

/* ─── Glass corner marks ─── */
.hero-glass-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  opacity: 0.4;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.hero-glass-corner::before,
.hero-glass-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.hero-glass-corner::before { width: 1px; height: 100%; inset-inline-start: 0; top: 0; }
.hero-glass-corner::after  { width: 100%; height: 1px; top: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; }

.hero-glass-corner-tl { top: 10px; inset-inline-start: 10px; }
.hero-glass-corner-tr { top: 10px; inset-inline-end: 10px; transform: scaleX(-1); }
.hero-glass-corner-bl { bottom: 10px; inset-inline-start: 10px; transform: scaleY(-1); }
.hero-glass-corner-br { bottom: 10px; inset-inline-end: 10px; transform: scale(-1, -1); }

/* ─── Head ─── */
.hero-section .hero-glass-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 16px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-live {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  color: var(--success);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-live-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 50%, transparent);
  animation: glassLivePulse 2s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes glassLivePulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(0.85); }
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-issue {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.75;
}

/* ─── Status ─── */
.hero-section .hero-glass-status {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-status-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-status-value {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-status-pulse {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-glow);
  animation: statusPulse 2s var(--ease-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes statusPulse {
  0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--accent-glow); }
  70%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px transparent; }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 transparent; }
}

/* ─── Stats grid ─── */
.hero-section .hero-glass-stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 16px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-stat {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding-inline: 4px;
  border-inline-end: 1px solid var(--line-soft);
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-stat:last-child {
  border-inline-end: none;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-stat strong {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-stat span {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.8;
  direction: ltr;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

/* ─── Foot ─── */
.hero-section .hero-glass-foot {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
  padding-top: 4px;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-name {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass-latin {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FOOTER SIGNATURE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-top: clamp(56px, 7vw, 88px);
  padding-top: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 34px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-section .hero-signature {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-mark {
  display: block;
  width: clamp(80px, 9vw, 120px);
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-mark svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-name {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-name strong {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-name small {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.2;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-footer-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-footer-meta span + span::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-inline-end: 18px;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MARQUEE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-marquee {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  margin-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.25rem) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  width: max-content;
  animation: hero-marquee-scroll 42s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0.7;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-sep {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  opacity: 0.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

@keyframes hero-marquee-scroll {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .hero-section .hero-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 40px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-aside {
    position: static;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-glass {
    max-width: 480px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-rail {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-section {
    padding-block: 96px 48px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-masthead,
  .hero-section .hero-corner,
  .hero-section .hero-aside,
  .hero-section .hero-signature,
  .hero-section .hero-footer-meta,
  .hero-section .hero-tech-row {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    line-height: 1.22;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-description {
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-actions .btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 54px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-footer {
    margin-top: 40px;
    padding-top: 20px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hero-aurora-blob-1 { opacity: 0.4; }
  .hero-aurora-blob-2 { opacity: 0.3; }
  .hero-aurora-blob-3 { display: none; }
  .hero-aurora-grid { opacity: 0.2; }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: 1.7rem;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow,
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-aurora-blob {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-role-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-text,
  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-glass-live-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-glass-status-pulse {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-marquee-track {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   HERO — 2026 Editorial Edition v2
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   - Confident typography (Vercel/Linear standard)
   - Premium buttons with arrow + count badge
   - Inline trust row (three verifiable numbers)
   - Persian-correct spacing (ALReq compliant)
   - Zero non-composited animations
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION BASE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: clamp(116px, 14vw, 172px) clamp(64px, 8vw, 96px);
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.hero-section .hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  width: min(calc(100% - 48px), 1280px);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   AMBIENT BACKGROUND
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  contain: strict;
}

.hero-bg-orb {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(100px);
  will-change: transform;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}

.hero-bg-orb-1 {
  top: -25%;
  inset-inline-end: -12%;
  width: 52vw;
  height: 52vw;
  max-width: 760px;
  max-height: 760px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 40% 40%,
    var(--accent-glow) 0%,
    transparent 62%
  );
  opacity: 0.65;
  animation: heroOrb1 28s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-bg-orb-2 {
  bottom: -30%;
  inset-inline-start: -15%;
  width: 44vw;
  height: 44vw;
  max-width: 620px;
  max-height: 620px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 50% 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 50%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 68%
  );
  opacity: 0.4;
  animation: heroOrb2 34s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes heroOrb1 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(-26px, 22px, 0) scale(1.06); }
}

@keyframes heroOrb2 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(22px, -20px, 0) scale(1.04); }
}

/* Subtle dot grid overlay */
.hero-bg-grid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(
    circle at 1px 1px,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent) 1px,
    transparent 0
  );
  background-size: 34px 34px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 75% 60% at 55% 40%,
    #000 25%,
    transparent 72%
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 75% 60% at 55% 40%,
    #000 25%,
    transparent 72%
  );
  opacity: 0.3;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CORNERS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.32;
  z-index: 2;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::before,
.hero-section .hero-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::before {
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::after {
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner-tl { top: 1.5rem; inset-inline-start: 1.5rem; }
.hero-section .hero-corner-tr { top: 1.5rem; inset-inline-end: 1.5rem; transform: scaleX(-1); }
.hero-section .hero-corner-bl { bottom: 1.5rem; inset-inline-start: 1.5rem; transform: scaleY(-1); }
.hero-section .hero-corner-br { bottom: 1.5rem; inset-inline-end: 1.5rem; transform: scale(-1, -1); }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   VERTICAL RAIL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-rail {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  inset-inline-end: 1.25rem;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-section .hero-rail-line {
  width: 1px;
  height: 36px;
  background: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.25;
}

.hero-section .hero-rail-text {
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MASTHEAD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.1rem;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-left,
.hero-section .hero-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-center {
  opacity: 0.5;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CONTENT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-content {
  max-width: 920px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

/* ─── Eyebrow ─── */
.hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: clamp(0.6875rem, 0.66rem + 0.1vw, 0.75rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-eyebrow-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 40%, transparent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes heroDotPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(0.82); }
}

/* ─── Title ─── */
.hero-section .hero-title {
  margin: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) 0 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.14;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.2rem + 4.2vw, 4.5rem);
  line-height: 1.14;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line + .hero-title-line {
  margin-top: 0.02em;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-muted {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-accent {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-inline-start: 0.02em;
}

/* ─── Role pill ─── */
.hero-section .hero-role {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: clamp(24px, 2.8vw, 34px);
  padding: 7px 15px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 0.88rem + 0.3vw, 1.0625rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-role-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-section .hero-role-text {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: roleIn 420ms var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes roleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ─── Description ─── */
.hero-section .hero-description {
  max-width: 58ch;
  margin-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 28px);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem);
  line-height: 1.75;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BUTTONS — Premium 2026
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 44px);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 58px;
  padding-inline: 30px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 0.9rem + 0.15vw, 1rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    transform 260ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 360ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    color 240ms var(--ease-out);
}

/* ─── Primary button ─── */
.hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  color: #fff9f4;
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    #0a0908 0%,
    #211c18 55%,
    #0a0908 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08),
    0 12px 30px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: opacity 320ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
    0 18px 44px -14px var(--accent-glow),
    0 8px 20px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.24);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary .hero-btn-arrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: transform 320ms var(--ease-spring);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover .hero-btn-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-5px);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
    0 16px 38px -14px var(--accent-glow);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  display: none;
}

/* ─── Secondary button ─── */
.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 12px 28px -12px var(--accent-glow),
    0 4px 10px -4px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-count {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 26px;
  height: 22px;
  padding-inline: 7px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  transition:
    background-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    color 240ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover .hero-btn-count {
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TRUST ROW
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-trust {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
  margin-top: clamp(36px, 4.5vw, 52px);
  padding-top: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 28px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.6vw, 1.5rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.8;
  direction: ltr;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FOOTER SIGNATURE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-top: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px);
  padding-top: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 32px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-section .hero-signature {
  display: block;
  width: clamp(100px, 12vw, 160px);
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.hero-section .hero-footer-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-footer-meta span + span::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-inline-end: 18px;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MARQUEE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-marquee {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  margin-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.1rem) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  width: max-content;
  animation: hero-marquee-scroll 46s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0.65;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-sep {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  opacity: 0.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

@keyframes hero-marquee-scroll {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-rail {
    display: none;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-section {
    padding-block: 100px 52px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-masthead,
  .hero-section .hero-corner,
  .hero-section .hero-signature,
  .hero-section .hero-footer-meta {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 8.5vw, 2.5rem);
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-description {
    max-width: 100%;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 56px;
    padding-inline: 22px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-trust {
    gap: 18px;
    padding-top: 20px;
    margin-top: 28px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-trust-value {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-trust-label {
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-footer {
    margin-top: 44px;
    padding-top: 20px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hero-bg-orb-1 { opacity: 0.4; }
  .hero-bg-orb-2 { opacity: 0.3; }
  .hero-bg-grid { opacity: 0.2; }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow,
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    padding-inline: 12px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-bg-orb {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-text,
  .hero-section .hero-marquee-track {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn:hover,
  .hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover,
  .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
    transform: none;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover .hero-btn-arrow {
    transform: none;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   HERO — SIGNATURE 2026 EDITION
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Unique signatures (only our site):
   - Rotating aperture in the top-right corner
   - Live Tehran clock (Persian digits)
   - Sound bars visualizer
   - "Now working on" ticker
   - Project capacity dots
   - Persian date rail
   
   All animations are composited (transform/opacity only).
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION BASE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: clamp(112px, 13vw, 160px) clamp(64px, 8vw, 96px);
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.hero-section .hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  width: min(calc(100% - 48px), 1320px);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   AMBIENT BACKGROUND
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  contain: strict;
}

.hero-bg-orb {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(100px);
  will-change: transform;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}

.hero-bg-orb-1 {
  top: -25%;
  inset-inline-end: -12%;
  width: 52vw;
  height: 52vw;
  max-width: 800px;
  max-height: 800px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 40% 40%,
    var(--accent-glow) 0%,
    transparent 62%
  );
  opacity: 0.7;
  animation: heroOrb1 30s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-bg-orb-2 {
  bottom: -30%;
  inset-inline-start: -15%;
  width: 44vw;
  height: 44vw;
  max-width: 640px;
  max-height: 640px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 50% 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 50%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 68%
  );
  opacity: 0.45;
  animation: heroOrb2 36s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes heroOrb1 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(-28px, 22px, 0) scale(1.06); }
}

@keyframes heroOrb2 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(22px, -20px, 0) scale(1.05); }
}

.hero-bg-grid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(
    circle at 1px 1px,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 9%, transparent) 1px,
    transparent 0
  );
  background-size: 36px 36px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 78% 62% at 55% 40%,
    #000 22%,
    transparent 72%
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 78% 62% at 55% 40%,
    #000 22%,
    transparent 72%
  );
  opacity: 0.32;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SIGNATURE — APERTURE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-aperture {
  position: absolute;
  top: -8%;
  inset-inline-end: -8%;
  width: clamp(320px, 42vw, 560px);
  height: clamp(320px, 42vw, 560px);
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.35;
  filter: blur(0.5px);
  animation: apertureRotate 90s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
  transform-origin: center;
  contain: strict;
}

.hero-aperture svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

@keyframes apertureRotate {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to   { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero-aperture {
    width: 280px;
    height: 280px;
    top: -6%;
    inset-inline-end: -12%;
    opacity: 0.28;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CORNERS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.32;
  z-index: 2;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::before,
.hero-section .hero-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::before {
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::after {
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner-tl { top: 1.5rem; inset-inline-start: 1.5rem; }
.hero-section .hero-corner-tr { top: 1.5rem; inset-inline-end: 1.5rem; transform: scaleX(-1); }
.hero-section .hero-corner-bl { bottom: 1.5rem; inset-inline-start: 1.5rem; transform: scaleY(-1); }
.hero-section .hero-corner-br { bottom: 1.5rem; inset-inline-end: 1.5rem; transform: scale(-1, -1); }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   VERTICAL RAIL — Persian date
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-rail {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  inset-inline-start: 1.25rem;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero-section .hero-rail-line {
  width: 1px;
  height: 36px;
  background: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.25;
}

.hero-section .hero-rail-text {
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.66rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.32em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: 0.5;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TOP BAR — LIVE + CLOCK
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-topbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding-bottom: 1.1rem;
  margin-bottom: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ─── LIVE indicator ─── */
.hero-section .hero-live {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 6px 12px 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 10%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 25%, transparent);
  color: var(--success);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.hero-section .hero-live-bars {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 12px;
}

.hero-section .hero-live-bars span {
  display: block;
  width: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: currentColor;
  transform-origin: bottom;
  animation: soundBar 1.2s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-section .hero-live-bars span:nth-child(1) {
  height: 6px;
  animation-delay: 0s;
}

.hero-section .hero-live-bars span:nth-child(2) {
  height: 12px;
  animation-delay: 0.15s;
}

.hero-section .hero-live-bars span:nth-child(3) {
  height: 8px;
  animation-delay: 0.3s;
}

@keyframes soundBar {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35); }
  50%      { transform: scaleY(1); }
}

.hero-section .hero-live-text {
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
}

/* ─── Clock ─── */
.hero-section .hero-clock {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 40%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-clock {
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-clock-label {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.hero-section .hero-clock-time {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MASTHEAD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.1rem;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-left,
.hero-section .hero-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-center {
  opacity: 0.5;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MAIN GRID
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-grid {
  display: grid;
