```css
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
  gap: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
  align-items: start;
}

.hero-section .hero-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* ─── Eyebrow ─── */
.hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: clamp(0.6875rem, 0.66rem + 0.1vw, 0.75rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-eyebrow-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 40%, transparent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes heroDotPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(0.82); }
}

/* ─── Title ─── */
.hero-section .hero-title {
  margin: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) 0 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.14;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.2rem + 4.2vw, 4.5rem);
  line-height: 1.14;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line + .hero-title-line {
  margin-top: 0.02em;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-muted {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-accent {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-inline-start: 0.02em;
}

/* ─── Role pill ─── */
.hero-section .hero-role {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: clamp(24px, 2.8vw, 34px);
  padding: 7px 15px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 0.88rem + 0.3vw, 1.0625rem);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-role-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-section .hero-role-text {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: roleIn 420ms var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes roleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ─── Description ─── */
.hero-section .hero-description {
  max-width: 58ch;
  margin-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 28px);
  font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem);
  line-height: 1.75;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BUTTONS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-top: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 44px);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 58px;
  padding-inline: 30px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 0.9rem + 0.15vw, 1rem);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition:
    transform 260ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 360ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    color 240ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  color: #fff9f4;
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    #0a0908 0%,
    #211c18 55%,
    #0a0908 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08),
    0 12px 30px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: opacity 320ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
    0 18px 44px -14px var(--accent-glow),
    0 8px 20px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.24);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary .hero-btn-arrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: transform 320ms var(--ease-spring);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover .hero-btn-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-5px);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  color: #fff;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  display: none;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 12px 28px -12px var(--accent-glow);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-count {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 26px;
  height: 22px;
  padding-inline: 7px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  transition:
    background-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    color 240ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover .hero-btn-count {
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TRUST ROW
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-trust {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
  margin-top: clamp(36px, 4.5vw, 52px);
  padding-top: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 28px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.6vw, 1.5rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.8;
  direction: ltr;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GLASS SIGNATURE CARD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-visual {
  position: sticky;
  top: 120px;
  align-self: start;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 28px);
  border-radius: 24px;

  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 78%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent) 100%
  );

  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04),
    0 24px 60px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.14),
    0 8px 24px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);

  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) 35%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent) 65%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -30%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 70%;
  height: 70%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-glass {
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  }
}

/* ─── Card corners ─── */
.hero-glass-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  opacity: 0.45;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.hero-glass-corner::before,
.hero-glass-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.hero-glass-corner::before { width: 1px; height: 100%; inset-inline-start: 0; top: 0; }
.hero-glass-corner::after  { width: 100%; height: 1px; top: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; }

.hero-glass-corner-tl { top: 10px; inset-inline-start: 10px; }
.hero-glass-corner-tr { top: 10px; inset-inline-end: 10px; transform: scaleX(-1); }
.hero-glass-corner-bl { bottom: 10px; inset-inline-start: 10px; transform: scaleY(-1); }
.hero-glass-corner-br { bottom: 10px; inset-inline-end: 10px; transform: scale(-1, -1); }

/* ─── Head ─── */
.hero-glass-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-glass-live {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  color: var(--success);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.hero-glass-live-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 55%, transparent);
  animation: heroDotPulse 2s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-glass-issue {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

/* ─── Currently working on ─── */
.hero-glass-currently {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.hero-glass-currently-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.hero-glass-currently-text {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.45;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  animation: currentlyIn 420ms var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes currentlyIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ─── Capacity ─── */
.hero-glass-capacity {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-glass-capacity-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.hero-glass-capacity-dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
}

.hero-glass-capacity-dots span {
  flex: 1;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: background-color 300ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-glass-capacity-dots .is-open {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px -2px var(--accent-glow);
}

.hero-glass-capacity-dots .is-filled {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 12%, transparent);
}

.hero-glass-capacity-count {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.85;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ─── Big clock inside card ─── */
.hero-glass-clock {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.hero-glass-clock-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-glass-clock-time {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* ─── Foot ─── */
.hero-glass-foot {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
}

.hero-glass-name {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.hero-glass-latin {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FOOTER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-top: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px);
  padding-top: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 32px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-section .hero-signature {
  display: block;
  width: clamp(100px, 12vw, 160px);
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.hero-section .hero-footer-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-footer-meta span + span::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-inline-end: 18px;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MARQUEE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-marquee {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  margin-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.1rem) 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  width: max-content;
  animation: hero-marquee-scroll 46s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0.65;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-sep {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  opacity: 0.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

@keyframes hero-marquee-scroll {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .hero-section .hero-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 48px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-visual {
    position: static;
    max-width: 480px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-rail {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-aperture {
    top: -4%;
    inset-inline-end: -18%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-section {
    padding-block: 96px 52px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-masthead,
  .hero-section .hero-corner,
  .hero-section .hero-signature,
  .hero-section .hero-footer-meta,
  .hero-section .hero-visual,
  .hero-section .hero-topbar {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .hero-aperture {
    width: 220px;
    height: 220px;
    top: -2%;
    inset-inline-end: -20%;
    opacity: 0.22;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 8.5vw, 2.5rem);
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-description {
    max-width: 100%;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 56px;
    padding-inline: 22px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-trust {
    gap: 18px;
    padding-top: 20px;
    margin-top: 28px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-trust-value {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-trust-label {
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-footer {
    margin-top: 44px;
    padding-top: 20px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .hero-bg-orb-1 { opacity: 0.4; }
  .hero-bg-orb-2 { opacity: 0.3; }
  .hero-bg-grid { opacity: 0.2; }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow,
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    padding-inline: 12px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-bg-orb,
  .hero-aperture {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-text,
  .hero-section .hero-marquee-track,
  .hero-section .hero-live-bars span,
  .hero-glass-live-dot,
  .hero-glass-currently-text {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn:hover,
  .hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover,
  .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
    transform: none;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   HERO — FULL SIGNATURE 2026
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Everything visible on every screen.
   Mobile-first. Premium everywhere.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SECTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section {
  position: relative;
  padding-block: 96px 48px;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section {
    padding-block: clamp(112px, 13vw, 160px) clamp(64px, 8vw, 96px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-inner {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  width: min(calc(100% - 32px), 1320px);
  margin-inline: auto;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-inner {
    width: min(calc(100% - 48px), 1320px);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BACKGROUND — AURORA
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  contain: strict;
}

.hero-bg-orb {
  position: absolute;
  border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(90px);
  will-change: transform;
  backface-visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateZ(0);
}

.hero-bg-orb-1 {
  top: -25%;
  inset-inline-end: -15%;
  width: 70vw;
  height: 70vw;
  max-width: 800px;
  max-height: 800px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 40% 40%,
    var(--accent-glow) 0%,
    transparent 62%
  );
  opacity: 0.6;
  animation: heroOrb1 30s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-bg-orb-2 {
  bottom: -30%;
  inset-inline-start: -20%;
  width: 60vw;
  height: 60vw;
  max-width: 640px;
  max-height: 640px;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 50% 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-soft) 50%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 68%
  );
  opacity: 0.4;
  animation: heroOrb2 36s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes heroOrb1 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(-28px, 22px, 0) scale(1.06); }
}

@keyframes heroOrb2 {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { transform: translate3d(22px, -20px, 0) scale(1.05); }
}

.hero-bg-grid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: radial-gradient(
    circle at 1px 1px,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 9%, transparent) 1px,
    transparent 0
  );
  background-size: 32px 32px;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 78% 62% at 55% 40%,
    #000 22%,
    transparent 72%
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
    ellipse 78% 62% at 55% 40%,
    #000 22%,
    transparent 72%
  );
  opacity: 0.3;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   APERTURE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-aperture {
  position: absolute;
  top: 2%;
  inset-inline-end: -18%;
  width: 240px;
  height: 240px;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.35;
  animation: apertureRotate 90s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
  contain: strict;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-aperture {
    top: -6%;
    inset-inline-end: -8%;
    width: clamp(320px, 42vw, 560px);
    height: clamp(320px, 42vw, 560px);
    opacity: 0.38;
  }
}

.hero-aperture svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

@keyframes apertureRotate {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to   { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CORNERS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.3;
  z-index: 2;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-corner {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
    opacity: 0.32;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::before,
.hero-section .hero-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::before {
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner::after {
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-corner-tl { top: 0.85rem; inset-inline-start: 0.85rem; }
.hero-section .hero-corner-tr { top: 0.85rem; inset-inline-end: 0.85rem; transform: scaleX(-1); }
.hero-section .hero-corner-bl { bottom: 0.85rem; inset-inline-start: 0.85rem; transform: scaleY(-1); }
.hero-section .hero-corner-br { bottom: 0.85rem; inset-inline-end: 0.85rem; transform: scale(-1, -1); }

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-corner-tl { top: 1.5rem; inset-inline-start: 1.5rem; }
  .hero-section .hero-corner-tr { top: 1.5rem; inset-inline-end: 1.5rem; }
  .hero-section .hero-corner-bl { bottom: 1.5rem; inset-inline-start: 1.5rem; }
  .hero-section .hero-corner-br { bottom: 1.5rem; inset-inline-end: 1.5rem; }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TOPBAR — LIVE + CLOCK
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-topbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 10px;
  padding-bottom: 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-topbar {
    padding-bottom: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-live {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 5px 11px 5px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 10%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 25%, transparent);
  color: var(--success);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-live {
    padding: 6px 12px 6px 10px;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-live-bars {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  height: 11px;
}

.hero-section .hero-live-bars span {
  display: block;
  width: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: currentColor;
  transform-origin: bottom;
  animation: soundBar 1.2s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-section .hero-live-bars span:nth-child(1) { height: 5px; animation-delay: 0s; }
.hero-section .hero-live-bars span:nth-child(2) { height: 11px; animation-delay: 0.15s; }
.hero-section .hero-live-bars span:nth-child(3) { height: 7px; animation-delay: 0.3s; }

@keyframes soundBar {
  0%, 100% { transform: scaleY(0.35); }
  50%      { transform: scaleY(1); }
}

.hero-section .hero-clock {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 40%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-clock {
    padding: 6px 12px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-clock {
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-clock-label {
  font-size: 0.56rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-clock-label {
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-clock-time {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-clock-time {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MASTHEAD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-masthead {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.1rem;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-masthead {
    display: flex;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-left,
.hero-section .hero-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.65;
}

.hero-section .hero-masthead-center {
  opacity: 0.5;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GRID
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 40px;
  align-items: start;
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .hero-section .hero-grid {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(0, 0.85fr);
    gap: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-main {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  min-width: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   EYEBROW
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
    gap: 9px;
    padding: 7px 14px;
    font-size: clamp(0.6875rem, 0.66rem + 0.1vw, 0.75rem);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-eyebrow-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 40%, transparent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@keyframes heroDotPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(0.82); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TITLE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-title {
  position: relative;
  margin: 20px 0 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.18;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.hero-section .hero-title::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -20% -10%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    ellipse at 30% 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 60%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  animation: titleAura 9s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
  filter: blur(40px);
}

@keyframes titleAura {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: 0.8; transform: translate(-12px, 8px) scale(1.06); }
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title {
    margin: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px) 0 0;
    line-height: 1.14;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line {
  display: block;
  font-size: clamp(1.875rem, 8vw, 2.5rem);
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 600;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.2rem + 4.2vw, 4.5rem);
    line-height: 1.14;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-title-line + .hero-title-line {
  margin-top: 0.04em;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-muted {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-accent {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-inline-start: 0.02em;
  display: inline-block;
}

.hero-section .hero-title-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 50%,
    var(--accent) 100%
  );
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  animation: dotShimmer 3.5s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes dotShimmer {
  0%   { background-position: 100% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -100% 0; }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ROLE PILL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-role {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 6px 13px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink);
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: clamp(24px, 2.8vw, 34px);
    padding: 7px 15px;
    font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 0.88rem + 0.3vw, 1.0625rem);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-role-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: heroDotPulse 2.4s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-role-dot {
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-role-text {
  display: inline-block;
  animation: roleIn 420ms var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes roleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(6px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DESCRIPTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-description {
  max-width: 100%;
  margin-top: 18px;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-description {
    max-width: 58ch;
    margin-top: clamp(20px, 2.4vw, 28px);
    font-size: clamp(1rem, 0.95rem + 0.25vw, 1.125rem);
    line-height: 1.75;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ACTIONS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 28px;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: row;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    width: auto;
    margin-top: clamp(32px, 3.6vw, 44px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-btn {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 54px;
  padding-inline: 24px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
  transition:
    transform 260ms var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow 360ms var(--ease-out),
    background-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    border-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    color 240ms var(--ease-out);
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-btn {
    width: auto;
    gap: 12px;
    min-height: 58px;
    padding-inline: 30px;
    font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 0.9rem + 0.15vw, 1rem);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  color: #fff9f4;
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    #0a0908 0%,
    #211c18 55%,
    #0a0908 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08),
    0 12px 30px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: opacity 320ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
    0 18px 44px -14px var(--accent-glow),
    0 8px 20px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.24);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary .hero-btn-arrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: transform 320ms var(--ease-spring);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover .hero-btn-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-5px);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  color: #fff;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-primary::before {
  display: none;
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 12px 28px -12px var(--accent-glow);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-count {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 26px;
  height: 22px;
  padding-inline: 7px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  transition:
    background-color 240ms var(--ease-out),
    color 240ms var(--ease-out);
}

.hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover .hero-btn-count {
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  color: var(--ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .hero-section .hero-btn-secondary:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TRUST ROW — visible on ALL screens
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-trust {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 28px;
  padding-top: 22px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-trust {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
    width: auto;
    margin-top: clamp(36px, 4.5vw, 52px);
    padding-top: clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 28px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-value {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-trust-value {
    font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1rem + 0.6vw, 1.5rem);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-trust-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.8;
  direction: ltr;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-trust-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GLASS CARD — visible everywhere
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-visual {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 480px;
}

@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  .hero-section .hero-visual {
    position: sticky;
    top: 120px;
    align-self: start;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-glass {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 22px;

  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 58%, transparent) 100%
  );

  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background-clip: padding-box;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 65%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04),
    0 20px 50px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.16),
    0 8px 24px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);

  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-glass {
    gap: 20px;
    padding: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 28px);
    border-radius: 24px;
  }
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-glass {
    backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-glass::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) 35%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent) 65%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.hero-section .hero-glass::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -30%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 70%;
  height: 70%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

.hero-glass-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.hero-glass-corner::before,
.hero-glass-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.hero-glass-corner::before { width: 1px; height: 100%; inset-inline-start: 0; top: 0; }
.hero-glass-corner::after  { width: 100%; height: 1px; top: 0; inset-inline-start: 0; }

.hero-glass-corner-tl { top: 10px; inset-inline-start: 10px; }
.hero-glass-corner-tr { top: 10px; inset-inline-end: 10px; transform: scaleX(-1); }
.hero-glass-corner-bl { bottom: 10px; inset-inline-start: 10px; transform: scaleY(-1); }
.hero-glass-corner-br { bottom: 10px; inset-inline-end: 10px; transform: scale(-1, -1); }

.hero-glass-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-glass-live {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  color: var(--success);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.hero-glass-live-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 15%, transparent),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 55%, transparent);
  animation: heroDotPulse 2s var(--ease-in-out) infinite;
}

.hero-glass-issue {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.hero-glass-currently {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

.hero-glass-currently-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.hero-glass-currently-text {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.45;
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.hero-glass-currently-text > span:first-child {
  animation: currentlyIn 420ms var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes currentlyIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.hero-glass-currently-cursor {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 2px;
  height: 1em;
  background: var(--accent);
  margin-inline-start: 3px;
  animation: cursorBlink 1s steps(2) infinite;
}

@keyframes cursorBlink {
  0%, 50%   { opacity: 1; }
  51%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
}

.hero-glass-capacity {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 14px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.hero-glass-capacity-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.hero-glass-capacity-dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
}

.hero-glass-capacity-dots span {
  flex: 1;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.hero-glass-capacity-dots .is-open {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px -2px var(--accent-glow);
}

.hero-glass-capacity-dots .is-filled {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 12%, transparent);
}

.hero-glass-capacity-count {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.85;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-glass-clock {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}

.hero-glass-clock-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.24em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
}

.hero-glass-clock-time {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;

}

@media (min-width: 721px) {

  }
}

.hero-glass-foot {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 3px;
}

.hero-glass-name {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: 0;
}

.hero-glass-latin {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FOOTER — visible everywhere
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-top: 40px;
  padding-top: 22px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-footer {
    gap: 24px;
    margin-top: clamp(60px, 8vw, 96px);
    padding-top: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 32px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-signature {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-mark {
  display: block;
  width: 70px;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-signature-mark {
    width: clamp(80px, 9vw, 120px);
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-mark svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-name {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1px;
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-name strong {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-signature-name strong {
    font-size: 13px;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-signature-name small {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1.2;
  direction: ltr;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-signature-name small {
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-footer-meta {
  display: none;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-footer-meta {
    display: flex;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-footer-meta span + span::before {
  content: "·";
  margin-inline-end: 18px;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MARQUEE — visible everywhere
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-marquee {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  margin-top: 40px;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0.85rem 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
  -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent,
    black 8%,
    black 92%,
    transparent
  );
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-marquee {
    margin-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
    padding: clamp(0.85rem, 1.8vw, 1.1rem) 0;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  width: max-content;
  animation: hero-marquee-scroll 46s linear infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2.5rem;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.26em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  white-space: nowrap;
  opacity: 0.65;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  direction: ltr;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .hero-section .hero-marquee-item {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  }
}

.hero-section .hero-marquee-sep {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  opacity: 0.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

@keyframes hero-marquee-scroll {
  from { transform: translateX(0); }
  to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   VERY SMALL SCREENS (<400px)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .hero-section .hero-title-line {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow,
  .hero-section .hero-role {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    padding-inline: 11px;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-glass {
    padding: 18px;
    gap: 14px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-bg-orb,
  .hero-aperture,
  .hero-section .hero-title::before,
  .hero-section .hero-title-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-marquee-track,
  .hero-section .hero-live-bars span,
  .hero-glass-live-dot,
  .hero-glass-currently-text > span:first-child,
  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-dot,
  .hero-section .hero-role-text {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .hero-glass-currently-cursor {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn:hover {
    transform: none;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-btn-primary:hover .hero-btn-arrow {
    transform: none;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   FIX — Services grid columns
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   مشکل: `.service-item` سه ستون داشت ولی JSX چهار فرزند
   می‌سازه (number, icon, title, arrow). نتیجه: عنوان توی
   ستون ۲۴px گیر می‌کرد و کلمه‌به‌کلمه می‌شکست.
   
   راه‌حل: چهار ستون — به اندازه‌ی هر چهار فرزند.
   ============================================================ */

.service-item {
  grid-template-columns: 40px 40px 1fr 24px;
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .service-item {
    grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr 22px;
  }

  .service-item .service-icon {
    display: none;
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   FIX — Theme toggle icons
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   مشکل: در JSX از کلاس‌های `theme-icon-sun` و `theme-icon-moon`
   استفاده می‌شه، ولی layout.css فقط `icon-sun` و `icon-moon`
   رو استایل کرده بود. نتیجه: آیکن‌ها بدون رنگ و سایز درست.
   ============================================================ */

.site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 9px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: block;
  transition:
    opacity 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

/* Sun — light mode */
.site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon-sun {
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 1;
  transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
}

/* Moon — hidden in light mode */
.site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon-moon {
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0;
  transform: rotate(-100deg) scale(0.4);
}

/* Dark mode — flip visibility */
[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon-sun {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: rotate(90deg) scale(0.4);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon-moon {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
}

/* Mobile — smaller padding */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon {
    padding: 7px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MAGNETIC BUTTONS — 2026 Edition
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - Wrapper stays fixed; inner element moves
   - JS drives via RAF; CSS provides fallback
   - Disabled on touch and reduced-motion
   ============================================================ */

.magnetic {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  will-change: transform;
}

.magnetic-inner {
  display: inline-block;
  will-change: transform;
  transform: translate3d(
    var(--magnetic-x, 0px),
    var(--magnetic-y, 0px),
    0
  );
  transition: transform var(--motion-slow) var(--motion-ease-spring);
}

/* When JS is active, disable CSS transition to let RAF drive it */
.magnetic[data-magnetic-active="true"] .magnetic-inner {
  transition: none;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FALLBACK — no motion allowed
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: none) or (pointer: coarse) {
  .magnetic-inner {
    transform: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .magnetic-inner {
    transform: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MANUSCRIPT GRID — Persian Khatam (8-pointed star / خاتم)
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Two overlapping squares (0° + 45°) = 8-pointed star.
   Sacred geometry of Isfahan mosques + Quran illumination.

   SAFE IMPLEMENTATION:
   - Fully percent-encoded data-URI (no raw spaces, no raw #)
   - No CSS custom property holding the URL (avoids minifier bugs)
   - No background-attachment: fixed
   - No !important
   - Minimal targeting: body + 5 solid surfaces
   ============================================================ */

/* ─── Light mode ─── */
body,
.commitments-section,
.process-section,
.site-footer,
.why-section::before,
.latest-blog-section::before {
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20width='40'%20height='40'%20viewBox='0%200%2040%2040'%3E%3Cg%20fill='none'%20stroke='%23B45309'%20stroke-opacity='0.09'%20stroke-width='0.75'%3E%3Crect%20x='10'%20y='10'%20width='20'%20height='20'/%3E%3Crect%20x='10'%20y='10'%20width='20'%20height='20'%20transform='rotate(45%2020%2020)'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  background-size: 40px 40px;
  background-repeat: repeat;
}

/* ─── Dark mode ─── */
[data-theme="dark"] body,
[data-theme="dark"] .commitments-section,
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MOBILE BOTTOM NAV — Liquid Glass Scrubbing Edition
   ============================================================ */

.mbn {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .chapter-rail,
  .chapter-rail.is-visible {
    display: none !important;
    visibility: hidden !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {

  /* ─── ROOT — Floating Pill ─── */
  .mbn {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    left: 14px;
    right: 14px;
    z-index: 90;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 4px;
    max-width: 500px;
    height: 78px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 6px;
    border-radius: 32px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    direction: rtl;
    font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);
    isolation: isolate;
    pointer-events: auto;

    /* Liquid glass */
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78) 0%,
        rgba(252, 246, 240, 0.62) 45%,
        rgba(255, 249, 244, 0.74) 100%
      );
    backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(2.1);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(2.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1),
      inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.05),
      inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6),
      inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6),
      0 0 0 0.5px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.05),
      0 3px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.1),
      0 16px 36px -12px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.22),
      0 42px 96px -28px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42);

    /* Entrance */
    animation: mbn-enter 680ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 300ms both;
  }

  @keyframes mbn-enter {
    0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(120%); }
    60% { opacity: 1; }
    100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  /* Top specular streak */
  .mbn::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 14%;
    right: 14%;
    height: 1.5px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) 20%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) 80%, transparent);
    border-radius: 2px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 4;
    filter: blur(0.6px);
  }

  /* Ambient underglow */
  .mbn::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    left: 16%;
    right: 16%;
    bottom: -28px;
    height: 54px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, var(--mbn-aura, rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.32)) 0%, transparent 70%);
    filter: blur(28px);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: -1;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: background 640ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  /* Dark mode */
  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn {
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg,
        rgba(52, 46, 40, 0.92) 0%,
        rgba(28, 24, 20, 0.82) 45%,
        rgba(20, 17, 14, 0.92) 100%);
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16),
      inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65),
      0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
      0 3px 8px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
      0 16px 36px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7),
      0 42px 96px -28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95);
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn::before {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) 20%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) 80%, transparent);
  }

  /* ─── AURORA ─── */
  .mbn-aurora {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 0;
    width: calc(100% / var(--mbn-count, 5));
    height: 100%;
    transform: translate3d(calc(-100% * var(--mbn-index, 0)), -50%, 0);
    transition: transform 640ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.15, 0.4, 1);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .mbn-aurora-glow {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 8% 14%;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 60%, var(--mbn-aura, rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.5)) 0%, transparent 72%);
    filter: blur(20px);
    animation: mbn-aura-pulse 3.8s ease-in-out infinite;
    transition: background 640ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  @keyframes mbn-aura-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.12); }
  }

  .mbn[data-hide-indicator="true"] .mbn-aurora { opacity: 0; }

  /* ─── ITEMS ─── */
  .mbn-items {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
    touch-action: none; /* enable scrubbing */
  }

  /* ─── SLIDING INDICATOR ───
     Uses `right` (physical) instead of `inset-inline-start` for
     consistent RTL positioning across browsers.
     In RTL flex layout, item[0] is rightmost → right: calc(0%)
     item[4] is leftmost → right: calc(80%) + padding
     ─────────────────────────── */
  .mbn-slider {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    right: calc(var(--mbn-index, 0) * (100% / var(--mbn-count, 5)) + 3px);
    width: calc(100% / var(--mbn-count, 5) - 6px);
    border-radius: 28px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
    transition:
      right 640ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.15, 0.4, 1),
      opacity 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 1) 0%, rgba(255, 250, 242, 0.92) 100%);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 1),
      inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
      inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7),
      inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7),
      0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.07),
      0 16px 40px -12px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.34),
      0 4px 14px -4px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.12);
  }

  .mbn-slider-glow {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -12px;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, var(--mbn-aura, rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.34)) 0%, transparent 65%);
    filter: blur(18px);
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0.9;
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn-slider {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(76, 66, 56, 0.98) 0%, rgba(50, 42, 36, 0.95) 100%);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
      inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
      0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
      0 16px 42px -12px rgba(20, 177, 171, 0.46),
      0 4px 14px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  }

  .mbn[data-hide-indicator="true"] .mbn-slider { opacity: 0; }

  /* ─── ITEM ─── */
  .mbn-item {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3px;
    padding: 10px 2px 8px;
    min-height: 66px;
    border-radius: 28px;
    color: #6b6560;
    text-decoration: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    overflow: hidden;
    isolation: isolate;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transition:
      color 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn-item { color: #a9a296; }

  .mbn-item:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0d7377);
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: 28px;
  }

  .mbn-item:active { transform: scale(0.9); }

  .mbn-item.is-active,
  .mbn-item.is-scrubbing { color: #0d7377; }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn-item.is-active,
  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn-item.is-scrubbing { color: #14b1ab; }

  /* ─── ICON ─── */
  .mbn-item-icon {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition:
      transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
      filter 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .mbn-item-icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

  .mbn-item.is-active .mbn-item-icon,
  .mbn-item.is-scrubbing .mbn-item-icon {
    transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.14);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 10px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.5));
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn-item.is-active .mbn-item-icon,
  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn-item.is-scrubbing .mbn-item-icon {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 12px rgba(20, 177, 171, 0.65));
  }

  /* ─── LOGO + RING ─── */
  .mbn-logo-wrap {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .mbn-logo-ring {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    pointer-events: none;
    color: #0d7377;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mbn-logo-ring { color: #14b1ab; }

  .mbn-logo-ring-progress { transition: stroke-dashoffset 200ms linear; }

  .mbn-item-logo {
    display: block;
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    border-radius: 9px;
    object-fit: cover;
    background: #0a0908;
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
      0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42),
      0 0 0 1px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06);
    pointer-events: none;
    transition:
      transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
      box-shadow 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .mbn-item.is-active .mbn-item-logo,
  .mbn-item.is-scrubbing .mbn-item-logo {
    transform: scale(1.12);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28),
      0 6px 16px -3px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.6),
      0 0 0 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.68),
      0 0 28px -4px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.72);
  }

  /* ─── LABEL ─── */
  .mbn-item-label {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    max-width: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition:
      font-weight 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      color 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
  }

  .mbn-item.is-active .mbn-item-label,
  .mbn-item.is-scrubbing .mbn-item-label {
    font-weight: 800;
    transform: translateY(-0.5px);
  }

  /* ─── CTA ─── */
  .mbn-cta {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3px;
    min-height: 66px;
    min-width: 92px;
    padding: 10px 14px 8px;
    border-radius: 28px;
    color: #ffffff;
    text-decoration: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    overflow: hidden;
    isolation: isolate;
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #B22222 0%, #8B1A1A 50%, #6B0F0F 100%);
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5),
      inset 0 -1.5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22),
      0 1px 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.32),
      0 6px 20px -4px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.58),
      0 20px 48px -12px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.52);
    transition:
      transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
      box-shadow 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .mbn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 3px; }
  .mbn-cta:active { transform: scale(0.93); }

  .mbn-cta-shine {
    position: absolute;
    top: -50%; left: -60%; width: 50%; height: 200%;
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6) 50%, transparent 100%);
    transform: skewX(-20deg);
    animation: mbn-shine 5.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  @keyframes mbn-shine { 0%, 60% { left: -60%; } 85%, 100% { left: 150%; } }

  .mbn-cta-pulse {
    position: absolute;
    inset: -2px;
    border-radius: inherit;
    border: 2px solid rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.6);
    opacity: 0;
    animation: mbn-cta-pulse 3.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 3;
  }

  @keyframes mbn-cta-pulse {
    0% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1); }
    70% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.12); }
    100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.12); }
  }

  .mbn-cta .mbn-item-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; pointer-events: none; }
  .mbn-cta .mbn-item-icon svg { filter: drop-shadow(0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)); }
  .mbn-cta .mbn-item-label { color: #ffffff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 10px; pointer-events: none; }

  .mbn-cta.is-active {
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55),
      0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5),
      0 6px 20px -4px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.78),
      0 0 36px -4px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.72),
      0 24px 56px -14px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.64);
  }

  /* ─── Body padding ─── */
  body { padding-bottom: calc(126px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SMALL SCREENS (≤ 400px)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .mbn { left: 8px; right: 8px; height: 74px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 30px; gap: 2px; }
  .mbn-item { min-height: 62px; padding: 9px 1px 7px; border-radius: 24px; gap: 2px; }
  .mbn-item-icon { width: 28px; height: 28px; }
  .mbn-item-logo { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px; }
  .mbn-logo-ring { width: 30px; height: 30px; }
  .mbn-item-label { font-size: 9px; }
  .mbn-slider { border-radius: 24px; }
  .mbn-cta { min-height: 62px; min-width: 78px; padding: 9px 10px 7px; border-radius: 24px; }
  .mbn-cta .mbn-item-icon { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
  .mbn-cta .mbn-item-label { font-size: 9px; }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mbn { animation: none !important; }
  .mbn-slider, .mbn-aurora, .mbn-aurora-glow { transition: opacity 200ms ease !important; }
  .mbn-item, .mbn-item-icon, .mbn-item-logo, .mbn-item-label, .mbn-cta,
  .mbn-cta-shine, .mbn-cta-pulse {
    transition: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
```

## FILE: src\styles\mobile-declutter.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   MOBILE DECLUTTER — Reduce visual noise on small screens
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Strategy:
   - Hide non-essential decorative elements
   - Collapse multi-line CTAs to single-line
   - Tighten vertical rhythm
   - Every element must justify its presence
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     HERO — remove decoration, keep message
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

  /* Hide masthead — too much small text at top */
  .hero-masthead {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Hide vertical rail (already hidden but double-safe) */
  .hero-rail {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Hide corner marks — pure decoration */
  .hero-corner {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Hide hand-drawn arrow */
  .hero-arrow {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Hide marquee strip — full width of noise */
  .hero-marquee {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Hide tech chips — not essential for first impression */
  .hero-tech {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Hide signature block — extra layer */
  .hero-signature {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Hide hero footer meta (PORTFOLIO 01/04) */
  .hero-footer-meta {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* Simplify hero footer — just a divider */
  .hero-footer {
    margin-top: 32px !important;
    padding-top: 20px !important;
    min-height: auto !important;
    display: block !important;
  }

  /* Tighter hero spacing */
  .hero-section {
    padding-block: 88px 48px !important;
  }

  .hero-title {
    margin-bottom: 14px !important;
  }

  .hero-role {
    margin-top: 16px !important;
    padding: 6px 12px !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
  }

  .hero-description {
    margin-top: 14px !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 1.75 !important;
  }

  .hero-actions {
    margin-top: 20px !important;
    gap: 8px !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SERVICES — remove decorative masthead
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .services-masthead {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ABOUT — remove identity rule + fact labels noise
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .about-identity-rule {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     BACK TO TOP — smaller, less intrusive
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .back-to-top {
    width: 40px !important;
    height: 40px !important;
    bottom: calc(88px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
    inset-inline-end: 12px !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     MOBILE BOTTOM NAV — tighter, cleaner
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .mobile-nav {
    padding: 5px !important;
    max-width: 440px !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-list {
    height: 56px !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item {
    padding: 6px 2px 4px !important;
    gap: 2px !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon {
    width: 20px !important;
    height: 20px !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-label {
    font-size: 9.5px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
  }

  /* CTA button more compact */
  .mobile-nav-cta {
    padding: 6px 12px 4px !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta-icon {
    width: 18px !important;
    height: 18px !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SECTION HEADINGS — tighter, no decorative em-dash
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .section-heading {
    margin-bottom: 28px !important;
    gap: 10px !important;
  }

  .section-heading h2 {
    margin-top: 12px !important;
    line-height: 1.18 !important;
  }

  .section-heading > p {
    font-size: 13.5px !important;
    line-height: 1.75 !important;
  }

  /* Section spacing tighter */
  .section {
    padding-block: clamp(48px, 10vw, 72px) !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     PORTFOLIO — reduce chrome on cards
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .portfolio-card-chrome {
    padding: 8px 12px !important;
  }

  .portfolio-card-caption {
    padding: 12px 14px !important;
  }

  .portfolio-card-view {
```
