```css
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MOBILE FIX + GLASS DOCK NAV
   Version: 2.1 — Optimized for 6 items (5 nav + 1 CTA)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ── 1. Prevent horizontal scroll ── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  html, body {
    overflow-x: hidden;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  body {
    padding-bottom: calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  }

  img, video, iframe {
    max-width: 100%;
    height: auto;
  }
}

/* ── 2. Tech chips: horizontal wrap ── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-tech {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: row !important;
    flex-wrap: wrap !important;
    gap: 0.5rem !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    margin: 1rem 0 !important;
    list-style: none !important;
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  .hero-tech-chip {
    flex: 0 0 auto !important;
    width: auto !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   GLASS DOCK — Floating premium bottom nav
   Optimized for 5 nav items + 1 CTA
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  /* ── Wrapper: floating glass dock ── */
  .mobile-nav {
    position: fixed !important;
    top: auto !important;
    bottom: 12px !important;
    left: 12px !important;
    right: 12px !important;
    inset: auto 12px 12px 12px !important;
    width: auto !important;
    max-width: 520px !important;
    margin: 0 auto !important;
    padding: 6px !important;
    direction: rtl !important;
    z-index: 90 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    transform: none !important;
    translate: none !important;
    border-radius: 26px !important;

    /* Glass effect */
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) 0%,
        rgba(247, 243, 238, 0.78) 50%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82) 100%
      ) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(180%) !important;

    /* Border + inner highlight */
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) !important;

    /* Layered shadows for depth */
    box-shadow:
      0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) inset,
      0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03) inset,
      0 2px 6px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04),
      0 12px 28px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.10),
      0 24px 48px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08) !important;
  }

  /* Subtle top highlight line (glass sheen) */
  .mobile-nav::before {
    content: "" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: 12% !important;
    right: 12% !important;
    height: 1px !important;
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95),
      transparent
    ) !important;
    border-radius: 1px !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  /* ── Dark mode ── */
  [data-theme="dark"] .mobile-nav {
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        135deg,
        rgba(28, 24, 20, 0.85) 0%,
        rgba(20, 17, 14, 0.82) 50%,
        rgba(26, 22, 18, 0.85) 100%
      ) !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
    box-shadow:
      0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) inset,
      0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) inset,
      0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
      0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45),
      0 24px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) !important;
  }

  /* ── Hide state ── */
  .mobile-nav.is-hidden {
    transform: translateY(calc(100% + 40px)) !important;
    opacity: 0 !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
                opacity 0.3s ease !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     List container
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .mobile-nav-list {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: row !important;
    flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
    align-items: stretch !important;
    justify-content: space-between !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;

  }

  .mobile-nav-list > li {
    flex: 1 1 0% !important;

    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: stretch !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    position: relative !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Nav items — pill shaped tap targets
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .mobile-nav-item,
  .mobile-nav-cta {
    position: relative !important;
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    padding: 0.3rem 0.08rem !important;
    margin: 0 !important;

    box-sizing: border-box !important;

    color: #716b64 !important;
    transition:
      background 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),

      transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
  }

  /* ── Active state: soft orange pill with glow ── */
  .mobile-nav-item.is-active,
  .mobile-nav-item.active {
    color: #0d7377 !important;
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.12) 0%,
        rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.06) 100%
      ) !important;
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 1px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.15) inset,
      0 4px 12px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.15) !important;
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] .mobile-nav-item.is-active,
  [data-theme="dark"] .mobile-nav-item.active {
    color: #14b1ab !important;
    background:
      linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.20) 0%,
        rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.10) 100%
      ) !important;
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 1px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.25) inset,
      0 4px 14px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.25) !important;
  }

  /* ── Active indicator line above label ── */
  .mobile-nav-item.is-active::before,
  .mobile-nav-item.active::before {
    content: "" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    top: 3px !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    transform: translateX(-50%) !important;
    width: 14px !important;
    height: 2px !important;
    border-radius: 2px !important;
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      #0d7377,
      transparent
    ) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.7) !important;
    opacity: 0.9 !important;
  }

  /* ── Press feedback ── */
  .mobile-nav-item:active,
  .mobile-nav-cta:active {
    transform: scale(0.94) !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Labels
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .mobile-nav-label {
    display: block !important;
    font-size: 0.55rem !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    line-height: 1 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em !important;
    white-space: nowrap !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    text-overflow: ellipsis !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transition: color 0.25s ease !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     Icons
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .mobile-nav-icon,
  .mobile-nav-cta-icon {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    width: 20px !important;
    height: 20px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon svg,
  .mobile-nav-cta-icon svg {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    display: block !important;
    stroke-width: 1.8 !important;
  }

  /* Icon lift on active */
  .mobile-nav-item.is-active .mobile-nav-icon,
  .mobile-nav-item.active .mobile-nav-icon {
    transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.05) !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ORDER CTA — Premium orange button
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .mobile-nav-cta {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, #B22222 0%, #8B1A1A 55%, #6B0F0F 100%) !important;
    box-shadow:
      0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) inset,
      0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) inset,
      0 4px 12px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.35),
      0 8px 24px rgba(178, 34, 34, 0.25) !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
  }

  /* Shine sweep on CTA */
  .mobile-nav-cta::after {
    content: "" !important;
    position: absolute !important;
    top: 0 !important;
    left: -60% !important;
    width: 60% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    background: linear-gradient(
      100deg,
      transparent 0%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45) 50%,
      transparent 100%
    ) !important;
    transform: skewX(-20deg) !important;
    animation: cta-shine 4.5s ease-in-out infinite !important;
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta .mobile-nav-label,
  .mobile-nav-cta .mobile-nav-cta-icon,
  .mobile-nav-cta * {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    position: relative !important;
    z-index: 1 !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta:active {
    transform: scale(0.94) !important;
    box-shadow:
      0 2px 6px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.5),
      0 4px 14px rgba(178, 34, 34, 0.35) !important;
  }
}

/* ── CTA shine animation ── */
@keyframes cta-shine {
  0%, 70% {
    left: -60%;
  }
  100% {
    left: 130%;
  }
}

/* ── 3. Hero layout: stack on mobile ── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-rail,

  .hero-scroll {

}

/* ── 4. Single-column layouts on mobile ── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .about-grid,

}

/* ── 5. Hide desktop nav on mobile ── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {

  .nav-order-button,
  .brand-text,
  .brand-issue {
    display: none !important;

}

/* ── 6. Hide mobile nav on desktop ── */
@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .mobile-nav {
    display: none !important;
  }

  body {
    padding-bottom: 0 !important;
  }
}

/* ── 7. Small mobile (max-width: 380px) ── */
@media (max-width: 380px) {
  .mobile-nav {
    inset: auto 8px 8px 8px !important;

  .mobile-nav-list {

  }

    padding: 0.25rem 0.05rem !important;

    border-radius: 16px !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon,
  .mobile-nav-cta-icon {
    width: 18px !important;
    height: 18px !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-label {
    font-size: 0.5rem !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active::before,
  .mobile-nav-item.active::before {
    width: 10px !important;
    height: 1.5px !important;

/* ── 8. Reduced motion ── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

  }

  .mobile-nav-item,

  }
}
```

## FILE: src\styles\mobile-forms.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   MOBILE FORMS — Compact, elegant, native-grade
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - 16px minimum font size (prevents iOS auto-zoom)
   - Compact option cards (fits more per screen)
   - Sticky submit button
   - Auto-scroll to error
   - Auto-save feedback
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     INPUTS — 16px prevents iOS auto-zoom
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .form-field input,
  .order-page .form-field textarea,
  .order-page .form-field select {
    font-size: 16px !important;
    line-height: 1.5 !important;
    padding: 14px 16px !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    min-height: 52px !important;
  }

  .order-page .form-field textarea {
    min-height: 130px !important;
    padding: 14px 16px !important;
    font-size: 16px !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     LABELS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .form-field > span,
  .order-page .form-fieldset legend {
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em !important;
    color: var(--ink-3-strong) !important;
    margin-bottom: 7px !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     PROJECT-TYPE OPTIONS — Compact list
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .project-type-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    gap: 6px !important;
  }

  .order-page .project-type-option {
    min-height: 44px !important;
    padding: 10px 14px !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 1.35 !important;
    border-radius: 10px !important;
    gap: 10px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    justify-content: flex-start !important;
  }

  .order-page .project-type-option input {
    width: 18px !important;
    height: 18px !important;
    flex-shrink: 0 !important;
  }

  .order-page .project-type-option span {
    flex: 1;
    text-align: start;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     CONTACT METHODS — 3-col compact
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .contact-methods {
    display: grid !important;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr) !important;
    gap: 8px !important;
  }

  .order-page .contact-method {
    min-height: 52px !important;
    padding: 10px 8px !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    font-size: 13px !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 6px !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    text-align: center !important;
  }

  .order-page .contact-method input {
    display: none !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     CHECKBOX
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .form-checkbox {
    min-height: 52px !important;
    padding: 12px 14px !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
  }

  .order-page .form-checkbox input {
    width: 20px !important;
    height: 20px !important;
  }

  .order-page .form-checkbox span {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 1.5 !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SECTION HEADINGS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .form-section-heading {
    grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
    margin-bottom: 20px !important;
  }

  .order-page .form-section-heading > span {
    width: 30px !important;
    height: 30px !important;
    font-size: 11px !important;
  }

  .order-page .form-section-heading h2 {
    font-size: 17px !important;
    line-height: 1.3 !important;
  }

  .order-page .form-section-heading p {
    font-size: 12.5px !important;
    margin-top: 3px !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SUBMIT ROW
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .form-submit-row {
    padding: 18px !important;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 12px !important;
  }

  .order-page .form-submit-row p {
    font-size: 12px !important;
    text-align: center !important;
  }

  .order-page .form-submit-row .button {
    width: 100% !important;
    min-height: 54px !important;
    font-size: 15px !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     FORM SECTION — tighter padding
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .form-section {
    padding: 22px 18px !important;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     FIELD ERROR
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .order-page .form-field input[aria-invalid="true"],
  .order-page .form-field textarea[aria-invalid="true"] {
    animation: fieldShake 320ms cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97);
  }

  .order-page .form-fieldset[aria-invalid="true"] {
    animation: fieldShake 320ms cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97);
  }

  @keyframes fieldShake {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
    25%      { transform: translateX(-5px); }
    75%      { transform: translateX(5px); }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   STICKY SUBMIT — mobile only
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-sticky-submit {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  inset-inline: 12px;
  z-index: 60;
  padding: 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent) inset,
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08),
    0 12px 32px -8px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.16);
  animation: stickySlideUp 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  will-change: transform;
}

.order-sticky-submit .button {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 52px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 14px;
}

@keyframes stickySlideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(20px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

  }
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .order-sticky-submit {
    display: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DRAFT NOTICE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-draft-notice {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.order-draft-notice-text {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.order-draft-notice-text::before {
  content: "↻";
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.order-draft-clear {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: all var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease-out);
}

.order-draft-clear:hover {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .order-draft-notice {
    padding: 10px 14px;
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }

  .order-draft-clear {
    padding: 7px 13px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    min-height: 34px;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MOBILE MODAL — Bottom Sheet Experience
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - True bottom sheet on mobile
   - Drag handle with visual affordance
   - Swipe-down to close
   - Backdrop opacity follows drag
   - Smooth spring physics
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DRAG HANDLE — visible only on mobile
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.project-modal-drag-handle {
  display: none;
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .project-modal {
    padding: 0 !important;
    align-items: flex-end !important;
    background: rgba(10, 9, 8, var(--backdrop-opacity, 0.6)) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.2);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px) saturate(1.2);
    touch-action: none;
  }

  .project-modal-shell {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    max-height: 92svh !important;
    height: auto !important;
    border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0 !important;
    border-bottom: none !important;
    will-change: transform;
    touch-action: pan-y;
    transform: translateY(0);
    transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
    padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) !important;
    box-shadow:
      0 -8px 24px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.15),
      0 -24px 60px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.2) !important;
  }

  /* While dragging, disable transitions */
  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] .project-modal-shell {
    transition: none;
  }

  /* ═══ DRAG HANDLE ═══ */
  .project-modal-drag-handle {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 12px 0 8px;
    width: 100%;
    cursor: grab;
    touch-action: none;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    background: var(--paper-2);
    border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0;
    position: relative;
  }

  .project-modal-drag-handle:active {
    cursor: grabbing;
  }

  .project-modal-drag-bar {
    display: block;
    width: 40px;
    height: 4px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-3) 40%, transparent);
    transition:
      width 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .project-modal-drag-handle:active .project-modal-drag-bar {
    width: 56px;
    background: var(--accent);
  }

  /* ═══ NAV BAR — hide the drag handle background under it ═══ */
  .project-modal-nav {
    padding: 8px 16px 14px !important;
    background: var(--paper-2) !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 3;
  }

  /* ═══ MAIN SCROLL AREA ═══ */
  .project-modal-main {
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    touch-action: pan-y;
    max-height: calc(92svh - 130px) !important;
  }

  /* ═══ VISUAL ═══ */
  .project-modal-visual {
    min-height: 200px !important;
    height: 220px !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    position: relative;
  }

  /* ═══ BODY ═══ */
  .project-modal-body {
    padding: 22px 20px 32px !important;
    gap: 18px !important;
  }

  /* ═══ MOBILE SAFE AREA ═══ */
  .project-modal-body:last-child {
    padding-bottom: calc(40px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
  }

  /* ═══ NAV BUTTONS — bigger touch targets ═══ */
  .project-modal-nav-btn {
    width: 42px !important;
    height: 42px !important;
    min-width: 42px !important;
    min-height: 42px !important;
  }

  /* ═══ ACTION BUTTONS — full width, stacked ═══ */
  .project-modal-actions {
    flex-direction: column !important;
    gap: 10px !important;
    margin-top: 8px;
  }

  .project-modal-actions .button,
  .project-modal-share {
    width: 100% !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    min-height: 52px !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SMALL MOBILE (≤400px)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .project-modal-shell {
    border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important;
  }

  .project-modal-drag-handle {
    padding: 10px 0 6px;
    border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
  }

  .project-modal-drag-bar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 3.5px;
  }

  .project-modal-body {
    padding: 18px 16px 28px !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .project-modal-shell {
    transition: opacity 200ms ease;
  }

  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] .project-modal-shell {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MOBILE NAV V2 — Smart Header + Refined Bottom Nav
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - Header hides on scroll down, shows on scroll up
   - Refined bottom nav with better icon animation
   - Route-aware active states
   - Spring-based motion
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SMART HEADER — hide on scroll down
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.site-nav {
  transition:
    transform 380ms cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1),
    opacity 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    padding 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}

.site-nav.is-hidden {
  transform: translateY(-100%);
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* On desktop, keep header always visible (hide is only for mobile feel) */
@media (min-width: 901px) {
  .site-nav.is-hidden {
    transform: translateY(0);
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BOTTOM NAV — refined icon animations
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  /* Icon container */
  .mobile-nav-icon {
    transition:
      transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
      color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    transform-origin: center;
  }

  /* Icon SVG stroke-width */
  .mobile-nav-icon svg {
    transition: stroke-width 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  /* ═══ ACTIVE STATE ═══ */
  .mobile-nav-item.is-active .mobile-nav-icon {
    transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.12);
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active .mobile-nav-icon svg {
    stroke-width: 2.2;
  }

  /* ═══ ACTIVE INDICATOR — animated bar above label ═══ */
  .mobile-nav-item::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 3px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: center;
    width: 20px;
    height: 2.5px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      currentColor 20%,
      currentColor 80%,
      transparent
    );
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      transform 340ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
      opacity 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active::before {
    transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }

  /* ═══ ACTIVE LABEL — bold ═══ */
  .mobile-nav-label {
    transition:
      font-weight 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active .mobile-nav-label {
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.005em;
  }

  /* ═══ PRESS FEEDBACK ═══ */
  .mobile-nav-item:active .mobile-nav-icon {
    transform: scale(0.9);
    transition-duration: 100ms;
  }

  /* ═══ CTA BUTTON — pulse when active hover ═══ */
  .mobile-nav-cta-icon {
    transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
  }

  .mobile-nav-cta:active .mobile-nav-cta-icon {
    transform: rotate(90deg) scale(0.9);
    transition-duration: 180ms;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .site-nav {
    transition: opacity 200ms ease;
  }

  .site-nav.is-hidden {
    transform: translateY(0);
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .mobile-nav-icon,
  .mobile-nav-item::before,
  .mobile-nav-label,
  .mobile-nav-cta-icon {
    transition: none !important;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active .mobile-nav-icon {
    transform: none;
  }

  .mobile-nav-item.is-active::before {
    transform: translateX(-50%) scaleX(1);
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MOBILE PERFORMANCE FIX
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Fixes mobile scroll lag + layout breaks caused by
   content-visibility and contain rules.
   ============================================================ */

/* ─── Remove ALL content-visibility + contain on mobile ─── */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .services-section,
  .portfolio-section,
  .about-section,
  .why-section,
  .testimonials-section,
  .latest-blog-section,
  .newsletter-section,
  .faq-section,
  .final-cta-section,
  .commitments-section,
  .process-section,
  .site-footer,
  .hero-section {
    content-visibility: visible !important;
    contain-intrinsic-size: none !important;
    contain: none !important;
  }
}

/* ─── Smooth scroll on mobile ─── */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    overscroll-behavior-y: auto;
  }

  body {
    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }

  /* Remove backdrop-filter that slows scroll on mobile */
  .site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.4) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.4) !important;
  }

  /* Reduce heavy shadows on mobile */
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
      0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08) !important;
  }

  /* Remove heavy animations on mobile for smooth scroll */
  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-3 {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-2 {

    filter: blur(60px) !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-1 {
    opacity: 0.45 !important;

  .hero-section .hero-bg-grain {

  }
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MOBILE TOUCH — 2026 Standards
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - Ripple on tap (using CSS custom properties + JS coords)
   - Press feedback that feels native
   - Comfortable touch targets (min 44×44)
   - Haptic-like visual feedback
   - Only active on touch devices
   ============================================================ */

@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     MINIMUM TOUCH TARGETS — Apple HIG & Material Design
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  button,
  a,
  [role="button"],
  [role="link"],
  .btn,
  .button,
  label,
  summary,
  input[type="checkbox"],
  input[type="radio"] {
    min-height: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    touch-action: manipulation;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     PRESS FEEDBACK — natural touch feeling
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .btn,
  .button,
  .nav-order-button,
  .mobile-nav-item,
  .mobile-nav-cta,
  .project-modal-nav-btn,
  .faq-question,
  .service-item,
  .project-type-option,
  .contact-method,
  .blog-tag-chip,
  .not-found-suggestion,
  .portfolio-card {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    isolation: isolate;
    transition:
      transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
      opacity 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .btn:active,
  .button:active,
  .nav-order-button:active,
  .mobile-nav-item:active,
  .mobile-nav-cta:active,
  .project-modal-nav-btn:active,
  .service-item:active,
  .project-type-option:active,
  .contact-method:active,
  .blog-tag-chip:active,
  .not-found-suggestion:active {
    transform: scale(0.965);
    opacity: 0.92;
    transition-duration: 80ms;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     RIPPLE EFFECT
     Uses --ripple-x and --ripple-y set by JS.
     Falls back to center if not set.
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .btn::before,
  .button::before,
  .nav-order-button::before,
  .mobile-nav-item::before,
  .mobile-nav-cta::before,
  .project-modal-nav-btn::before,
  .faq-question::before,
  .service-item::before,
  .project-type-option::before,
  .contact-method::before,
  .blog-tag-chip::before,
  .not-found-suggestion::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: var(--ripple-y, 50%);
    left: var(--ripple-x, 50%);
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(
      circle,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4) 0%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%
    );
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: -1;
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      width 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      height 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .btn.is-rippling::before,
  .button.is-rippling::before,
  .nav-order-button.is-rippling::before,
  .mobile-nav-item.is-rippling::before,
  .mobile-nav-cta.is-rippling::before,
  .project-modal-nav-btn.is-rippling::before,
  .faq-question.is-rippling::before,
  .service-item.is-rippling::before,
  .project-type-option.is-rippling::before,
  .contact-method.is-rippling::before,
  .blog-tag-chip.is-rippling::before,
  .not-found-suggestion.is-rippling::before {
    width: 250%;
    height: 250%;
    opacity: 1;
    transition:
      width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      height 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  /* Darker elements need lighter ripple */
  [data-theme="dark"] .btn::before,
  [data-theme="dark"] .button::before,
  [data-theme="dark"] .project-modal-nav-btn::before,
  [data-theme="dark"] .faq-question::before,
  [data-theme="dark"] .service-item::before,
  [data-theme="dark"] .not-found-suggestion::before {
    background: radial-gradient(
      circle,
      rgba(20, 177, 171, 0.35) 0%,
      rgba(20, 177, 171, 0) 70%
    );
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     PRIMARY BUTTONS get a stronger ripple
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .btn-primary.is-rippling::before,
  .button-primary.is-rippling::before,
  .mobile-nav-cta.is-rippling::before {
    background: radial-gradient(
      circle,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 0%,
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%
    );
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     PREVENT DOUBLE-TAP ZOOM on iOS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  * {
    touch-action: manipulation;
  }

  /* But allow pinch-zoom on content */
  .blog-post-content,
  .project-modal-body,
  .about-content,
  .service-preview-content {
    touch-action: pan-y pinch-zoom;
  }

  /* Horizontal scroll areas */
  .blog-tags-list,
  .contact-methods,
  .hero-marquee {
    touch-action: pan-x;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .btn:active,
  .button:active,
  .nav-order-button:active,
  .mobile-nav-item:active,
  .mobile-nav-cta:active,
  .project-modal-nav-btn:active,
  .service-item:active,
  .project-type-option:active,
  .contact-method:active,
  .blog-tag-chip:active,
  .not-found-suggestion:active {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .btn::before,
  .button::before,
  .nav-order-button::before,
  .mobile-nav-item::before,
  .mobile-nav-cta::before,
  .project-modal-nav-btn::before,
  .faq-question::before,
  .service-item::before,
  .project-type-option::before,
  .contact-method::before,
  .blog-tag-chip::before,
  .not-found-suggestion::before {
    display: none !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MOBILE TYPOGRAPHY — 2026 Global Standards
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - WCAG 2.2 reading comfort
   - Persian-specific: tall ascenders/descenders need more room
   - 16px minimum body (prevents iOS zoom, meets a11y)
   - 60ch maximum line length on mobile
   - Proper spacing rhythm for paragraphs, lists, quotes
   - Auto-flow for tables and code blocks
   ============================================================ */

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ROOT SIZE — larger for comfortable reading
     iOS minimum 16px prevents auto-zoom, WCAG AAA recommends 18px
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  html {
    font-size: 17px;
  }

  body {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     HEADINGS — adjusted scale for mobile
     Larger than desktop ratio to compensate for reduced viewport
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  h1 {
    font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 8vw, 2.25rem);
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    margin-bottom: 0.6em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  h2 {
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 6.5vw, 1.875rem);
    line-height: 1.25;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  h3 {
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 5.5vw, 1.5rem);
    line-height: 1.35;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  h4 {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
  }

  h5,
  h6 {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     BODY PARAGRAPHS — comfortable reading on small screens
     Line length capped at ~55-60 characters
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.85;
    max-width: 60ch;
    margin-bottom: 1.1em;
    text-wrap: pretty;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
    word-break: break-word;
  }

  p:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  /* Lead paragraph — slightly larger for emphasis */
  .body-lead {
    font-size: 1.075rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 1.15em;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     LISTS — bigger touch targets, better rhythm
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  ul:not([class]),
  ol:not([class]) {
    padding-inline-start: 1.4em;
    margin-block: 1em 1.25em;
  }

  ul:not([class]) li,
  ol:not([class]) li {
    padding-inline-start: 0.35em;
    margin-block: 0.5em;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  ul:not([class]) li::marker,
  ol:not([class]) li::marker {
    font-size: 1.1em;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     BLOCKQUOTES — visual separation on mobile
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  blockquote {
    margin: 1.5em 0;
    padding: 1.1em 1.25em;
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
    border-inline-start-width: 4px;
    border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;
  }

  blockquote p {
    font-size: inherit;
    line-height: inherit;
    margin-bottom: 0.6em;
  }

  blockquote p:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     CODE & PREFORMATTED — auto-scroll, no page overflow
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  pre {
    margin: 1.25em 0;
    padding: 1em 1.15em;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
  }

  pre code {
    font-size: inherit;
    line-height: inherit;
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent;
  }

  code:not(pre code) {
    font-size: 0.85em;
    padding: 0.15em 0.35em;
    border-radius: 5px;
    word-break: break-word;
  }

  /* Keyboard key */
  kbd {
    font-size: 0.8em;
    padding: 0.15em 0.4em;
    border-radius: 5px;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     TABLES — horizontal scroll with visual hint
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .blog-post-content table,
  .order-form table {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow-x: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    margin: 1.25em 0;
  }

  .blog-post-content table thead,
  .blog-post-content table tbody,
  .blog-post-content table tr {
    display: table;
    width: 100%;
    table-layout: fixed;
  }

  .blog-post-content table th,
  .blog-post-content table td {
    padding: 0.7em 0.85em;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
    white-space: normal;
    word-break: break-word;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     LINKS — larger hit area for touch
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .blog-post-content a,
  .about-content a {
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
    text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px;
    padding: 2px 0;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     FIGURES & CAPTIONS
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  figure {
    margin-block: 1.5em;
  }

  figcaption {
    margin-top: 0.6em;
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
    text-align: center;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     HORIZONTAL RULES — bigger spacing
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  hr {
    margin: 2em 0;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     STRONG & EMPHASIS — better mobile legibility
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  strong,
  b {
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  em,
  i {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SMALL TEXT — meta, eyebrow, section-index
     Increase from 11-12px to 13-14px for readability
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .meta,
  .eyebrow,
  .section-index,
  .badge {
    font-size: 0.8125rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }

  .eyebrow {
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .eyebrow::before {
    width: 20px;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     BLOG POST CONTENT — reading mode
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .blog-post-content {
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.85;
    max-width: 100%;
    color: var(--ink-2);
  }

  .blog-post-content > p {
    margin-bottom: 1.15em;
  }

  .blog-post-content h2 {
    margin-top: 2em;
    margin-bottom: 0.65em;
    padding-bottom: 0.4em;
  }

  .blog-post-content h3 {
    margin-top: 1.6em;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ARTICLE HEADER — adjusted for mobile
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .blog-post-header h1 {
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 6.5vw, 2rem);
    line-height: 1.25;
    margin-bottom: 0.75em;
  }

  .blog-post-excerpt {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 1em;
  }

  .blog-post-meta {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    margin-bottom: 1em;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     HERO TITLE — tighter control on mobile
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .hero-title {
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  }

  .hero-description {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     ABOUT CONTENT
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .about-lead {
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-top: 1.4em;
  }

  .about-content > p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.85;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     SERVICE PREVIEW
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .service-preview-content p {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  .service-feature {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     FAQ — bigger reading size
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  .faq-question {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .faq-answer-inner p {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.85;
  }

  /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     PREVENT TEXT OVERFLOW
     Long URLs, emails, identifiers must not break the layout
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
  * {
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
  }

  a[href^="mailto:"],
  a[href^="tel:"],
  [data-long-text] {
    word-break: break-all;
    hyphens: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SMALL MOBILE (≤ 380px) — extra care for compact phones
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 380px) {
  html {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  body {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }

  h1 {
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 7.5vw, 1.875rem);
  }

  h2 {
    font-size: clamp(1.375rem, 6vw, 1.625rem);
  }

  h3 {
    font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 5vw, 1.375rem);
  }

  p {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  .blog-post-content {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 7.5vw, 1.875rem) !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TABLET (721px - 900px) — middle ground
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 721px) and (max-width: 900px) {
  p {
    max-width: 65ch;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  .blog-post-content {
    font-size: 1.0625rem;
    line-height: 1.85;
  }

  .blog-post-content p {
    max-width: 68ch;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PREVENT "WIDOW" WORDS in headings on mobile
   (single word on last line — looks bad on narrow screens)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  h1,
  h2,
  h3,
  .hero-title,
  .section-heading h2,
  .about-content h2,
  .why-header h2,
  .final-cta h2 {
    text-wrap: balance;
    max-width: 100%;
  }

  /* For paragraphs, "pretty" avoids widows in multi-line text */
  p,
  .body-lead,
  .hero-description {
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ACCESSIBILITY — increased legibility
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) and (prefers-contrast: more) {
  body {
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  p,
  li {
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  .blog-post-content {
    color: var(--ink);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   LANDSCAPE MOBILE — compact but readable
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px) and (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 500px) {
  html {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  h1 {
    font-size: 1.75rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5em;
  }

  h2 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }

  p {
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 0.85em;
  }

  .blog-post-content {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   MOTION SYSTEM — 2026 Global Standards
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - Physics-based easings (spring, bounce, anticipate)
   - Scroll-driven animations with @supports fallback
   - View Transitions API for route navigation
   - Every layer respects prefers-reduced-motion
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  /* ═══ DURATION SCALE — T-shirt sizing ═══ */
  --motion-instant:   80ms;
  --motion-fast:      160ms;
  --motion-base:      240ms;
  --motion-medium:    320ms;
  --motion-slow:      480ms;
  --motion-slower:    640ms;
  --motion-cinematic: 900ms;

  /* ═══ EASING CURVES ═══ */
  --motion-ease-out:        cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --motion-ease-in-out:     cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --motion-ease-emphasis:   cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --motion-ease-spring:     cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  --motion-ease-bounce:     cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55);
  --motion-ease-anticipate: cubic-bezier(0.36, 0, 0.66, -0.56);
  --motion-ease-sharp:      cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --motion-ease-cinematic:  cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);

  /* ═══ COMPOSITE PRESETS ═══ */
  --motion-button: var(--motion-fast) var(--motion-ease-out);
  --motion-card:   var(--motion-medium) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);
  --motion-modal:  var(--motion-medium) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);
  --motion-menu:   var(--motion-base) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);
  --motion-reveal: var(--motion-slow) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);

  /* ═══ DISTANCES ═══ */
  --motion-distance-xs: 4px;
  --motion-distance-sm: 8px;
  --motion-distance-md: 16px;
  --motion-distance-lg: 24px;
  --motion-distance-xl: 40px;

  /* ═══ BLUR VALUES ═══ */
  --motion-blur-sm: blur(2px);
  --motion-blur-md: blur(6px);
  --motion-blur-lg: blur(12px);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION — global safety net
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    scroll-behavior: auto !important;
  }

  .motion-slide-up,
  .motion-slide-down,
  .motion-scale-in,
  .motion-bounce-in {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   UTILITY ANIMATION CLASSES
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.motion-fade {
  animation: motionFadeIn var(--motion-reveal);
}

.motion-slide-up {
  animation: motionSlideUp var(--motion-reveal);
}

.motion-slide-down {
  animation: motionSlideDown var(--motion-reveal);
}

.motion-scale-in {
  animation: motionScaleIn var(--motion-modal);
}

.motion-bounce-in {
  animation: motionBounceIn var(--motion-slow) var(--motion-ease-bounce);
}

.motion-spin {
  animation: motionSpin 1s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes motionFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes motionSlideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(var(--motion-distance-md));
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes motionSlideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(calc(var(--motion-distance-md) * -1));
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes motionScaleIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.95);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes motionBounceIn {
  0%   { transform: scale(0.7); opacity: 0; }
  60%  { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

@keyframes motionSpin {
  from { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  to   { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SCROLL-DRIVEN ANIMATIONS
   Zero JavaScript. Runs on compositor thread.
   Guarded with @supports for progressive enhancement.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
  .scroll-fade-in {
    animation: scrollFadeIn linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 0% entry 60%;
  }

  .scroll-slide-up {
    animation: scrollSlideUp linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 0% entry 50%;
  }

  .scroll-slide-right {
    animation: scrollSlideRight linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 0% entry 50%;
  }

  .scroll-slide-left {
    animation: scrollSlideLeft linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 0% entry 50%;
  }

  .scroll-scale-in {
    animation: scrollScaleIn linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 10% entry 60%;
  }

  .scroll-blur-in {
    animation: scrollBlurIn linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 0% entry 60%;
  }

  .scroll-parallax {
    animation: scrollParallax linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: cover;
  }

  @keyframes scrollFadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to   { opacity: 1; }
  }

  @keyframes scrollSlideUp {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(var(--motion-distance-lg));
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes scrollSlideRight {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateX(calc(var(--motion-distance-lg) * -1));
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes scrollSlideLeft {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateX(var(--motion-distance-lg));
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes scrollScaleIn {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0.92);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: scale(1);
    }
  }

  @keyframes scrollBlurIn {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      filter: var(--motion-blur-md);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      filter: blur(0);
    }
  }

  @keyframes scrollParallax {
    from { transform: translateY(-2%); }
    to   { transform: translateY(2%); }
  }

  /* Staggered children — reveal each child with delay */
  .scroll-stagger > * {
    animation: scrollSlideUp linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 0% entry 50%;
  }

  .scroll-stagger > *:nth-child(1) { animation-range: entry 0% entry 40%; }
  .scroll-stagger > *:nth-child(2) { animation-range: entry 5% entry 45%; }
  .scroll-stagger > *:nth-child(3) { animation-range: entry 10% entry 50%; }
  .scroll-stagger > *:nth-child(4) { animation-range: entry 15% entry 55%; }
  .scroll-stagger > *:nth-child(5) { animation-range: entry 20% entry 60%; }
  .scroll-stagger > *:nth-child(6) { animation-range: entry 25% entry 65%; }
}

/* Fallback for browsers without scroll-driven support */
@supports not (animation-timeline: view()) {
  .scroll-fade-in,
  .scroll-slide-up,
  .scroll-slide-right,
  .scroll-slide-left,
  .scroll-scale-in,
  .scroll-blur-in,
  .scroll-stagger > * {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    filter: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   VIEW TRANSITIONS — smooth route navigation
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@view-transition {
  navigation: auto;
}

::view-transition-old(root) {
  animation: viewTransitionOut var(--motion-base) var(--motion-ease-out);
}

::view-transition-new(root) {
  animation: viewTransitionIn var(--motion-medium) var(--motion-ease-emphasis);
}

@keyframes viewTransitionOut {
  from { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  to   { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(0.98); }
}

@keyframes viewTransitionIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.98); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

/* Persistent elements across navigation */
.view-transition-persist-header {
  view-transition-name: header;
}

.view-transition-persist-footer {
  view-transition-name: footer;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  ::view-transition-old(root),
  ::view-transition-new(root) {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   NARRATIVE GLASS NAV — Infinite Debugged Edition
   ============================================================ */

.site-nav {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0 0 auto;
  z-index: 100;
  padding-block: 16px;
  transition: padding 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.site-nav .nav-inner {
  padding-inline: 10px !important;
}

/* ─── Unified Glass Pill ─── */
.site-nav .nav-pill {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 7px 7px 7px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 72%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #fff 68%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 90%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
    0 12px 28px -10px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.14);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  transition: all 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-pill {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 85%, transparent);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 78%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 95%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08),
    0 16px 40px -14px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.22),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .nav-pill {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 78%, transparent);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 10%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
    0 12px 28px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

/* ─── Brand ─── */
.site-nav .brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding: 3px 6px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: background-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.site-nav .brand:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent); }

.site-nav .brand-mark-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.site-nav .brand-mark-wrap::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -2px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent) 0%, transparent 70%);
  opacity: 0;
  filter: blur(6px);
  transition: opacity 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.site-nav .brand:hover .brand-mark-wrap::before { opacity: 1; }

.site-nav .brand-logo {
  width: 34px !important;
  height: 34px !important;
  border-radius: 10px !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06) !important;
  transition:
    transform 480ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 480ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}
.site-nav .brand:hover .brand-logo {
  transform: scale(1.08) rotate(-3deg) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22),
    0 6px 16px -3px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.55),
    0 0 0 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.55) !important;
}

.site-nav .brand-text { display: grid; gap: 0; }
.site-nav .brand-text strong {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.site-nav .brand-text small {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  line-height: 1.2;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ─── Desktop Nav ─── */
.site-nav .desktop-nav {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 0;
}

.site-nav .desktop-nav-list {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 4px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 55%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
}

/* ─── Sliding Indicator + Pulse ─── */
.site-nav .desktop-nav-slider {
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  bottom: 4px;
  inset-inline-start: 4px;
  width: calc((100% - 8px) / var(--nav-total, 5) - 2px);
  border-radius: 999px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  transform: translate3d(
    calc(-100% * var(--nav-index, 0) - var(--nav-index, 0) * 2px),
    0,
    0
  );
  transition: transform 620ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.15, 0.4, 1);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ec4c4 0%, #0a5c60 40%, #0d7377 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35),
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.5),
    0 4px 16px -4px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.35);
}

.site-nav .desktop-nav-slider-pulse {
  position: absolute;
  inset: -4px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.45) 0%, transparent 70%);
  filter: blur(10px);
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: navPulse 3.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes navPulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.08); }
}

/* ─── Nav Item ─── */
.site-nav .desktop-nav-item {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.site-nav .desktop-nav-item:hover { color: var(--ink); }
.site-nav .desktop-nav-item.is-active { color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }

.site-nav .desktop-nav-item:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Icon */
.site-nav .desktop-nav-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  transition:
    transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    filter 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.site-nav .desktop-nav-icon svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

.site-nav .desktop-nav-item:hover .desktop-nav-icon {
  transform: scale(1.15) rotate(12deg);
}

.site-nav .desktop-nav-item.is-active .desktop-nav-icon {
  transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.12);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3));
}

/* ─── Preview Card ─── */
.site-nav .nav-preview {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 16px);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-6px);
  z-index: 10;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: navPreviewIn 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
}

@keyframes navPreviewIn {
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
  }
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-arrow {
  position: absolute;
  top: -6px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(45deg);
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, transparent);
  border-left: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #fff 65%, transparent);
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #fff 65%, transparent);
  border-radius: 2px 0 0 0;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  min-width: 340px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #fff 72%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 92%, transparent),
    0 4px 12px -4px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.1),
    0 24px 56px -16px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.24);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.6);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .nav-preview-inner {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 90%, transparent);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #fff 12%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 8%, transparent),
    0 4px 12px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    0 24px 56px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  padding: 6px;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-icon svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-title {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-desc {
  font-size: 11.5px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-stat {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  text-align: center;
  padding-inline-start: 14px;
  border-inline-start: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-stat strong {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--accent);
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.site-nav .nav-preview-stat span {
  font-size: 9.5px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

/* ─── Actions ─── */
.site-nav .nav-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.site-nav .nav-order-button {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  height: 38px;
  padding-inline: 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ec4c4 0%, #0a5c60 40%, #0d7377 70%, #0a5c60 100%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 -1.5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 4px 12px -4px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.55);
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.site-nav .nav-order-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48),
    0 8px 22px -6px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.65);
}

.site-nav .nav-order-shine {
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  left: -60%;
  width: 50%;
  height: 200%;
  background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 50%, transparent 100%);
  transform: skewX(-20deg);
  animation: navShine 5.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  pointer-events: none;
}
@keyframes navShine {
  0%, 62% { left: -60%; }
  82%, 100% { left: 150%; }
}

.site-nav .nav-order-arrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}
.site-nav .nav-order-button:hover .nav-order-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-3px);
}

/* ─── Theme Toggle ─── */
.site-nav .theme-toggle {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 38px;
  height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent);
  transition: all 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}
.site-nav .theme-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
}

/* ─── Staggered Entrance ─── */
@keyframes navItemIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); filter: blur(4px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); filter: blur(0); }
}

.site-nav .desktop-nav-item {
  animation: navItemIn 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--nav-i, 0) * 60ms + 200ms);
}

.site-nav .brand {
  animation: navItemIn 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 100ms both;
}

.site-nav .nav-actions {
  animation: navItemIn 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 550ms both;
}

/* ─── Responsive ─── */
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .site-nav .nav-preview { display: none; }
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .site-nav .brand-text small { display: none; }
}

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
  .site-nav .desktop-nav { display: none; }
  .site-nav .nav-pill { justify-content: space-between; }
  .site-nav .brand { flex: 1; }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .site-nav { padding-block: 12px; }
  .site-nav .nav-pill { padding: 5px 5px 5px 10px; gap: 4px; }
  .site-nav .brand-text { display: none; }
  .site-nav .nav-order-button { height: 34px; padding-inline: 14px; font-size: 11.5px; }
  .site-nav .theme-toggle { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
}

/* ─── Reduced Motion ─── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .site-nav,
  .site-nav .nav-pill,
  .site-nav .desktop-nav-slider,
  .site-nav .desktop-nav-slider-pulse,
  .site-nav .desktop-nav-item,
  .site-nav .desktop-nav-icon,
  .site-nav .brand-logo,
  .site-nav .nav-order-button,
  .site-nav .nav-order-arrow,
  .site-nav .nav-order-shine,
  .site-nav .nav-preview,
  .site-nav .nav-preview-inner {
    transition: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
  .site-nav .desktop-nav-item:hover .desktop-nav-icon {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
```
