## FILE: src\styles\newsletter.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   NEWSLETTER — Editorial Lead Capture
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Beautiful, minimal, Persian-native.
   Amber accent glow, glassy card, zero spam vibes.
   ============================================================ */

.newsletter-section {
  position: relative;
}

.newsletter-card {
  position: relative;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding: clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px) clamp(28px, 5vw, 56px);
  border-radius: 28px;
  text-align: center;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      155deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 85%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 65%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, var(--line));
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 32px 80px -32px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.14);
}

/* ─── Ambient corner glow ─── */
.newsletter-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -30%;
  inset-inline-end: -20%;
  width: 60%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ─── Eyebrow ─── */
.newsletter-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.6875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
  position: relative;
}

/* ─── Title ─── */
.newsletter-title {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  font-size: clamp(1.625rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
  position: relative;
}

.newsletter-title em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ─── Body text ─── */
.newsletter-text {
  max-width: 480px;
  margin: 0 auto 36px;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
  position: relative;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FORM
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.newsletter-form {
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 520px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  position: relative;
}

.newsletter-input-wrap {
  flex: 1;
  position: relative;
}

.newsletter-input-wrap input {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 56px;
  padding: 0 20px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 70%, transparent);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  direction: ltr;
  text-align: left;
  outline: none;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
  transition:
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.newsletter-input-wrap input::placeholder {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.newsletter-input-wrap input:hover:not(:focus):not(:disabled) {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.newsletter-input-wrap input:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--paper);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint),
    0 8px 24px -8px var(--accent-glow);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.newsletter-input-wrap input:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.newsletter-input-wrap input[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 55%, var(--line));
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SUBMIT BUTTON
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.newsletter-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 56px;
  padding-inline: 28px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.005em;
  color: #fff9f4;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #0a0908 0%, #211c18 55%, #0a0908 100%);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25),
    0 8px 24px -10px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.42);
  transition:
    transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.newsletter-btn::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  transition: opacity 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.newsletter-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18),
    0 16px 40px -12px var(--accent-glow),
    0 6px 16px -6px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.24);
}

.newsletter-btn:hover:not(:disabled)::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.newsletter-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.985);
}

.newsletter-btn:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.newsletter-btn > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  display: inline-flex;
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.newsletter-btn:hover:not(:disabled) > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .newsletter-btn {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  color: #fff;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .newsletter-btn::before {
  display: none;
}

/* ─── Spinner ─── */
.newsletter-btn-spinner {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  border-top-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: newsletter-spin 0.7s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes newsletter-spin {
  to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SUCCESS STATE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.newsletter-success {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 18px 24px;
  border-radius: 16px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 8%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 25%, transparent);
  text-align: start;
  animation: newsletter-success-in 480ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
  position: relative;
}

.newsletter-success-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--success);
  color: #fff;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 50%, transparent);
}

.newsletter-success-icon svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
}

.newsletter-success-text {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.newsletter-success-text strong {
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.newsletter-success-text span {
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

@keyframes newsletter-success-in {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.92) translateY(8px);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ERROR & HINT
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.newsletter-error {
  margin: 14px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--danger);
  text-align: center;
  animation: newsletter-error-in 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

@keyframes newsletter-error-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-4px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

.newsletter-hint {
  margin: 18px 0 0;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.85;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .newsletter-card {
    padding: 32px 22px;
    border-radius: 20px;
  }

  .newsletter-eyebrow {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-size: 0.625rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  }

  .newsletter-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.375rem, 7vw, 1.75rem);
    line-height: 1.25;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .newsletter-text {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
    margin-bottom: 26px;
  }

  .newsletter-form {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .newsletter-input-wrap input,
  .newsletter-btn {
    min-height: 54px;
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .newsletter-input-wrap input {
    font-size: 16px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .newsletter-btn {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .newsletter-success {
    padding: 16px 18px;
    flex-direction: row;
    text-align: start;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 340px;
  }

  .newsletter-success-text strong {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }

  .newsletter-success-text span {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }

  .newsletter-hint {
    font-size: 0.6875rem;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .newsletter-input-wrap input,
  .newsletter-btn,
  .newsletter-btn::before,
  .newsletter-btn-spinner,
  .newsletter-success,
  .newsletter-error {
    transition: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .newsletter-btn:hover:not(:disabled),
  .newsletter-btn:hover:not(:disabled) > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
```


## FILE: src\styles\order-form-v2.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   ORDER FORM v4 — 2026 Redesign
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Scoped under .oform — no conflicts with legacy CSS
   - Non-clickable step indicators
   - Desktop 2-column grids for short fields
   - Mobile 3-step wizard
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BASE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform {
  --f-field-h: 54px;
  --f-field-radius: 14px;
  --f-gap: 18px;
  --f-pad: 24px;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent) inset,
    0 24px 60px -24px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.14);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .oform {
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) inset,
    0 24px 60px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PROGRESS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-progress {
  position: relative;
  padding: 22px var(--f-pad) 18px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--paper-2) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 55%, var(--surface)) 100%
  );
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.oform-progress-track {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  inset-inline: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line-strong) 25%, transparent);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.oform-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-2), var(--accent));
  transition: width 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  will-change: width;
}

.oform-progress-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.oform-progress-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 1px;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
}

.oform-progress-badge-unit {
  font-size: 10px;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.oform-progress-label {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   STEP PILLS (mobile only) — NON-CLICKABLE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-progress-steps {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  pointer-events: none; /* disable all interactions */
  user-select: none;
}

.oform-progress-steps::-webkit-scrollbar {
  display: none;
}

.oform-step-pill {
  flex: 1 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.oform-step-pill-num {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line-strong) 20%, transparent);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  transition:
    background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.oform-step-pill.is-done {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, var(--line));
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--ink-2));
}

.oform-step-pill.is-done .oform-step-pill-num {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.oform-step-pill.is-active {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -6px var(--accent-glow);
}

.oform-step-pill.is-active .oform-step-pill-num {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  color: #fff;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DRAFT NOTICE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-draft {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px var(--f-pad);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent);
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.oform-draft-text {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.oform-draft-text::before {
  content: "↻";
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.oform-draft-clear {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.oform-draft-clear:hover {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   STEP / SECTION HEADINGS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-step,
.oform-section {
  padding: 28px var(--f-pad) 24px;
}

.oform-section + .oform-section {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.oform-step-head,
.oform-section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.oform-step-num {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.oform-step-head-text {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.oform-step-title {
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.oform-step-subtitle {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   STEP BODY
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-step-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--f-gap);
}

/* 2-column grid for short fields */
.oform-fields-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: var(--f-gap);
}

/* Fields that shouldn't stretch in the 2-column grid */
.oform-fields-2 .oform-field {
  min-width: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FIELDS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  min-width: 0;
}

.oform-label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.oform-label-text {
  display: inline;
}

.oform-req {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.oform-input-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
}

.oform-input-wrap input,
.oform-input-wrap textarea {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0 16px;
  min-height: var(--f-field-h);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--f-field-radius);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  outline: none;
  transition:
    border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
}

.oform-input-wrap textarea {
  padding: 14px 16px;
  min-height: 130px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  resize: vertical;
}

.oform-input-wrap input:hover,
.oform-input-wrap textarea:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.oform-input-wrap input:focus,
.oform-input-wrap textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--paper);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint);
}

.oform-input-wrap input:disabled {
  opacity: 0.45;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.oform-input-wrap input::placeholder,
.oform-input-wrap textarea::placeholder {
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  opacity: 1;
}

/* ─── Field icons ─── */
.oform-icon {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  inset-inline-end: 16px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
  animation: oformIconIn 300ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.oform-icon svg {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  stroke-width: 3;
}

.oform-icon--top {
  top: 22px;
  transform: none;
}

.oform-field[data-state="success"] input,
.oform-field[data-state="success"] textarea {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 50%, var(--line));
  padding-inline-end: 48px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--surface) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 95%, var(--success)) 100%
  );
}

.oform-field[data-state="success"] .oform-icon {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 14%, transparent);
  color: var(--success);
}

.oform-field[data-state="error"] input,
.oform-field[data-state="error"] textarea {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 55%, var(--line));
  padding-inline-end: 48px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--surface) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, var(--danger)) 100%
  );
  animation: oformShake 340ms cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97);
}

.oform-field[data-state="error"] .oform-icon {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 12%, transparent);
  color: var(--danger);
}

.oform-field[data-state="error"] .oform-icon svg {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  stroke-width: 2.5;
}

@keyframes oformIconIn {
  0% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.4);
  }
  60% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.15);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes oformShake {
  0%,
  100% {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  25% {
    transform: translateX(-5px);
  }
  75% {
    transform: translateX(5px);
  }
}

/* ─── Hints ─── */
.oform-hint {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.oform-meta-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 6px;
}

.oform-counter {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.oform-counter.is-near {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.oform-counter.is-over {
  color: var(--danger);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CHECKBOX
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-check {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  border: 1.5px dashed var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--f-field-radius);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  min-height: var(--f-field-h);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.oform-check input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.oform-check-box {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: transparent;
  transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.oform-check-box svg {
  width: 12px;
  height: 12px;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 200ms;
}

.oform-check input:checked ~ .oform-check-box {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
}

.oform-check input:checked ~ .oform-check-box svg {
  opacity: 1;
}

.oform-check:has(input:checked) {
  border-style: solid;
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

.oform-check input:focus-visible ~ .oform-check-box {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.oform-check-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   OPTIONS GRID (project types)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-fieldset {
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 10px;
}

.oform-fieldset legend {
  padding: 0;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.oform-options {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.oform-option {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  min-height: 50px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--surface);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  min-width: 0;
}

.oform-option input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.oform-option-check {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: transparent;
  transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.oform-option-check svg {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 200ms;
}

.oform-option-label {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-align: start;
}

.oform-option:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.oform-option.is-active {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

.oform-option.is-active .oform-option-check {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
}

.oform-option.is-active .oform-option-check svg {
  opacity: 1;
}

.oform-option.is-active .oform-option-label {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.oform-option input:focus-visible ~ .oform-option-check {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CONTACT METHODS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-contacts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}

.oform-contact {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 8px;
  min-height: 72px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--surface);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.oform-contact input {
  position: absolute;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.oform-contact-radio {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface);
  transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.oform-contact-radio::after {
  content: "";
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  transform: scale(0);
  transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.oform-contact-label {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.oform-contact:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.oform-contact.is-active {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

.oform-contact.is-active .oform-contact-radio {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
}

.oform-contact.is-active .oform-contact-radio::after {
  transform: scale(1);
}

.oform-contact.is-active .oform-contact-label {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.oform-contact input:focus-visible ~ .oform-contact-radio {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SUMMARY
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-summary {
  margin-top: 4px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.oform-summary-title {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.oform-summary-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.oform-summary-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
}

.oform-summary-list span {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.oform-summary-list strong {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: end;
  word-break: break-word;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ERROR BANNER
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-error {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 14px var(--f-pad);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent);
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 20%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 20%, transparent);
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--danger);
  line-height: 1.5;
  animation: oformErrorIn 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.oform-error-icon {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--danger);
  color: #fff;
  margin-top: 1px;
}

.oform-error-icon svg {
  width: 11px;
  height: 11px;
}

@keyframes oformErrorIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-4px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ACTIONS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 20px var(--f-pad);
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.oform-actions--desktop {
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.oform-actions-note {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  line-height: 1.5;
  max-width: 320px;
}

.oform-actions--sticky {
  position: sticky;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 30;
  padding-bottom: calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BUTTONS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform-btn {
  flex: 1;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 54px;
  padding: 0 22px;
  border: 1.5px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 14px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.005em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.oform-btn svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.oform-btn--primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.05),
    0 8px 24px -10px var(--accent-glow);
}

.oform-btn--primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--accent-2);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.05),
    0 14px 32px -10px var(--accent-glow);
}

.oform-btn--primary:hover:not(:disabled) svg:last-child {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
}

.oform-btn--ghost {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  border-color: var(--line);
}

.oform-btn--ghost:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--paper);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.oform-btn--ghost:hover:not(:disabled) svg {
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

.oform-btn--lg {
  min-height: 58px;
  padding: 0 30px;
  font-size: 15px;
}

.oform-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98);
}

.oform-btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.oform-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* Honeypot */
.oform-honeypot {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px !important;
  height: 1px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: -1px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SUCCESS STATE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.oform--success {
  padding: 0;
}

.oform-success-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 56px 32px 44px;
}

.oform-success-icon {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 76px;
  height: 76px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent);
  animation: oformSuccessPop 700ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.oform-success-icon svg {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  stroke-width: 3;
}

@keyframes oformSuccessPop {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.5) rotate(-15deg);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  60% {
    transform: scale(1.1) rotate(3deg);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1) rotate(0);
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

.oform-success-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.oform-success-title {
  margin: 0 0 14px;
  font-size: clamp(22px, 4vw, 28px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.oform-success-text {
  max-width: 380px;
  margin: 0 0 28px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.oform-success-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 420px;
}

.oform-success-actions .oform-btn {
  flex: 1 0 180px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ─── Tablet ─── */
@media (min-width: 721px) and (max-width: 900px) {
  .oform {
    --f-pad: 28px;
    --f-gap: 20px;
    max-width: 100%;
    margin-inline: 16px;
  }

  .oform-options {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

/* ─── Desktop ─── */
@media (min-width: 901px) {
  .oform {
    --f-pad: 40px;
    --f-gap: 22px;
    max-width: 780px;
    border-radius: 28px;
  }

  .oform-progress {
    padding: 26px var(--f-pad) 22px;
  }

  .oform-section {
    padding: 40px var(--f-pad) 36px;
  }

  .oform-step-num {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .oform-step-title {
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .oform-step-subtitle {
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .oform-options {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .oform-actions {
    padding: 24px var(--f-pad);
  }

  /* At desktop, the last section is "روش تماس" — make it look distinct */
  .oform-section:last-child {
    background: linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 40%, var(--surface)) 100%
    );
  }
}

/* ─── Mobile ─── */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .oform {
    --f-pad: 18px;
    --f-gap: 16px;
    --f-field-h: 54px;
    max-width: 100%;
    margin-inline: 0;
    border-radius: 18px;
  }

  .oform-progress {
    padding: 16px var(--f-pad) 14px;
  }

  .oform-step {
    padding: 22px var(--f-pad) 18px;
  }

  .oform-step-head {
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
  }

  .oform-step-num {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .oform-step-title {
    font-size: 17px;
  }

  .oform-step-subtitle {
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  /* Fields single-column on mobile */
  .oform-fields-2 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--f-gap);
  }

  .oform-label {
    font-size: 12.5px;
  }

  .oform-input-wrap input,
  .oform-input-wrap textarea {
    font-size: 16px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .oform-icon {
    inset-inline-end: 14px;
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
  }

  .oform-icon--top {
    top: 20px;
  }

  .oform-options {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .oform-option {
    min-height: 48px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border-radius: 11px;
  }

  .oform-option-label {
    font-size: 13.5px;
  }

  .oform-contacts {
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .oform-contact {
    min-height: 68px;
    padding: 10px 6px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .oform-contact-label {
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .oform-actions {
    padding: 14px var(--f-pad);
  }

  .oform-btn {
    min-height: 52px;
    font-size: 14.5px;
    border-radius: 13px;
  }

  .oform-btn--ghost {
    flex: 0 0 100px;
  }

  .oform-summary {
    padding: 14px 16px;
  }

  .oform-summary-list {
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .oform-summary-list li {
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .oform-success-card {
    padding: 44px 24px 36px;
  }

  .oform-success-icon {
    width: 68px;
    height: 68px;
  }

  .oform-success-icon svg {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
  }

  .oform-success-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .oform-success-actions .oform-btn {
    flex: 1;
    width: 100%;
  }
}

/* ─── Small mobile ─── */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .oform {
    --f-pad: 14px;
    --f-gap: 14px;
  }

  .oform-step-title {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .oform-btn {
    padding: 0 16px;
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .oform-btn--ghost {
    flex: 0 0 88px;
  }

  .oform-step-pill {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .oform-step-pill-num {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    font-size: 9px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .oform-icon,
  .oform-field[data-state="error"] input,
  .oform-field[data-state="error"] textarea,
  .oform-success-icon,
  .oform-error {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .oform-btn,
  .oform-progress-fill,
  .oform-step-pill {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   ORDER PREMIUM — Infinite Edition
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Visual upgrade layer for the order form.
   Loaded AFTER order-form-v2.css so it wins the cascade.
   No component changes needed — pure CSS transformation.
   All animations GPU-composited. Full dark mode.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. AURORA BACKGROUND — behind the entire order page
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.order-page::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 5%;
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 90vw;
  height: 90vw;
  max-width: 900px;
  max-height: 900px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 3%, transparent) 30%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  filter: blur(60px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .order-page::before {
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 30%,
    transparent 65%
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. HEADER — premium editorial
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .order-header {
  position: relative;
}

.order-page .order-header .section-index {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  padding: 8px 16px 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.3);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
}

.order-page .order-header .section-index::before {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint),
    0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
}

.order-page .order-header h1 {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--ink) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 75%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
}

.order-page .order-header h1 span {
  -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. FORM SHELL — 6-layer premium glass
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 28px !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  overflow: hidden;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 95%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    inset -1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent),
    0 20px 48px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 18%, transparent),
    0 48px 100px -32px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 28%, transparent) !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .order-page .oform {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 95%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 85%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    inset 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04),
    0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    0 20px 48px -16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
    0 48px 100px -32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
}

/* Top specular light streak */
.order-page .oform::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 14%;
  right: 14%;
  height: 1.5px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    color-mix(in srgb, #fff 100%, transparent) 25%,
    color-mix(in srgb, #fff 100%, transparent) 75%,
    transparent
  );
  border-radius: 2px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 10;
  filter: blur(0.5px);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .order-page .oform::before {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 25%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 75%,
    transparent
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. PROGRESS BAR — premium glow
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-progress {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 100%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, var(--surface)) 100%
    ) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-progress-track {
  height: 3.5px !important;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-progress-fill {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent-2) 0%,
    var(--accent) 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 12px -1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 65%, transparent),
    0 0 24px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) !important;
  transition: width 640ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.15, 0.4, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-progress-badge {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 100%
  ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. STEP PILLS (mobile) — premium
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-step-pill {
  padding: 9px 14px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03) !important;
  transition:
    background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-step-pill-num {
  width: 20px !important;
  height: 20px !important;
  font-size: 10px !important;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-step-pill.is-active {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 70%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  ) !important;
  border-color: transparent !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 1px 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.3),
    0 8px 22px -6px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.55) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-step-pill.is-active .oform-step-pill-num {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
}

.order-page .oform-step-pill.is-done {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent) !important;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 85%, var(--ink)) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-step-pill.is-done .oform-step-pill-num {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. STEP HEADINGS — premium
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-step-num {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 100%
  ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-step-title {
  letter-spacing: -0.015em !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. FIELDS — premium focus & validation states
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-input-wrap input,
.order-page .oform-input-wrap textarea {
  border-width: 1.5px !important;
  transition:
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-input-wrap input:hover:not(:focus),
.order-page .oform-input-wrap textarea:hover:not(:focus) {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 20%, transparent) !important;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 100%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-input-wrap input:focus,
.order-page .oform-input-wrap textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, var(--accent)) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* Success state */
.order-page .oform-field[data-state="success"] input,
.order-page .oform-field[data-state="success"] textarea {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 55%, var(--line)) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 92%, var(--success)) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 10%, transparent) !important;
}

/* Error state */
.order-page .oform-field[data-state="error"] input,
.order-page .oform-field[data-state="error"] textarea {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 55%, var(--line)) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      var(--surface) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 94%, var(--danger)) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 10%, transparent) !important;
}

/* Field icons — bigger pulse */
.order-page .oform-icon {
  width: 24px !important;
  height: 24px !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 30%, transparent),

}

.order-page .oform-field[data-state="success"] .oform-icon {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success) 16%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--success) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-field[data-state="error"] .oform-icon {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 14%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--danger) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. LABELS — refined
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-label {
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em !important;
  transition: color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-field:has(input:focus) .oform-label,
.order-page .oform-field:has(textarea:focus) .oform-label {
  color: var(--accent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-req {
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  line-height: 1 !important;
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-field:has(input:focus) .oform-req,
.order-page .oform-field:has(textarea:focus) .oform-req {
  transform: scale(1.2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. CHECKBOX — premium
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-check {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 60%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 45%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 18%, transparent) !important;
  transition:
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-check:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.order-page .oform-check:has(input:checked) {
  border-style: solid !important;
  border-color: var(--accent) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent),
    0 8px 24px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-check-box {
  width: 24px !important;
  height: 24px !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  border-width: 1.8px !important;
}

.order-page .oform-check input:checked ~ .oform-check-box {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ec4c4 0%, #0d7377 100%) !important;
  border-color: transparent !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. OPTION CARDS — premium
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-option {
  border-width: 1.5px !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  transition:
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-option:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 6px 18px -6px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-option.is-active {
  border-color: var(--accent) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-option-check {
  width: 22px !important;
  height: 22px !important;
  border-radius: 7px !important;
  border-width: 1.8px !important;
  transition:
    background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-option.is-active .oform-option-check {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ec4c4 0%, #0d7377 100%) !important;
  border-color: transparent !important;
  transform: scale(1.08);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-option.is-active .oform-option-label {
  color: var(--ink) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   11. CONTACT METHODS — premium
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-contact {
  border-width: 1.5px !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 55%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  transition:
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-contact:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.order-page .oform-contact.is-active {
  border-color: var(--accent) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-contact-radio {
  width: 22px !important;
  height: 22px !important;
  border-width: 1.8px !important;
}

.order-page .oform-contact.is-active .oform-contact-radio {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ec4c4 0%, #0d7377 100%) !important;
  border-color: transparent !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-contact.is-active .oform-contact-label {
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   12. SUMMARY CARD — premium
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-summary {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 40%, var(--surface)) 100%
    ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03) !important;
  border-radius: 16px !important;
}

.order-page .oform-summary-list strong {
  color: var(--ink) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   13. SUBMIT BUTTON — premium gradient + shine
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-btn--primary {
  position: relative !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  isolation: isolate !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 70%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45),
    inset 0 -1.5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22),
    0 1px 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.3),
    0 8px 22px -6px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.55),
    0 20px 48px -14px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.45) !important;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-btn--primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5),
    0 1px 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.3),
    0 14px 32px -8px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.68),
    0 28px 60px -18px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.55) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-btn--primary:active:not(:disabled) {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98) !important;
}

/* Shine sweep */
.order-page .oform-btn--primary::before {
  content: "" !important;
  position: absolute !important;
  top: -50% !important;
  left: -60% !important;
  width: 50% !important;
  height: 200% !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    100deg,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  ) !important;
  transform: skewX(-20deg) !important;
  animation: oformShine 5.5s ease-in-out infinite !important;
  pointer-events: none !important;
  z-index: 1 !important;
  opacity: 0 !important;
  inset: unset !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  transition: none !important;
}

.order-page .oform-btn--primary:hover:not(:disabled)::before {
  opacity: 1 !important;
  animation: oformShineHover 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
}

@keyframes oformShineHover {
  0% { left: -60%; }
  100% { left: 160%; }
}

.order-page .oform-btn--primary svg {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   14. GHOST BUTTON — refined
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-btn--ghost {
  border-width: 1.5px !important;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 75%, transparent) !important;
  transition:
    background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1) !important;
}

.order-page .oform-btn--ghost:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) !important;
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   15. ERROR BANNER — refined
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-error {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 10%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 6%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 25%, transparent) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 25%, transparent) !important;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 95%, var(--ink)) !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
}

.order-page .oform-error-icon {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 60%, transparent) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   16. SUCCESS STATE — cinematic
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .oform-success-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.order-page .oform-success-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 120%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 60%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

.order-page .oform-success-card > * {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.order-page .oform-success-icon {
  width: 88px !important;
  height: 88px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 100%
  ) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  border: 1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent),
    0 0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent),
    0 20px 48px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) !important;
  animation:
    oformSuccessPop 700ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    oformSuccessPulse 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) 800ms infinite !important;
}

@keyframes oformSuccessPulse {
  0%, 100% {
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
      0 0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent),
      0 0 0 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent),
      0 20px 48px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent);
  }
  50% {
    box-shadow:
      inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
      0 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent),
      0 0 0 28px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent),
      0 24px 56px -12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
  }
}

.order-page .oform-success-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 14px !important;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.order-page .oform-success-title {
  letter-spacing: -0.025em !important;
}

/* Success buttons */
.order-page .oform-success-actions .oform-btn--primary {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 70%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  ) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   17. SECTIONS — desktop spacing refinement
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 901px) {
  .order-page .oform-section {
    position: relative;
  }

  .order-page .oform-section::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 15%;
    bottom: 0;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      transparent,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent) 50%,
      transparent
    );
  }

  .order-page .oform-section:last-child::after {
    display: none;
  }

  .order-page .oform-section-head {
    gap: 16px !important;
    margin-bottom: 28px !important;
  }

  .order-page .oform-step-num {
    width: 44px !important;
    height: 44px !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    font-weight: 800 !important;
  }

  .order-page .oform-step-title {
    font-size: 22px !important;
  }

  .order-page .oform-step-subtitle {
    font-size: 14px !important;
    line-height: 1.7 !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   18. REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .order-page .oform-input-wrap input:focus,
  .order-page .oform-input-wrap textarea:focus,
  .order-page .oform-check:hover,
  .order-page .oform-option:hover,
  .order-page .oform-option.is-active,
  .order-page .oform-contact:hover,
  .order-page .oform-contact.is-active,
  .order-page .oform-btn--primary:hover,
  .order-page .oform-btn--ghost:hover,
  .order-page .oform-step-pill.is-active {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .order-page .oform-btn--primary::before,
  .order-page .oform-success-icon {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   19. MOBILE — kill hover states, keep touch feedback
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px), (hover: none) {
  .order-page .oform-option:hover,
  .order-page .oform-contact:hover,
  .order-page .oform-check:hover,
  .order-page .oform-input-wrap input:hover:not(:focus),
  .order-page .oform-input-wrap textarea:hover:not(:focus) {
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .order-page .oform-option:active,
  .order-page .oform-contact:active,
  .order-page .oform-check:active {
    transform: scale(0.98) !important;
  }
}
```
