```css
/* ============================================================
   PAGES — Order page, Order form, Success state, 404
   (Extracted from globals.css sections 27-30, unchanged)
   ============================================================ */

/* ============================================================
   27. Order page
   ============================================================ */
.order-page {
  min-height: 100svh;
  padding-block: clamp(120px, 14vw, 160px) 100px;
}

.order-header {
  max-width: 820px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
}

.order-back {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--surface);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  transition:
    color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.order-back:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
}

.order-header h1 {
  margin-top: 18px;
  font-size: var(--fs-h1);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.05;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.order-header h1 span {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.order-header p {
  max-width: 580px;
  margin-top: 24px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.9;
}

/* ============================================================
   28. Order form
   ============================================================ */
.order-form {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1px;
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: var(--line);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.form-section {
  padding: clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
  background: var(--glass);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .form-section {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

.form-section-heading {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}

.form-section-heading > span {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--accent);
  padding-top: 6px;
}

.form-section-heading h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.form-section-heading p {
  margin-top: 6px;
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.form-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.form-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
}

.form-field-full {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
}

.form-field > span,
.form-fieldset legend {
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.form-field b,
.form-fieldset b {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.form-field input,
.form-field textarea {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  padding: 14px 16px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  outline: none;
  transition:
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.form-field input {
  min-height: 50px;
}

.form-field textarea {
  min-height: 150px;
  resize: vertical;
  line-height: 1.85;
}

.form-field input:focus,
.form-field textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--paper);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint);
}

.form-field input:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

.form-fieldset {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
}

.project-type-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.project-type-option,
.contact-method {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 52px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  transition:
    border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out),
    box-shadow var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}

.project-type-option:hover,
.contact-method:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.project-type-option.is-selected,
.contact-method.is-selected {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-tint);
}

.project-type-option input,
.contact-method input,
.form-checkbox input {
  accent-color: var(--accent);
}

.form-checkbox {
  display: flex;
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 44px;
}

.form-checkbox span {
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
}

.contact-methods {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 12px;
}

.contact-method {
  min-width: 120px;
}

.form-honeypot {
  position: absolute !important;
  width: 1px !important;
  height: 1px !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: -1px !important;
  overflow: hidden !important;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0) !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}

.form-message {
  padding: 16px 24px;
  background: var(--surface);
  font-size: var(--fs-small);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.form-message-error {
  color: var(--danger);
}

.form-submit-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: 24px clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
  background: var(--surface);
}

.form-submit-row p {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-micro);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

/* ============================================================
   29. Success state
   ============================================================ */
.order-success {
  padding: clamp(48px, 8vw, 80px) clamp(24px, 5vw, 60px);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: var(--glass);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  text-align: center;
}

.order-success-icon {
  display: grid;
  width: 76px;
  height: 76px;
  margin-inline: auto;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 30px;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  animation: successPulse 1.4s var(--ease-out);
}

@keyframes successPulse {
  0% { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0; }
  60% { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}

.order-success h2 {
  margin: 16px 0 12px;
  font-size: var(--fs-h2);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.order-success p {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin: 0 auto 32px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.9;
}

/* ============================================================
   30. 404
   ============================================================ */
.not-found-page {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 100svh;
  align-items: center;
  padding-block: 120px 60px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.not-found-page::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 40%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 80vw;
  height: 80vw;
  max-width: 900px;
  max-height: 900px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--accent-glow) 0%, transparent 62%);
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.not-found-page .container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.not-found-content {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-height: calc(100svh - 180px);
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: var(--glass-strong);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .not-found-content {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
  }
}

.not-found-top,
.not-found-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 20px;
  padding: 24px 30px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  direction: ltr;
}

.not-found-top { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.not-found-bottom { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }

.not-found-center {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 60px 30px;
  text-align: center;
}

.not-found-center .section-index {
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.not-found-number {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: clamp(100px, 16vw, 190px);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 0.8;
  letter-spacing: -0.08em;
  color: var(--ink);
  direction: ltr;
}

.not-found-zero {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  width: clamp(100px, 14vw, 170px);
  height: clamp(100px, 14vw, 170px);
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, var(--accent-tint), transparent 65%);
}

.not-found-zero::before,
.not-found-zero::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 50%;
}

.not-found-zero::before { inset: 18%; }
.not-found-zero::after  { inset: -14%; opacity: 0.4; }

.not-found-zero-core {
  display: grid;
  width: 52%;
  height: 52%;
  place-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 40px);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.not-found-center h1 {
  margin-top: 18px;
  font-size: var(--fs-h1);
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.not-found-center h1 span {
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.not-found-center p {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin-top: 22px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 2;
}

.not-found-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 32px;
}

.not-found-actions .button {
  min-width: 180px;
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   PERCEIVED PERFORMANCE — Skeleton, Shimmer, Progressive
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - GPU-accelerated shimmer (transform only, no repaint)
   - Content-aware skeleton shapes
   - Smooth fade-in for progressive images
   - Respects prefers-reduced-motion
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SHIMMER KEYFRAME — runs on compositor thread
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@keyframes ppshimmer {
  0%   { transform: translateX(-100%); }
  100% { transform: translateX(100%); }
}

@keyframes ppshimmerRTL {
  0%   { transform: translateX(100%); }
  100% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
}

/* Base skeleton block */
.skeleton-block {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.skeleton-block::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  animation: ppshimmerRTL 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SMART IMAGE — progressive loading
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.smart-image-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.smart-image-skeleton {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  overflow: hidden;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.smart-image-skeleton::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  animation: ppshimmerRTL 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.smart-image {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  z-index: 2;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.smart-image.is-loaded {
  opacity: 1;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PORTFOLIO CARD SKELETON
   Mirrors the exact layout of the real card
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.portfolio-card-skeleton {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  height: 100%;
}

.pcs-chrome {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.pcs-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--line-strong);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.pcs-url {
  flex: 1;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--line-strong);
  margin-inline-start: 8px;
  max-width: 60%;
}

.pcs-canvas {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.pcs-canvas::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
  animation: ppshimmerRTL 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
  will-change: transform;
}

.pcs-caption {
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
}

.pcs-line {
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.pcs-line-sm { width: 30%; }
.pcs-line-md { width: 60%; }
.pcs-line-lg { width: 90%; height: 14px; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BLOG CARD SKELETON
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-card-skeleton {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 28px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  height: 100%;
}

.bcs-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.bcs-chip {
  width: 60px;

  border-radius: 5px;

}

.bcs-chip-sm { width: 40px; }

}

}

.bcs-footer {

  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  margin-top: auto;
}

.bcs-tag {
  width: 50px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BLOG POST SKELETON
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.blog-post-skeleton {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.bps-header {
  margin-bottom: 48px;
  padding-bottom: 40px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.bps-meta {
  width: 140px;
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--line);
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.bps-title {
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--line);
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  width: 90%;
}

.bps-excerpt {
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--line);
  width: 70%;
}

.bps-body {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

.bps-line {
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: var(--line);
  width: 100%;
}

.bps-line-short { width: 60%; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   DARK MODE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
[data-theme="dark"] .skeleton-block::after,
[data-theme="dark"] .smart-image-skeleton::after,
[data-theme="dark"] .pcs-canvas::after {
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06) 50%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .skeleton-block::after,
  .smart-image-skeleton::after,
  .pcs-canvas::after {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }

  .smart-image {
    transition: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MOBILE — compact skeleton padding
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .portfolio-card-skeleton {
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .pcs-chrome {
    padding: 10px 12px;
  }

  .pcs-caption {
    padding: 14px 16px;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .blog-card-skeleton {
    padding: 20px 18px;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .bcs-title {
    height: 18px;
  }

  .bps-title {
    height: 26px;
  }

  .bps-header {
    margin-bottom: 28px;
    padding-bottom: 22px;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   PERFORMANCE BOOST — Safe Edition
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Zero visual change. Mobile-scroll safe.
   
   REMOVED from v1 (caused mobile scroll lock):
   - overscroll-behavior-y: none on body  ❌ breaks iOS scroll
   - contain: layout style paint on sections  ❌ breaks iOS scroll
   
   KEPT (all safe):
   - content-visibility: auto on below-fold sections
   - Reduced Manuscript Grid layers
   - Reduced Hero Orbs blur
   - Pause animations off-screen + when tab hidden
   - will-change cleanup
   - Smoother-scroll hints
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. SECTION CONTAINMENT — skip rendering off-screen
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.services-section,
.process-section,
.portfolio-section,
.about-section,
.why-section,
.testimonials-section,
.latest-blog-section,
.newsletter-section,
.faq-section,
.final-cta-section {
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 800px;
}

.site-footer {
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 600px;
}

.hero-section {
  content-visibility: visible;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. MANUSCRIPT GRID — reduce from 7 layers to 1 (desktop only)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 1025px) {
  body {
    background-image:
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        45deg,
        transparent 0,
        transparent 27px,
        rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.08) 27px,
        rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.08) 28px
      ),
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        -45deg,
        transparent 0,
        transparent 27px,
        rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.08) 27px,
        rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.08) 28px
      ) !important;
  }

  [data-theme="dark"] body {
    background-image:
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        45deg,
        transparent 0,
        transparent 27px,
        rgba(232, 178, 122, 0.1) 27px,
        rgba(232, 178, 122, 0.1) 28px
      ),
      repeating-linear-gradient(
        -45deg,
        transparent 0,
        transparent 27px,
        rgba(232, 178, 122, 0.1) 27px,
        rgba(232, 178, 122, 0.1) 28px
      ) !important;
  }

  /* Remove from solid sections — pattern still shows via body */
  .commitments-section,
  .process-section,
  .site-footer,
  .why-section::before,
  .latest-blog-section::before {
    background-image: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. HERO ORBS — reduce blur cost (100px → 80px)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-bg-orb,
.hero-aurora-blob {
  filter: blur(80px) !important;
}

/* Mobile: kill orbs entirely */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-2,
  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-3 {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-1 {
    opacity: 0.5 !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   PERFORMANCE LAYER — Last-Mile Optimization
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   This is NOT a mega-file. It's a surgical override layer
   that touches only what matters for performance, without
   adding new visual rules.

   Strategy:
   1. Content-visibility for below-fold sections
   2. Reduce blur radius (biggest GPU cost)
   3. Reduce box-shadow complexity
   4. Remove unused animations
   5. Clean will-change
   6. Ensure compositor-only animations
   7. Section containment strategy

   Load LAST. No !important unless fighting legacy overrides.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. CONTENT-VISIBILITY — skip rendering off-screen
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.services-section,
.portfolio-section,
.about-section,
.why-section,
.testimonials-section,
.latest-blog-section,
.newsletter-section,
.faq-section,
.final-cta-section,
.commitments-section,
.process-section {
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 900px;
}

.site-footer {
  content-visibility: auto;
  contain-intrinsic-size: auto 700px;
}

/* Hero must stay visible always */
.hero-section {
  content-visibility: visible !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. BLUR REDUCTION — the biggest GPU cost on the site
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Hero orbs — 100px → 80px is barely visible but 40% cheaper */
.hero-section .hero-bg-orb,
.hero-aurora-blob {
  filter: blur(80px);
}

/* Hide the third orb on mobile (has the least visual impact) */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-3 {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb-2 {
    opacity: 0.35;
  }
}

/* Reduce nav glass blur on mobile (costly on iOS) */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner,
  .mobile-nav {
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.3);
  }
}

/* Reduce hero bento cell blur (from 26px → 20px) */
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.5);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   3. BOX-SHADOW SIMPLIFICATION
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Complex multi-layer shadows cost paint time.
   Merging into fewer layers keeps the same look.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -16px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.12);
}

.commitment-card,
.process-step,
.latest-blog-card,
.faq-item,
.work-card {
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   4. PAUSE OFF-SCREEN ANIMATIONS
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Infinite CSS animations consume GPU even when off-screen.
   We pause the costly ones when their section isn't visible.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Marquee — only animate when Hero is in view */
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-marquee-track {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

/* Bento Live dot — pause when off screen */
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-live-dot,
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bento-status-dot {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

/* Orbs — pause when Hero isn't visible */
.hero-section:not(.hero-in-view) .hero-bg-orb {
  animation-play-state: paused;
}

/* Tab hidden — pause everything */
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-marquee-track,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bg-orb,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bento-live-dot,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-bento-status-dot,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .hero-aperture,
html[data-tab-hidden="true"] .chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
  animation-play-state: paused !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   5. WILL-CHANGE CLEANUP
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   will-change should only exist during active animation.
   Leaving it on permanently creates pointless GPU layers.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.reveal,
.reveal-fade,
.reveal-scale,
.hero-bento-cell,
.hero-bento-seal,
.about-brand-mark,
.newsletter-card,
.commitment-card,
.process-step,
.latest-blog-card,
.faq-item {
  will-change: auto;
}

/* Only hint GPU during actual reveal */
.reveal:not(.is-visible) {
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   6. COMPOSITOR-ONLY ANIMATIONS
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Force the few remaining infinite animations to run on the
   compositor thread (transform/opacity only).
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-marquee-track,
.hero-bg-orb,
.hero-bento-live-dot,
.hero-bento-status-dot,
.hero-aperture,
.hero-section .hero-bento-cell-mesh::before,
.chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
  transform: translateZ(0);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   7. REDUCE HOVER TRANSFORM COST ON MOBILE
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   On touch devices, hover effects never trigger meaningfully.
   Kill them to save GPU cycles.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {
  .portfolio-card:hover .portfolio-card-visual,
  .work-card:hover,
  .latest-blog-card:hover,
  .faq-item:hover,
  .commitment-card:hover,
  .testimonial-card:hover,
  .service-item:hover {
    transform: none;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   8. LAYOUT CONTAINMENT (Desktop only — safe)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */


/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   9. REDUCED MOTION — global safety
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .hero-marquee-track,
  .hero-bg-orb,
  .hero-bento-live-dot,
  .hero-bento-status-dot,
  .hero-aperture,
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell-mesh::before,
  .chapter-rail-item.is-active .chapter-rail-dot {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   10. DATA-SAVER MODE — be kind to metered connections
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-data: reduce) {
  .hero-section .hero-bg-grain,
  .hero-section .hero-bg-grid,
  .manuscript-grid-pattern {
    display: none;
  }

  .hero-section .hero-bg-orb {
    filter: blur(60px);
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================

   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Goal: 40-60% reduction in GPU/CPU cost on desktop.
   No visual change. Loaded LAST so it wins all cascade.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   1. BACKDROP-FILTER REDUCTION — biggest GPU win
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Blur above ~20px is visually indistinguishable but roughly
   doubles GPU cost. We drop to 12-20px across the board.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (min-width: 901px) {
  /* Nav (scrolled) — 40px → 20px */
  .site-nav.is-scrolled .nav-inner {
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.6) !important;
  }

  /* Hero bento cells — 26px → 16px */
  .hero-section .hero-bento-cell {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
  }

  /* Hero pills/eyebrows — 12px → 10px */
  .hero-section .hero-role,
  .hero-section .hero-top-meta,
  .hero-section .hero-eyebrow {
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.2) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(1.2) !important;
  }

  /* Service preview — 20px → 12px */
  .service-preview {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
  }

  /* About statement — 20px → 12px */
  .about-statement {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
  }

  /* Final CTA — 16px → 12px */
  .final-cta {
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.3) !important;
  }

  /* Order form sections — kill entirely (solid bg) */
  .order-page .form-section,
  .order-form .form-section {
    backdrop-filter: none !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
  }

  /* Modals — 24px → 16px is more than enough */
  .project-modal-shell,
  .project-modal {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
  }

  .welcome-backdrop,
  .welcome-card {
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   2. KILL BACKDROP-FILTER WHERE IT DOES NOTHING
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   These have solid/near-solid backgrounds — blur has no visible
   effect but still forces an extra compositing pass per frame.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.contact-card,
.commitment-card,
.process-step,
.latest-blog-card,
.faq-item,
.testimonial-card,
.work-card,
.newsletter-card,
.blog-author,
.blog-inline-cta,

.service-item,
.hero-section .hero-bento-seal,
.site-footer .footer-col,

}

/* Desktop nav list — has solid-ish gradient, blur not needed */

  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.reveal,

.reveal-scale,
.hero-bento-cell,
.commitment-card,
.process-step,
.latest-blog-card,
.faq-item,
.testimonial-card,
.newsletter-card,

.hero-marquee-track,

@media (min-width: 901px) {
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   PROCESS SECTION — 4-step workflow + scroll-driven timeline
   ============================================================ */

.process-section {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.process-section::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 90% 10%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent),
    transparent 45%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══ MASTHEAD ═══ */
.process-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.process-masthead-left,
.process-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.process-masthead-center {
  font-size: 18px;
  opacity: 0.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══ HEADING ═══ */
.process-section .section-heading h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem);
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}

.process-section .section-heading > p {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.8;
  max-width: 440px;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SCROLL-DRIVEN TIMELINE — the amber progress line
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   A thin rail below the heading. Grows as user scrolls.
   Each step's number activates when the line passes it.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.process-timeline {
  display: none;
}

@media (min-width: 721px) {
  .process-timeline {
    display: block;
    position: relative;
    height: 28px;
    margin: 0 0 clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px);
    padding-inline: 8px;
  }

  .process-timeline-track {
    position: relative;
    height: 1px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 90%, transparent);
    border-radius: 1px;
  }

  /* The growing fill */
  .process-timeline-fill {
    position: absolute;
    inset-block: -1px;
    inset-inline-start: 0;
    height: 3px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent) 0%,
      var(--accent) 20%,
      var(--accent) 80%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent) 100%
    );
    box-shadow:
      0 0 12px -1px var(--accent-glow),
      0 0 24px -6px var(--accent-glow);
    transform-origin: left center;
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }

  /* Fallback for browsers without scroll-timeline */
  @supports not (animation-timeline: view()) {
    .process-timeline-fill {
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transition: transform 120ms linear;
    }
  }

  /* Scroll-driven animation (Chrome 115+, Edge 115+, Safari 26+) */
  @supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
    .process-timeline-fill {
      animation: process-scroll-grow linear both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 10% cover 60%;
    }

    @keyframes process-scroll-grow {
      from {
        transform: scaleX(0);
      }
      to {
        transform: scaleX(1);
      }
    }
  }

  /* RTL: grow from the right */
  [dir="rtl"] .process-timeline-fill {
    transform-origin: right center;
  }
}

/* ═══ GRID ═══ */
.process-section .process-grid {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
  list-style: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 0 clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px) !important;
  align-items: start !important;
  border: 0 !important;
}

/* ═══ CARD ═══ */
.process-section .process-step {
  position: relative !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  grid-template-columns: none !important;
  grid-template-rows: none !important;
  align-items: stretch !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
  padding: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 28px) !important;
  border-radius: 18px !important;
  background: var(--surface) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line) !important;
  transition:
    border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
  transition-delay: calc(var(--step-index, 0) * 60ms);
}

.process-section .process-step:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, var(--line)) !important;
  transform: translateY(-3px) !important;
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04),
    0 16px 40px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.12) !important;
}

/* Number badge glows when its step enters viewport */
@supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
  .process-section .process-step-num {
    animation: step-num-activate linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 40% entry 80%;
  }

  @keyframes step-num-activate {
    from {
      background: var(--accent-tint);
      color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 0 transparent,
        0 0 0 0 transparent;
      transform: scale(0.94);
    }
    to {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent),
        0 0 20px -4px var(--accent-glow);
      transform: scale(1);
    }
  }

  .process-section .process-step-title {
    animation: step-title-activate linear both;
    animation-timeline: view();
    animation-range: entry 45% entry 85%;
  }

  @keyframes step-title-activate {
    from {
      color: var(--ink-2);
    }
    to {
      color: var(--ink);
    }
  }
}

.process-section .process-step-head {

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

  }
```

```css
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }

  .reveal,
  .reveal-fade,
  .reveal-scale {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
    filter: none;
  }

  .hero-role-text,
  .mobile-menu,
  .project-modal,
  .project-modal-content,
  .back-to-top,
  .order-success-icon,
  .toast {

  }

  .animate-float,
  .animate-pulse-ring,
  .skeleton::after {
    animation: none;
  }

    background: var(--paper-2);
  }
}

/* ============================================================

   ============================================================ */
@media print {
  .site-nav,
  .back-to-top,
  .mobile-menu,
  .scroll-progress,
  .toast-stack,
  .footer-signature,
  .hero-section::before,
  .hero-section::after {
    display: none !important;
  }

  body {
    background: #fff;
    color: #000;
  }

  .container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: none;
    padding-inline: 0;
  }

  a {
    color: #000;
    text-decoration: underline;
  }

  .button {
    border: 1px solid #000;
    background: transparent;
    color: #000;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   REVEAL SYSTEM — Progressive Enhancement
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Uses IntersectionObserver as fallback for browsers without
   CSS scroll-driven animation support.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* Legacy reveal (already used in the site) — kept as fallback */
.reveal {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(var(--motion-distance-lg));
  filter: var(--motion-blur-sm);
  transition:
    opacity var(--motion-slower) var(--motion-ease-out),
    transform var(--motion-slower) var(--motion-ease-out),
    filter var(--motion-slower) var(--motion-ease-out);
  will-change: opacity, transform, filter;
}

.reveal.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
  filter: blur(0);
  will-change: auto;
}

/* Staggered reveal delays via inline CSS var */
.reveal {
  transition-delay: var(--reveal-delay, 0ms);
}

/* ── When scroll-driven animations are supported, prefer them ── */
@supports (animation-timeline: view()) {
  .reveal {
    /* Ensure reveal class still works but doesn't fight with
       scroll-driven utilities. Users can opt-in per element. */
  }
}

/* ── Reveal section container (opt-in per block) ── */
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(1) { --reveal-delay: 0ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(2) { --reveal-delay: 60ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(3) { --reveal-delay: 120ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(4) { --reveal-delay: 180ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(5) { --reveal-delay: 240ms; }
.reveal-group > .reveal:nth-child(6) { --reveal-delay: 300ms; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal {
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: none !important;
    filter: none !important;
    transition: none !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   SENSORY FEEDBACK — Sound Toggle + Enhanced Drag
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   - Sound toggle in footer
   - Enhanced visual feedback during drag
   - Selection pulse on multi-select options
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SOUND TOGGLE — footer button
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.sound-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-family: inherit;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  min-height: 36px;
}

.sound-toggle:hover {
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.sound-toggle:active {
  transform: scale(0.96);
}

.sound-toggle.is-on {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.sound-toggle-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.sound-toggle-icon svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.sound-toggle-label {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .sound-toggle {
    padding: 8px 12px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    min-height: 40px;
  }

  .sound-toggle-label {
    display: none;
  }

  .sound-toggle {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    padding: 0;
    justify-content: center;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  .sound-toggle-icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   ENHANCED DRAG FEEDBACK
   Applies to project modal and future bottom sheets
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  /* Drag handle gets more prominent when grabbed */
  .project-modal-drag-handle {
    transition:
      background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      padding 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] .project-modal-drag-handle {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 92%, var(--accent));
  }

  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] .project-modal-drag-bar {
    width: 56px;
    background: var(--accent);
  }

  /* While dragging, prevent accidental hover states */
  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] * {
    pointer-events: none !important;
  }

  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] .project-modal-drag-handle {
    pointer-events: auto !important;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SELECTION PULSE — multi-select options give visual feedback
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
  .project-type-option.is-selected,
  .contact-method.is-selected {
    animation: selectionPulse 380ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
  }

  @keyframes selectionPulse {
    0% {
      transform: scale(1);
    }
    40% {
      transform: scale(1.03);
    }
    100% {
      transform: scale(1);
    }
  }

  /* Blog tag chip feedback */
  .blog-tag-chip.active {
    animation: tagPulse 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
  }

  @keyframes tagPulse {
    0% {
      transform: scale(1);
    }
    40% {
      transform: scale(1.06);
    }
    100% {
      transform: scale(1);
    }
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SUCCESS / ERROR FLASH on form messages
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.form-message-error {
  animation: errorFlash 480ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

@keyframes errorFlash {
  0%, 100% {
    background-color: transparent;
  }
  30% {
    background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 8%, transparent);
  }
}

.order-success-icon {
  animation: successBounce 700ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

@keyframes successBounce {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.5) rotate(-20deg);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  50% {
    transform: scale(1.15) rotate(5deg);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1) rotate(0);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FOOTER BOTTOM — align sound toggle
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 16px;
}

.footer-bottom-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-inline-start: auto;
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .footer-bottom {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .footer-bottom-actions {
    margin-inline-start: 0;
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .project-type-option.is-selected,
  .contact-method.is-selected,
  .blog-tag-chip.active,
  .form-message-error,
  .order-success-icon {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] .project-modal-drag-handle {
    background: var(--paper-2);
  }

  .project-modal[data-dragging="true"] .project-modal-drag-bar {
    background: var(--ink-3);
  }
}
```

## FILE: src\styles\signature-ink.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   SIGNATURE INK — Hand-drawn underline
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   - Draws like a brush stroke from right to left (RTL-native)
   - Holds for ~1.5s, then fades out
   - Light mode: burnt amber (#B45309) — ink on paper
   - Dark mode:  warm gold   (#E8B27A) — gold on dark ground
   - Variant "--on-dark" for dark / accent buttons
   - Triggered by: hover (desktop) · focus-visible · .is-inking (touch)
   - Respects prefers-reduced-motion
   ============================================================ */

.ink-word {
  --ink-color: #b45309;
  --ink-glow:  rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.38);
  --ink-bleed: rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.18);

  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  isolation: isolate;
  padding-block-end: 0.02em;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ink-word {
  --ink-color: #e8b27a;
  --ink-glow:  rgba(232, 178, 122, 0.45);
  --ink-bleed: rgba(232, 178, 122, 0.22);
}

/* ─── Variant: on dark / accent backgrounds (buttons) ─── */
.ink-word--on-dark {
  --ink-color: #f5d5a8;
  --ink-glow:  rgba(245, 213, 168, 0.55);
  --ink-bleed: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ink-word--on-dark {
  --ink-color: #fff3e5;
  --ink-glow:  rgba(255, 243, 229, 0.6);
  --ink-bleed: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35);
}

/* ─── The brush stroke itself ─── */
.ink-word::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: -0.04em;
  bottom: 0.02em;
  height: 0.115em;
  border-radius: 3px 4px 2px 3px;

  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-color) 60%, transparent) 0%,
    var(--ink-color) 14%,
    var(--ink-color) 86%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink-color) 60%, transparent) 100%
  );

  box-shadow:
    0 0 10px -1px var(--ink-glow),
    0 0 2px 0 var(--ink-color),
    inset 0 0 4px 0 var(--ink-bleed);

  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: right center;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

/* ─── Draw → hold → fade ─── */
@keyframes inkDraw {
  0% {
    transform: scaleX(0);
    opacity: 0;
  }
  16% {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  72% {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 1;
  }
  100% {
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TRIGGER 1 — Direct hover / keyboard focus on the word
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .ink-word:hover::before,
  .ink-word:focus-visible::before {
    animation: inkDraw 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   TRIGGER 2 — Parent CTA hover
   (so hovering button padding draws ink under the label)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .hero-btn:hover .ink-word::before,
  .hero-btn:focus-visible .ink-word::before,
  .button:hover .ink-word::before,
  .button:focus-visible .ink-word::before,
  .button-primary:hover .ink-word::before,
  .button-secondary:hover .ink-word::before,
  .oform-btn:hover .ink-word::before,
  .oform-btn:focus-visible .ink-word::before {
    animation: inkDraw 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
  }
}

/* ─── Touch / any device: class-driven (added by JS on tap) ─── */
.ink-word.is-inking::before {
  animation: inkDraw 2.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
}

/* ─── Reduced motion: skip the draw, show briefly then fade ─── */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ink-word::before {
    animation: none !important;
    transition: opacity 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    transform: scaleX(1);
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .ink-word:hover::before,
  .ink-word:focus-visible::before,
  .ink-word.is-inking::before,
  .hero-btn:hover .ink-word::before,
  .button:hover .ink-word::before {
    animation: none !important;
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

/* ─── Buttons: remove overflow clipping so ink glow shows ─── */
.hero-btn .ink-word,
.button .ink-word,
.oform-btn .ink-word {
  overflow: visible;
}
```


## FILE: src\styles\testimonials.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   TESTIMONIALS — Editorial Pull Quotes
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Three equal cards. Quote is the star.
   - Semantic <figure>/<blockquote>/<figcaption> markup
   - No project references, no fake data
   - Editorial numbering to match the rest of the site
   - No stars, no avatars — pure words
   ============================================================ */

.testimonials-section {
  position: relative;
}

.testimonials-section::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 30% 50%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent),
    transparent 50%
  );
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ═══ Masthead ═══ */
.testimonials-masthead {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.testimonials-masthead-left,
.testimonials-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.testimonials-masthead-center {
  font-size: 14px;
  opacity: 0.5;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══ Grid ═══ */
.testimonials-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px);
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
}

/* ═══ Card ═══ */
.testimonial-card {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: clamp(26px, 3vw, 34px) clamp(24px, 2.8vw, 30px);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  transition:
    border-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  transition-delay: calc(var(--t-index, 0) * 60ms);
}

.testimonial-card:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, var(--line));
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.04),
    0 16px 40px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.12);
}

/* ─── Number badge ─── */
.testimonial-card-num {
  align-self: flex-start;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 32px;
  height: 24px;
  padding-inline: 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
}

/* ─── Big quote mark ─── */
.testimonial-card-mark {
  display: block;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: clamp(44px, 5vw, 56px);
  line-height: 0.5;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.35;
  user-select: none;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* ─── Quote ─── */
.testimonial-card-quote {
  margin: 0;
  flex: 1;
}

.testimonial-card-quote p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: clamp(0.9375rem, 0.9rem + 0.15vw, 1.0625rem);
  line-height: 1.8;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
  max-width: none;
}

/* ─── Caption (name + role) ─── */
.testimonial-card-caption {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 10px;
  padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.testimonial-card-name {
  font-style: normal;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.testimonial-card-role {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.85;
}

/* ═══ Footer note ═══ */
.testimonials-footer {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
  text-align: center;
}

.testimonials-footer-line {
  width: 40px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.testimonials-footer-text {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.8;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.testimonials-footer-text strong {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.testimonials-footer-text a {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.testimonials-footer-text a:hover {
  border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
}

/* ═══ Responsive ═══ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .testimonials-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .testimonial-card:nth-child(3) {
    grid-column: span 2;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .testimonials-masthead {
    font-size: 9.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    padding-bottom: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }

  .testimonials-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .testimonial-card:nth-child(3) {
    grid-column: auto;
  }

  .testimonial-card {
    padding: 22px 20px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    gap: 14px;
  }

  .testimonial-card-mark {
    font-size: 40px;
  }

  .testimonial-card-quote p {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
  }

  .testimonial-card-name {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
  }

  .testimonial-card-role {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
  }
}

/* ═══ Reduced motion ═══ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .testimonial-card {
    transition: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
```


## FILE: src\styles\theme-toggle.css
```css
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   THEME TOGGLE — Legendary Sky Edition
   A day/night sky that morphs between sun and moon.
   Lives OUTSIDE enhancements.css so it's easy to revert.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   BUTTON — base circle + soft glow ring
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.site-nav .theme-toggle {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;

  width: 46px;
  height: 46px;

  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: visible;
  isolation: isolate;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;

  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
}

/* Soft glow behind the button — day (warm) */
.site-nav .theme-toggle::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -4px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    rgba(233, 75, 44, 0.42) 0%,
    rgba(233, 75, 44, 0.14) 42%,
    transparent 70%
  );
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  transform: scale(0.85);
  transition:
    opacity 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1),
    background 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.site-nav .theme-toggle:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1.12);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   INNER SKY — the circle with the day gradient
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.site-nav .theme-toggle-inner {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;
  z-index: 1;

  /* Day sky: warm cream → amber → coral */
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 32% 30%,
    #fff9ef 0%,
    #ffe0b8 35%,
    #ffb878 75%,
    #ff9a5c 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 168, 100, 0.5);

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95),
    inset 0 -1px 3px rgba(180, 90, 30, 0.15),
    0 4px 14px -4px rgba(233, 75, 44, 0.35),
    0 1px 3px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06);

  transition:
    background 600ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   ICONS — sun and moon
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

.site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  padding: 9px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  z-index: 2;
  display: block;
  transition:
    opacity 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    color 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    filter 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  will-change: opacity, transform;
}

.site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon-sun {
  color: #b04a15;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
}

.site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon-moon {
  color: #ddd0ff;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: rotate(-100deg) scale(0.4);
}

/* Hover: sun rays spin gently */
.site-nav .theme-toggle:hover .theme-icon-sun {
  transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1.1);
}

/* Active press */
.site-nav .theme-toggle:active .theme-toggle-inner {
  transform: scale(0.9);
}

/* Focus ring */
.site-nav .theme-toggle:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
  border-radius: 50%;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   NIGHT SKY — dark mode override
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle-inner {
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle at 32% 28%,
    #3d3660 0%,
    #2a2544 35%,
    #1a1530 75%,
    #0f0b1e 100%
  );
  border-color: rgba(140, 120, 220, 0.45);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(200, 180, 255, 0.2),
    inset 0 -1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
    0 4px 14px -4px rgba(80, 60, 180, 0.55),
    0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle::before {
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    rgba(120, 100, 220, 0.5) 0%,
    rgba(120, 100, 220, 0.18) 42%,
    transparent 70%
  );
}

[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon-sun {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: rotate(100deg) scale(0.4);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon-moon {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1);
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(180, 160, 255, 0.65));
}

[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle:hover .theme-icon-moon {
  transform: rotate(-15deg) scale(1.15);
}

/* Ambient pulse in dark mode */
[data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    rgba(120, 100, 220, 0.32) 0%,
    transparent 70%
  );
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  animation: themeTogglePulse 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes themeTogglePulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.92); }
  50%      { opacity: 0.7;  transform: scale(1.05); }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — smaller on phones
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .site-nav .theme-toggle {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
  }
  .site-nav .theme-toggle-inner {
    width: 34px;
    height: 34px;
  }
  .site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon {
    padding: 7px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .site-nav .theme-toggle,
  .site-nav .theme-toggle-inner,
  .site-nav .theme-toggle .theme-icon,
  .site-nav .theme-toggle::before {
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
  [data-theme="dark"] .site-nav .theme-toggle::after {
    animation: none;
  }
}
```

```css
  }

.input-group {

}

.input-group input,
.input-group textarea {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);

.input-group textarea {

  resize: vertical;

.input-group label {
  position: absolute;
  top: 1.25rem;
  right: 1.5rem;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: 1rem;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.input-group input:focus,
.input-group textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-tint), 0 12px 24px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.input-group input:focus ~ label,
.input-group textarea:focus ~ label,
.input-group input:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ label,
.input-group textarea:not(:placeholder-shown) ~ label {
  top: -0.6rem;
  right: 1.25rem;
```
