## FILE: src\styles\welcome-onboarding.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   WELCOME ONBOARDING — Editorial Guide Edition
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   3-step magazine-style welcome card.
   
   Design sources:
   - Appcues modal best practices (2026)
   - LinkedIn/Saasfactor 96-SaaS analysis (2026)
   - Once UI Handbook (controlled dialog)
   - Untitled UI RTL patterns
   
   Structure:
   - Full-screen dark blur backdrop
   - Centered editorial card (max-w 720px)
   - Editorial rulers + crosshairs on card edges
   - Masthead with progress dots
   - Big chapter number (۰۱ / ۰۳)
   - Editorial typography
   - Skip always visible + Next button
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   OVERLAY & BACKDROP
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 9999;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 24px;
  animation: welcomeFadeIn 380ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.welcome-backdrop {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 62%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.4);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.4);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .welcome-backdrop {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, #000 68%, transparent);
}

@keyframes welcomeFadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to   { opacity: 1; }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CARD — the editorial cover
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-card {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 720px;
  max-height: calc(100svh - 48px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;

  padding: 0; /* inner sections handle padding */
  border-radius: 28px;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 90% 60% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 6%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.08),
    0 40px 100px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.28);

  animation: welcomeCardIn 600ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) 100ms both;
}

@keyframes welcomeCardIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(28px) scale(0.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   EDITORIAL CORNERS (crosshairs)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-corner {
  position: absolute;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  pointer-events: none;
  color: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.6;
  z-index: 3;
}

.welcome-corner::before,
.welcome-corner::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
}

.welcome-corner::before {
  width: 1px;
  height: 100%;
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  top: 0;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
}

.welcome-corner::after {
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  top: 50%;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.welcome-corner-tl { top: 14px; inset-inline-start: 14px; }
.welcome-corner-tr { top: 14px; inset-inline-end: 14px; }
.welcome-corner-bl { bottom: 14px; inset-inline-start: 14px; }
.welcome-corner-br { bottom: 14px; inset-inline-end: 14px; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   EDITORIAL RULER (top of card)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-ruler {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 8px 32px 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 8.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.35;
  direction: ltr;
  pointer-events: none;
  user-select: none;
}

.welcome-ruler span {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   MASTHEAD
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-masthead {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 16px 32px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 9.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
}

.welcome-masthead-left {
  opacity: 0.7;
  justify-self: start;
}

.welcome-masthead-right {
  opacity: 0.55;
  justify-self: end;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  max-width: 100%;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   PROGRESS DOTS
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-progress {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.welcome-progress-dot {
  position: relative;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.welcome-progress-dot::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--line-strong);
  transition:
    background-color 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.welcome-progress-dot:hover::before {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 50%, var(--line-strong));
  transform: scale(1.15);
}

.welcome-progress-dot.is-done::before {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent);
}

.welcome-progress-dot.is-active {
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.welcome-progress-dot.is-active::before {
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent),
    0 0 12px -2px var(--accent-glow);
}

.welcome-progress-dot:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   STEP NUMBER (۰۱ / ۰۳)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-step-num {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 22px 32px 0;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  direction: ltr;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  align-self: flex-start;
}

.welcome-step-num-current {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.welcome-step-num-sep {
  opacity: 0.4;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.welcome-step-num-total {
  opacity: 0.6;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BODY — the content
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 18px 32px 32px;
  animation: welcomeBodyIn 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.welcome-body[data-dir="prev"] {
  animation-direction: reverse;
}

@keyframes welcomeBodyIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-12px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

/* ─── Eyebrow ─── */
.welcome-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
  direction: ltr;
  align-self: flex-start;
  position: relative;
  padding-inline-start: 22px;
}

.welcome-eyebrow::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 50%;
  width: 14px;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.6;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

/* ─── Title ─── */
.welcome-title {
  margin: 0 0 20px;
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.4vw, 2.25rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.18;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.welcome-title-em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}

.welcome-title-em::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: -3px;
  bottom: 0.05em;
  height: 0.06em;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.25;
  border-radius: 2px;
}

/* ─── Subtitle ─── */
.welcome-subtitle {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 52ch;
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   CHAPTERS (step 2 only)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-chapters {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 28px 0 0;
}

.welcome-chapter {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 14px 14px;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  transition:
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.welcome-chapter:hover {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line));
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.welcome-chapter-num {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 30px;
  height: 30px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent);
}

.welcome-chapter-body {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.welcome-chapter-title {
  margin: 0 0 2px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.welcome-chapter-text {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   FOOTER — actions
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.welcome-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 20px 32px 26px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 55%, transparent);
}

.welcome-skip {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.welcome-skip:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.welcome-skip:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.welcome-footer-actions {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.welcome-nav-btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding-inline: 22px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.welcome-nav-prev {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
}

.welcome-nav-prev:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.welcome-nav-prev > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  display: inline-flex;
  transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.welcome-nav-prev:hover > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transform: translateX(3px);
}

.welcome-nav-next {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff9f4;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
    0 8px 22px -10px var(--accent-glow);
}

.welcome-nav-next:hover {
  background: var(--accent-2);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2),
    0 14px 32px -12px var(--accent-glow);
}

.welcome-nav-next:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98);
}

.welcome-nav-next > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  display: inline-flex;
  transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1);
}

.welcome-nav-next:hover > span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
}

.welcome-nav-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .welcome-nav-next {
  background: linear-gradient(
    145deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 70%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — TABLET (≤ 900px)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .welcome-overlay {
    padding: 20px;
  }

  .welcome-chapters {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE — MOBILE (≤ 720px) — Bottom sheet style
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .welcome-overlay {
    padding: 0;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }

  .welcome-card {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 94svh;
    border-radius: 28px 28px 0 0;
    animation: welcomeCardMobileIn 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
      100ms both;
  }

  @keyframes welcomeCardMobileIn {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(48px);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
  }

  /* Hide the top ruler on mobile — too much noise */
  .welcome-ruler {
    display: none;
  }

  /* Smaller crosshairs */
  .welcome-corner {
    width: 11px;
    height: 11px;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }

  .welcome-corner-tl { top: 12px; inset-inline-start: 12px; }
  .welcome-corner-tr { top: 12px; inset-inline-end: 12px; }
  .welcome-corner-bl { bottom: 12px; inset-inline-start: 12px; }
  .welcome-corner-br { bottom: 12px; inset-inline-end: 12px; }

  /* Compact masthead */
  .welcome-masthead {
    padding: 14px 20px 12px;
    font-size: 8.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .welcome-masthead-right {
    display: none;
  }

  .welcome-masthead {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
  }

  .welcome-masthead-left {
    justify-self: start;
  }

  .welcome-progress {
    justify-self: end;
  }

  /* Tighter step number */
  .welcome-step-num {
    padding: 16px 20px 0;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .welcome-step-num-current {
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  /* Body */
  .welcome-body {
    padding: 14px 20px 24px;
  }

  .welcome-eyebrow {
    font-size: 9.5px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .welcome-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.375rem, 7vw, 1.875rem);
    line-height: 1.22;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .welcome-subtitle {
    font-size: 0.9375rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  /* Chapters */
  .welcome-chapters {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 22px;
  }

  .welcome-chapter {
    padding: 12px 12px;
    gap: 10px;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .welcome-chapter-num {
    width: 26px;
    height: 26px;
    font-size: 9.5px;
  }

  .welcome-chapter-title {
    font-size: 13px;
  }

  .welcome-chapter-text {
    font-size: 11.5px;
  }

  /* Footer */
  .welcome-footer {
    padding: 16px 20px calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    flex-direction: column-reverse;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .welcome-footer-actions {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .welcome-nav-btn {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 52px;
    font-size: 14.5px;
    border-radius: 14px;
  }

  .welcome-nav-prev {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding-inline: 18px;
    min-width: 90px;
  }

  .welcome-skip {
    align-self: center;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .welcome-masthead {
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  }

  .welcome-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7.5vw, 1.625rem);
  }

  .welcome-subtitle {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
  }

  .welcome-nav-btn {
    min-height: 50px;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .welcome-overlay,
  .welcome-card,
  .welcome-body {
    animation: none !important;
  }

  .welcome-progress-dot,
  .welcome-progress-dot::before,
  .welcome-nav-btn,
  .welcome-nav-prev > span[aria-hidden="true"],
  .welcome-nav-next > span[aria-hidden="true"],
  .welcome-skip,
  .welcome-chapter {
    transition: none !important;
  }

  .welcome-nav-next:hover,
  .welcome-chapter:hover {
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
```

```css
/* ============================================================
   WORK PAGES — /work, /work/[slug]
   ------------------------------------------------------------
   Editorial magazine style for project listing and detail
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   BREADCRUMB
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-breadcrumb {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  padding-top: 100px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.work-breadcrumb a {
  color: var(--ink-3);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.work-breadcrumb a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.work-breadcrumb span[aria-hidden="true"] {
  opacity: 0.4;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
}

.work-breadcrumb span[aria-current="page"] {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   /work PAGE — Listing
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-page {
  padding-bottom: clamp(80px, 10vw, 120px);
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.work-header {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
}

.work-title {
  margin: 16px 0 20px;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5.5vw, 3.5rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.work-title em {
  font-style: normal;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.work-intro {
  font-size: clamp(15px, 1.2vw, 17px);
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  max-width: 640px;
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ═══ Grid ═══ */
.work-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(380px, 1fr));
  gap: 28px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(48px, 6vw, 80px);
}

.work-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  transition:
    transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.work-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, var(--line));
  box-shadow:
    0 2px 8px -2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.06),
    0 24px 60px -20px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.18);
}

.work-card-visual {
  position: relative;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.work-card-visual img {
  transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.work-card:hover .work-card-visual img {
  transform: scale(1.04);
}

.work-card-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  inset-inline-end: 14px;
  z-index: 2;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 5px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 70%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.4);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.4);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.work-card-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 22px 22px 20px;
  flex: 1;
}

.work-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.work-card-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
}

.work-card-category {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.work-card-title {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
  color: var(--ink);
  transition: color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.work-card:hover .work-card-title {
  color: var(--accent);
}

.work-card-desc {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.work-card-footer {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: auto;
  padding-top: 16px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.work-card-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
}

.work-card-tag {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  color: var(--ink-3);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.work-card-arrow {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--accent);
  transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.work-card:hover .work-card-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-6px);
}

/* ═══ Work CTA ═══ */
.work-cta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 32px;
  padding: clamp(32px, 5vw, 48px) clamp(28px, 4vw, 48px);
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent-tint) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, var(--line));
}

.work-cta-content h2 {
  margin: 8px 0 10px;
  font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.work-cta-content p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  max-width: 480px;
}

.work-cta .button {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   /work/[slug] — Detail Page
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-detail {
  padding-bottom: clamp(80px, 10vw, 120px);
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.work-detail-header {
  max-width: 900px;
  margin-bottom: clamp(40px, 5vw, 64px);
}

.work-detail-header-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.work-detail-status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4px 11px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--accent-tint);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

.work-detail-title {
  margin: 0 0 22px;
  font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.05;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.work-detail-latin {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.4em;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
  opacity: 0.7;
  direction: ltr;
  vertical-align: middle;
  margin-inline-start: 8px;
}

.work-detail-lead {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 0 32px;
  font-size: clamp(16px, 1.3vw, 19px);
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ═══ Facts grid ═══ */
.work-detail-facts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr));
  gap: 20px 32px;
  margin: 0 0 32px;
  padding: 24px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.work-detail-facts > div {
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
}

.work-detail-facts dt {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.work-detail-facts dd {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* ═══ Demo button ═══ */
.work-detail-demo {
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.work-detail-demo-dot {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  animation: workDemoPulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) infinite;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes workDemoPulse {
  0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); }
  70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0); }
}

/* ═══ Cover ═══ */
.work-detail-cover {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  margin-bottom: clamp(48px, 6vw, 80px);
  border-radius: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

/* ═══ Content ═══ */
.work-detail-content {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid;
  gap: clamp(40px, 5vw, 56px);
}

.work-detail-section {
  display: grid;
  gap: 16px;
}

.work-detail-section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 14px;
}

.work-detail-section-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.work-detail-section h2 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.3;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.work-detail-section p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.9;
  color: var(--ink-2);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

.work-detail-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
}

.work-detail-list li {
  position: relative;
  padding-inline-start: 26px;
  font-size: 15.5px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.work-detail-list li::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  top: 0.75em;
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);
  border: 1.5px solid var(--accent);
}

.work-detail-list--accent li::before {
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

/* ═══ Metrics ═══ */
.work-detail-metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr));
  gap: 16px;
  padding: clamp(24px, 3vw, 36px);
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.work-detail-metric {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
  text-align: center;
}

.work-detail-metric strong {
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 36px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.work-detail-metric span {
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink-3-strong);
}

/* ═══ Quote ═══ */
.work-detail-section--quote blockquote {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 24px 28px;
  border-radius: 4px 20px 20px 4px;
  border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--accent);
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent-tint) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-tint) 40%, transparent) 100%
  );
  font-size: 16.5px;
  line-height: 1.85;
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-wrap: pretty;
}

/* ═══ Tech ═══ */
.work-detail-tech {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 12px;
}

.work-detail-tech-label {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 10.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}

.work-detail-tech-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
}

.work-detail-tech-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 7px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  color: var(--ink-2);
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* ═══ CTA ═══ */
.work-detail-cta {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: clamp(64px, 8vw, 96px) auto clamp(64px, 8vw, 96px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;
  padding: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px);
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent-tint) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, var(--line));
}

.work-detail-cta-content h2 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: clamp(20px, 2.5vw, 26px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.work-detail-cta-content p {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ink-2);
}

.work-detail-cta .button {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* ═══ Related ═══ */
.work-detail-related {
  padding-top: clamp(48px, 6vw, 72px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.work-detail-related-title {
  margin: 0 0 28px;
  font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.work-detail-related .work-grid {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   SKELETON
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-skeleton-breadcrumb {
  width: 220px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  margin-top: 100px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  animation: workSkeleton 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
}

.work-skeleton-header {
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 48px;
}

.work-skeleton-line {
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  animation: workSkeleton 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
}

.work-skeleton-line-sm { width: 30%; height: 12px; }
.work-skeleton-line-md { width: 60%; }
.work-skeleton-line-lg { width: 85%; height: 44px; }

.work-skeleton-cover {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: var(--paper-2);
  margin-bottom: 48px;
  animation: workSkeleton 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite;
}

.work-skeleton-body {
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid;
  gap: 14px;
}

@keyframes workSkeleton {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.5; }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .work-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
    gap: 22px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 720px) {
  .work-breadcrumb {
    padding-top: 80px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
  }

  .work-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .work-card {
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .work-card-body {
    padding: 18px 16px 16px;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .work-card-title {
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .work-card-desc {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    line-clamp: 2;
  }

  .work-card-badge {
    top: 10px;
    inset-inline-end: 10px;
    padding: 4px 9px;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .work-cta,
  .work-detail-cta {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 24px 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
  }

  .work-cta-content,
  .work-detail-cta-content {
    text-align: center;
  }

  .work-cta-content h2,
  .work-detail-cta-content h2 {
    font-size: 22px;
  }

  .work-cta .button,
  .work-detail-cta .button {
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  /* Detail */
  .work-detail-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 8vw, 2.5rem);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .work-detail-latin {
    display: block;
    margin-inline-start: 0;
    margin-top: 4px;
    font-size: 0.32em;
  }

  .work-detail-lead {
    font-size: 15px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .work-detail-facts {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 20px 0;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .work-detail-facts dt {
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .work-detail-facts dd {
    font-size: 13.5px;
  }

  .work-detail-cover {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }

  .work-detail-content {
    gap: 32px;
  }

  .work-detail-section h2 {
    font-size: 19px;
  }

  .work-detail-section p,
  .work-detail-list li {
    font-size: 14.5px;
    line-height: 1.85;
  }

  .work-detail-metrics {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
    padding: 24px 20px;
  }

  .work-detail-metric {
    padding: 12px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .work-detail-metric:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }

  .work-detail-section--quote blockquote {
    padding: 18px 20px;
    font-size: 14.5px;
    border-radius: 4px 14px 14px 4px;
  }

  .work-detail-related {
    padding-top: 40px;
  }

  .work-detail-related-title {
    font-size: 22px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .work-skeleton-breadcrumb {
    margin-top: 80px;
  }

  .work-skeleton-cover {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    border-radius: 18px;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .work-detail-facts {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .work-detail-title {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .work-card,
  .work-card-visual img,
  .work-card-title,
  .work-card-arrow {
    transition: none !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }

  .work-detail-demo-dot,
  .work-skeleton-breadcrumb,
  .work-skeleton-line,
  .work-skeleton-cover {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}
```

## FILE: src\styles\work-premium.css
```css
/* ============================================================
   WORK + MODAL + ORDER + 404 PREMIUM — Infinite Edition (Batch 3)
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Covers: /work, ProjectViewer, /work/[slug], /order, /404
   Pure CSS. No component changes. GPU-composited only.
   ============================================================ */

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   § 1. WORK PAGE — Header & Aurora
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-page,
.work-detail {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.work-page::before,
.work-detail::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 8%;
  inset-inline-start: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 90vw;
  height: 90vw;
  max-width: 900px;
  max-height: 900px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 2%, transparent) 30%,
    transparent 65%
  );
  filter: blur(70px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .work-page::before,
[data-theme="dark"] .work-detail::before {
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 30%,
    transparent 65%
  );
}

.work-breadcrumb a,
.work-breadcrumb span[aria-current="page"] {
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: all 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.work-breadcrumb a:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent) !important;
}

.work-title {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
}

.work-title em {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   § 2. WORK CARDS — 6-layer glass
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-card {
  position: relative !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 90%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 72%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 84%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 92%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    inset -1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 20px 48px -18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 18%, transparent),
    0 48px 100px -34px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 26%, transparent) !important;

  transition:
    transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .work-card {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 95%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 90%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32),
    0 2px 6px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42),
    0 20px 48px -18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55),
    0 48px 100px -34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78) !important;
}

.work-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent) 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  z-index: 1;
}

.work-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-8px) !important;
  border-color: transparent !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 98%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent),
    0 2px 8px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent),
    0 28px 60px -20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 34%, transparent),
    0 64px 128px -44px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 28%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.work-card-visual {
  position: relative;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
}

.work-card-visual img {
  transition:
    transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    filter 500ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.work-card:hover .work-card-visual img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
  filter: saturate(1.08) contrast(1.03);
}

.work-card-badge {
  padding: 6px 13px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 100%
  ) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15),
    0 4px 14px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-card-num {
  padding: 4px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 100%
  ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 4px 10px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
}

.work-card-category {
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.work-card-title {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
}

.work-card-tag {
  padding: 4px 11px !important;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 45%, transparent);
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  transition:
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.work-card:hover .work-card-tag:first-child {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent);
}

.work-card-arrow {
  display: grid !important;
  place-items: center;
  width: 36px !important;
  height: 36px !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  transition:
    transform 340ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    background 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 340ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.work-card:hover .work-card-arrow {
  transform: translateX(-6px) !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  ) !important;
  border-color: transparent !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3),
    0 8px 22px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, transparent) !important;
}

/* Work CTA */
.work-cta {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 80% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 90%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 72%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 92%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 24px 56px -20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-cta::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.work-cta-content h2 {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   § 3. WORK DETAIL PAGE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.work-detail-title {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em !important;
}

.work-detail-lead {
  font-size: clamp(16px, 1.3vw, 19px);
  line-height: 1.8;
}

.work-detail-status {
  padding: 6px 14px !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 100%
  ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
}

.work-detail-facts {
  padding: 28px 0;
  border-top-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
  border-bottom-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-detail-facts dt {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
}

.work-detail-facts dt::before {
  content: "";
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  opacity: 0.85;
}

.work-detail-facts dd {
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.work-detail-cover {
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  isolation: isolate;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 92%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 2px 6px -2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 28px 64px -24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 20%, transparent),
    0 64px 140px -48px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 30%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-detail-cover::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.work-detail-section-num {
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-width: 32px;
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 100%
  );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent);
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-weight: 800;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 4px 10px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);
}

.work-detail-section h2 {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
}

.work-detail-list li::before {
  background: var(--accent) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent);
}

.work-detail-metrics {
  padding: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px) !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  border-radius: 24px !important;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 80% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 88%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent),
    0 16px 40px -18px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-detail-metric strong {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 60%, var(--accent-2)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
}

.work-detail-section--quote blockquote {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 4px 24px 24px 4px !important;
  border-inline-start: 4px solid var(--accent) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-detail-tech-chip {
  padding: 8px 16px !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 62%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03) !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.work-detail-tech-chip:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 8px 20px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-detail-cta {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  overflow: hidden;
  isolation: isolate;

  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 80% at 50% 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 60%
    ),
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 90%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 72%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 92%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 20%, transparent),
    0 24px 56px -20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 32%, transparent) !important;
}

.work-detail-cta::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

.work-detail-related-title {
  position: relative;
  padding-bottom: 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent);
  font-weight: 800 !important;
}

.work-detail-related-title::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -1px;
  inset-inline-start: 0;
  width: 60px;
  height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   § 4. PROJECT VIEWER MODAL
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.project-modal {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper) 78%, transparent);
  backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.6);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(1.6);
}

.project-modal-shell {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 94%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 98%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent),
    inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    inset -1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 0 0 0.5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent),
    0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 10%, transparent),
    0 32px 72px -24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 24%, transparent),
    0 80px 160px -48px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 32%, transparent) !important;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .project-modal-shell {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 98%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 94%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
    0 0 0 0.5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
    0 4px 12px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
    0 32px 72px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65),
    0 80px 160px -48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) !important;
}

.project-modal-shell::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent) 30%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 3%, transparent) 70%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 10;
}

.project-modal-nav {
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 90%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 70%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4);
}

.project-modal-nav-counter {
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  color: var(--ink) !important;
}

.project-modal-nav-btn {
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    background 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.project-modal-nav-btn:hover:not([disabled]) {
  transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.06) !important;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    var(--accent-2) 100%
  ) !important;
  border-color: transparent !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35),
    0 6px 18px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) !important;
}

.project-modal-nav-btn:active:not([disabled]) {
  transform: scale(0.94) !important;
}

.project-modal-nav-demo {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 100%
  ) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2),
    0 1px 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.3),
    0 8px 22px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) !important;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.project-modal-nav-demo:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5),
    0 12px 30px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 68%, transparent) !important;
}

/* Metrics overlay */
.project-modal-metric {
  padding: 16px 18px !important;
  background: rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.72) !important;
  backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.8) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.8) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15),
    0 8px 24px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
    0 0 0 0.5px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.2) !important;
  border-radius: 18px !important;
}

.project-modal-metric strong {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

/* Modal content */
.project-modal-body {
  position: relative;
}

.project-modal-body h2 {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    var(--ink) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 78%, var(--accent)) 100%
  );
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  color: transparent;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em !important;
}

.project-modal-subtitle {
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper-2) 60%, transparent);
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 5%, transparent);
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent);
  align-self: flex-start;
  display: inline-flex;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Case study sections */
.case-study-section::before {
  background: linear-gradient(
    180deg,
    var(--accent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent) 100%
  ) !important;
  width: 3px !important;
}

.case-study-num {
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 16%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 100%
  ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 28%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 40%, transparent),
    0 3px 10px -3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
}

.case-study-heading {
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.case-study-list li::before {
  background: var(--accent) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 15%, transparent) !important;
}

.case-study-list--highlight li::before {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 18%, transparent),
    0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) !important;
}

.case-study-section--quote blockquote {
  position: relative;
  padding: 22px 26px !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  border-inline-end: 4px solid var(--accent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 45%, transparent),
    0 12px 32px -16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent) !important;
  font-size: 1rem !important;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.project-modal-tech-chip {
  padding: 8px 16px !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 62%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 6%, transparent) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03) !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.project-modal-tech-chip:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, transparent) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      135deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 5%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 55%, transparent),
    0 8px 20px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, transparent) !important;
}

.project-modal-actions .button-primary {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #2ec4c4 0%,
    #0a5c60 40%,
    #0d7377 70%,
    #0a5c60 100%
  ) !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42),
    inset 0 -1.5px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22),
    0 1px 2px rgba(13, 115, 119, 0.3),
    0 10px 26px -8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent) !important;
  transition:
    transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.project-modal-actions .button-primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5),
    0 14px 34px -10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 68%, transparent) !important;
}

.project-modal-share {
  border-width: 1.5px !important;
  transition:
    transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1),
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) !important;
}

.project-modal-share:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) !important;
  border-color: var(--accent) !important;
  color: var(--accent) !important;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   § 5. ORDER PAGE — final polish layer
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.order-page .order-header .order-back {
  padding: 10px 18px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 82%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 65%, transparent) 100%
    );
  border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 8%, transparent);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 60%, transparent),
    0 1px 2px rgba(10, 9, 8, 0.03);
  transition:
    transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    border-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    background 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.order-page .order-header .order-back:hover {
  transform: translateX(-4px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 40%, transparent);
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 8%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 4%, transparent) 100%
    );
  color: var(--accent);
}

.order-page .order-success {
  border-radius: 28px !important;
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  isolation: isolate;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.order-page .order-success::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: -1px;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    155deg,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent) 0%,
    transparent 40%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent) 100%
  );
  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   § 6. 404 PAGE
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
.not-found-page {
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

.not-found-page::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 40%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 80vw;
  height: 80vw;
  max-width: 900px;
  max-height: 900px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(
    circle,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent) 0%,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 3%, transparent) 30%,
    transparent 62%
  );
  filter: blur(80px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: -1;
}

.not-found-content {
  border: 1px solid transparent !important;
  background-clip: padding-box !important;
  isolation: isolate;

  background:
    linear-gradient(
      180deg,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 88%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 70%, transparent) 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 84%, transparent) 100%
    ) !important;

  box-shadow:
    inset 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 96%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 4%, transparent),
    inset 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #fff 50%, transparent),

  -webkit-mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0);
  mask:
    linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,

  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   § 7. REDUCED MOTION
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .work-card,
  .work-card-visual img,
  .work-card-arrow,
  .work-detail-cover,
  .work-detail-metrics,
  .work-detail-tech-chip,

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   § 8. MOBILE — kill hover
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 900px), (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {
  .work-card:hover,
  .work-card:hover .work-card-visual img,
  .work-detail-tech-chip:hover,

    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.4) !important;
  }
}
```

```ts
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import matter from "gray-matter";

const postsDirectory = path.join(process.cwd(), "src/content/blog");

export type BlogPost = {
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  excerpt: string;
  date: string;
  dateFormatted: string;
  readingTime: number;
  tags: string[];
  category: string;
  featured: boolean;
  content?: string;
  toc?: TOCItem[];
};

export type TOCItem = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  level: number;
};

/* ─── Get all posts ─── */
export function getAllPosts(): BlogPost[] {
  if (!fs.existsSync(postsDirectory)) return [];

  const fileNames = fs.readdirSync(postsDirectory);

  return fileNames
    .filter((f) => f.endsWith(".md"))
    .map((fileName) => {
      const slug = fileName.replace(/\.md$/, "");
      const fullPath = path.join(postsDirectory, fileName);
      const fileContents = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, "utf8");
      const { data, content } = matter(fileContents);

      const wordCount = content.split(/\s+/).length;
      const readingTime = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wordCount / 200));

      return {
        slug,
        title: data.title || slug,
        excerpt: data.excerpt || "",
        date: data.date || "",
        dateFormatted: formatDate(data.date),
        readingTime,
        tags: data.tags || [],
        category: data.category || "عمومی",
        featured: data.featured || false,
      };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? 1 : -1));
}

/* ─── Get single post ─── */
export function getPostBySlug(slug: string): BlogPost | null {
  const fullPath = path.join(postsDirectory, `${slug}.md`);
  if (!fs.existsSync(fullPath)) return null;

  const fileContents = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, "utf8");
  const { data, content } = matter(fileContents);

  const wordCount = content.split(/\s+/).length;
  const readingTime = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wordCount / 200));
  const toc = extractTOC(content);

  return {
    slug,
    title: data.title || slug,
    excerpt: data.excerpt || "",
    date: data.date || "",
    dateFormatted: formatDate(data.date),
    readingTime,
    tags: data.tags || [],
    category: data.category || "عمومی",
    featured: data.featured || false,
    content,
    toc,
  };
}

/* ─── Get all unique tags ─── */
export function getAllTags(): { tag: string; count: number }[] {
  const allPosts = getAllPosts();
  const tagMap = new Map<string, number>();

  allPosts.forEach((post) => {
    post.tags.forEach((tag) => {
      tagMap.set(tag, (tagMap.get(tag) || 0) + 1);
    });
  });

  return Array.from(tagMap.entries())
    .map(([tag, count]) => ({ tag, count }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
}

/* ─── Get related posts ─── */
export function getRelatedPosts(
  currentSlug: string,
  currentTags: string[],
  limit: number = 3
): BlogPost[] {
  const allPosts = getAllPosts().filter((p) => p.slug !== currentSlug);

  return allPosts
    .map((post) => ({
      ...post,
      score: post.tags.filter((tag) => currentTags.includes(tag)).length,
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)
    .slice(0, limit);
}

/* ─── Extract TOC ─── */
function extractTOC(content: string): TOCItem[] {
  const headings: TOCItem[] = [];
  const lines = content.split("\n");

  lines.forEach((line) => {
    const match = line.match(/^(#{2,3})\s+(.+)$/);
    if (match) {
      const level = match[1].length;
      const title = match[2].trim();
      const id = title
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^\w\u0600-\u06FF\s-]/g, "")
        .replace(/\s+/g, "-");
      headings.push({ id, title, level });
    }
  });

  return headings;
}

/* ─── Format date ─── */
function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
  if (!dateStr) return "";
  try {
    const date = new Date(dateStr);
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("fa-IR", {
      year: "numeric",
      month: "long",
      day: "numeric",
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}
/* ─── Get latest N posts (for homepage) ─── */
export function getLatestPosts(limit: number = 3): BlogPost[] {
  const allPosts = getAllPosts();
  return allPosts.slice(0, limit);
}
```

```ts
import type { ProjectRequestData } from "@/lib/validation";

const EMAILJS_API = "https://api.emailjs.com/api/v1.0/email/send";

export async function sendProjectRequestEmail(
  data: ProjectRequestData
) {
  const serviceId = process.env.EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID;
  const templateId = process.env.EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const publicKey = process.env.EMAILJS_PUBLIC_KEY;
  const privateKey = process.env.EMAILJS_PRIVATE_KEY;

  if (!serviceId || !templateId || !publicKey) {
    throw new Error("Email configuration is incomplete.");
  }

  if (!privateKey) {
    throw new Error("EmailJS private key is missing.");
  }

  const fullName = [data.firstName, data.lastName]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" ");

  const projectTypes = data.projectTypes.join("، ");

  const templateParams = {
    first_name: data.firstName,
    last_name: data.lastName || "وارد نشده",
    phone: data.phone,
    email: data.email || "وارد نشده",
    business_name: data.personalProject
      ? "پروژه شخصی"
      : data.businessName,
    personal_project: data.personalProject ? "بله" : "خیر",
    project_types: projectTypes,
    description: data.description,
    contact_preference: data.contactPreference,

    full_name: fullName,

    from_name: fullName,
    reply_to: data.email || data.phone,
    subject: `درخواست پروژه جدید — ${fullName}`,
    message: data.description,
  };

  const response = await fetch(EMAILJS_API, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      service_id: serviceId,
      template_id: templateId,
      user_id: publicKey,
      accessToken: privateKey,
      template_params: templateParams,
    }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorText = await response.text();
    throw new Error(
      `EmailJS error (${response.status}): ${errorText}`
    );
  }
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   NEWSLETTER — Notify owner of new subscriber
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   Uses the same EmailJS service. Sends an email to the
   site owner with the new subscriber's email so they can
   add it to their newsletter tool manually.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

export async function sendNewsletterNotification(
  subscriberEmail: string
) {
  const serviceId = process.env.EMAILJS_SERVICE_ID;
  const templateId = process.env.EMAILJS_TEMPLATE_ID;
  const publicKey = process.env.EMAILJS_PUBLIC_KEY;
  const privateKey = process.env.EMAILJS_PRIVATE_KEY;

  if (!serviceId || !templateId || !publicKey || !privateKey) {
    throw new Error("Email configuration is incomplete.");
  }

  const templateParams = {
    first_name: "خبرنامه",
    last_name: "مشترک جدید",
    phone: "—",
    email: subscriberEmail,
    business_name: "—",
    personal_project: "—",
    project_types: "خبرنامه",
    description: `مشترک جدید خبرنامه:\n${subscriberEmail}`,
    contact_preference: "email",

    full_name: "خبرنامه سایت",

    from_name: "خبرنامه سایت",
    reply_to: subscriberEmail,
    subject: `خبرنامه — مشترک جدید: ${subscriberEmail}`,
    message: `ایمیل جدید در خبرنامه:\n\n${subscriberEmail}\n\nلطفاً به لیست خبرنامه اضافه شود.`,
  };

  const response = await fetch(EMAILJS_API, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      service_id: serviceId,
      template_id: templateId,
      user_id: publicKey,
      accessToken: privateKey,
      template_params: templateParams,
    }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorText = await response.text();
    throw new Error(`EmailJS error (${response.status}): ${errorText}`);
  }
}
```

## FILE: src\lib\rate-limit.ts
```ts
type RateLimitEntry = {
  count: number;
  resetAt: number;
};

const requests = new Map<string, RateLimitEntry>();

const WINDOW_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_REQUESTS = 5;

export function checkRateLimit(ip: string) {
  const now = Date.now();
  const existing = requests.get(ip);

  if (!existing || existing.resetAt <= now) {
    requests.set(ip, {
      count: 1,
      resetAt: now + WINDOW_MS,
    });

    return {
      allowed: true,
      retryAfter: Math.ceil(WINDOW_MS / 1000),
    };
  }

  if (existing.count >= MAX_REQUESTS) {
    return {
      allowed: false,
      retryAfter: Math.ceil((existing.resetAt - now) / 1000),
    };
  }

  existing.count += 1;
  requests.set(ip, existing);

  return {
    allowed: true,
    retryAfter: Math.ceil((existing.resetAt - now) / 1000),
  };
}
```
